Bava Kamma 16b:17-17a:11: Gemara may "aliyyay"? amar rabbi elazar: bimulle shebbinchasav.
Vechen hu omer: "vayyishkav chizkiyyahu im avotav, vayyikberuhu bemaale kivre vene david", veamar rabbi elazar: "bemaale" – etzel meullim shebbammishpacha, uman ninhu – david ushelomo.

"Vayyikberuhu vekivrotav asher kara lo beir david, vayyashkivuhu bammishkav asher mille besamim uzenim" – may "besamim uzenim"? rabbi elazar amar: zeyne zeyne. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: besamim shekkol hammeriach bahen ba lide zimma.
"Ki charu shucha lelochdeni, ufachim tamnu leraglay" – rabbi elazar amar: shechashaduhu mizzona. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: shechashaduhu meeshet ish.
Bishlama leman deamar shechashaduhu mizzona – hayeynu dichtiv: "ki shucha amukka zona". ella leman deamar shechashaduhu meeshet ish, may "shucha"? attu eshet ish mi nafka mikkelal zona?

Bishlama leman deamar shechashaduhu meeshet ish – hayeynu dichtiv: "veatta Adonai yadata et kol atzatam alay lammavet". ella leman deamar shechashaduhu mizzona, may "lammavet"? shehishlichuhu liver tit.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "yihyu muchshalim lefanecha, beet appecha ase bahem"? amar yirmeya lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, afillu beshaa sheosin tzedaka – hacheshilem bivne adam sheenan mehugganim, kede shello yekabbelu alehen sachar.
"Vechavod asu lo vemoto" – melammed shehoshivu yeshiva al kivro.
Peligi ba rabbi natan verabbanan, chad amar shelosha,
Vechad amar shiva. veamri la: sheloshim.
Tanu rabbanan: "vechavod asu lo vemoto" – ze chizkiyya melech yehuda, sheyyatzu lefanav sheloshim veshishsha elef chalutze chatef, divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi nechemya: vahalo lifne achav asu ken!
Ella shehinnichu sefer tora al mittato, veamru: kiyyem ze ma shekkatuv baze.
Vehaiddana name avdinan hachi! appoke mappekinan, annoche la mannechinan. veibbaet ema: annoche name mannechinan, "kiyyem" la amrinan.

Amar rabba bar bar chana: hava azelna bahadeh derabbi yochanan lemishal shemata, ki hava ayel levet hakkisse vahava baena minneh milleta, la pashet lan ad demashe yedeh umannach tefillin umevarech, vahadar amar lan: afillu "kiyyem" amrinan; "limmed" la amrinan.
Vehaamar mar: gadol talmud tora, shehattalmud mevi lide maase! la kashya; ha lemigmar, ha leagmore.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, may dichtiv: "ashrechem zore al kol mayim, meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor"? kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim, zoche lenachalat shene shevatim.
Shenneemar: "ashrechem zore" – veen "zeria" ella tzedaka, shenneemar: "ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed"; veen "mayim" ella tora, shenneemar: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim".
Vezoche lenachalat shene shevatim – zoche lechila keyosef, dichtiv: "ben porat yosef, banot tzaada ale shur"; vezoche lenachalat yissashchar, dichtiv: "yissashchar chamor garem".

It deamri: oyvav noflim lefanav keyosef – dichtiv: "bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav afse aretz"; vezoche levina keyissashochar – dichtiv: "umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim, ladaat ma yaase yisrael".
Berakhot 12b:26-13a:3: Gemara tanya, amar lahem ben zoma lachachamim: vechi mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim limot hammashiach! vahalo kevar neemar "hinne yamim baim neum Adonai velo yomru od chay Adonai asher heela et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim ki im chay Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham".
Amru lo: lo shetteaker yetziat mitzrayim mimmekomah, ella shettehe shibud malchuyot ikkar, vitziat mitzrayim tafel lo.
Kayyotze bo atta omer: "lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha",

Lo sheyyeaker "yaakov" mimmekomo, ella "yisrael" ikkar veyaakov" tafel lo. vechen hu omer "al tizkeru rishonot vekadmoniyyot al titbonanu": al tizkeru rishonot" — ze shibud malchuyot, "vekadmoniyyot al titbonanu" — zo yetziat mitzrayim.
"Hinni ose chadasha atta titzmach", tane rav yosef: zo milchemet gog umagog.

Mashal lema haddavar dome — leadam shehaya mehallech badderech ufaga bo zeev venitztzal mimmennu, vehaya mesapper veholech maase zeev. paga bo ari venitztzal mimmennu, vehaya mesapper veholech maase ari. paga bo nachash venitztzal mimmennu, shachach maase shenehem, vehaya mesapper veholech maase nachash. af kach yisrael — tzarot acharonot meshakkechot et harishonot.
Isaiah 42:11-14: Yisu midbar vearav chatzerim teshev kedar yaronnu yoshve sela merosh harim yitzvachu
Yasimu laAdonai kavod utehillato baiyyim yaggidu
Adonai kaggibbor yetze keish milchamot yair kina yaria af-yatzriach al-oyvav yitgabbar {s}
Hechesheti meolam acharish etappak kayyoleda efe eshshom veeshaf yachad
Isaiah 42:15-19: Achariv harim ugevaot vechol-esbam ovish vesamti neharot laiyyim vaagammim ovish
Veholachti ivrim bederech lo yadau bintivot lo-yadu adrichem asim machshach lifnehem laor umaakashshim lemishor elle haddevarim asitim velo azavtim
Nasogu achor yevoshu voshet habbotchim bappasel haomrim lemassecha attem elohenu {p}
Mi ivver ki im-avdi vecheresh kemalachi eshlach mi ivver kimshullam veivver keeved Adonai
Isaiah 42:20-25: (Raita) [raot] rabbot velo tishmor pakoach oznayim velo yishma

Vehu am-bazuz veshasuy hafeach bachurim kullam uvevatte chelaim hochbau hayu lavaz veen matztzil meshissa veen-omer hashav

Isaiah 43:1-5: Veatta ko-amar Adonai boraacha yaakov veyotzercha yisrael al-tira ki gealticha karati veshimcha li-atta

Ki ani Adonai elohecha kedosh yisrael moshiecha natatti chofrecha mitzrayim kush useva tachtecha

Al-tira ki ittecha-ani mimmizrach avi zarecha umimmaarav akabbetzekka
Mishnah Berakhot 1:1-4: Meematay korin et shema bearvit. mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan, ad sof haashmura harishona, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ad chatzot. rabban gamliel omer, ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. maase shebbau vanav mibbet hammishte, amru lo, lo karinu et shema. amar lahem, im lo ala ammud hashshachar, chayyavin attem likrot. velo zo bilvad, ella kol ma sheamru chachamim ad chatzot, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. hekter chalavim veevarim, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vechol hanneechalim leyom echad, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. im ken, lamma amru chachamim ad chatzot, kede leharechik et haadam min haavera:

Meematay korin et shema beshacharit. mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan. rabbi eliezer omer, ben techelet lecharti. vegomrah ad hanetz hachamma. rabbi yehoshua omer, ad shalosh shaot, shekken derech bene melachim laamod beshalosh shaot. hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid, keadam hakkore vattora:

Bet shammay omrim, baerev kol adam yattu veyikreu, uvabboker yaamdu, shenneemar (Devarim 6) uveshachbecha uvekumecha. uvet hillel omrim, kol adam kore chedarko, shenneemar (sham) uvelechtecha vadderech. im ken, lamma neemar uveshachbecha uvekumecha, beshaa shebbene adam shochvim, uveshaa shebbene adam omdim. amar rabbi tarfon, ani hayiti va vadderech, vehitteti likrot, kedivre vet shammay, vesikkanti veatzmi mippene hallistim. amru lo, keday hayita lachuv beatzmecha, sheavarta al divre vet hillel:

Bashshachar mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha, uvaerev shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha. achat arukka veachat ketzara. makom sheamru lehaarich, eno rashshay lekatztzer. lekatztzer, eno rashshay lehaarich. lachtom, eno rashshay shello lachtom. veshello lachtom, eno rashshay lachtom:
Mishnah Berakhot 1:5-2:3:
Mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim ballelot. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya, hare ani keven shivim shana, velo zachiti shetteamer yetziat mitzrayim ballelot, ad shedderashah ben zoma, shenneemar (Devarim 16) lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha. yeme chayyecha, hayyamim. kol yeme chayyecha, hallelot. vachachamim omrim, yeme chayyecha, haolam hazze. kol yeme chayyecha, lehavi limot hammashiach:  
Haya kore vattora, vehiggia zeman hammikra, im kivven libbo, yatza. veim lav, lo yatza. bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv, uvaemtza shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, baemtza shoel mippene hayyira, umeshiv mippene hakkavod, bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod, umeshiv shalom lechol adam: 
Ellu hen ben happerakim, ben beracha rishona lishniyya, ben sheniyya lishma, uven shema livhaya im shamoa, ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer, ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv. rabbi yehuda omer, ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv lo yafsik. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, lamma kadma shema livhaya im shamoa, ella chede sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim techilla, veachar kach yekabbel alav ol mitzvot. vehaya im shamoa levayyomer, shevhaya im shamoa noheg bayyom uvallayla, vayyomer eno noheg ella bayyom: 
Hakkore et shema velo hishmia leazno, yatza. rabbi yose omer, lo yatza. kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha, rabbi yose omer yatza, rabbi yehuda omer lo yatza. hakkore lemafrea, lo yatza. kara vetaa, yachazor lemakom shettaa:
Mishnah Berakhot 2:4-7:
Haummanin korin berosh hailan o verosh hannidbach, ma sheenan rashshain laasot ken battefilla: 
Chatan patur mikkeriat shema ballayla harishon ad motzae shabbat, im lo asa maase. maase berabban gamliel shekkara vallayla harishon shennasa. amru lo talmidav, lo limmadtanu, rabbenu, shechatan patur mikkeriat shema ballayla harishon. amar lahem, eni shomea lachem levattel mimmenni malchut shamayim afillu shaa echat: 
Rachatz layla harishon shemmeta ishto. amru lo talmidav, lo limmadtanu, rabbenu, sheavel asur lirchotz. amar lahem, eni chishar kol adam, istenis ani: 
Ucheshemmet tavi avdo, kibbel alav tanchumin. amru lo talmidav, lo limmadtanu rabbenu, sheen mekabbelin tanchumin al haavadim. amar lahem, en tavi avdi kishar kol haavadim, kasher haya:
Mishnah Berakhot 2:8-3:4:
Chatan im ratza likrot keriat shema layla harishon, kore. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol harotze littol et hashshem yittol: 
Mi shemmeto mutal lefanav, patur mikkeriat shema, min hattefilla umin hattefillin. nose hammitta vechillufehen vechillufe chillufehen, et shellifne hammitta veet shelleachar hammitta, et shellammitta tzorech bahen peturim, veet sheen lammitta tzorech bahen chayyavin. ellu vaellu peturim min hattefilla: 
Kavru et hammet vechazru, im yecholin lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggiu lashshura, yatchilu. veim lav, lo yatchilu. haomdim bashshura, happenimim peturim, vehachitzonim chayyavin: 
Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin mikkeriat shema umin hattefillin, vechayyavin bitfilla uvimzuza, uvevirkat hammazon: 
Baal keri mehareher belibbo veeno mevarech, lo lefaneha velo leachareha. veal hammazon mevarech leacharav, veeno mevarech lefanav. rabbi yehuda omer, mevarech lifnehem uleacharehem:
Mishnah Berakhot 3:5-4:2: Haya omed battefilla, venizkar shehu vaal keri, lo yafsik, ella yekatztzer. yarad litbol, im yachol laalot ulehitkassot velikrot ad shello tanetz hachamma, yaale veyitkasse veyikra. veim lav, yitkasse vammayim veyikra. aval lo yitkasse, lo vammayim haraim velo veme hammishra, ad sheyyattil letochan mayim. vechamma yarchik mehem umin hatztzoa, arba ammot:
Zav sheraa keri, venidda sheppalta shichvat zera, vehameshammeshet sheraata nidda, tzerichin tevila, verabbi yehuda poter:

Tefillat hashshachar, ad chatzot. rabbi yehuda omer, ad arba shaot. tefillat hammincha ad haerev. rabbi yehuda omer, ad pelag hammincha. tefillat haerev en lah keva. veshel musafin kol hayyom. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheva shaot:

Rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya mitpallel bichnisato levet hammidrash uvitziato tefilla ketzara. amru lo, ma makom litfilla zo. amar lahem, bichnisati ani mitpallel shello teera takala al yadi, uvitziati ani noten hodaya al chelki:
Mishnah Berakhot 4:3-6: Rabban gamliel omer, bechol yom mitpallel adam shemone esre. rabbi yehoshua omer, meen shemone esre. rabbi akiva omer, im shegura tefillato befiv, yitpallel shemone esre. veim lav, meen shemone esre:

Rabbi eliezer omer, haose tefillato keva, en tefillato tachanunim. rabbi yehoshua omer, hamehallech bimkom sakkana, mitpallel tefilla ketzara. omer, hosha hashshem et ammecha et sheerit yisrael, bechol parashat haibbur yihyu tzarchehem lefanecha. baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:
Haya rochev al hachamor, yered. veim eno yachol lered, yachazir et panav, veim eno yachol lehachazir et panav, yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim:
Haya yoshev bisfina o vekaron o veasda, yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim:
Mishnah Chullin 1:2-5:
Hashshochet bemaggal yad, betzor, uvekane, shechitato cheshera. hakkol shochatin uleolam shochatin, uvakkol shochatin, chutz mimmaggal katzir, vehammegera, vehashshinnayim, vehatztzipporen, mippene shehen chonkin. hashshochet bemaggal katzir bederech halichatah, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. veim hecheliku shinneha, hare hi chesakkin: 
Hashshochet mittoch hattabbaat veshiyyer bah melo hachut al pene chullah, shechitato cheshera. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, melo hachut al pene rubbah: 
Hashshochet min hatztzedadin shechitato cheshera. hammolek min hatztzedadin, melikato fesula. hashshochet min haoref, shechitato fesula. hammolek min haoref, melikato cheshera. hashshochet min hatztzavvar, shechitato cheshera. hammolek min hatztzavvar, melikato fesula, shekkol haoref kasher limlika, vechol hatztzavvar kasher lishchita. nimtza, kasher bishchita, pasul bimlika. kasher bimlika, pasul bishchita: 
Kasher battorin, pasul bivne yona. kasher bivne yona, pasul battorin. techillat hatztzihuv, baze uvaze pasul:
Mishnah Chullin 1:6-2:3:
Kasher bappara, pasul baegla. kasher baegla, pasul bappara. kasher bakkohanim, pasul balviyyim. kasher balviyyim, pasul bakkohanim. tahor bichle cheres, tame vechol hakkelim. tahor bechol hakkelim, tame vichle chares. tahor bichle etz, tame vichle mattachot. tahor bichle mattachot, tame vichle etz. hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim, patur bammetukim. hachayyav bammetukim, patur bammarim: 
Hattemed, ad shello hechemitz, eno nikkach bechesef maaser, ufosel et hammikve. mishshehechemitz, nikkach bechesef maaser veeno fosel et hammikve. haachin hashshuttafin, keshechayyavin bakkalbon, peturin mimmasar behema. keshechayyavin bemasar behema, peturin min hakkalbon. kol makom sheyyesh mecher, en kenas. vechol makom sheyyesh kenas, en macher. kol makom sheyyesh meun, en chalitza. vechol makom sheyyesh chalitza, en meun. kol makom sheyyesh tekia, en havedala. vechol makom sheyyesh havedala, en tekia. yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, tokin velo mavdilin. bemotzae shabbat, mavdilin velo tokin. ketzad mavdilin, hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh. rabbi dosa omer, ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal: 
Hashshochet echad baof, ushenayim babbehema, shechitato cheshera. verubbo shel echad, kamohu. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyishchot et havveridin. chatzi echad baof, veechad vachetzi babbehema, shechitato fesula. rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema, shechitato cheshera: 
Hashshochet shene rashin keechad, shechitato cheshera. shenayim ochazin bassakkin veshochatin, afillu echad lemala veechad lematta, shechitatan keshera: 
Hittiz et harosh bevat achat, pesula. haya shochet vehittiz et harosh bevat achat, im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar, keshera. haya shochet vehittiz shene rashim bevat achat, im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar echad, keshera. bamme devarim amurim. bizman sheholich velo hevi, o hevi velo holich. aval im holich vehevi, afillu chol shehu, afillu veizmel, keshera. nafla sakkin veshachata, af al pi sheshshachata chedarkah, pesula, shenneemar (Devarim 12), vezavachta veachalta, ma sheatta zoveach, atta ochel. nafla hassakkin vehigbihah, naflu chelav vehigbihan, hishchiz et hassakkin veaf, uva chavero veshachat, im shaha chede shechita, pesula. rabbi shimon omer, im shaha chede vikkur:
Mishnah Chullin 2:4-7:
Shachat et havveshet ufasak et haggargeret, o shachat et haggargeret ufasak et havveshet, o sheshshachat achad mehen vehimtin lah ad shemmeta, o shehechelid et hassakkin tachat hashsheni ufesako, rabbi yeshevav omer, nevela. rabbi akiva omer, terefa. kelal amar rabbi yeshevav mishshum rabbi yehoshua, kol shennifsela vishchitatah, nevela. kol sheshshechitatah karauy vedavar acher garam lah lippasel, terefa. vehoda lo rabbi akiva: 
Hashshochet behema chayya veof velo yatza mehen dam, kesherim, veneechalim beyadayim mesoavot, lefi shello huchsheru vedam. rabbi shimon omer, huchsheru vashshechita: 
Hashshochet et hamesukkenet, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad shettefarkes bayyad uvaragel. rabbi eliezer omer, dayyah im zinneka. amar rabbi shimon, af hashshochet ballayla ulemachar hishkim umatza chetalim meleim dam, keshera, shezzinneka, uchemiddat rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ad shettefarkes o vayyad o varegel o ad shettechashkesh biznavah, echad behema dakka veechad behema gassa. behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechezira, pesula, sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh bilvad. bamme devarim amurim, shehayta vechezkat mesukkenet. aval im hayta vechezkat beria, afillu en bah achad mikkol hassimanim hallalu, keshera: 
Hashshochet lenachri, shechitato cheshera. verabbi eliezer posel. amar rabbi eliezer, afillu shechatah sheyyochal hannachri mechatzar kaved shellah, pesula, shessetam machashevet nachri laavoda zara. amar rabbi yose, kal vachomer haddevarim, uma bimkom shehammachashava foselet, bemukdashin, en hakkol holech ella achar haoved, mekom sheen machashava foselet, bechullin, eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet:
Mishnah Chullin 2:8-3:1:
Hashshochet leshem harim, leshem gevaot, leshem yammim, leshem neharot, leshem midbarot, shechitato fesula. shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshem achad mikkol ellu, veechad leshem davar kasher, shechitato fesula: 
En shochatin lo letoch yammim, velo letoch neharot, velo letoch kelim. aval shochet hu letoch uga shel mayim, uvisfina, al gabbe chelim. en shochatin legumma kol ikkar, aval ose gumma vetoch beto bishvil sheyyikkanes haddam letochah. uvashshuk lo yaase chen, shello yechakke et hamminin: 
Hashshochet leshem ola, leshem zevachim, leshem asham taluy, leshem pesach, leshem toda, shechitato fesula. verabbi shimon machshir. shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshem achad mikkol ellu, veechad leshem davar kasher, shechitato fesula. hashshochet leshem chattat, leshem asham vadday, leshem bechor, leshem maaser, leshem temura, shechitato cheshera. ze hakkelal, kol davar shenniddar venniddav, hashshochet lishmo, asur, vesheeno niddar veniddav, hashshochet lishmo, kasher: 
Ellu terefot babbehema. nekuvat havveshet, ufesukat haggargeret, nikkav kerum shel moach, nikkav hallev levet chalalo, nishbera hashshidra venifsak hachut shellah, nittal hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemennu chelum, harea shennikkeva, o shechasra, rabbi shimon omer, ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot. nikkeva hakkeva, nikkeva hammara, nikkevu haddakkin, hakkeres happenimit shennikkeva, o shennikra rov hachitzona, rabbi yehuda omer, haggedola tefach, vehakketanna berubbah. hameses uvet hakkosot shennikkevu lachutz, nafla min haggag, nishtabberu rov tzaloteha, uderusat hazzeev. rabbi yehuda omer, derusat hazzeev baddakka, uderusat ari baggassa, derusat hannetz baof haddak, uderusat haggas baof haggas. ze hakkelal, kol sheen kamoha chayya, terefa:
Mishnah Chullin 3:2-6:
Veellu chesherot babbehema. nikkeva haggargeret o shennisdeka. ad kamma techsar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad kaissar haitalki. nifchata haggulgolet velo nikkav kerum shel moach, nikkav hallev velo levet chalalo, nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah, nittela hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna chazzayit, hameses uvet hakkosot shennikkevu ze letoch ze, nittal hattechol, nittelu hakkelayot, nittal lechi hattachton, nittal haem shellah, vacharuta vide shamayim. haggeluda, rabbi meir machshir, vachachamim poslin: 
Veellu terefot baof. nekuvat havveshet, pesukat haggargeret, hikkattah chulda al roshah, mekom sheose otah terefa, nikkav hakkurkevan, nikkevu haddakkin, nafla laur venechmeru vene meeha, im yerukkim, pesulin. im adummim, kesherim. derasah, uterafah bakkotel, o sheritztzetzattah behema umefarkeset, veshahata meet leet ushechatah, keshera: 
Veellu chesherot baof. nikkeva haggargeret o shennisdeka, hikkattah chulda al roshah, mekom sheeno ose otah terefa, nikkav hazzefek. rabbi omer, afillu nittal. yatzu vene meeha velo nikkevu, nishtabberu gappeha, nishtabberu ragleha, nimretu chenafeha. rabbi yehuda omer, im nittela hannotza, pesula: 
Achuzat haddam, vehammeushshenet, vehametzunnenet, vesheachla haredufni, vesheachla tzoat tarnegolim, o sheshshatta mayim haraim, keshera. achla sam hammavet o shehikkishah nachash, mutteret mishshum terefa, vaasura mishshum sakkanat nefashot: 
Simane vehema vechayya neemru min hattora, vesimane haof lo neemaru. aval amru chachamim, kol of haddores, tame. kol sheyyesh lo etzba yetera, vezefek, vekurkevano niklaf, tahor. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, kol of hacholek et raglav, tame:
Mishnah Chullin 3:7-4:3:
Uvachagavim, kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim, vearba kenafayim, vekarsullayim, uchenafav chofin et rubbo. rabbi yose omer, ushemo chagav. uvaddagim, kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekaskaset. rabbi yehuda omer, shene kaskassin usenappir echad. veellu hen kaskassin, hakkevuin bo. usenappirin, happoreach bahen: 
Behema hammaksha leled, vehotzi haubbar et yado vehechezirah, muttar baachila. hotzi et rosho, af al pi shehecheziro, hare ze cheyalud. chotech meubbar shebbemeeha, muttar baachila. min hattechol umin hakkelayot, asur baachila. ze hakkelal, davar sheggufah, asur. sheeno gufah, muttar: 
Hamevakkeret hammaksha leled, mechattech evar evar umashlich lakkelavim. yatza rubbo, hare ze yikkaver, veniftera min habbechora: 
Behema shemmet ubbarah betoch meeha vehoshit haroe et yado venaga bo, ben bivhema temea, ben bivhema tehora, tahor. rabbi yose haggelili omer, bitmea, tame, uvithora, tahor. haishsha shemmet veladah betoch meeha ufashta chayya et yadah venaga vo, hachayya temea tumat shiva, vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze havvalad:
Mishnah Yevamot 10:3-7:
Haishsha shehalach baalah uvenah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah, met balech veachar kach met benech, venisset, veachar kach amru lah, chilluf hayu haddevarim, tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer. amru lah, met benech veachar kach met balech, venityabbema, veachar kach amru lah, chilluf hayu haddevarim, tetze, vehavvalad rishon veacharon mamzer. amru lah, met balech, venisset, veachar kach amru lah, kayyam haya umet, tetze, vehavvalad rishon mamzer, vehaacharon eno mamzer. amru lah, met balech, venitkaddesha, veachar kach ba valah, mutteret lachazor lo. af al pi shennatan lah acharon get, lo fesalah min hakkehunna. et zo darash rabbi elazar ben matya, veishsha gerusha meishah (Vayikra 21), velo meish sheeno ishah: 
Mi shehalcha ishto limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lo, meta ishtecha, venasa et achotah, veachar kach bat ishto, mutteret lachazor lo. hu muttar bikrovot sheniyya, usheniyya mutteret bikrovav. veim meta rishona, muttar bashsheniyya. amru lo, meta ishtecha, venasa et achotah, veachar kach amru lo, kayyemet hayta, umeta, havvalad rishon mamzer, vehaacharon eno mamzer. rabbi yose omer, kol shepposel al yede acherim, posel al yede atzmo. vechol sheen posel al yede acherim, eno fosel al yede atzmo: 
Amru lo, meta ishtecha, venasa achotah meaviha, meta, venasa achotah meimmah, meta, venasa achotah meaviha, meta, venasa achotah meimmah, venimtzeu chullan kayyamot, muttar barishona, bashshelishit, uvachamishit, ufotrot tzarotehen, veasur bashsheniyya uvarviit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah. veim ba al hashsheniyya leachar mitat harishona, muttar bashsheniyya uvarviit, ufotrot tzarotehen, veasur bashshelishit uvachamishit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah: 
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad, hu fosel al yede achin, vehaachim poslin al yado, ella shehu fosel techilla, vehaachin poslin techilla vasof. ketzad, ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, pasal al yede achin. bau aleha achin, veasu vah maamar, natnu get o chaltzu, paslu al yado: 
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, veachar kach ba aleha achiv shehu ven tesha shanim veyom echad, pasal al yado. rabbi shimon omer, lo fasal:
Mishnah Yevamot 10:8-11:2:
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, veachar kach ba al tzaratah, pasal al yede atzmo. rabbi shimon omer, lo fasal. ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, umet, choletzet velo mityabbemet. nasa ishsha umet, hare zo fetura: 
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, umishshehigdil nasa ishsha acheret umet, im lo yada et harishona mishshehigdil, harishona choletzet velo mityabbemet, vehashsheniyya o choletzet o mityabbemet. rabbi shimon omer, meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyya. echad shehu ven tesha shanim veyom echad, veechad shehu ven esrim shana shello hevi shete searot: 
Nosin al haanusa veal hamefutta. haones vehamefatte al hannesua, chayyav. nose adam anusat aviv umefuttat aviv, anusat beno umefuttat beno. rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv umefuttat aviv: 
Haggiyyoret shennitgayyeru vaneha immah, lo choltzin velo meyabbemin, afillu horato shel rishon shello vikdushsha veledato vikdushsha, vehashsheni horato veledato vikdushsha. vechen shifcha shennishtachreru vaneha immah:
Mishnah Yevamot 11:3-6:
Chamesh nashim shennitarvu valdotehen, higdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu, arbaa choltzin leachat, veechad meyabbem otah. hu ushelosha choltzim leacheret, veechad meyabbem. nimtzeu arba chalitzot veyibbum lechol achat veechat: 
Haishsha shennitarev veladah bivlad kallatah, higdilu hattaarovot, venasu nashim, umetu, bene hakkalla choltzin velo meyabbemin, shehu sefek eshet achiv sefek eshet achi aviv. uvene hazzekena, o choltzin o meyabbemin, shehu sefek eshet achiv veeshet ben achiv. metu hakkesherim, bene hattaarovot livne hazzekena choltzin velo meyabbemin, shehu sefek eshet achiv veeshet achi aviv, uvene hakkalla, echad choletz veechad meyabbem: 
Kohenet shennitarev veladdah bivlad shifchatah, hare ellu ochlim batteruma, vecholkim chelek echad baggoren, veenan mittammein lemetim, veen nosin nashim, ben kesherot ben pesulot. higdilu hattaarovot, veshichreru ze et ze, nosin nashim reuyot lakkehunna, veenan mittammein lemetim. veim nitmeu, enan sofgin et haarbaim. veenan ochlim batteruma. veim achlu, enan meshallemin keren vachomesh. veenan cholkin al haggoren. umochrin et hatteruma, vehaddamim shellahem. veenan cholkim bekadshe hammikdash, veen notnin lahem kadashim, veen motziin shellahem miyyadam, ufeturin min hazzeroa umin hallechayayim umin hakkeva, uvechoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev, venotnin alav chumre chohanim vechumre yisreelim: 
Mi shello shahata achar bala shelosha chodashim venisset, veyalda, veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon. hayu lah banim min harishon uvanim min hashsheni, choltzin velo meyabbemin. vechen hu lahem, choletz velo meyabbem. hayu lo achim min harishon veachim min hashsheni shello meotah haem, hu choletz umeyabbem, vehem, echad choletz veechad meyabbem:
Mishnah Yevamot 11:7-12:4:
Haya echad yisrael veechad kohen, nose ishsha reuya lechohen, veeno mittamme lemetim, veim nitma, eno sofeg et haarbaim. veeno ochel batteruma, veim achal, eno meshallem keren vachomesh. veeno cholek al haggoren. umocher hatteruma, vehaddamim shello. veeno cholek bekadshe hammikdash, veen notnim lo et hakkadashim, veen motziin et shello miyyado. ufatur min hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva. uvechoro yehe roe ad sheyyistaev. venotnin alav chumre chohanim vechumre yisreelim. hayu shenehem kohanim, hu onen alehem, vehem onnim alav. hu eno mittamme lahem, vehem enan mittammein lo. hu eno yoresh otan, aval hem yorshin oto. ufatur al makkato veal killato shel ze veshel ze, veole vemishmaro shel ze veshel ze, veeno cholek. im hayu shenehem bemishmar echad, notel chelek echad: 
Mitzvat chalitza bishlosha dayyanin, vaafillu shelashtan hedyotot. chaltza veminal, chalitzatah keshera. beanpilin, chalitzatah pesula. besandal sheyyesh lo akev, kasher. vesheen lo akev, pasul. min haarkubba ulematta, chalitzatah keshera. min haarkubba ulemala, chalitzatah pesula: 
Chaltza vesandal sheeno shello, o vesandal shel etz, o veshel semol bayyamin, chalitzatah keshera. chaltza vegadol shehu yachol lahaloch bo, o vekatan shehu chofe et rov raglo, chalitzatah keshera. chaltza vallayla, chalitzatah keshera, verabbi eliezer posel. bassemol, chalitzatah pesula, verabbi eliezer machshir: 
Chaltza verakka, aval lo kara, chalitzatah keshera. kara verakka, aval lo chaltza, chalitzatah pesula. chaltza vekara, aval lo rakka, rabbi eliezer omer, chalitzatah pesula. rabbi akiva omer, chalitzatah keshera. amar rabbi eliezer, kacha yease (Devarim 25), kol davar shehu maase, meakkev. amar lo rabbi akiva, mishsham reaya, kacha yease laish, kol davar shehu maase vaish: 
Hacheresh shennechelatz vehachereshet shechaltza, vehacholetzet lakkatan, chalitzatah pesula. ketanna shechaltza, tachalotz mishshettagdil. veim lo chaltza, chalitzatah pesula:
Mishnah Yevamot 9:1-4:
Yesh muttarot levaalehen vaasurot liyvamehen, muttarot liyvamehen vaasurot levaalehen, muttarot laellu velaellu, vaasurot laellu velaellu. veelu muttarot levaalehen vaasurot liyvamehen, kohen hedyot shennasa et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen gadol, chalal shennasa cheshera veyesh lo ach kasher, yisrael shennasa vat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer, mamzer shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael, muttarot levaalehen vaasurot liyvamehen: 
Veellu muttarot liyvamehen vaasurot levaalehen. kohen gadol shekkiddesh et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen hedyot, kasher shennasa chalala veyesh lo ach chalal, yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach mamzer, mamzer shennasa vat yisrael veyesh lo ach yisrael, muttarot liyvamehen vaasurot levaalehen. asurot laellu velaellu, kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen gadol o chohen hedyot, kasher shennasa chalala veyesh lo ach kasher, yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael, mamzer shennasa vat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer, asurot laellu velaellu. ushear kol hannashim, muttarot levaalehen veliyvamehen: 
Sheniyyot middivre sofrim, sheniyya labbaal velo sheniyya layyavam, asura labbaal umutteret layyavam. sheniyya layyavam velo sheniyya labbaal, asura layyavam umutteret labbaal. sheniyya laze velaze, asura laze velaze. en lah lo chetubba, velo ferot, velo mezonot, velo velaot, vehavvalad kasher, vechofin oto lehotzi. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer, yesh lahen ketubba: 
Bat yisrael meoreset lechohen, meubberet mikkohen, shomeret yavam lechohen, vechen bat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma. bat yisrael meoreset lelevi, meubberet millevi, shomeret yavam lelevi, vechen bat levi leyisrael, lo tochal bammaaser. bat levi meoreset lechohen, meubberet mikkohen, shomeret yavam lechohen, vechen bat kohen lelevi, lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser:
Mishnah Yevamot 9:5-10:2:
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, tochal batteruma. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal batteruma. nisset lelevi, tochal bammaaser. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal bammaaser. nisset leyisrael, lo tochal lo vatteruma, velo vammaaser. met, velah hemennu ven, lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser. met benah miyyisrael, tochal bammaaser. met benah millevi, tochal batteruma. met benah mikkohen, lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser: 
Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma. met velah hemennu ven, lo tochal batteruma. nisset lelevi, tochal bammaaser. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal bammaaser. nisset lechohen, tochal batteruma. met, velah hemennu ven, tochal batteruma. met benah mikkohen, lo tochal batteruma. met benah millevi, lo tochal bammaaser. met benah miyyisrael, chozeret levet aviha. veal zo neemar (Vayikra 22), veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel: 
Haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah, met balech, venisset, veachar kach ba valah, tetze mizze umizze, utzericha get mizze umizze. veen lah ketubba velo ferot velo mezonot velo velaot, lo al ze velo al ze. im natla mizze umizze, tachazir. vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. velo ze vaze mittammein lah, velo ze vaze zakkain lo vimtziatah velo vemaase yadeha, velo vahafarat nedareha. hayta vat yisrael, nifsela min hakkehunna, uvat levi min hammaaser, uvat kohen min hatteruma. veen yorshim shel ze veyorshim shel ze yorshim et ketubbatah. veim metu, achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin. rabbi yose omer, ketubbatah al nichse valah harishon. rabbi elazar omer, harishon zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha. verabbi shimon omer, biatah o chalitzatah meachiv shel rishon poteret tzaratah, veen havvalad mimmennu mamzer. veim nisset shello virshut, mutteret lachazor lo: 
Nisset al pi vet din, tetze, ufetura min hakkarban. lo nisset al pi vet din, tetze, vechayyevet bakkarban. yafe koach bet din, sheppotrah min hakkarban. horuha vet din linnase, vehalcha vekilkela, chayyevet bakkarban, shello hittiruha ella linnase:
Niddah 7b:5-8: Gemara tanya: amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua: atta lo shamata, ani shamati; atta lo shamata ella achat, vaani shamati harebe.

En omrim lemi shello raa et hachodesh "yavo veyaid", ella lemi sheraahu. kol yamav shel rabbi eliezer hayu osin kerabbi yehoshua, leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer hechzir rabbi yehoshua et haddavar leyoshno.
Kerabbi eliezer, bechayyav may tama la? mishshum derabbi eliezer shammuti hu, vesavar: i avdinan kevavteh bachada, avdinan kevavteh beachranyayta.
Umishshum kevodo derabbi eliezer, la matzenan machenan behu. leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer (dematzinu) [dematzenan] machenan behu, hechzir et haddavar leyoshno.
Proverbs 1:1-6: Ladaat chochma umusar lehavin imre vina
Lakachat musar hasekel tzedek umishpat umesharim

Proverbs 1:11-15: Im-yomru lecha ittanu neerva ledam nitzpena lenaki chinnam
Nivlaem kishol chayyim utemimim keyorde vor
Kol-hon yakar nimtza nemalle vattenu shalal

Beni al-telech bederech ittam mena raglecha minnetivatam
Proverbs 1:16-21: Ki raglehem lara yarutzu vimaharu lishpoch-dam
Ki-chinnam mezora harashet beene kol-baal kanaf

Tashuvu letochachti hinne abbia lachem ruchi odia devaray etchem

Shema beni musar avicha veal-tittosh torat immecha
Ki ׀ livyat chen hem leroshecha vaanakim legargerotecha
Shabbat 13a:4-13b:1: Ibbaya lehu: nidda mahu shettishan im baalah hi bevigdah vehu bevigdo? amar rav yosef, ta shema: haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechol, divre bet shammay. bet hillel omrim: lo ole velo neechol. shane hatam delekka deot.

Hachi name mistabbera dehecha deikka deot shane. dekatane sefa: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenayim ochlin al shulchan echad, ze ochel basar veze ochel gevina, veen choshshin. velav ittemar ala amar rav chanin bar amme amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheen makkirin ze et ze, aval makkirin ze et ze — asurim. vehane name, makkirin ze et ze ninhu. hachi hasheta?! hatam deot ikka, shinnuy lekka. hacha ikka deot veikka shinnuy.

Ikka deamri: ta shema, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenayim ochlin al shulchan echad, ze basar veze gevina. veittemar ala, amar rav chanin bar amme amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheen makkirin ze et ze, aval makkirin ze et ze — asur. vehane name, makkirin ze et ze ninhu! hatam, deot ikka shinnuy lekka. hacha, ikka deot veikka shinnuy.
Ta shema: lo yochal hazzav im hazzava mishshum hergel avera. hacha name, deot ikka shinnuy lekka.

Ta shema: "el heharim lo achol veenav lo nasa el gillule bet yisrael veet eshet reehu lo timme veel ishsha nidda lo yikrav". makkish ishsha nidda leeshet reehu: ma eshet reehu hu bevigdo vehi bevigdah — asur, af ishto nidda hu bevigdo vehi bevigdah — asur. shema minna.
Ufeliga derabbi pedat: deamar rabbi pedat lo asra tora ella kureva shel gilluy arayot bilvad, shenneemar: "ish ish el kol sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva".

Ulla ki have ate mibbe rav hava menashshek lehu leachvoteh abbe chadayyhu, veamri la abbe yedayyhu. ufeliga dideh addideh, deamar ulla: afillu shum kureva asur, mishshum "lach lach amri nezira sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".

Tane deve eliyyahu: maase betalmid echad sheshshana harebe, vekara harebe, veshimmesh talmide chachamim harebe, umet bachatzi yamav. vehayta ishto notelet tefillav umechazzartam bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot, veamra lahem: katuv battora "ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha", baali sheshshana harebe vekara harebe

Veshimmesh talmide chachamim harebe, mippene ma met bachatzi yamav? velo haya adam machzirah davar. paam achat nitarachti etzlah vehayta mesicha kol oto meora. veamarti lah: bitti, bime niddutech ma hu etzlech? amra li: chas veshalom, afillu beetzba ketanna lo naga [bi]. bime libbunicha mahu etzlech? achal immi veshata immi veyashan immi bekeruv basar, velo alta dato al davar acher. veamarti lah: baruch hammakom sheharago, shello nasa panim lattora. shehare amra tora: "veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav". ki ata rav dimi, amar: mitta chada havay. bemareva amri: amar rav yitzchak bar yosef, sinar mafsik beno levenah.
Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 1:1: Yitgabber kaari laamod babboker laavodat boro sheyyehe hu meorer hashshachar: <small> hagga: veal kol panim lo yeacher zeman hattefilla shehatztzibbur mitpallelin. </small> <small><small>(tur)</small></small> <small> hagga: </small> <small> shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid hu kelal gadol battora uvemaalot hatztzaddikim asher holchim lifne haelohim, ki en yeshivat haadam utenuotav vaasakav vehu levaddo beveto kishivato utenuotav vaasakav vehu lifne melech gadol, velo dibburo veharechavat piv kirtzono vehu im anshe beto ukerovav kedibburo bemoshav hammelech, kol shekken kesheyyasim haadam el libbo shehammelech haggadol hakkabba asher melo chol haaretz kevodo omed alav veroe bemaasav, kemo shenneemar: im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai, miyyad yaggia elav hayyira vehahachnaa ufachad Adonai yitbarach uvashto mimmennu tamid </small> <small><small>(more nevochim 11 80 22)</small></small> <small> velo yitbayyesh mippene bene adam </small> <small> hammaligim alav baavodat Adonai yitbarach gam behetznea lechet. uveshachbo al mishkavo yeda lifne mi hu shochev, umiyyad kesheyyeor mishshenato yakum </small> <small> bizrizut laavodat boro yitalle veyitromem </small> <small><small>(tur)</small>. </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 206:4-6:
Kol davar shemmevarech alav leachlo o lehariach bo, tzarich leachazo bimino keshehu mevarech. 
En mevarchin, lo al ochel velo al mashke, ad sheyyeviuhu lefanav; berach veachar kach heviuhu lefanav, tzarich levarech paam acheret; aval mi shebberach al perot shellefanav veheviu lo yoter meoto hammin, o mimmin acher shebbirkato kevirkat harishon, eno tzarich levarech. <small> hagga: vetov lizzaher lechattechilla lihyot dato al kol ma sheyyaviu lo </small> <small><small>(bet yosef tur yore dea siman 19)</small>. </small> 
Natal beyado peri leachlo uverach alav, venafal miyyado veneevad o nimas, tzarich lachazor ulevarech af al pi shehaya meoto min lefanav yoter keshebberach al harishon. <small> hagga: rak shello haya </small> <small> alav dato leachlo </small> <small><small>(haggahot maymoni 84 vechol bo veabbudarham uteshuvat maharil 70 92)</small>. </small> vetzarich lomar: baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed al shehotzi shem shamayim levattala; veim amar keshennafal: baruch atta Adonai, velo amar elohenu, yesayyem veyomar: lammedeni chukkecha <small><small>(tehillim kayit, 12)</small>, </small> sheyyehe nire kekore pasuk, veen kan motzi shem shamayim levattala. aval haomed al ammat hammayim mevarech veshote, af al pi shehammayim sheshshote lo hayu lefanav keshebberach, mippene shellechach nitkavven techilla. <small> hagga: vel 70 209 </small> <small><small>(saif 1)</small></small> <small> im berach betaut ma dino. </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 250:1-2:
Yashkim babboker bayom hashshishshi lehachin tzarche shabbat, vaafillu yesh lo kamma avadim leshammesho yishtaddel lehachin beatzmo shum davar letzarche shabbat kede lechabbedo, ki rav chisda haya mechattech hayyerek dak dak; verava verav yosef hayu mevakkein etzim; veraz haya madlik haesh; verav nachman haya metakken habbayit umachnis kelim hatztzerichim leshabbat umefanne kele hachol; umehem yilmad kol adam, velo yomar: lo efgom kevodi, ki ze hu kevodo shemmechabbed hashshabbat. <small> hagga: veyesh lehashechiz </small> <small> hassakkin beerev shabbat, ki zehu mikkevod hashshabbat shemmechin atzmo laachila </small> <small><small>(kol bo uvet yosef beshem sefer chayye olam)</small>. </small> 
Yarbe bevasar veyayin umigdanot kefi yechalto.
Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 307:1: Vedabber davar <small><small>(yeshaya noach, 13)</small>: </small> shello yehe dibburecha shel shabbat kedibburecha shel chol; hilkach asur lomar: davar peloni eese lemachar o sechora pelonit ekne lemachar, vaafillu besichat devarim betelim asur leharebot. <small> hagga: uv shessippur shemuot vedivre chiddushim hu oneg lahem, muttar </small> <small> lesapperam beshabbat kemo bachol; aval mi sheeno mitanneg, asur leamram kede sheyyitanneg bahem chavero </small> <small><small>(405 70 sefer acher)</small>. </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 339:3: En metappechin lehakkot kaf el kaf, velo mesappekin lehakkot kaf al yarech, velo merakkedin, gezera shemma yetakken kele shir. vaafillu lehakkot beetzba al hakkarka, o al halluach, o achat keneged achat kederech hameshorrim, o lekashkesh beegoz letinok, o lesachek bo bezug kede sheyyishtok, kol ze vechayyotze bo asur, gezera shemma yetakken kele shir; ulesappek kilachar yad, muttar. <small> hagga: veha dimsappekin umerakkedin haiddana velo machinan behu mishshum demutav sheyyihyu shoggin vechulei. veyesh omrim devazzeman hazze hakkol share, deen anu bekiin baasiyyat kele shir velekka lemigzar shemma yetakken kele shir demilleta delo shachiach hu veefshar sheal ze nahagu lehakel bakkol </small> <small><small>(tosafot sof perek hammevi kadde yayin)</small>. </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Orach Chayim 61:1: Yikra keriat shema bechavvana, beema uveyira, beretet vazia.
Yevamot 16a:7-10: Hitchilu mesabbevim oto bahalachot, ad shehiggiu letzarat habbat. amaru lo: tzarat habbat mahu? amar lahen: machloket bet shammay uvet hillel. halacha kedivre mi? amar lahen: halacha kevet hillel. amru lo: vahalo mishshimcha amru halacha kevet shammay!
Amar lahem: dosa shematem, o ben harekinas shematem? amaru lo: chayye rabbi, setam shamanu. amar lahem: ach katan yesh li, bechor satan hu, veyonatan shemo, vehu mittalmide shammay.

Vehizzaharu shello yekappeach etchem bahalachot, lefi sheyyesh immo shelosh meot teshuvot betzarat habbat shehi mutteret. aval meid ani alay shamayim vaaretz, sheal medocha zo yashav chaggay hannavi, veamar shelosha devarim: tzarat habbat asura,
Ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit, umekabbelim gerim min hakkardoyin umin hattarmodim.
Zevachim 4a:1-16: Menalan devaenan zevicha lishmah? deamar kera: "veim zevach shelamim korbano" – shettehe zevicha leshem [shelamim].
Middichtiv "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim", "hazzorek et dam hashshelamim" – vela ketiv "zevach"; vehacha ketiv "zevach"; shema minna: shettehe zevicha leshem shelamim.
Vechi tema lelaf mizzevicha; ma lizvicha – shekken nifsela shello leshem ochlin bappesach!
Ella amar kera: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim" – shettehe kabbala leshem shelamim.
Velichtov rachamana bekabbala, velelaf shechita minna!
Mishshum deikka lemifrach – ma lekabbala shekken pesula bezar veishsha.
Vechi tema lelaf mehane – ma lehane shekken teunot tzafon, veyeshnan bechattaot happenimiyyot!
Ella amar kera: "hazzorek et dam hashshelamim" – shettehe zerika leshem shelamim.
Mishshum deikka lemifrach – ma lizrika, shekken chayyayv aleha zar mita.
Vechi tema lelaf mikkullehu; ma lechullehu – shekken avoda shei efshar levattelah; tomar beholacha – sheefshar levattelah?!

Ella amar kera: "vehikriv et hakkol hammizbecha", veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh; vetanya: "vehikrivu" – zo kabbalat haddam; veappek rachamana bilshon holacha – lememra deholacha la tappeka mikkelal kabbala.
Zohar, Addenda, Volume I 39:334: Yashav rabbi berachya vedarash may hay deka amrinan kol yoma haolam habba, velo yadinan may kaamar, haolam habba metargem alma deate melammed shekodem shennivra haolam ala bemachshava livro or gadol lehair venivra or gadol sheen kol birya yechola lishlot bo, tzafa hakkadosh baruch hu sheenan yecholin lesovlo lakach shevii vesam lahem bimkomo vehashear genazo latztzaddikim leatid lavo. amar im yizku baze hashevii veyishmeruhu, etten lahem ze leolam acharon. vehayeynu dichtiv, haolam habba. shekkevar ba mikodem sheshet yeme berishit. hada hu dichtiv, (sham 31) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha paalta lachosim bach neged bene adam:
Zohar, Introduction 11: Bereshit ribbi shimon patach (Yeshayahu 51:16) vaasim devaray beficha. kamma it leh levar nash leishtaddela beorayyta yemama velelya, begin dekudesha berich hu tzayyit lekalhon deinnun demitasseke beorayyta, uvechol milla deitchaddash beorayyta al yeda dehahu deishtaddal beorayta, avid rekia chada.

Tenan behahi shaata demilla deorayyta itchaddeshat mippumeh devar nash, hahi milla salka veitattedat kammeh dekudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu natil lehahi milla venashik lah veattar lah beshivin itrin gelifin umechakkekan. umilla dechachmeta deitchaddesha, salka veyatva al resha detzaddik chay almin. vetasa mittamman veshata beshivin elef almin uselikat legabbe attik yomin. vechol millin deattik yomin millin dechachmeta innun berazin setimin illain.

Vehahi milla setima dechachmeta deitchaddeshat hacha kad salka itchabberat beinnun millin (derazin) deattik yomin vesalka venachta bahadayyhu vealat betamnesar almin genizin (Yeshayahu 64:3) deayin la raata elohim zulatecha. nafke mittamman veshatan veatyayn melean ushelemin veitattadu kamme attik yomin. behahi shaata arach attik yomin behay milla venicha kammeh mikkola. natil lehahi milla veatar lah (Shemot 14) bitlat mea veshivin elef itrin. hahi milla tasat vesalka venachta veitavida rekia chada.

Vechen kol milla umilla dechachmeta (sefer acher ateabedayn) (sefer acher rekiin) kayyaymin bekiyyuma shelim kamme attik yomin. vehu kare lon shamayim chadashim, shamayim mechudashim, setimin derazin dechachmeta illaa. vechol innun shear millin deorayyta demitchaddeshin kayyaymin kamme kudesha berich hu vesalkin veitavidu artzot hachayyim. venachtin umitatterin legabbe eretz chad, veitchaddash veitavid kola eretz chadasha mehahi milla deitchaddash beorayyta.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:22) ki kaasher hashshamayim hachadashim vehaaretz hachadasha asher ani ose omdim lefanay vegomer. asiti la ketiv ella ose, deavid tadir meinnun chiddushin verazin deorayyta. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 51:16) vaasim devaray beficha uvetzel yadi kissiticha lintoa shamayim velisod aretz. hashshamayim la ketiv ella shamayim.

Amar ribbi elazar mahu uvetzel yadi kissiticha. amar leh beshaata deitmasar orayyta lemoshe, atu kamma ribbo demalache illain leokda leh beshalhova defumehon, ad dechafa aleh kudesha berich hu. vehasheta dehay milla salka veitatterat vekayyma kamme kudesha berich hu, ihu chafe al hahi milla vechasse al hahu bar nash dela yishtemoda legabbayyhu ella kudesha berich hu. vela yekanneun legabbeh ad deitavid mehahi milla shamayim chadashim veeretz chadasha hada hu dichtiv uvetzel yadi kissiticha lintoa shamayim velisod aretz. mikkan dechol milla desatim meena salka letoalta illaa hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 51:16) uvetzel yadi kissiticha. veammay itchafe veitkasse meena, begin letoalta illaa. hada hu dichtiv lintoa shamayim velisod aretz kema deittemar.

Velemor letziyyon ammi atta. velemor leinnun tarin umillin dimtzuyaynin illen al illen ammi atta. al tikre (bateykevan 18 daf la b) ammi atta, ella immi atta lemehve shuttafa immi, ma ana bemillula dili avadit shamayim vaaretz kema deat amer, (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasiu, uf hachi at. zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayyta. vei tema demilla dechol bar nash dela yada avid da.

Ta chaze, hahu delav archeh (yitro 87 1) berazin deorayyta vechiddesh millin dela yeda al bureyehon kedka yeut, hahi milla salka venafik legabbe hahi mila (Mishlei 16:28) ish tahpuchot leshon shaker, miggo nukeva dithoma rabba vedalig chamesh mea parse lekabbela lehahi milla venatil lah veazil behahi milla lego nukeveh veavid bah rekia deshav deikre tohu.

Vetas behahu rekia hahu ish tahpuchot shitta alfe parse bezimna chada. kevan dehay rekia deshav kaim nafkat miyyad (pikkude 275) eshet zenunim veatkif behahu rekia deshav (nusach acher hi) (nusach acher veish tahpuchot) veishtattefat beh umittamman nafkat vekatlat kamma alafin verivvavn, begin dechad kayymat behahu rekia it lah reshu vichalta lemeheve tas kol alma beriga chada.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:18) hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashsheva. heavon da dechura. vechaavot haagala chattaa. man chattaa, da nukeva deikre chattaa. ihu mashich hahu deikre avon beinnun chavle hashshav. ulevatar kaavot haagala chattaa, lehahi nukeva deikre chattaa, detamman ittakfat lemehve tas lekatla bene nasha. veal da (Mishlei 7:26) ki rabbim chalalim hippila, man hippila, da hahi chattaa dekatlit bene nesha. man garim da, talmid chacham dela mate lehoraa umore, rachamana lishshezvan.

Amar ribbi shimon lechavraya bematuta minnayycho dela tafkun mippumayychu milla deorayyta dela (yitro 87 1) yedatun vela shematun meilana ravreva kedka yeut, begin dela tehvon garmin lehahu chattaa lekatla uchlosin debar nash lemaggana. patchu kulhon veamru rachamana lishshezvan, rachamana lishshezvan.

Ta chaze, beorayyta bara kudesha berich hu alma, veha ukemuha dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon vaehye shaashuim yom yom veihu istakkal bah zimna uteren utelata vearba zimnin, ulevatar amar lon, ulevatar avid bah avidta. leulefa livne nasha dela yiyiton lemite bah. kema deat amer, (iyyov 28:27-28) az raah vaysapperah hchinah vegam chakarah vayyomer laadam.

Velokovel arba zimnin innun dichtiv, az raah, vaysapperah, hchinah, vegam chakarah, bara kudesha berich hu ma devara. vead la appik avidteh, ail arba tevin bekadmita dichtiv bereshit bara elohim et, ha arba. ulevatar hashshamayim. innun lokovel arba zimnin deistakkal kudesha berich hu beorayta ad la yappik avidteh leumenuteh.
Zohar, Introduction 18: Patach ribbi shimon veamar kol man dechade beinnun moadayya vela yahiv chulakeh lekudesha berich hu, hahu ra ayin satan sone oto veka mekatreg leh vesalik leh mealma vechamma aku al aku mesabbev leh.

Chulakeh dekudesha berich hu, lemechode lemiskene kefum ma deyachil lemebad. begin dekudesha berich hu beyomayyay illen ate lemechome leinnun manin tevirin dileh, veal alayyhu vechame dela it lehon lemechede, uveche alayyhu. salik leela (uvae) lecharba alma.

Atan bene metivta kammeh veamre ribbon alma, rachum vechannun itkeriat yitgalgelun rachamach al benach. amar lon vechi (bene) alma la (yadin dela) avdit leh ella al chesed dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:3) amarti olam chesed yibbane, vealma al da kayyma. amre kammeh malache illae, ribbon alma ha pelanya deachil verave veyachil lemebad tivu im miskeni vela yahiv lon midi. ate hahu mekatrega uteva reshu uredaf avatreh dehahu bar nash.

Man lan bealma gadol meavraham deavad tivu lechol biryayn. beyoma deavad mishteyay, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 21:8) vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal, vayyaas avraham mishte gadol beyom higgamel et yitzchak. avad avraham mishteyay ukera lechol ravreve dara lehahi seudata. vetaninan bechol seudata dechedva, hahu mekatrega azil vechame i hahu bar nash akdim tivu lemiskene, umiskene beveta, hahu mekatrega itperash mehahu beta vela al tamman, vei lav al tamman. vechame irbuveya dechedva bela miskeni uvela tivu deakdim lemiskene, salik leela umekatrega aleh.

Avraham kevan dezammin leravreve dara, nachat mekatrega vekam al pitcha kegavvna demiskena vela hava man deashgach beh. avraham hava meshamesh leinnun malchin veravrevin. shara onikat benin lechullehu, dela havo mehemnin kad ihi olidat ella amru asufi hu umin shuka aytiu leh. begin kach atyayn benayyhu bahadayyhu venatlat lon sara veonikat lon kamayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 21:7) mi millel leavraham henika vanim sara, banim vadday. vehahu mekatrega al pitcha. amra (sara) tzechok asa li elohim. miyyad salik hahu mekatrega kamme kudesha berich hu veamar leh ribbon alma at amart avraham ohavi, (ha avraham) avad seudeta vela yahav lach midi, velav lemiskeni, vela kariv kadamach afillu yona chad. vetu amrat sara dechayychat bah.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu man bealma keavraham. velo zaz mittamman, ad devilbel kol hahi chedva, ufakkid kudesha berich hu lemikrav leyitzchak karbena, veitgezar al sara detamut al tzaara divrah. kol hahu tzaara garim, dela yahiv midi lemiskene.
Zohar, Introduction 19: Patach ribbi shimon veamar may dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el Adonai. ta chaze, kamma hu chela takkifa deorayyta, vechamma hu illaa al kola. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta la dachil meillae umittattae. velo dachil mimmarin bishin dealma. begin deihu achid beilana dechayye veyallif minneh bechol yoma.

Deha orayyta tolif levar nash lemezal beorach keshot. tolif leh eta hech yatuv kamme mareh levatla hahi gezera. deafillu itgezar aleh dela yitbattel hay gezera, miyyad itbattel veistallak minneh vela sharya aleh devar nash behay alma. uvegin kach bae leh levar nash leishtaddela beorayta yemama velele vela yitade minah hada hu dichtiv (yehoshua 1:8) vehagita vo yomam valayla. vei itadde minnah deorayyta o itperash minah keillu itperash meilana dechayye.

Ta chaze, eta levar nash, kad ihu salik belelya al arseh bae lekabbela aleh malchuta dilela belibba shelim uleakdema lemimsar kammeh pikdona denafsheh (Bereshit 19 amud bet) umiyyad ishteziv mikkol marin bishin umikkol ruchin bishin vela shaltin aleh.

Uvetzafra kam mearseh bae levarcha lemareh ulemeal leveteh ulemisgad kamme hechaleh bidchilu saggeya, uvatar ken yitzle tzeloteh veyissav eta meinnun avahan kaddishin dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:8) vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha eshtachave el hechal kadshecha beyiratecha.

Hachi ukemuha la libbae leh levar nash leoola leve kenishta ella i amlich bekadmita beavraham yitzchak veyaakov, begin deinnun tekinu tzelota lekame kudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha, da avraham. eshtachave el hechal kadshecha, da yitzchak. beyiratecha, da yaakov. uvae leachlala lon beresha, uvatar ken yeul leve kenishta vitzalle tzeloteh. keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.
Zohar, Introduction 30: Pikkuda asiraa leanacha tefillin uleashlama garmeh bediyyukena illaa. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo. patach veamar (Shir hashshirim 7:6) roshech alayich kakkarmel hay kera okimna veittemar. aval roshech alayich kakkarmel, da resha illaa tefillin deresha, shema demalka ilaa kaddisha yedovȧ4 beatvavn reshimin, kol at veat parshata chada, shema kaddisha gelifa besiddura deatvavn kedka yeut. utenan (Devarim 28:10) ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka, illen tefillin deresha, deinnun shema kaddisha besiddura deatvoy.

Parsheta kadmaa (Shemot 13:2) kaddesh li chol bechor. da 10 deihi kodesh. buchera dechol kudeshin illain. peter kol rechem, behahu shevil dakkik denachat min yod deihu aftach rachama (rachmah) lemebad perin veibbin kedka yaot. veihu kodesh illaa.

Parsheta tinyayna (Shemot 13) vehaya chi yeviacha. da 5 hechala. deitpattach rachama (rachmah) dilah miggo yod bechamshin pitchin akkesadderain veidderin setimin deveh. dehahu peter deavid yod behay hechala lemishma bah kala di nafka miggo shofar da. begin deshofar da hu satim bechol sitrin, veata yod ufetach leh leappaka minneh kala. vechevan deaftach leh taka leh veappik minneh kala leappaka avdin lecheru.

Uvitkiu deshofara da nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. vechach zammin zimna ochora lesof yomaya. vechol purekana mehay shofar atya. uvegin kach it bah yetziat mitzrayim befarshata da. deha mehay shofar ate bechela deyud defatach rachama dilah veappik kaleh lefurekana deavdin. veda 5 at tinyayna dishma kaddisha.

Parsheta telitaa raza deyichuda (Devarim 6) dishma yisrael. da vav dechalil kolla, uveh yichuda decholla. uveh ityaychadan vehu natil kolla. parsheta reviaa (Devarim 5) vehaya im shamoa, kelilu ditren sitrin deitachadat behu keneset yisrael gevura diltatta. veda 5 batraa denatla lon veitkelelat minnehon.

Utefillin atvavn dishma kaddisha innun mammash. veal da roshech alayich kakkarmel illen tefillin (ba 43 1, vaetchannan 264 1) deresha). (Shir hashshirim 7:6) vedallat roshech hahi tefilla shel yad deihi miskena legabbe ela uf hachi shelimu it lah kegavvna dilela.

(Shir hashshirim 7:6) melech asur barhatim kashir ihu veachid beinnun batte leitachada behahu shema kaddisha kedka yeut. veal da man deittakkan behu ihu havi betzelem elohim. ma elohim ityachada beh shema kaddisha, af hu ityachad beh shema kaddisha kedka yeut. zachar unekeva bara otam. tefillin deresha utefilla shel yad vechola chad.
Zohar, Introduction 34: Pikkuda arbesar lenatra yoma deshabbatta, deihu yoma denayycha mikkol ovade bereshit. hacha kelilan teren pikkudin. chad netira deyom hashshabbat. vechad lekadsha hahu yoma bekiddusheh. lenatra yoma deshabbatta kema deadkarna veatarna alayyhu deihu yoma denayycha lealmin. vechol avidan beh ishtachlelu veitavidu ad deitkaddash yoma.

Kevan deitkaddash yoma ishtaar beria deruchin dela itbere lon gufa. vechi la hava yada kudesha berich hu leakava lekaddesha yoma ad deyitberun gufin lehani ruchin. ela ilana dedaat tov vera atar hahu sitra ochora dera uvaa leittakkefa bealma veitparshu kamma ruchin bechamma zayynin leittakkefa bealma begufin.

Kevan dechama kudesha berich hu kach, atar miggo ilana dechayye neshiva derucha uvatash beilana ochora veatar sitra ochora detov veitkaddash yoma. deha beriu degufin veitaru deruchin besitra detov ihu behay lelya, vela besitra ochora.

Veilmale akdim sitra ochora behay lelya ad dela yakdim sitra detov, la yachil alma lemekam kammayyhu afillu riga chada. aval asvavta akdim kudesha berich hu dedalig kammeh kiddusha deyoma veakdim kamme sitra ochora veitkeyyaym alma. uma dechashiv sitra ochora leitbene bealma leittakkefa, itbene behay lelya sitra detov veittakkaf veitbenun gufin veruchin kaddishin behay lelya missitra detov. uvegin kach onatan dechakkimin deyade da mishshabbat leshabbat.

Deha keden chamat da sitra ochora dechamma deihi chashivat lemebad, avide (avid) sitra dikdusha. azla umeshatteta bechamma chayyaylin vesitrin dilah vechamat kol innun deka meshamshe arsayyhu begilluya degufehon linhora devutzina, vechol innun benin denafkin mittamman havu nichfin desharu alayyhu ruchin mehahu sitra ochora. veinnun ruchin artilain dechayyayvaya deikrun mazzikin veshariat behu lilit uketilat lon.

Kevan deitkaddash yoma veshalta kedusha al alma, hahu sitra ochora azirat garmah veittamrat kol lelya deshabbatta veyoma deshabbatta, bar min asimon vechol kat dileh deazle al sheragge bitmiru lemechome al gilluye deshimmusha, ulevatar ittammerun go nukeva dithoma rabba. kevan denafak shabbatta, kamma chayyaylin umashshiryayn parchin umeshattetin bealma, veal da itkan shir shel pegaim dela yishletun al amma kaddisha.

Lean atar meshattete behahu lelya. kad nafke bivhilu vechashvin leshalletaa bealma al amma kaddisha vechaman lon bitzlota veamrin shirata da, uvesheruta mavdele bitzlota umavdele al hakkos, parche mittamman veazle umeshatte umatan lego madbera. rachamana leshezvan minnayyhu umisitran (umissitra) bisha.

Amru rabbotenu zichrono livracha telata innun garmin bisha legarmayyhu. chad man delayyit garmeh. tinyayna man dezarak nahama o perurin deit behu kazzayit. telitaa man deokid sheragga bemifka deshabbatta ad la matu yisrael lekiddusha desidra degarim lenura degehinnom leadlaka behay nura ad la mata zimnayyhu.

Dechad ducheta it baggihinnam leinnun deka mechallele shabbatot, veinnun daanushin bagehinnom layytin leh lehahu deokid sheragga ad la mata zimneh, veamri leh (Yeshayahu 22:17) hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver vegomer (Yeshayahu 22:18) tzanof yitznafcha tzenefa kaddur el eretz rachavat yadayim.

Begin delav yaot hu leadlaka nura kad nafik shabbatta ad demavdele yisrael bitzlota umavdele al kassa. begin dead hahu zimna shabbat hu, ukedusha deshabbat shalit alana. uveshaata demavdilin al kassa kol innun chayyaylin vechol innun mashshiryayn deitmenan al yome dechol, kol chad vechad yativ leatreh ufulechaneh deitmene aleh.

Begin dechad al shabbatta veitkaddash yoma, kodesh itar veshallit bealma, vechol itadde mishshuletanuta dileh, ad shaata denafik shabbatta la tayyvin leatrayyhu. veaf al gav denafik shabbatta la tayyvin leatrayyhu ad zimna deamre yisrael baruch atta Adonai hammavdil ben kodesh lechol. keden kodesh istallak, umashshiryayn deitmaniu al yome dechol mitarin vetayyvin leatrayyhu kol chad vechad al matreh deitpekad aleh.

Veim kol da la shaltin ad dihon nehorin meraza dishraga. vechulhon ikrun meore haesh begin (damenahevarea denura denagda) (nusach acher damerazea deammuda denura) umisoda denura atyan kulhu veshaltin al alma tattaa. vechol da kad bar nash adlik sheragga ad la shelimu yisrael kiddusha desidra.

Aval i ihu mamtin ad deyashlimu kiddusha desidra, innun chayyayvin degehinnom matzdikin alayyhu dina dekudesha berich hu, veinnun mekayyeyme al hahu bar nash kol birchan deka amre tzibbura (Bereshit 27:28) veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim (Devarim 28:3) baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade vegomer. (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemaltehu Adonai. beyom ra mibbae leh, may beyom raa. yoma deshalta hahi raa lemesav nishmeteh.

Ashre maskil el dal da hu shechiv mera leassaa leh mechovoy gabbe kudesha berich hu. davar achar da yoma dedina sharya al alma ishteziv minneh kema deittemar beyom raa yemaltehu Adonai. yoma deitmasar dina lehahu raa leshaltaa al alma (chaser):

rashi: Natatti chafrecha mitzrayim. vehem hayu lecha lefidyon, shebbechorehem metu veatta, beni bechori, nitztzalta, vihyitem chayyavim kelaya, kemo shenneemar (Yechezkel 20:8) "vaomar lishpoch chamati alehem beeretz mitzrayim":
targum: Are ana Adonai elahach kadisha deyisrael parkach yehavet chalifach mitzrae kush useva techotach:

rashi: Asher natatta immadi. kan kafar battova (avoda zara 5):
ohc: Vayyomer haadam haishsha vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma maane bilshono bitshuvat "haishsha" vegomer, afillu kal shebbakkallim lo yashiv teshuva kazo, umikkol shekken lemelech gadol. veod amro min haetz shello haya tzarich lomar ella "hi natna li vaochel", umuvan haddavar sheal haetz hammuzkar hiv omer, vechen matzinu sheamra chavva bitshuvatah "hannachash hishshiani vaochel" velo hutzrecha lomar "min haetz".

Venire shekkavvanat haadam hi shello yada davar, ki im haishsha hevia lefanav hammezumman veachal, veeno chayyav lishol al hammuggash lefanav, davar ze minnayin, ki halo kol haaretz lefanav hi melea maadannim asher nata Adonai. vedikdek lomar asher natatta immadi shello lechayyevo lechappes uledakdek achareha ladaat hammuva lefanav, kevan shehaishsha hallaz netanah Adonai immo leezer ulehoil, veen ra yored mehashshamayim veen lo livdok achareha ki min hassetam maaseha naim. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (kiddushin 76:) en bodkin min hammizbeach ulemala vechulei, ad kan. hare dechol shehuchzak bemakom kadosh chezkat kashrut shelema alav, umikkol shekken ishsha gedola kazo asher bara lo Adonai leezer, eno tzarich lechappes achareha ma notenet lefanav.

Veamro min haetz perush: min haetz hannatua baggan, ki chullah melea nite Adonai (Bereshit 2:8-9). viduyyak amro min haetz, ki lo al haetz hammuzkar bedivre Adonai hiv omer, ella al etz meatze haggan. velichshennomar deal etz haddaat hiv omer, en hakkavvana shehu yada shemmimmennu hevia lo veachal, ella achar sheachal yada ki mimmennu achal meemtzaut hakkarato beharegashato hahishtannut, uleolam bishat maase lo yada davar velo shaal, letzad bitchono baishsha shennatan Adonai immo, vehu shettaan beamro "asher natatta immadi" vegomer. od efshar lomar sheggam haadam taa ki lo asar Adonai ella happeri velo haetz, vehu amro min haetz, veen ze perush nachon mikkamma teamim verishon ikkar.

Umeatta en beyad adam avon ella shogeg, veefshar sheddin ones yesh lo, ki lo haya lo makom lomar lo haya lecha latet lev leval techeta, velo chashad baishsha shettaachilehu devar issur kevan shennittena lo meel elyon. velaze timtza shello killel Adonai laadam ella laadama. haemet ki shigyono hiv shello nishmar bedabbero lechavva velo hizkir lah ella happeri, kannishma middevareha lannachash, shemmizze nimshach hachet lechavva, uchemo shepperashnu (Bereshit 3:3).

rashi: Veetten adam tachtecha. tamid ani ragil bechach:
targum: Midat chaviv kodamay ityekarta vaana rechimtach umesaret ammaya techotach umalkevata chalaf nafshach:

ohc: Vayyomer Adonai el kayin vegomer. kashe amro lamma chara vegomer, hahetev yechere lo al hafelagat shifluto beerech achiv hakkatan vayyippelu fanav, uvamme mesir bashto beamro halo im tetiv, ze hu tikkun lehabba velo lesheavar. od tzarich ladaat amro lappetach chattat rovetz en lo mashmaut, vechol haamur bainyan tzarich perush.

Achen kavvanat devar Adonai hu techillat devarav, hodio ki hishgiach Adonai biv haregashot asher avaruhu, veal kol achat hu omer "lamma" lechol happerushim shepperashnu bacharon appo unefilat panav. venatan lo taam haddavar visodo ladaat daat elyon vesodo, vehu amro halo im tetiv, perush: im tihye mibbechinat hattov, kol maasecha shora alehem bechinat hattov umeatzman hem mitnasseim, ki hakkedushsha enah tzericha laacherim. vetze ulemad (bava metzia pe:) mimmaase kiso shel rabbi chiyyay shehaya ole meatzmo lemala, vehu amro seet, perush: meatzmo. vetitparesh seet al hammincha gam al kayin atzmo shello yippelu fanav shehu tzelem hannaot, ella tihye maalato nissaa vehi bechinat hattov shehi bechinat harommut vehaggedulla, vehem keneged 2 bechinot haamurim bainyan "vayyisha Adonai el hevel veel minchato" shehem 2 devarim. veim lo tetiv, perush: keshettishlol bedatecha bechinat hattov, lappetach perush: lehatechalatcha chashuv ra, hinne bechinat hara shennikret chattat rovetzet alecha gam al kol maasecha vesholelet mimmecha hannesiut umoshelet bemaasecha. umeatta ma makom lacharon appecha kevan sheatta sibba laddavar?

Veamro veelecha teshukato, kan ramaz ki yetzer hara yesh betivo bechinat hatteshuka lehachati haadam, keteva shebbaadam lehitauot taava velachshok zahav. veamro veatta timshal bo, kan hodia ki hagam ki hu beseder ze, yeshno beyado limshol bo, umeatta lamma yippelu fanecha achar shebbeyadcha haddavar limshol bo uleharim hammichshol shehu hachattat.

Od yechavven lomar al ze hadderech: veim lo tetiv lappetach – shehu shaar kabbalat hammenachot vehatteshurot, sham rovetz hachattat leval yihye makom laalot hatteshura, veen tzarich lomar sheen bah koach lehinnasot. veim tomar atta haadon shallit tekabbel hammincha velo yihye monea hachattat, laze amar hen emet im taase teshuva yesh makom letaana zo, aval kevan sheencha choshev bitshuva karamuz betevat "lo tetiv" sheodcha mitavve vechoshek livchinat hara, vehu amro veelecha teshukato, veatta chafetz limshol bo ulegaresh oto leval yirbotz lefitchacha. vahagam ki Adonai yirtze lehaferido mealecha, aval tzarich sheatta tarchikehu mitteshukatcha, ki chol od sheadam choshek bivchinat hara hu mamshilo alav, keamro (tehillim 81:10): "lo yihye vecha el zar". ucheshehaadam moes bidvarav uvaatzato zo hi hashepalato, vehu amro (Mishlei 16:32): "umoshel berucho milloched ir". uchefi ze yedabber Adonai elav bederech temiha, kederech shehitchil ledabber elav "lamma vegomer velamma" vegomer, ki telunato al atzmo velo al malko, ki ech yachpotz sheyyimshol hu bo vehu mamshilo al atzmo, vehaven:

rashi: Hishshiani. hitani, kemo al yashshi etchem chizkiyyahu (divrei hayamim 2 32):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai elohim laishsha vegomer. taam sheela zo hi lehitvaddot al avonah lifne Adonai, ki baze hayta arucha lemachalatah, ki amra "hannachash hishshiani" veze hu vidduyah. gam taana ki shogeget baddavar letzad pittuy hannachash. uchevar katavti lemala ki lo yada sheyyeshno lemesit ze, sheim hayta yodaat bo lo hayta nishmaat lo. veamrah hishshiani sheramza leshon nesiut rosh, ki amar lah shebbeemtzaut achila zo tihye kelohim vetitnasse, vehodet beshiggatah lifne konah.

rashi: Latet liftayim arma. meshalim ellu amar kohelet liknot bahem happetayim arma, lenaar daat, vegam lenaar hamenuar mikkol limmud shello lamad adayin kelum:
Mezimma. machashevet etza:
targum: Lemittan leshavre arimuta velitlae yediata vetareta:

rashi: Vayyaas elohim et harakia. tikkeno al amdo, vehi asiyyato, kemo veasta et tzipparneha (Devarim 21):

Meal larakia. al harakia lo neemar ella meal larakia, lefi shehen teluyin baavir. umippene ma lo neemar ki tov beyom sheni? lefi shelo haya nigmar melechet hammayim ad yom shelishi, vahare hitchil bah besheni, vedavar shello nigmar eno bimloo vetuvo; uvashshelishi shennigmar melechet hammayim vehitchil vegamar melacha acheret, kafal bo ki tov shete peamim, achat ligmar melechet hashsheni veachat ligmar melechet hayyom:
ohc: Vayyaas elohim et harakia. mikra ze lo haya tzarich leamro, achar shekkevar amar pasuk shellifne ze "vayyomer elohim" vegomer, bo haya lo ligmor omer "vayhi chen". veod roani ki lo yutzdak lomar "vayhi chen" achar amro "vayyaas elohim", ella achar amirat "vayyomer elohim" yashmienu ki hu amar vattehi.
Venire lomar ki shelosha melachot naasu barakia. haechad hi beriat havayat galmo bammetziut, veze hu shennivra beyom rishon bammaamar harishon:

Vehav sheamar elav Adonai sheyyaase rakia, perush sheyyimmatach veyease vilon, veshier Adonai lo shiur hammittuach hu kede sheyyaspik lehavedil ben mayim lamayim, vehu haamur bappasuk shellifne ze (Bereshit 1:6).

Vehag – lihyot shehashshamayim kadduriyyim hem umeshuppaim, ki en lanu lomar shemmeshunnet rakia zo mikkol hashshamayim, uvaddibbur sheamar "yehi rakia" lo amar ella sheyyimmatach, aval seder tikkuno im yihye nimtach kevilon behashevaa o meshuppa liktzotav o mutte leechad mitztzidde 4 ruchot haolam en ze nishma bemaamar Adonai sheamar "yehi rakia", laze chazar veamar vayyaas perush tikken seder haarachato keseder tikkune shamayim shehem kikara hafucha letzad matta vaachoreha lemala, litamim yeduim levore olam. vechazar lomar vayyavdel vegomer, leheyot ki seder hammaase asher hechino habbore hu hafekiyyut lammaamar hassamuch sheyyavdil ben vechulei sheen keli beseder ze monea ben 2 memot ellu, laze amar shehagam sheasao keseder ze af al pi chen "vayyavdel ben" vegomer. veal 2 peratim ellu amar hakkatuv vayyaas shekkevao basseder sheyyashar beenav, vesheasa bo hametzaa sheyyuchal seet gam beseder ze.

Vedikdek lomar asher meal vegomer, lomar shehagam shehu asuy keseder ze, hivdil ben mayim shealav, ma sheen metziut ze yechola lihyot baolam. veachar kol ze amar vayhi chen, chozer lema shekkatuv befasuk 1 uv, ki kesheamar lo lihyot nirka ken haya, uchesheamar lo lihyot mavdil, hagam sheen haarachato kefi hatteva lehavedil beseder ze kannizkar, vayhi chen. o efshar shettaam sheikkev lomar vayhi chen achar pasuk "vayyaas", shello ratza lomar vayhi chen ad shehishlim hammaase bechol tenae habberia.

Veachar shekkatavti ze matzati ki mikra male dibber hakkatuv meid al perushenu, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 42:5) "ko amar vegomer bore hashshamayim venotehem", hare shezzachar 2 devarim, habberia levad vehannetiyya levad, vehu shepperashti bemaase 1 uv, ki beyom rishon hayta habberia, uveyom sheni hayta hannetiyya, uvichlal hannetiyya veafnah hem 2 devarim sheramaznu.

Veraiti maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha bivreshit rabba (perek 4): "vayyaas elohim et harakia" – ze echad mehammikraot shehirish ben zoma et haolam, vahalo bemaamar echad "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu" (tehillim 33:6) ad kan. ulefi darkenu vehaaretz shakta meraashah, veulay ki ma shehirish haolam ben zoma haya kodem sheyyishshev hammikraot, aval achar yishshuv hammikraot nacha shakta haaretz.

O yomar al ze hadderech lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "vayyomer elohim yikkavu" vegomer, ki 2 memot hem – echad zachar veechad nekeva. lefi ze, letzad shehayu hammemot kullam meoravim kederech shehaya haor vehachoshech meoravim, zeer sham zeer sham, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 83) vehivdil Adonai ben haor vegomer. kemo chen mayim haelyonim, perush hameullim vehem hazzecharim, hayu meoravim im mayim hattachtonim bammadrega. vehen atta amar Adonai sheharakia yavdil 2 havedalot: ha sheyyevarer ze mizze kefi ma shehitbia hakkadosh baruch hu bo sheyyevarer ze mizze, vehav sheyyihyu muvdalim tamid beemtzauto shehu yafsik ben shenehem. uchefi ze amro yehi rakia betoch hammayim kan nitkavven el habberur hamevarer ben 2 hammemot, vehu sheamar betoch hammayim lefi shehayu kol hammemot meoravim. veachar kach asa Adonai hachana larakia sheyyihye muchan lehafesik ben shenehem tamid, vezo hi havedala 2, veal shenehem amar hakkatuv "vayhi chen".

rashi: Yirat Adonai reshit daat. ad kan peresh letzorech ma asa shelomo hassefer hazze, veatta matchil hassefer:

Yirat Adonai reshit daat. hi terumat ikkar haddaat vehi tihye lecha harishona ladaat. lifne chachmatcha hakedem leyira et yotzrecha, vehi titten belibbecha laasot bechachma uvedaat, ki haevilim, asher enam yereim et Adonai, hem bozim et hachachma veet hammusar:
targum: Resh chachmeta dechalta dayya vechachmeta umarduta sichle shaytin:

rashi: Yom echad. lefi seder leshon happarasha haya lo lichtov yom rishon, kemo shekkatuv bishar hayyamim sheni, shelishi, revii, lamma chatav echad? lefi shehaya hakkabba yachid beolamo, shelo nivreu hammalachim ad yom sheni, kach meforash bvra:
Veed yaale. leinyan beriato shel adam, heela hattehom vehishka ananim lishrot heafar venivra adam, kegabbal ze, shennoten mayim veachakka lash et haissa, af kan, vehishka, veachakka vayyitzer:

Tadshe haaretz deshe esev. lo deshe leshon esev velo esev leshon deshe, velo haya leshon hammikra lomar taasiv haaretz, shemine deshaim mechullakin, kol echad leatzmo nikra esev peloni, veen lashon lamdabber lomar deshe peloni, shelleshon deshe hu levishat haaretz keshehi mitmallet bidshaim:
Tadshe haaretz. titmalle vetitkasse levush asavim. bilshon laaz nikra deshe arebareytz, kulan beirbuveya, vechol shoresh leatzmo nikra esev:
Mazria zera. sheyyegaddel bo zaro lizroa mimmenu bemakom acher:
Etz peri. sheyyehe taam haetz ketaam happeri, vehi lo asta chen, ella vattotze haaretz etz ose peri velo haetz peri, lefichach keshennitkallel adam al avono nifkeda gam hi al avonah venitkallela:
Asher zaro vo. hen garine chol peri shemmehen hailan tzomeach keshennotin oto:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim tadshe vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha (chullin 60.) amru shehagam shello amar habbore "lemino" ella laetz, nasu haddeshaim kal vachomer vechulei. vekashe, ki leseder hakkatuv hikdim Adonai devarav al haddeshaim, veim ken lamma nitakkevu millatzet techef samuch mammash lemaamar Adonai ad sheggamar Adonai omer lehotzi etz shemmimmennu nasu kal vachomer. ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk "bereshit" ki chol makom sheyyomar devar gevurot beshem elohim yedabber bedibbur echad kol hammaamar, im ken lo hayta hakedama laddeshaim kodem laetz.

rashi: Yisu midbar. kol beshir:

Chatzerim teshev kedar. (musav al yisu) midbar kedar, shehem darim atta boohalim, yisu kol veyaronnu (kemo "vehachatzerim asher teshev kedar"), bemidbar kedar shehem darim atta beoholehem yihyu arim vachatzerim kevuim:
Yoshve sela. hammetim sheyyichyu (Bereshit Rabba 13 6); ken tirgem yonatan:
Merosh harim yitzvachu. "meresh turiyya yerimun kalehon" (targum yonatan):
targum: Yeshabbach madbera vekirvin deyatvin beh petzichin yatvin midbar arvai yeshabbechun metaya kad yifkun mibbatte almehon mereshe turaya yerimun kalhon:

rashi: Vehu. haam hazze bazuy veshasuy, vesof hainyan velo yasim al lev (Yeshayahu 42:25) kol ze lomar, lamma keraatnu zot mi natan limshissa yaakov (Yeshayahu 42:24):
Hafeach bachurim kullam. bachurehem pache nefesh kullam. tosefet: davar acher: hafeach bachurim kullam – yasimu et atzmam befache haadama uvechorim, uvevatte chelaim hachbau yochiach shekken hu:
Veen omer hashav. kemo 'hashev, lefichach hu rafe, aval "hashshav beamtachtenu" (Bereshit 43:18) hu dagesh:
targum: Vehu am baziz vaanis itchafiu vahata ulemin kulehon uvevatte yesurin aninin havo laadi velet dimshezev leviza velet daamar atev:

rashi: Mikkedem legan eden. bemizracho shel gan eden chutz laggan:
Et hakkeruvim. malache chabbala:
Hacherev hammithappechet. velah lahat leayyem alav millikkanes od laggan targum lahat shenan, kemo shalaf shenana uvilshon laaz leima umidreshe aggada yesh, vaani eni va ella lifshuto:
Ki asita zot. mikkan sheen mehappechim bizchuto shel mesit, sheillu shealo lamma asita zot? haya lo lehashiv divre harav vedivre hattalmid divre mi shomin? (sanhedrin 29):
Mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade. im mibbehema nitkallel mechayya lo kol shekken, heemidu rabbotenu midrash ze vemassechet bechorot (daf 8) lelammed sheyyeme ibburo shel nachash sheva shanim:
Al gachevanech telech. raglayim hayu lo veniktzetzu:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai elohim el hannachash vegomer. shelosha devarim garam bedibburo: 1, sheggaram silluk or kevodo yitbarach shehaya chofef al adam veishto kemo shekkatavnu lemala, vehu sod katnot or. 2, garam shennichretu adam vechavva meolam hazze shello yichyu leolam, kaonesh harashum bakkatuv (Bereshit 2:17): "ki beyom achalcha mimmennu mot tamut". 3, garam sheafillu bayyamim asher hem chayyim baolam lo yitaddenu beeden elohim, kaamur (Bereshit 3:24): "vaygaresh et haadam".

Keneged shelashtan laka shelosha: keneged hafeshatat anan kavod shehu bechinat baruch, amar Adonai elav "arur" vegomer. keneged hacheratat adam mehaolam hazze nichretu raglav (Bereshit Rabba 80:20), shehem beerech adam, bechinat heder haolam hazze shehu raglayim shel olam haasiyya. ki yesh lecha ladaat ki im lo haya adam ochel meetz haddaat, haya matzuy baolam hazze uvaolam haelyon keachat, keadam haddar bevayit uvaaliyya, ucheshechata nigsham veeno yachol ladur bishnehem yachad ella baolam hazze bifne atzmo, uchesheyyirtze laalot laaliyya tzarich hishtannut haggeshem, vezo hi mitat adam. laze nichretu ragle nachash. ucheneged ma sheggaram lishlol meadam vechavva hitaddenut gan eden, amar elav "veafar tochal" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (yoma 75.) ki chol ma sheyyochal lo yitom ella taam afar. ulefi ze yeduyyak al nachon amro hakkadosh baruch hu lannachash bitchillat devarav "ki asita zot", perush ki hakkelalot shemmekallelo Adonai hem maasav sheasa, vehem devarenu atzman, vehaven:

rashi: Yishma chacham. hammeshalim hallalu:
Veyosef. al chachmato:
Lekach. limmud:
Chacham. ze baal hashshemua:
Venavon. mosif al yediat chacham, sheyyodea lehavin davar mittoch davar umosif al shemuato:
targum: Yishma chakkima veyosif madaa vesucheltana madberanuta yikne:

rashi: Vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa. nechama hayta lefanav shebberao vattachtonim, sheillu haya min haelyonim haya mamridan (bivreshit Rabba):

Vayyitatztzev. haadam el libbo shel makom, ala vemachashavto shel makom lehaatzivo, zehu targum unkelos. davar acher vayyinnachem – nehfecha machshavto shel makom mimmiddat rachamim lemiddat haddin, ala vemachshava lefanav ma laasot baadam sheasa baaretz, vechen kol leshon nichum shebbammikra leshon nimlach ma laasot, uven adam veyitnecham (Bamidbar 23) veal avadav yitnecham (Devarim 32) vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa (Shemot 32) nichamti ki himlachti (Shmuel 1 15) kullam leshon machashava acheret hem:

Vayyitatztzev el libbo. nitabbel al avdan maase yadav, kemo neetzav hammelech al beno (sham 2 19), vezo chatavti litshuvat hamminim goy echad sheshshaal et rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, amar lo en attem modim shehakkabba roe et hannolad? amar lo hen, amar lo veha chetiv vayyitatztzev el libbo? amar lo nolad lecha ben zachar miyyamecha? amar lo hen, amar lo ume asita? amar lo samachti vesimmachti et hakkol, amar lo velo hayita yodea shessofo lamut? amar lo bishat chedvata chedvata bishat evla evla, amar lo kach maase hakkabba, af al pi sheggaluy lefanav shessofan lachato uleavdan lo nimna millevaran bishvil hatztzaddikim haatidim laamod mehem:
