Ben chamesh meot shana. amar rabbi yudan ma taam kol haddorot holidu lek shana veze lachamesh meot? amar hakkabba im reshaim hem yovdu vammayim vera letzaddik ze, veim tzaddikim hem atriach alav laasot tevot harebe, kavash et mayano velo holid ad chamesh meot shana, kede shello yehe yefet haggadol shebbevanav rauy loonashin lifne hammabbul (Bereshit Rabba), dichtiv ki hannaar ben mea shana yamut (Yeshayahu 65) rauy leonesh leatid, vechen lifne mattan tora:
Et shem et cham veet yafet. vahalo yefet haggadol hu? ella vattechilla atta doresh et shehu tzaddik venolad keshehu mahul vesheavraham yatza mimmennu vechulei bivreshit Rabba:

Mikkedem. bemizracho shel eden nata et haggan. veim tomar, hare chevar katav vayyivra et haadam vegomer, raiti bivrayta shel 201 beno shel Rabbi yose haggelili 72 middot shehattora nidreshet, vezo achat mehen, kelal shelleacharav maase hu ferato shel rishon, vayyivra et haadam zehu kelal, satam beriato mehechan vesatam maasav, chazar uferesh vayyitzer Adonai elohim vegomer, vayyatzmach lo gan eden vayyannichehu began eden vayyappel alav tardema, hashshomea savur shehu maase acher, veeno ella ferato shel rishon; vechen etzel habbehema chazar vechatav vayyitzer Adonai vegomer min haadama kol chayyat hassade, kede lefaresh vayyave el haadam likrot shem ulelammed al haofot shennivreu min harkak:
ohc: Vayyitta Adonai vegomer vayyasem vegomer vayyatzmach vegomer. taam shehifsik besimat haadam betoch hodaat nite haggan, lomar ki bishvilo bara Adonai haggan velichvodo. veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayyitta vegomer vayyasem, perush lesibba zo lasum sham haadam, veachar kach chazar lefaret inyene haggan venaharotav vetoaliyyotehem. vechazar lomar (Bereshit 2:15) vayyikkach Adonai vegomer vayyannichehu vegomer, legallot al ma shepperashnu beamro "vayyasem", shello nitkavven lomar bah ella shehaadam haya sibba lintoa haggan, sheim al hodaat hannachat adam baggan hare hu omer "vayyikkach" vegomer "vayyannichehu". ufasuk "vayyannichehu" levad lo yaspik lehodaa zo shebbishvil haadam lo lishmo bara Adonai haggan, sheefshar ki Adonai berao lasum bo laasher yishar beenav, limshartav, lemalachav, laruchot haelyonim, uveoto zeman nitratztza sheyyihye sham gam haadam, uven yomo nikra parush vegarush veshaluach, venishar haggan lishar beruav. laze hodia Adonai chasdo ki haggan laadam berao, veodennu omed laadam hayyadid lekono, veen leshum nivra chelek baggan zulat adam asher lo pagam deyokano vetzalmo.

rashi: Berosh homiyyot tikra. bemakom shehi nishmaat venichrezet, sham hi koret veomeret inyan shellematta: ad matay petayim vegomer:
Befitche shearim. hem mekom yeshivat hazzekenim:
targum: Beresh birata machreza uvemaalana detare bichrakke milaha amra:

rashi: Raot rabbot. reiyyot harebe lifnechem, veenchem shomrim lehabbit bemaasay velashuv elay:
Pakoach aznayim. ani asuk lifkoach aznechem al yede neviay, velo yishma ish mikkem et devaray, uleshon hove hu:
targum: Chazetun sagian vela netartun itpattacha udenechun vela kabbeltun ulefan:

rashi: Natiti yadi. lirmoz lahem lasur elay, keadam hamerammez lachavero beyado venote yado elav, lasur elav:
targum: Al dekarit vela hemantun aremit ayday vela atziutun:

rashi: Vayyetze kayin. yatza vehachenaa kegonev daat haelyona:
Beeretz nod. baeretz shekkol haggolim nadim sham:

Kidmat eden. sham gala aviv kesheggorash miggan eden, shenneemar vayyashken mikkedem legan eden et shemirat derech mevo haggan, sheyyesh lilmod shehaya adam sham, umatzinu ruach mizrachit koletet bechol makom et harotzchim shenneemar az yavdil moshe vegomer, mizrecha shamesh (Devarim 4), davar acher beeretz nod, kol makom sheholech hayta haaretz mizdazea tachtav, vehabberiyyot omrim suru mealav, zehu sheharag et achiv:
Hechesheti meolam. ze yamim rabbim hechesheti al churban beti, vetamid acharish:
Etappak. leshon hove; ad atta hetzikatni ruchi, umeatta kayyoleda efe:
Eshshom. etbahel:
Veeshaf. veetavve lehashemid hakkol yachad, kol oyvay:
targum: Yehavit lehon arka mealma deim yetuvun leorayta vela tavu kechavlin al yelidta yitgele dini alehon yitzdun visufun kachada:

rashi: Yom hashshishshi. hosif Adonai bashshishshi vigmar maase vereshit, lomar shehitna immahem, al menat sheyyekabbelu alehem yisrael chamishsha chummeshe tora. davar acher yom hashshishshi, kullam teluyim veomdim ad yom hashshishshi, hu 6 besivan hammuchan lemattan tora:
ohc: Vayyar elohim vegomer. perush: beemtzaut beriat haadam nira maasehu bichlaluto ki tov hu, ki im en adam ma toelet bechol hattikkun uvechol habberia vetzimche haadama, ki en havechanat tova nikkeret ella beemtzaut haadam, ki elav yukkar veyuvchan hattov veyode lammetiv. veamro tevat vehinne ma shello dikdek lomar bayyamim sheamar bahem "ki tov", leheyot ki haadam matzinu lo shekkilkel maasav veasa maase hara, laze dikdek lomar vehinne ki ma shehaya az letzad maase Adonai tov haya meod, veachar kach hu haadam bikkesh chishshevonot rabbot letzad heyot habbechira beyado lehara o lehetiv, veshalal hattov vehivva bemaasav bechinat hara, aval letzad maase Adonai lo bara ella letzad hattov.

Od yirtze beamro vayyar elohim vegomer, kan ramaz ki bishat beriat haadam hibbit Adonai batztzaddikim (Bereshit Rabba 3), vehu amro vayyar vegomer vehinne tov shehem hatztzaddikim. vahagam shehibbit barshaim, gam lahem hechin veasa tikkun livriatam, vehu amro meod, veamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 89) "meod" ze malach hammavet, shebbeemtzauto nitkanim hannivraim hannotim midderech hassechel. velaze keneged bechinat hatztzaddikim amar vehinne tov, perush hinne hinnam bechinat tov mibbeli tzorech mavet. ucheneged bechinat hammattim akalkallotam yeshnam gam hem bivchinat tov beemtzaut meod:

Od yirmoz kan taam habberia, lema sheyyadanu ki ikkar hakkol hu haadam uvishvilo veelav bara Adonai kol beruav, umeatta tavo hashsheela laadam lamma, laze amar vehinne tov meod perush shehagam shebbechinat nishmat haadam hu mibbechinat hattov, im kol ze berao Adonai laalot bemaalot hattov yoter mimma shehu, vehu amro meod al yede maase haadam mitallet nishmato mimmadrega lemadrega, ashre enosh yaase zot.

rashi: Kara yammim. vahalo yam echad hu? ella eno dome taam dag haole min hayyam beakko letaam dag haole min hayyam beaspamya:
ohc: Vayyikra elohim layyabbasha eretz. vehi hammuzkeret befasuk rishon "bereshit" vegomer. veamro tevat vayyikra titparesh biv ofannim: o leshon keriat shem, o leshon tzeaka – tzaak aleha leval titpashshet od, keamram zichronam livracha (chagiga 12.) sheamar leolamo "day", vechevan sheshshama velo nitpashsheta od keraah "eretz", keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 5:8) sheal shem shennitratztzet nikret "eretz".

Veamro kara yammim – lo ze hu hattehom haamur befasuk 2, ki hattehom yeamer al kelalut memot vaasher mittachat laaretz. gam memot hannikvim haya az bivchinat tehom kodem shenniret haaretz, ki hayu shavim betaarovet im memot asher hem hen hayyom tachat laaretz.
Veamro vayyar elohim ki tov chozer gam al mikve hammayim, ki baze yesh chayyut vekiyyum haolam, ki mimmennu geshamim baolam, keamram zichronam livracha (taanit 9:).

rashi: Hu shemi. hu meforash bilshon adnut vechoach, vealay lehareot sheadon ani, lefichach kevodi leacher lo etten:
targum: Ana Adonai hu shemi vikari deitgeleti alechon leam ocharan la etten vetushebachti lefalche tzalmaya:

rashi: Roe tzon. lefi shennitkallela haadama peresh lo meavodatah:
ohc: Vattosef vegomer et achiv et havel. taam shehutzrach lomar "et achiv" lelo tzorech, gam heerich lomar paamayim tevat et, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 102) ki achar shennitztzach hevel lekayin vehippilo, richem alav hevel vekam mealav, veachar kach kam kayin vegomer vaharago (tanchuma, Bereshit 9). vehu sheramaz beamro et achiv, perush ki nahag hu im kayin bemiddat haachva kannizkar, aval kayin nahag immo belo achva ella keadam acher, vehu amro et havel belo achva, velaze hifsik beet" 2. od ramaz biv ettin al derech amram zichronam livracha (yevamot sav) ki 2 teomot noldu im hevel, laze amar 2 peamim "et", uvekayin paam achat "et" ki lo nolda ella achat.

rashi: Hammeorot haggedolim. shavim nivreu venitmaata hallevana al shekkitrega veamra ie lishne melachim sheyishtammeshu vecheter echad:
Veet hakkochavim. al yede shemmiet et hallevana hirba tzevaayha lehafis datah:
ohc: Vayyaas elohim vegomer. taam shello hispik bema sheamar kevar "vayhi chen" al kol haamur, ki maase ze hu maase chadash, sheachar shennitmaata hayyareach kaamur bedivrehem, tikken hashshem vekava maase chadash, shekkava memshala layyareach ballayla, ki bayyom en lah memshala lifne or hashshemesh, velivva lah hakkochavim. veen baze hafekiyyut lema sheamar hashshem bitchillat devarav, ki kevar ramaz acharit davar mereshito kemo sheddiyyakti beamro "yehi". vahagam shepperashnu otah beofen acher, sovelet hi 2 happerushim.

rashi: Yehi rakia. yechezak harakia, sheaf al pi shennivreu shamayim beyom 1 adayin lachim hayu vekarshu vashsheni miggaarat hakkabba beamro yehi rakia, vezehu shekkatav (Iyov 26) ammude shamayim yerofafu – kol yom rishon, uvashsheni yitmehu miggaarato, keadam shemmishtomem veomed miggaarat hameayyem alav:
Betoch hammayim. beemtza hammayim, sheyyesh hefresh ben mayim haeloyonim larakia kemo ven harakia lammayim sheal haaretz, ha lamadta, shehem teluyim bemaamaro shel melech:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim yehi rakia vegomer. perush harakia shebbara Adonai beyom rishon, kemo shepperashti befasuk "bereshit" (Bereshit 1:1) shehakkol nivra yachad bedibbur echad, ella shello nitkena melechet kol davar vedavar al afnah. atta amar elohim sheyyikne mekomo betoch hammayim, veyihye meshammesh davar ze lehavedil ben mayim lamayim. veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze (Bereshit 1:7).

rashi: Arur atta min haadama. yoter mimma shennitkallela hi kevar baavonah, vegam bazo hosifa lachato,
Asher patzta et piha lakachat et deme achicha vegomer. vehinneni mosif lah kelala etzlecha, lo tosef tet kochah:

Vayyikkach lo lemech. lo haya lo lefaresh kol ze, ella lelammedenu missof hainyan, shekkiyyem hakkabba havetachato sheamar shivatayim yukkam kayin, amad lemech leachar sheholid banim veasa dor shevii veharag et kayin, zehu sheamar ki ish haragti lefitzi vegomer:

Shete nashim. kach haya darkan shel dor hammabbul achat lifriyya ureviyya veachat letashmish, zo shehi letashmish mashkah kos shel ikkarin kede shetteaker umekushshetet kechalla umaachilah maadannim, vachavertah nezufa vaavela kealmana, vezehu shepperesh iyyov roe akara lo teled vealmana lo yeyetiv (Iyov 24), kemo shemmeforash beaggadat chelek (uvivra):
Ada. hi shel periyya ureviyya al shem shemmegunna alav umuseret meetzlo, ada targum shel sura:
Tzilla. hi shel tashmish, al shem sheyyoshevet tamid betzillo, divre aggada hem bivra:
Harishonot, shehivtachti leavraham al galut mitzrayim (Bereshit 15:14) "vegam et haggoy vegomer":
Hinne vau. shamarti havetachati, veatta chadashot ani maggid leammi, lehavetiach al galut sheniyya:
targum: Kadmayata ha ataa vechadtan ana mechave ad la atyan evsar yatchon:

rashi: Vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach. haaretz keshettizraenna mine zeraim, tatzmiach kotz vedardar kundas veakkaviyyot, vehen neechalin al yede tikkun (betza 34):

Veachalta et esev hassade. uma kelala hi zo? vahalo babberacha neemar lo hinne natatti lachem et kol esev zorea zera vego? ella ma amur kan berosh hainyan arura haadama baavurecha beitztzavon tochlenna, veachar haitztzavon vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach, keshettizraenna kitnit o yarkot ginna hi tatzmiach lecha kotzim vedardarim ushear isve hasade veal karchacha tochlem:
Hael Adonai. baal haddin uvaal harachamim:
Bore hashshamayim. techilla kemin pakia shel sheti, veachar kach nata otam, kidita bemassechet chagiga (chagiga 12 1):
Vetzeetzaeha. bore et hayyotze mimmenna:
Noten neshama. nishmat chayyim:
Laam aleha. lechullam beshave:
Veruach. kedusha:
Laholchim bah. lammithallechim lefanav:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elah alma Adonai di vera shemaya utelanun shachlil ara vedayraha yahev nishmeta leama di alah veruach ledimhalchin bah:

rashi: Ladaat chachma umusar. hammeshalim haellu amar lehodia labberiyyot chachma umusar sheyyihyu amelim battora, shehi chachma umusar uvina:
targum: Lemeda chachmeta umarduta leetbayin imre veyuneta:

rashi: Vayyiven. kevinyan, rechava millematta uketzara millemala lekabbel havvalad keotzar shel chittim, shehu rachav millemata vekatzar millemala shello yachbid massao al kirotav:
Vayyiven et hatztzela leishsha. lihyot ishsha, kemo vayyaas oto gidon leefod (Shoftim 8), lihyot efod:

Lachem yihye leochla ulechol chayyat haaretz. hishva lahem behemot vechayyot lemaachol, velo hirsha leadam uleishto lehamit beriyya veleechol basar, ach kol yerek esev yochlu yachad kulam, ucheshebbau vene noach hittir lahem basar, sheneemar kol remes asher hu chay vegomer keyerek esev shehittarti leadam harishon natatti lachem et kol:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim hinne natatti lachem vegomer. shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: leheyot shekkevar amar "umilu et haaretz vechivshuha uredu" vegomer, baze asa et haadam adon veshallit bechol habberia, veatta ba lomar toelet hannetina shehu leachla, uvaze hirsha otam leechol mehatztzemachim. umimmotza davar atta yodea ki ma shennatan lahem degat hayyam veof hashshamayim vehabbehema eno ella limshol bahem, lo leechol mehem, ki perat al echad mehannimshalim shehu laachila velo kullam.

Veet kol haetz asher bo feri etz. kan shalal etz haddaat, ki eno begeder ze ose peri levad, ella shehu atzmo peri. veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: veet kol haetz – velo kol haetz bichlal, ella oto asher bo feri etz, velo oto shehu atzmo peri, shehu etz haddaat shennitztavva alav achar kach beferush. o yomar daafillu etz haddaat bichlal, vahagam shemmatzinu shennitztavva alav, kevar amru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 101) sheim haya mamtin ad erev shabbat haya mekaddesh al hayyayin ad kan, umittoch divrehem atta lamed ki lo neesar issur olam.

rashi: Yaazin. latet lev lezot mi natan limshissa yaakov:
Leachor. yakshiv veyishma davar sheyyaamod lo baacharona, vechen tirgem yonatan leachor: "lesofa", vechen kol 'leachor shebbammikra: atid lihyot hu:
targum: Man bechon yatzet da yekabbel visabbar lesofa:

ohc: Vaychullu hashshamayim vegomer. mikra ze lo yadanu ma ba lelammedenu, venire ki yechavven lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 68,9) hakkadosh baruch hu mekomo shel olam. gam matzinu ki hu male olam, kaamur (Yeshayahu 6:3): "melo chol haaretz kevodo", umeatta oro yitbarach nimtza behekkef haolam uvifnimiyyuto. vetzarich latet lev ladaat taam haddavar lamma asa Adonai kacha. umekubbalni mippi zikne tora ki taam sheasa Adonai haolam kadduri hu kede sheyyaamod veyitkayyem behashevaat koche chalakav. uferushan shel devarim hu, yesh lecha ladaat sheen teshuka baolam areva vachaviva venechmedet veneehevet venitevet umekuvva lannivraim, uvifrat lechelke haruchani hammakkir veyodea bechinat or haelohut, kehaddevekut beoro yitbarach, veelav yichsefu kol nefesh chiyyunit hammaggaat lehakkir ketzat minnoam oro yitbarach, tetze nafsham lachazot benoam Adonai. ulecha ladaat ki chol asher bara Adonai beolamo, yatzar bo Adonai bechinat hahaskala vehahavchana kefi bechinato – baale chayyim medabberim uvilti medabberim, vetzomeach vedomem, yesh lechol echad koach mehahaskala lehakkir yotzro kefi hassagato. uvaze taskil ladaat haamadat haolam beeze davar hu taluy veomed mibbeli hitnoaut, ki Adonai gilla sodo el yereav uveemtzaut hahearot hanneemarim hussag hammurgash. vehu ki beemtzaut oro hanneerav vehamekuvve asher yesovev kadduriyyut haolam behashevaa, vechol chelek vechelek mehassovev shel haolam yitatztzem bechoach esh hatteshuka habboeret bo lehitkarev livchinat kelalut netzer hamekuvve. velihyot ki chol bechinat sibbuv haolam tishve bo shiur hatteshuka, ben mitztzad ma shemmimmennu – ki en taavat chelek echad rabba al chavero shebbeemtzaut ze yitrabbe hitatztzemut hachelek hahu veyechalesh shekkenegdo, ben mitztzad ma sheelav hu haor hannaim, ki eno karov lechelek mehassovev yoter mechavero shebbaze yigdal chelek mehaolam bechoach hitatztzemuto yoter mechelek acher, ella hakkol behashevaa. vechol chut hassaara mikkol chelke hassovev shel haolam yitatztzem lehitkarev umoshech letzad happone elav, uveemtzaut hitatztzemut hannimshach mikkol sevivot kadduriyyut haolam nimtza haolam omed vekayyam, vechol chelek maamid et chavero beemtzaut haamur. venimtza kol haolam takua bitedot umasmere cheshek habbore letzad kelot unetot ruchaniyyut shebbo lehitkarev lehanneerav yitalle shemo. uvaze atta massig taam shebbara Adonai haolam kadduri, vehaven. uvaze gam ken matzinu taam lamma haolam nirka venitka beli hitnoaut, ki hahitnoaut tithavve letzad hagebarat vehachelashat chelek mechelke hammaamid, ma sheen ken bimtziut ze i efshar lehitnoea beshum ofen.

Veefshar ki laze ramzu zichrono livracha benoam imrehem (chagiga 12:) veze leshonam: dekayme vela yade al ma kayme, ad kan. hakkavvana ki im hayu hannivraim mavchinim havechana zo, veyadu rum maalat chibbat hakkodesh uteshukat hannivraim lannelam hanneerav, veyiru kamma hu otzem hattikva vehahitatztzemut domem ze shehu haolam, asher mitatztzem lehitkarev lehanot meor hamekuvve, velo nahag rifyon beshum chelek mesovev haolam – yisu kal vachomer mizze kamma tzarich haadam laasot, ki bo nitrabbet hahavchana vehahaskala. gam yesh lecha ladaat ki leheyot shekkol hannivraim bimlo olam, kol asher ruach hachiyyuni bo, amru zichrono livracha (yalkut tehillim 150) ki en kol nefesh mityashshevet bimkomah ki im letzad sheyyeshno lannichsaf umekuvve melo olam hazze, lo tigal hannefesh et habbasar. uletaam ze heir Adonai olamo mikkevodo, uchevodo male olam, venimtza haolam betoch toch boro, veor habbore betoch kol haolam vesovev olamo. uvaze amad venitkayyem haolam beemtzaut hatteshuka lammatzuy, vehu amro vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam, perush "vaychullu" al derech amro (tehillim 84:3) "nichsefa vegam kalta". uveemtzaut ze nishlema venitkayyema habberia. vetaam shehotzi hakkatuv hainyan belashon ze "vaychullu", lirmoz ki hu teshuka gedola ad kelot hachelek el hakkol, vehu bechina gedola mibbechinat hacheshek vehatteshuka. vehu sheramaz david beamro "nichsefa vegam kalta", hare ze maggid ki bechina zo gedola mibbechina shellefaneha, uveemtzaut bechina zo vehitatztzemutah haolam kayyam. veze hu sod keriato "chay haolamim", vehaven. vehu sod "beor pene melech chayyim".

rashi: Haya keachad mimmennu. hare hu yachid battachtonim kemo sheani yachid baelyonim, uma hi yechiduto? ladaat tov vara, ma sheen ken bivhema vechayya
Veatta pen yishlach yado. umishsheyyichye leolam hare hu karov lehateot habberiyyot acharav, velomar af hu eloah. veyesh midreshe aggada, aval en meyushshavin al peshuto:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer hen haadam vegomer. yesh lehair lamma lo chash hael letzauot lehaadam al etz hachayyim leval yakdim veyochal mimmennu vachay leolam kodem sheyyochal meetz haddaat?

Od amro tevat haya shehaya tzarich lomar "hu". od, lo haya tzarich lomar ella "hen haadam keechad mimmennu". od, ech yutzdak ledammoto lelohim letzad sheyyodea tov vara? od, ech yutzdak lomar tevat "mimmennu" chas veshalom shemmare sheyyesh lemala kidmut, vehaya tzarich lomar "keechad mikkem" o "kelohim"?

Achen leheyot shekkadam Adonai vetzivva laadam al etz haddaat, lo chash Adonai lehaadam sheyyochal meetz hachayyim ben mitztziddo ben mitztzad hammesit. ben mitztziddo – ki hu meshullal mehahakkara vehayyedia levakkesh tachbulot laalot berume hatzelachot gufiyyot, ben letzad hammesit – ki hammesit mittivo shello yasit lehaadam al haddavar sheyyesh lo bo hanaa uzechut, ufeshita shello yesitehu leechol meetz hachayyim. veim haya Adonai metzavvehu al etz hachayyim im etz haddaat, haya hammesit mitgare bo leechol meetz hachayyim letzad bittul hammitzva, veefshar shehaya motze makom lehasit gam laadam atzmo. laze nitchakkem Adonai leval tzavvoto al ze, shebbaze lo yitgare bo mesit, vechaasher achal meetz haddaat veyeshno behakkarat davar sheyyeot lo, nichnas begeder safek shemma yishlach yado leechol lichyot leolam.

Velachashasha zo dibber Adonai devar chachma, vezo hi shiur devarav: "hen haadam haya keachad", perush she berao keachad, perush keachdut echad hammukkeret baolam shehu achduto yitbarach, keamro "naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu" vehishlito battachtonim keamro "veyirdu" vegomer, veyatzta peulla zo mimmennu, perush mehaadam, ladaat tov vara, ki ani tzivvitiv leval yochal meetz haddaat tov vara, ella shehu chata vehissig hayedia, vechevan shehissig hayedia yesh lachush shebbeemtzaut hayedia yivchar leechol meetz hachayyim vachay leolam. umatzati reaya leferush "mimmennu" middivre uneklos shettirgem "mimmennu" – "minneh".

Od yitbaer hainyan al ze hadderech, ki Adonai beyom tzauoto al etz haddaat tzivva 2 devarim: ha hu bilti achol meetz haddaat, vehav im yochal yeshno betakkanat hammavet, vehu amro "ki beyom vegomer tamut", ki ze hu tikkun haddavar vahava leh kelav hannittak laase shehu hattikkun. uchevar katavnu lemala ki zulat hachet haya haadam massig laalot lehitadden baolam hannitzchi bidmut shehu, vehaya dar baaliyya uvechatzer, vetze ulemad meeliyyahu hannavi zachur lattov. veal yede hachet nifsela geviyyato mehassagat alot lemakom kadosh, uchesheyyihye mushelal efshariyyut hahafrada mehaggeviyya hare hu chaser hassagat hitaddenut hannitzchi vehearev hamekuvve. uchefi ze, hagam shello tzivva hael lehaadam bilti achol meetz hachayyim, haadam meatzmo yifrosh mechashash yom achlo meetz haddaat, sheim lo chen en metziut letakken hallav venimtza haadam avud. aval achar sheachal, hen emet im haya bedato sheachilato hi achila shetztzarich aleha mita, peshita shello haya Adonai chash sheyyochal meetz hachayyim, ella sheachilato hayta beshogeg uchemo shekkatavnu lemala, umeatta en lo lachush od al heavon lishmor atzmo bilti karov laetz. ki yesh lecha ladaat ki ikkar taam mitzvat hammelech al etz haddaat hi levilti yussag bedaat adam hakkarat bechinat hara, vetihye dato muchletet bivchinat hattov mibbeli haregashat bechinat hara vahavayato baolam. vehu amro (Kohelet 7:29) "asa vegomer et haadam yashar", perush bidia achat tova veen dimyon hara metzuyyar bedato. vechaasher hukkar hara bidiato vedato, veze lecha haot "vayyedu ki erummim vayyitboshashu", en makom lemitzva zo baolam. veyachshov haadam sheppaka mitzva zo meatzmah umeatta lo yachush lishloach yado vachay, veamar Adonai ki toe bedato vetzarich hu lamut afillu al shiggato asher shagag mittaam shekkatavnu lemala, ki nifsal gufo mealot el haelohim yachad im hanneshama.

Ulefi derech ze naskil maamar echad tamuah (Bereshit Rabba 21,6), veze leshonam: "veatta pen yishlach yado", amar rabbi abba bar kahana: melammed sheppatach lo hakkadosh baruch hu petach shel teshuva, dichtiv "veatta" – en "veatta" ella teshuva, shenneemar (Devarim 10:12): "veatta yisrael ma" vegomer, vehu amar "pen" – en "pen" ella lav. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yishlach yado veachal, veim achal vachay leolam, ad kan leshonam. divrehem zichronam livracha temuhim beyoter, ech yutzdak lomar Adonai leadam sheyyachzor bitshuva veyimrod mered gadol kaze lomar "lo"? od, lamma lo chash Adonai sheyyochal ella kesheamar "lo"? vehaya nire lomar ki im haya ose teshuva lo haya Adonai makpid al chayyuto leolam, veze eno, ki kevar nitchayyev mita beyom achlo meetz haddaat.

Ulefi darkenu yavou al nachon divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha, ki Adonai ratza lehodia lehaadam ki chata baachilato, uveemtzaut hakkarato ken, hu meatzmo yibbadel milleechol meetz hachayyim kemo shekkatavnu lemala ki hu ze tikkuno. velaze amar lo sheyyaase teshuva, umashmaut teshuva yaggid ki pasha. vehaadam heshiv "lav", perush ki lo chata sheyyitztarech lashuv, vetoen taana hannishmaat ki lo yada bah veeno ella shogeg veeno tzarich laasot teshuva. vechevan shettaan ken, amar Adonai meatta yishlach yado veachal, sheen lo monea kefi sevarato. laze shillecho Adonai ki mishpato nechtam lamut al achilato mittaam shekkatavnu. veachar kach shav venichnas beme gichon 130 shana lechapparat avon (pirki derabbi eliezer 20):

Vehinne hagam she amar elav "beyom achalcha mimmennu" vegomer, divre kadosh amaram biv panim: yesh bemashmaut yom – yomo shel adam, veyesh bemashmaut yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu shehu elef shana (midrash Rabba 99). vehakkavvana hu kefi bechinat hachet uchefi haregashato baddavar: im yarshia laavor pi Adonai beazzut – yekuyyam bo yomo shel adam, veim yishgog shegaga kazo vigalle dato ki lo haya chafetz baddavar – tihye hakkavvana yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu elef shana, kemo shekken haya.

rashi: Ken archot kol botzea batza. gozel gezela naa venechmedet hi lo, vechinnam hi lo (Mishlei 1:17), vesofo et nefesh bealav yikkach. nefesh atzmo, shennaasa achshav baal hammamon sheggazal mechavero:
targum: Hechden inun archata dechol deavdin ila nafshata demarehon nasvin:

rashi: Vayyatzmach. leinyan haggan hakkatuv medabber:
Betoch haggan. baemtza:
Vayyikkach. lekacho vidvarim naim ufittahu likkanes (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyikkach vegomer leavdah uleshamrah – mashmaut hakkatuv yaggid ki haggan tzarich lah oved veshomer, vehaemet yachchish ze, ki lamma yihye tzarich leshamrah? im mehaggannavim – ze havay hi, uma hi haavoda shehayta tzericha haggan? veim tzericha oved, im ken ze lah chameshet alafim vachamesh meot shana mi avadah?

Achen yesh lecha ladaat ki chol hove eno ella dugma leruchaniyyut, uchemo shehaadama tzericha avoda vehazeraa vehageshama lehotzi mezon haadam, gam shemira middevarim hammafsidim vehammeriim latztzomeach, kemo chen gan eden asher hi hayyom admat hannefashot levad, ki haggufot nigshemu, gam hi tzericha avoda ushemira kefi ruchaniyyutah. hageshama hameyuchedet lah hi esek hattora, kemo sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 32:2): "yaarof kammatar likchi tizzal kattal imrati", vehazzeraim hem mitzvot ase asher yaase otam haadam, karamuz bedivre hannavi (Hoshea 10:12): "ziru lachem" vegomer, vahagam shello nizkar bedivre hannavi ella hatztzedaka, lo al perat hatztzedaka levad hu omer ella al kol perate hatztzedakot hu omer, vechen huva bedivrehem zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim 114) shekkol mitzvot sheyyaase haadam hakkadosh baruch hu zorah vechulei, vehaavoda hi hitassekut gadol vehistakkelut nimretzet battora shehu ikkar mitzvatah, vehashshemira gam ken leval yifrotz gedareha uleval yafsid tzemacheha, vehi shemirat mitzvot lo taase asher tzarich haadam lishmor leval avor alehem ki hem hammafsidim kol davar tov. vehu amram zichronam livracha (sota ka.): "avera mechabba mitzva", vahagam sheamru veen avera mechabba tora, en kavvanatam lomar shemmaase hara lo yafsid hattora kol ikkar, ella lomar sheen koach baavera achat lechabbot hattora, uleolam ki yarbe lehashechit tishshachet torato veyidach nerah vetehafech shilyato al panav rachamana litztzelan:

Umeatta yutzdak lomar al gan eden "leavdah uleshamrah". vehinne bayyamim hahem keshehinniach Adonai haadam began eden, haya mabbit vetzofe bifullot tzaddik lechayyim bemaasav ma shehaya poel began eden, ach achar asher nigrash haadam hushlal mimmennu reot haddavar, aval hammaase nefesh amel amla lo, ki haruchaniyyut lo yimnaenna haharchaka vehappeulla naaset. ashre hamechakke veyaggia baolam hazze leechol mipperi darko shehu mezon hanneshama began eden. shuv ba leyadi maamar chazal veze leshonam: "leavdah" – ellu mitzvot ase, "uleshamrah" – ellu mitzvot lo taase, vechavvanatam zichronam livracha al derech shebbearnu.

rashi: Vayyitzer min haadama. hi yetzira hi asiyya haamura lemala vayyaas elohim et chayyat haaretz vegomer, ella va uferesh shehaofot nivreu min harkak, lefi sheamar lemala min hammayyim nivreu vechan amar min haaretz nivreu (chullin 27), veod limmedcha kan shebbishat yetziratan miyyad bo vayyom heviam el haadam likrot lahem shem. uvedivre aggada yetzira zo leshon ridduy vechibbush, kemo ki tatzur el ir (Devarim 24), shekkevashan tachat yado shel adam (Bereshit Rabba):
Vechol asher yikra lo haadam nefesh chayya vegomer. sarsehu ufarshehu, kol nefesh chayya asher yikra lo haadam shem, hu shemo leolam:
Neerva ledam. lishpoch dam:
Nitzpena. leshon "maarav" (Yehoshua 8:9):
Nitzpena lenaki chinnam. hakkatuv omer shetztzefinatam lenaki – chinnam hu:
targum: In yemrun eta imana nichmon lidma nitshe lezakke magan:

rashi: Vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam. hu afar veavi alav mayim veemche oto, lechach neemar lashon michuy:
Meadam ad behema. af hem hishchitu darkam (Bereshit Rabba). davar acher hakkol nivra bishvil adam vechevan shehu chale ma tzorech beellu:
Ki nichamti ki asitim. chashavti ma laasot al asher asitim:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai emche vegomer. hutzrach lomar "ki nichamti" vegomer, velo hispik bema sheamar besamuch, ba lomar shettaam sheamar "emche" hu letzad shennicham al asiyyatam, lo letzad maasehem haraim. ki yesh hefresh im hakkillayon yihye letzad maasehem haraim, yimmatzun shello yitchayyevu kelaya, vehem otam shello higgiu loonashin, veim yihye hakkillayon letzad ki nicham Adonai, katan vegadol sham hu bichlal haggezera. velaze amar emche vegomer ki nichamti ki asitim, uletaam ze en nimlat. velaze amar techef umiyyad venoach matza chen beene Adonai, perush lo letzad maasav, ki bivchinat hachazara shechazar Adonai mibberiat haadam lo yatztzilennu heyoto tzaddik, velaze hutzrach lomar "matza chen" velo mechao. veen mizze hochacha lomar ki lo haya tzaddik, ki hagam shehaya tzaddik lo tatztzilennu tzidkato, ella bechinat hachen shehissig meemtzaut bechinat hammitzvot, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki yesh mitzva shettoaltah hi lehameshich chen al haadam, o bivchinat 3 o 4 mitzvot yeduot, vaAdonai lo hodia toaliyyot hammitzvot letaam sheamru zichrono livracha (tanchuma, ekev) sheyyarutzu kol haolam lattoaliyyot, veze noach zacha umatza hachen, gam shemo yaggid ken – noach chen.
Chassalat parashat Bereshit

rashi: Uleadam lo matza ezer. vayyippol Adonai elohim tardema. keshehevian hevian lefanav kol min vamin zachar unekeva, amar lechullam yesh ben zug veli en ben zug, miyyad vayyappel (Bereshit Rabba):
Bezeat appecha. leachar shettitrach bo harebe:
ohc: Ad shuvecha vegomer. taam shennatan 2 teamim ki mimmenna vegomer ki afar vegomer, leheyot shettaam "mimmenna lukkachta" eno taam maspik lashuv el haadama, ki halo kodem shechata gam ken haya bivchina zo, velo nigzar alav lashuv lammakom shemmimmennu lukkach, laze natan taam 2 beamro "ki afar atta" vegomer. hakkavvana baze ki im haya nitztzol mehachet bischar kiyyum mitzvat Adonai, haya Adonai magbir bo tzad haruchaniyyut veyihye gufo mizdakkech veyithappech hachomer veyease tzura behitgabberut chelek haruchani, ma sheen ken achar shechata garam 2 devarim: hiflig chelek hachomer shebbo vehigshimo vehuchlat mimmennu hithappechuto letzura, gam huchshach maor haruchani shebbo veen bo koach lehair livchinat hachomer laasoto tzura. vehu amro "ki", perush taam sheani omer lecha atta shettashuv el haadama shellukachta mimmenna velo mikkodem laze, ki afar atta, perush heemadta atzmecha bemiddat afar shehugshamta mitztzad maasecha shello shamarta hammitzva shebbeemtzautah haya hazzikkuch, vechevan shekken, ki chol makor yekav limkoro veshov yashuv elav, vehu mekor galmo hu min haadama lukkach. vetaam amro veel afar tashuv nitkavven od lomar ki lo millevad sheyyashuv el haadama ella sheyyihye nirkav gufo veyease hu atzmo afar. vechen heemidu perush happasuk bemassechet shabbat (shabbat kinnev.) bemaase dehanhu kappulae derav nachman.

rashi: Vayyikra elohim larakia shamayim. sa mayim, sham mayim, esh umayim, sheervan ze vaze veasa mehem shamayim:
ohc: Vayyikra vegomer. kan hodia ki ellu hem haamurim befasuk "bereshit" vegomer, uma shekkeraam befasuk rishon beshem shamayim, perush: beria achat sheatid likrotah shamayim, uleolam lo kara Adonai lo shem ze ad yom 2.

Uledivre rabbotenu sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 84) perush shamayim hu sa mayim, yechavven hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyikra Adonai larakia veamar lo "sa mayim" kede sheyyihye avir limkom hannivraim kede sheyyihyu hannivraim ben shamayim laaretz, vezulat ze en makom leyoshve tevel ad shekkara larakia sheyyissa hammayim shehayu munachim alav. veamar lammayim hattachtonim sheyyikkavu lemakom echad beyom 3 venitraet hayyabbasha baze hinne makom leyoshve tevel. veen setira laze middivre rabbotenu sheamru mayim haelyonim benes omdim, shehagam shehashshamayim hem nosim otam, im kol ze leseder techunat hashshamayim vesidduram hirgishu ki benes omdim kemo shekkatavnu befasuk "vayyaas".

rashi: Chachmot bachutz taronna. hare chachmoteha shel tora bechutzoteha tizakna lehazehirchem lasur alehem. uma hen chutzoteha? batte midrashot:
Barchovot. bimkom shemmarchivin otah. kach darash rabbi tanchuma (tanchuma, bechukkotay 4):
targum: Chachmeta veshuka mishtabbecha umishkake yahava kalah:

rashi: Az huchal. leshon chullin, likro et shemot haadam veet shemot haatzabbim bishmo shel hakkabba laasotan aza velikrotan elohut:
Lo tov heyot vegomer. shello yomru shete rashuyot hen, hakkabba yachid vaelyonim veen lo zug, veze yachid vattachtonim veen lo zug (Bereshit Rabba):
Ezer kenegdo. zacha – ezer; lo zacha – kenegdo lehillachem:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer lo tov vegomer. kashe, halo kevar beyom bero elohim adam "zachar unekeva bara otam" (Bereshit 1:27). od kashe amro samuch lo eese lo ezer kenegdo vegomer vayyitzer vegomer kol chayyat hassade, shennire sheratza lezavveg lo chayyat hassade, veze pele lezavveg adam uvehema. veod sheyyasir nekevat behema o chayya mibben zugah ulezavvegah im haadam, elyonim lematta vetachtonim lemala. od kashe amro vayyappel Adonai tardema vegomer, vechi lo haya Adonai yachol livro lo bat zugo afar min haadama? millevad ma shehikshenu shemmatzinu lo shebbara lo bat zugo beyom hibbaro, uchemo sheheid hakkatuv achar ken "zachar unekeva beraam vegomer beyom hibbaram" (Bereshit 5:2), verazal amru derashot rabbot utzerichin poter, aval peshat hakkatuv lo metzanuhu.

Venire lefi ma shekkadam middivre razal (berachot 61.) ki adam vechavva du partzufin nivreu, leman deamar partzuf, uleman deamar zanav, kidita bemassechet shabbat, uchefi ze zot haishsha veze binyanah, ki mittechilla beraah devuka immo mammash, leman deamar kisvarato uleman deamar kisvarato. uveseder ze yeshnam gam ken bahachanat hammolid, dahalo timtza sheamar Adonai lahem (Bereshit 1:28) "peru urevu" vegomer kodem hannesira, ha lamadta shehechinam Adonai leholid gam bihyotam beseder ze, vezot haishsha asher nisser Adonai ulekachah mimmekom devikatah asher beraah beyom hibbaram.

Gam davar yadua hu ki chol maskil vechacham hammatchil lehabbit imre noam Adonai, torat Adonai, meet yeoru enav yeda godel hafelagat middat tuvo yitbarach asher higdil lehitchakkem lehachin hafelagat hattov vehachanato. umeatta yesh lanu lachkor zot sibbat chet haadam uma shennitgalgel lo velichlalut hannivraim, umetzanuha ki hi haishsha hayta sibba lechol hefsed vechilyon haolam, sheshshalat bah hannachash venitztzach datah velo haya immah haadam, kannishma mehakkatuv. veamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 19,3) ki haya haadam yashen o leman deamar shehaya over baolam vechulei umatza nachash lechavva bifne atzmah vehesitah. umeatta yihye pe velashon lannivraim lomar yad Adonai asta zot bema shennisserah velo hinniach tachlit habberia kasseder harishon velo haya makom lannachash lehasit haishsha bifne atzmah. asher al ken nitchakkem Adonai vechatav kodem lekichat hatztzela mehaadam taam haddavar shekkavvanat Adonai baddavar hayta lehetiv lehaadam, elohim chashavah letova kemiddat elohenu. veze hu shiur umashmaut hakketuvim: achar asher hodia otanu bivriat yom 6 ki bara haadam zachar unekeva du partzufin o zanav, raa Adonai ki lo nachon sheyyihye haadam bad echad. vahagam shehayta lo bat zug, af al pi chen echad haya veeno ella levaddo. vehammashal baze – im yirtze hu lalechet laasot chafatzav telech immo, gam im telech haishsha leshammesh balah yelech immah gam ken, venimtza shehu bad echad. venimlach Adonai ki haezer tihye ezer kenegdo, perush binyan nifrad lemulo leshammesho velahachanato, ki livchinat haholada vehazziuug kevar hutba basseder harishon, ki matzinu lo shetztzivva lahem "peru urevu" kodem hannesira. umeatta, im laze hayta sibbat kichat hannekeva mitztzad haadam, yeshno metziut acher sheyyigzor Adonai al echad mehannivraim veyihye lo leezer lehoil, vetishshaer haishsha bimkom yetziratah. laze amar hakkatuv (Bereshit 2:19): vayyitzer vegomer kol chayyat hassade vegomer vayyave el haadam lirot ma yikra lo, ki bivchinat keriat hashshem tukkar bechinat hammezeg, uveemtzaut hahakkara yuchal levarer metziut haezer hayeshnah. vehodia hakkatuv ki lo matza ezer, vehuchrach likloa hannekeva mitztziddo velaasotah kenegdo. vehakkavvana hi letovat haadam, veim achar kach yatza ma sheyyatza vehaya ze sibba lehametzaat haishsha beyichud mibbalade ishah vehikkishah nachash, en makom lomar lamma asa Adonai kacha, ki elokim chashavah letova visharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam vegomer. veze hu shiur hakketuvim, leheyot sheratza hakkatuv lehodia chet haadam ki hu ze sibba ligzerat hammavet vehu hassovev, vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv (25) "vayyihyu shenehem" vegomer kodem lehodia hachanat hassibba shehi letzad heyot haishsha mufredet migguf adam, vehu amro: vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav, perush nesirat haishsha mehaadam. veleheyot shettakshe lomar velamma hayta hachana zo lachet, velo haya lo laAdonai linsor otah vekanta lah mekomah veaz lo haya chet baolam, laze kadam lomar ki haya letzad hahechreach, vehu amro vayyomer vegomer lo tov heyot haadam levaddo vegomer, vahagam shebbikkesh haezer mehannivraim dichtiv "vayyave el haadam" vegomer lo matza ezer laadam mehem vehuchrach linsor hannekeva venacha daat adam bah kenegdo velo temuna meachorav, ki baze tissa ol subbolo lanuach hu bimkomo veotah yishlach lehachin velaasot tzerachav.

Ulefi darkenu yesh taam nachon bachakira achat: lamma Adonai nimlach mimmachshavto rishona shebbara haadam uvat zugo immo vechazar unesarah? ki hakkavvana hi lehodia ki maase Adonai tov hu lakkol, velohim chashavah letova uvara yachad zachar unekeva. ella diltzad hanaat haadam lesadder hachanato, hifridam mikkol hannivraim. en nishtavin elav veen metziut livro lo adam acher lahachanato, ki yesh teamim rabbim venichbadim levilti asot Adonai 2 adam kemaamaram zichronam livracha, vehaven. nimtzeta omer ki chol seder haamur befarasha zo bevakkashat haezer ushelilato vehametzaato, eno ella letzad asot hannekeva nifredet mehazzachar ki tov hav meha. aval leinyan hazziuug hachanat periyya ureviyya kevar berao Adonai beyom 6 uveraam lifrot velirbot, veen menia laze letzad sheen panim befanim, ki hechinam Adonai leharekava gam basseder shehayu bah achor veachor, sheyyarik hazzachar hazzera derech makom asher bo hannotzar. veyesh lanu lachkor zot: leeze taam bara Adonai haishsha beguf haadam mammash velo beraah beriyya bifne atzmah min heafar kemo shebbara hazzachar? venire ki baze gilla dato yitbarach ki yesh hefresh ben hachanat ziuug haenoshi mizziuug habbahami, ki ziuug habbahami poel peullat hahazraa bechol nekeva asher tizdammen lefanav. vahagam sheamar hakkatuv besug ze gam ken "zachar unekeva", lo sheyyitchayyev kol zachar lehakkir nekevato, kol shemmimmino hi kol asher yizdammen lefanav mimmino hare hu rashshay. veen rishshum veyichud linkevat zachar babbahami lomar "zo parato shel shor ze vezo parato" vechulei, ma sheen ken haadam shello millevad shemmuvdal bivchinat hammin, ella gam muvdal bifrate hammin, ki chol echad yesh lo bat zugo bifne atzmo. velaze nitchakkem Adonai livnot bat zugo shel haadam meatzamav, lomar ki zo basar mibbesaro. velaze keshehizhir al haarayot rasham kinnuy haarayot el hazzecharim, keamro (Vayikra 18:14): "ervat avicha, ervat achi avicha" vegomer, hare shehagam sheeno metzuvve ella al hannekevot, meyached haddavar el hazzecharim, vehaven:

rashi: Nefesh chayya. sheyyehe vah chayyut:

Sheretz. kol davar chay sheeno gavoah min haaretz karuy sheretz: baof, kegon zevuvim, bashshekatzim, kegon nemalim vechippushim vetolaim, babberiyyot, kegon choled veachbar vechomet vechayyotze vahem, vechol haddagim:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim yishretzu vegomer. perush sheyyithauu mehammayim beriyyot, vedavar ze eno bitmidut ella bishat maamar habberia, veotam habberiyyot sheshshartzu hammayim amdu leolam kemin habbehemi asher hotzia haaretz, shello hotzia ella bishat hammaamar veamdu leolam kemitzvat Adonai lahem sheyyishretzu veyifru veyirbu. veamro sheretz nefesh chayya hem haddagim. veamar leshon sheretz lehaferish beno uven hameofef, ki ze en lo koach ella besamuch mammash laaretz, vehammeofef yeofef al haaretz veeno tzarich lehissamech, veod lo sheyyagbiah ad lashshamayim, keamro "al pene rekia", vezulat maamar ze lo hayu haofot magbihim ad lashshamayim.

Veamro rekia hashshamayim – perush: rakia hannikra shamayim. veen lehakeshot ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 86) veze leshonam: hechan chamma ulevana? berakia 2, shenneemar "vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim". mikra male hu, veanshe keneset haggedola pershuha (Nechemya 9:6): "atta asita et hashshamayim usheme hashshamayim vechol tzevaam", hechan hem tzevaam? berakia 2, ad kan. ledivrehem zichronam livracha ma yaanu befasuk ze "veof yeofef al pene rekia hashshamayim"?

Venire ki al pi hannekuddot yishtanne katuv ze mikra devayyitten otam" vegomer (Bereshit 1:17), ki chan katav kamatz tachat resh shel rakia, vesham katav sheva tachat haresh shel rekia. vehinne kesheamar rekia bishva yaggid shehu samuch, perush rekia shel shamayim, uchesheyyomar rakia bekamatz eno samuch leshamayim, uferush hu rakia vehu hannikra shamayim, uvaze lo kashya, vehaven.

rashi: Vattelahatehu missaviv. kede sheyyiru veyikchu musar, keinyan shenneemar (Tzefanya 3:6): "hichratti goyim nashammu pinnotam, amarti ach tiri vegomer":
Velo yada. yodea hu, ella sheddash beakev; lo chash lehavin zot velashuv merisho:
Vattivar bo. achar puranut haovde kochavim umazzalot shemmissaviv, baara beatzmo:
targum: Ushefach alehon chemat rugeze utekof avde kerave ayti alehon uketalu vehon mischor sechor vela yedau veshalitu vehon vela shaviu dechalte al libba:

rashi: Ze sefer toldot adam. zo hi sefirat toldot adam, umidreshe aggada yesh rabbim:
Beyom bero vegomer. maggid shebbayyom shennivra holid:
ohc: Ze sefer vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro "ze sefer", ma hassippur hallaz. od amro beyom bero vegomer bidmut, shennire ki beyom bero haya bidmut velo achare chen. od, achar shekkevar hodia davar ze beyom habberia lamma chazar paam 2 al haddavar. od, lamma hutzrach lomar paam 2 od "zachar unekeva" vegomer, veod lamma chazar lomar paam 2 "beyom hibbaram".

Achen kavvanat hakketuvim lishmor derech Adonai, ki kol archotav chayyim ad haolam. vehinne bevo elohim lesadder shene olam asher nisderu baddorot lechamma sibbot niglot venistarot, vehutzrach lehazekir mitat adam veyotze chalatzav, hikdim lehasir taanat toen kenegdo yitbarach: ech yimas yegia kappav? kivyachol, yesh yotzer asher yishbor kelav? yesh bone soter binyanav? yesh toreach umafsid tirchato? veyoter tigdal hattemiha behagedil erech hahove venifsad, velamma yaase kacha? hu hayyotzer, hu habbore, hu habbone olamo letzorech haadam veyishberennu befeta, venimtza chemdat hakkol mufsedet veen hefsed nogea ella livaleha. asher al ken kodem sheyyomar hakkatuv mitat adam, kadam veamar ki lo meAdonai haya haddavar lehamit dor chemdat habberia, ella hu hassovev leatzmo lamut. vehu amro ze sefer toldot, perush asher holid adam beemtzaut maasav, ki toldot yeamer al habbanim veal hammaasim kederech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, noach) befarashat "elle toldot noach" vedarshu zichronam livracha: ikkar toladot shel tzaddikim mitzvot umaasim tovim. hinne sheyyomar al asher yaase haadam behanehagotav leshon toladot, gam kan yaggid toldotav shel adam ki mimmennu yatzu haddevarim hefech chefetz Adonai, ki Adonai chafatz beyom shebberaam lihyot bidmut elohim. vehu amro: beyom bero adam bidmut elohim asa oto, perush tikkeno lichyot tamid, al derech amro (Tehillim 82:7): "ani amarti elohim attem vegomer achen keadam temutun", hare ze maggid ki beamro elohim – chayyim ad haolam. veamro zachar unekeva beraam yaggid ki ma sheamar "bidmut elohim" vegomer hayta gam hannekeva begeder ze. gam nitkavven lomar shehagam shebberaam bidmut elohim lichyot leolam, af al pi chen beraam zachar unekeva lifrot velirbot.

Veamar od vayvarech vegomer vayyikra shemam adam, shehu shem hameulle, ki higdil Adonai chasdo immahem bechol bechinat hammaalot. vegamar omer beyom hibbaram, shekkol hammaalot hayu beyom habberia, aval lo amad haddavar ken ben bivchinat haadam ben bivchinat haishsha kammuvan mehammeora. veachar shehodia ma shemmimmennu yitbarach, katav "vaychi adam" vegomer "vayyamot", vehaddavar muvan ki lo meet Adonai hayta zot velo chibbel maase yadav, ella hu hassovev.

rashi: Ze yenachamenu. yanach mimmennu et itztzevon yadenu. ad shello va noach lo haya lahem kele macharesha vehu hechin lahem vehayta haaretz motzia kotzim vedardarim keshezzorim chittim, mikkillato shel adam harishon, uvime noach nacha, vezehu yenachamenu, veim lo tefarshehu kach en taam hallashon nofel al hashshem veatta tzarich likrot shemo menachem:
Nivlaem. lannekiyyim keshehem chayyim:
Keshol. habbolea kol guf shalem:
Utemimim. eno leshon tzaddikim, ella milleshon shelemim: nivlaem keshehem shelemim, keadam hayyored betoch habbor keshehu shalem. kelomar: beodam beashram nahargem, venirash nichsehem:
targum: Nivlainun kishyol lechaye velidla mum hech nachate guva:

rashi: Elle. haamurim lemala:

Toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram beyom asot Adonai. limmedcha shekkullam nivreu varishon. davar acher behibbaram, baAdonai veraam, shen veyah Adonai tzur olamim (Yeshayahu 26), bev otiot hallalu shel hashshem yatzar shene olamim, velimmedcha chan shehaolam hazze nivra beHei, remez sheyyardu lematta lirot shachat kehe zot shessetuma mikkol tzedadim ufetucha lematta laredet derech sham:
ohc: Elle toldot vegomer. kevar rabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (Bereshit Rabba 81) hakkatuv, aval peshuto shel mikra lo noda.

Venire ki leheyot shekkadam vehodia hakkatuv ki amar Adonai lannivraim sheyyaasu gam hem toladot, lashshamayim lachlok hammayim veharebe peratim kaamur bedivrehem, velaaretz amar gam ken lehotzi chayyot ulehotzi atze perot vaasavim, velammayim amar "yishretzu hammayim" vegomer, kede shello yite adam veyachshov ki haaretz vehashshamayim meatzman asu happeulla vetolid hammachshava hallezu toladot meshubbashot. laze ba hakkatuv veamar elle toldot hashshamayim, perush: toladot shehotziu hashshamayim vehaaretz devar yom beyomo kakkatuv beseder hayyamim. lo tachshov ki hem asu haddevarim yesh meayin kederech habbore yitalle shemo shebbara hakkol yesh meayin, lo chen hu, ella "behibbaram beyom asot" shehu yom echad shebbara Adonai otam bechoach habberia shebbara Adonai bahem, bara sheyyotziu ma sheggazar alehem achar kach, kemo shebbara baadam koach hammolid bechoach ofen habberia shehitbia bo hu hayyotzer baruch hu habbore, veen adam ose davar, kemo chen hashshamayim vehaaretz.
Vetaam shello hizkir ella shamayim vaaretz, velo hizkir hammayim, ki hu kalul bashshamayim.

Veshiur tevat behibbaram keillu amar "bahem beraam" perush: lattoladot hannizkarim. o titparesh keshiur tevat "helichi" (Shemot 2:9), veamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba perek 1) ze shellichi, uchemo chen yechavven hakkatuv amro behibbaram perush: beotan haamurim besamuch beraam, uleolam hu hayyotzer hu habbore.

rashi: Chiddekel. shemmemav chaddin vekallin:
Ferat. shemmemav parin veravin vemavrin et haadam: kush veashshur. adayin lo hayu, vechatav hammikra al shem heatid:
Kidmat ashshur. lemizrachah shel ashshur:
Hu ferat. hechashuv al kullam, hannizkar al shem 11:
Vayvarech, vaykaddesh. bercho bamman, shekkol yemot hashshavua yored lahem omer laggulgolet, uvashshishshi lechem mishne, vekiddesho bamman, shello yarad kelal beshabbat, vehammikra katuv al heatid:
Asher bara elohim laasot. hammelacha shehayta reuya leasot bashshabbat, kafal vaasaah bashshishshi kemo shemmeforash bevr:
ohc: Vayvarech elohim vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hi habberacha, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 11,2) amru bercho bamman vechulei, vedivrehem zichronam livracha enam ella remez bakkatuv, aval happeshat lo yedabber al zeman mehazzemannim haatidin.

Vehannachon bemashmaut hakkatuv hu, ki leheyot shehaolam hazze tzarich hu leshefa hamekayyem, vehu bechinat haachila vehashshetiyya vetzarche haadam, vechullan mussagim al yede torach vigia haggashmit vechullin hi, vehashshem kesheratza lekaddesh yom hashshevii kadam uvercho shello yechsar bo davar, hagam sheen tovat haolam hashshafal musseget mehapperishut vehakkedushsha ella meesek chol, af al pi chen bercho shello yechsar tov, veod lo shehu yater al shear hayyamim lechem mishne shalosh seuddot vetaanugim yeterim, vezo hi birchato vehu davar hefech hasseder. ulema shepperash bazzohar (yitro pach.) ki beyom hashshabbat mishtalshel hashshefa shel kol sheshet yeme hammaase, yechuvvan al ze amro vayvarech ki vo tzivva Adonai et habberacha lechayyut haolamot.

Ki vo shavat vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv bemaamar ze. venire lefaresh lefi ma shekkatavnu lemala ki haolam haya chaser hakkiyyum ad shebbaata shabbat veamad haolam. veyesh lehair baze sheotam yamim kodem shebbaa shabbat bema haya haolam omed, ucheshem shehispik lichyot beotan yamim belo nefesh hashshabbat haya matmid veholech.

Achen matzinu ki hakkadosh baruch hu gilla haddavar bema sheamar (Shemot 20:11) baaseret haddibberot: "ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim" vegomer, hare gilla ki bishat habberia lo bara Adonai koach baolam zulat laamod sheshet yamim letaam hannoda lo gam yadua leyode emet. venitchakkem Adonai uvara yom echad hu yadua laAdonai, uvo bayyom chozer Adonai umashpia nefesh laolam shiur hamekayyem od sheshet yamim, vechen al ze hadderech. vezulat ze hayyom haya haolam charev bigmar sheshet yamim vechozer letohu vavohu, vetzarich Adonai lahachino paam 2, uveemtzaut shabbat haolam omed. vehu amro ki vo, perush: beemtzaut yom ze shavat mikkol melachto, uferesh ma hu hammelacha – hi habberia atzmah, ki lo mehattikkun shehu hammaase levad shavat, ella gam mehabberia. uchevar katavti lemala shehabberia hi yesh meayin, vehu ma shennivra beyom rishon bedibbur echad, vehammaase hu hattikkun asher tikken devar yom beyomo, uveemtzaut yom shabbat mashpia bichlalut haolamot ruach hamekayyemet od sheshet yamim.

Ulefi perushenu ze matzanu nachat ruach bemaamar echad sheamru zichronam livracha (shavat kayit:) "kol hamekaddesh vechulei veomer vaychullu vegomer keillu naasa shuttaf lehakkadosh baruch hu bemaase vereshit" ad kan. vedivrehem rechokim udechukim lefi hannire, mi shama kazot sheyyavo adam veyishtattef bedavar shekkevar nigmera melachto? en achar maase kelum uvamme yease shuttaf? od, ma hi happeulla haggedola hazzot shebbeemtzautah yassig hassaga zo? veod, lu yihye sheyyihye maase ze gadol ad meod, minnayin lahem lomar davar ze shehu naasa shuttaf? veim letzad hagedalat hassachar, haya lahem lehagedil secharo lechallek lo barabbim (Yeshayahu 53:12) veorech yamim ugevura veosher vechulei, uminnayin matzu lehaarich lashon letzad illaa lehishtattef immo bemaase vereshit?

Ulema shepperashti emet yehge chikkam udevar Adonai befihem emet betaam tzodek, ki leheyot shehashshabbat hu hamekayyem haolam kol sheshet yamim, veachar avor sheshet yamim yavo shabbat acheret vichayyehu vikayyemehu od sheshet yamim acherim. ulecha ladaat ki metziut hashshabbat baolam hu kiyyumo shemmekayyemim oto, ki im en mekayyemim shabbat en shabbat. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (shavat kanna:): challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe, veim en shomer shabbat ma zot osa. velaze kol hamekaddesh et hashshabbat vechulei, perush mekayyem veshomer kedushshato, beemtzaut ze yeshno leshabbat umeemtzauto mitkayyem haolam. hareta ladaat ki hu hamekayyem haolam veen lecha shuttaf gadol mizze kaddin vechahalacha. ulecha ladaat ki miyyom bero elohim adam lo chasar haolam davar hammaamid tzaddik yesod olam shehu shomer shabbat, ki adam shomer shabbat haya alav hashshalom (Bereshit Rabba 22), veacharav kam shet beno ki hu haya tzaddik gamur, veacharav kamma tzaddikim, ucheshezze nofel kevar ba hashshemesh shomer shabbat metushelach vechulei, noach, shem, avraham vechulei, umishsham lo paska shemirat shabbat miyyisrael, vaafillu bemitzrayim hayu shomre shabbatot kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1:32), venachon.

Vahagam shekkatavnu lemala beferush pasuk "vaychullu" (Bereshit 2:1) ki haamadat haolam hu becheshek hakebalat or hammakkif vehayyashar banneelamot, en ze machchish lidvarenu kan, ki zulat hashshabbat en hassaga baolam lehakkir lichsof velichlot el habbore, vehaven.

rashi: Terem yihye vaaretz. kol terem shebbammikra leshon ad lo hu, veeno leshon kodem, veeno nifal lomar hitrim, kaasher yomar hikdim veze mochiach, veod acher ki terem tirun (Shemot 9) adayin lo tirun, veaf ze tefaresh adayin lo haya vaaretz, keshennigmera veriat haolam bashshishshi kodem shenivra adam, vechol esev hassade terem yitzmach, adayin lo tzamach, uveg shekkatuv totze haaretz, lo yatzu, ella al petach karka amdu ad yom shishshi:

Ki lo himtir. umata lo himtir? lefi sheadam ayin laavod et haadama, veen makkir betovatam shel geshamim, ucheshebba adam veyada shehem tzorech laolam, hitpallel alehem veyardu vetzamchu hailanot vehaddeshaim:
Adonai elohim. Adonai hu shemo, elohim shehu shallit veshofet al kol, vechen perush ze bechol makom lefi peshuto, Adonai shehu elohim:
ohc: Vechol siach hassade vegomer. ba lehodia ma sheramaz befasuk rishon ki hu habbore hakkol al derech shepperashti. veamar ki haaretz lo hotzia tzimchah ad asher hishkah Adonai vehu amro: ki lo himtir vegomer. gam hodia ki chayyat hassade hu yetzira, keamro: "vayyitzer Adonai vegomer kol chayyat hassade" (Bereshit 2:19), ella shehechin golem mehaadama kemo shehechin tzurat adam, vehasheratzat hammayim remazah gam ken beamro "veof hashshamayim", uchevar amru zichronam livracha (chullin 27:) ki meharkak nivreu.

Od yechavven hakkatuv lomar bedakdek bakkatuv od amro, veadam ayin, ma hu hakkavvana behodaa zo. od lamma chazar lomar vayyitzer vegomer afar vegomer, uchevar hishmianu (Bereshit 1:27) "beyom bero elohim adam", veim ba lehashemienu ki min heafar berao, lamma hutzrach lichpol hodaat habberia? vehaya lo lehosif sham behodaat habberia velomar "afar min haadama"?

Achen yitbaer al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 94) ki adam harishon challato shel olam, ad kan, muvan middivrehem ki haolam din challa yesh bo, veshanu rabbotenu beferek 2 mimmassechet challa (challa 2:5) veze leshonam: hammafrish challato kemach vechulei enah challa, utenan beferek 3 (challa 3:1): "gilgel bachittim vechulei haochel mimmenna chayyav mita" ad kan. vehinne en metziut laaretz lehotzi mimmenna tzemachim zulat al yede hashekaat haaretz, veze hu gilgul baissa. umeatta kol tzimche haadama asurim kodem shehurema mimmenna challa shehu yetzirat haadam, ki haadama nitchayyeva bechalla vechol zeman shello hurema challatah tevel hi. vehu sheamar hakkatuv kan vechol siach hassade terem yihye vegomer vechol esev vegomer terem yitzmach, ki lo himtir bayyom hashshelishi laaretz lehotziam, ella haaretz nitabbera mehem bemaamaro yitbarach aval lo yatzu. vehattaam hu lihyot sheadam ayin shehu hachalla shel haaretz. veamar hattikkun sheasa Adonai lehotzi hatztzemachim veed yaale min haaretz vegilgel et kol afar haolam, keamro vehishka et kol vegomer vayyitzer Adonai vegomer et haadam afar vegomer, zo hi haramat hachalla. achar shennitchayyeva kol haaretz bechalla veherim Adonai challa zo, huttera kol haaretz utzemacheha, veim haya megalgel bammayim chelek echad mehaaretz lo haya yotze mikkelal tevel ella hachelek shennitgalgel.

Veyesh lecha ladaat ki afar shemmimmennu notzar haadam lo afar shel gan eden ella shel haolam, uchemo sheddiyyek hakkatuv (Bereshit 3:23): "laavod et haadama asher lukkach mishsham", aval gan eden lo hutzrach leharim mimmenna challa veachar kach yotzi mimmenna netaim ki kullah kodesh, velaze amar: vayyitta Adonai vegomer gan beeden mikkedem, perush kodem beriat haadam, keamram zichronam livracha (fesachim ned:) vehechinah laadam shehaya atzmo challa kodesh lehanot mikkodesh vechakkohen haochel bitruma.

rashi: Mi ivver bachem? en echad ki im avdi hu haivver shebbechullechem, vecheresh shebbachem hare hu kemalachi asher ani sholeach lehinnave nevuot:
Mi ivver kimshullam. mi haya ivver bachem, kevar kibbel yissurav, vahare hu kimshullam kol tagmulav veyotze naki:
targum: Hala im yetuvun rashiaya yitkeron avde vechayavaya dinviye shelachit alehon ela rashiaya atidin leishtalama pureanut chovehon beram im yetuvun yitkeron avdaya dayay:

rashi: Ki taavor bammayim. kesheavarta beyam suf ittecha hayiti:
Uvanneharot lo yishtefucha. garta ben hammitzrim vehaummot hamerubbin keme nahar, velo yachlu lecha lechallot:
Ki telech bemo esh. leatid lavo: "ki hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur" (Malachi 3:19), sheakdir chamma al harshaim, "velihat otam hayyom habba" (sham), gam sham lo tikkave:
Velehava. shettisrof haummot, kemo shenneemar "vehayu ammim misrefot sid" (Yeshayahu 33:12), gam hi lo tivar bach:
targum: Are vekadmeta kad avartun veyama desuf memri hava besadechon paro umitzrae desagiin keme nahara la yechilu lechon veaf betinyaneta kad tahachun levene ammaya detakifun keeshta la yichlun lechon umalkevan dachasinan keshalhovita la yeshetzun yatchon:

rashi: Vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo. bidfus heasuy lo, shehakkol nivra bemaamar vehu nivra bayyadayim, shenneemar vattashet alay kappecha (Tehillim 139); naasa vechotam kematbea haasuya al yede roshem shekkorin 166 109 vechen hu omer tithappech kechomer chotam (Iyov 38):
Betzelem elohim bara oto. peresh lecha sheoto tzelem hametukkan lo, tzelem deyokan yotzro hu:

Zachar unekeva bara otam. ulehallan hu omer vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav vegomer (Bereshit 2)? midrash aggada shebberao shene fartzufim bivria rishona, veachar kach chalako. ufeshuto shel mikra, kan hodiacha shennivreu shenehem bashshishshi velo fe lecha ketzad beriyyatan, uferesh lecha bemakom acher:
ohc: Vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo. perush betzalmo hannikkar baadam, vehakkavvana shebbara galmo vegam tzalmo. veachar kach amar betzelem elohim, baze hodianu hatztzelem shebberao bo ki hu tzelem elohim.

Od yirtze lomar ki bara haadam biv tzelamim: harishon tzelem hannikkar bechol adam, vaafillu bivne adam harekim mehakkedushsha asher lo mibbene yisrael hemma, vaalehem amar betzalmo perush shel hannivra. vehav hem bechinat hameushsharim am yisrael nachalat shadday, keneged ellu amar betzelem elohim berao. hare ze ba lelammedenu ki yesh bannivraim 2 tzelamim: tzelem hannikkar vetzelem elohim ruchani nelam, vehaven:

rashi: Tehillato miktze haaretz. al karcham, kesheyyiru et gevurati leyisrael, yodu kol haovde kochavim umazzalot ki elohim ani:
Yorde hayyam. porse bisfinot:
Umeloo. hakkevuim bayyam, velo baiyyim, ella betoch hammayim shofchim afar kol echad veechad kede bayit, veholchim mibbayit levayit bisfina, kegon ir vevnitziy:
targum: Shabbachu kodam Adonai tushebachta chadta emaru tushebachte misyafe ara nachate yama umelaah nagvan veyatvehon:

rashi: Vayyikra haadam. chazar hakkatuv leinyano harishon vayyikra haadam shemot, velo hifsik ella lelammedcha sheal yede keriat shemot nizdavvega lo chavva, kemo shekkatuv uleadam lo matza ezer kenegdo, lefichach, vayyappel tardema, veal yede shekkatav vayyihyu arummim, samach lo parashat hannachash, lehodiach shemmittoch sheraa ervatah veraa otam asukim betashmish nitavva lah uva alehem bemachashava uvemirma:
Chavva. nofel al leshon chayya, shemmechayya et valdoteha, kaasher tomar me hove laadam (Kohelet 2), bilshon haya:
ohc: Vayyikra haadam shem vegomer. yesh latet lev lamma lo kara lah shem beshaa rishona, kodem kol maase asher naasa.

Da ki zot haishsha kevar nitallet leshevach, vekara lah Adonai shem yachad im balah, keamro "vayyikra et shemam adam" – shem lithilla uletiferet, ki shem ze adam hiv shem meulle, uchemaamar hannavi (Yechezkel 34:31): "adam attem", veamru zichronam livracha (yevamot 61.) attem keruyim adam vechulei. umeatta en makom leadam likrot shem lechavva, ma sheen ken achar maase sheshshama ledivre mesit vehezida beetz haddaat yarda mibbechinatah vechasra shem hameulle. vechen midda zo baolam shekkol sheyyazid adam yechsar shemo, keamro (Mishlei 10:7): "veshem reshaim yirkav" rachamana litzlan. laze ba haadam vekara lah shem al maaseha shehayta em kol chay. vahagam sheggam sheadam chata, kevar katavti lemala sheshshogeg haya baddavar.

Veod gam lo hukkera yerida lefi shaa, shekkara lo hakkatuv kan "haadam" 3 o 4 peamim. veyesh lecha ladaat ki bechinat "haadam" hi pechuta mibbechinat shem "adam", kaamur bemassechet avoda zara (avoda zara 3.) veze leshonam: amar rabbi yirmeya (haggirsa baggemara rabbi meir, ulam hattosafot besanhedrin 59. katvu veyesh mefarshim degarsinan rabbi yirmeya, haggaha) "asher yaase otam haadam" vegomer – kohanim uleviyyim lo neemar vechulei, afilu goy haosek battora vechulei. vehikshu Rashi vetosafot maamar ze im maamar rabbi shimon bar yochay sheamar: attem keruyim adam vechulei, vetertzu hattosafot sheyyesh hefresh umaala ben "adam" lehaadam", ki "adam" hiv haggadol vehameshubbach vechulei. vahagam sherashi zichrono livracha katav (sanhedrin 59.) shecholkim hattannaim, im kol ze divre hattosafot ikkar, ki matzinu beferush bedivre rashbi shemmechallek kedivre hattosafot. vetaam haddavar hiv ki "adam" hiv becheshbono 45, ushemo shel hakkadosh baruch hiv havaya bemilluy alfin yaale chen, uvetosefet hahe tovad hakkavvana harmuza. velaze kara lo "haadam" achar shechata, aval lo nishar birida zo, shemmatzinu lo shechazar Adonai ukerao "adam", dichtiv "vayyeda adam od et ishto", vechazar lemaalato ki cheto shogeg hiv.

Od yesh lomar taam keriat shem achar kol hammaase. vekodem yesh lehair lamma yityachasu eleha hachayyim velo yityachasu el haadam, ki gam hiv av kol chay. od yesh lehair ki lattaam haamur haya tzarich likrotah chayya velo chavva. achen hakkavvana hi lihyot shennitchaddeshu bah 2 devarim: ha, sheshshama divre hammesit kara otah al shemo, vehu amro chavva milleshon chivya shehu hannachash, uchemo chen huva besefer hazzohar (zohar chodesh Bereshit 19), vehav shennigzar aleha leled beetzev. laze kara lah chavva velo keraah chivya, lirmoz ki hi hayta em kol chay, kevan shehi sovelet haitztzavon shel herayon veshel leda, lah yaata lehityaches em kol chay velo laadam. velo amar hakkatuv ella taam shehu bilti muchash bemashmaut hashshem, ki remez hachivya nikkar hiv bashshem. gam semach haddavar lemaase hannachash yaggid haddavar.

rashi: Mishle. kol devarav dugmot umeshalim; meshal hattora beishsha tova, umeshal haovde gillulim beishsha zona:
targum: Matloy dishlomo bar david malka deyisrael:

rashi: Vayyitzer. shete yetzirot, yetzira laolam hazze vitzira litchiyyat hammetim, aval babbehema sheenah omedet laddin lo nichtav bitziratah shene yodin:

Afar min haadama. tzavar afro mikkol haadama mearba ruchot, shekkol makom sheyyamut sham tehe kolatto likvura. davar acher natal afaro mimmakom shenneemar bo mizbach adama taase li (Shemot 20), halevay tihye lo chappara veyuchal laamod:

Vayyippach beappav. asao min hattachtonim umin haelyonim, guf min hattachtonim uneshama min haelyonim, lefi shebbeyom rishon nivreu shamayim vaaretz, bashsheni bara rakia laelyonim, bashshelishi terae hayyabbasha lattachtonim, barvii bara meorot laelyonim, bachamishi yishretzu hammayim lattachtonim, huzkak bashshishshi livroot bo vaelyonim uvattachtonim, veim lav yesh kina vemaase vereshit, sheyyihyu ellu rabbim al ellu bivriat yom echad:
Lenefesh chayya. af behema vechayya nikreu nefesh chayya, ach zo shel adam chayya shebbechullan, shenittosef bo dea vedibbur:
Hachershim vehaivrim. al yisrael hu omer:
targum: Rashiaya deinun kechershin hala udenin lechon shemau vechayavaya deinun kesaman hala aynin lechon istakkalu vachazo:

rashi: Vayyaas. tikkenam betzivyonam uvekomatan:
ohc: Vayyaas elohim – perush beriat nefesh hachiyyunit al derech shepperashnu besheretz hammayim (Bereshit 1:21). verashi peresh beofen acher, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

Vayyihyu kol yeme adam vegomer. taam shehutzrach hakkatuv lehodia perat uchelal shel hashshanim lelo tzorech, velo hispik bifrat levad keseder shellakach hakkatuv befarashat noach. hu lihyot shechayye kol hannivraim hem ketzuvim vacharutzim miyyom halleda, dichtiv (Iyov 14:5): "im charutzim yamav", veadam harishon leheyot shennotzar lichyot tamid im lo haya chote, uchemo shekkatavnu lemala, lo hayta lo kitzva. vehu sheamar vayyihyu kol yeme adam asher chay, hakkavvana lo hakketzuvim lo miyyom heyoto ki lo hayta lo kitzva, vekitzvato hayta baolam hazze naasa lo hakkitzva asher chay velo asher niktzevu lo. uma shekkatav perat uchelal meadam vead noach lehodia ki kullam shalmu yemehem asher katzvu lahem, veen kavvanat hakkatuv beamro vayyihyu kol yeme vegomer letzaref hassach, ella lomar "vayyihyu kol yeme" vegomer hem yamim hakketzuvim lo miyyom heyoto, shello katzvu lo yoter meolam haelyon, velo amar "asher chay", shettavin shecheshbon ma shechay hu mone kederech shekkatav beadam kemo shepperashti vehaven.

rashi: Naase adam. anvetanuto shel hakkabba lamadnu mikkan, lefi sheadam hu bidmut hammalachim veyitkanneu vo, lefichach nimlach bahem, ucheshehu dan et hammelachim hu nimlach befamalya shello, shekken matzinu veachav, sheamar lo micha raiti et Adonai yoshev al kiso vechol tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav mimino umissemolo (Melachim 1 22), vechi yesh yamin usemol lefanav? ella ellu mayminim lizchut veelu masmeilim lechova, vechen bigzerat irin pitgama uvememar kaddishin sheelta (Daniel 4), af kan befamalya shelo natal reshut, amar lahem yesh baelyonim kidmuti; im en kidmuti vattachtonim hare yesh kina vemaase vereshit:

Naase adam. aappi shello siyyeuhu vitzirato veyesh makom lamminim lirdot, lo nimna hakkatuv millelammed derech eretz umiddat anava sheyyehe haggadol nimlach venotel reshut min hakkatan; veim katav eese adam, lo lamadnu sheyyehe medabber im bet dino, ella im atzmo, uteshuvat hamminim katav betziddo, vayyivra et haadam, velo chatav vayyivreu:
Betzalmenu. bidfus shellanu:
Kidmutenu. lehavin ulehaskil:
Veyirdu vidgat hayyam. yesh ballashon hazze leshon ridduy uleshon yerida; zacha, rode vachayyot uvabbehemot, lo zacha, naase yarud lifnehem vehachayya moshelet bo:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim naase adam vegomer. hakkavvana baze ki lo bara Adonai et haadam kivriat sheretz hammayim vesheretz haaretz, asher amar lammayim vehishritzu veamar laaretz vehotzia, ella hu habbore amar shehu yaase haadam.

Veamar naase ki hu mekor haanava, laze dibber bilshon rabbim, ki chen yedabber yachid heanav, velo chash latet makom letaut, ki hikdim lomar "vayyomer elohim" shem yachid. Adonai hu haelohim hu bichvodo uveatzmo kivyachol gaval afaro vehefiach bo ruach chayyim. od yirtze beamro naase bilshon rabbim, ki middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu rabbim hem, 13 middot rachamim veshem elohim shehu middat haddin hiskimu yachad livro adam.

Veamro betzalmenu kidmutenu, efshar sheyyechavven lomar sheyyihye bo tzad harachamim vetzad haddin, lehafeil bahem darche haddin vedarche harachamim laasher yikkonu, vehaven. vehu sod amro (Bereshit 2:7) "vayyitzer Adonai elohim" vegomer. veamro veyirdu yaskim leferushenu, leheyot shehabberia hi behiddamut labbore bivchinot harachamim vehaddin, bedin hu sheyyihye moshel bannivraim, ki yesh bo bechinat harachamim larauy velatztzarich elav, ulehamit lammitchayyev baddin. vehishlito bakkol, vahagam shello hizkir shelita bammayim, ramuz beamro "bidgat hayyam", hare hizkir hayyam bannishlatim.

Uvederech remez ramaz beamro leshon yerida, al derech ma shehodiunu zichronam livracha (sefer haggilgulim), ki beemtzaut maase haadam yered bemadregato mibbechinat adam livchinat dagim velivchinat ofot velivchinat behema velivchinat sheratzim, kefi erech hachet yishpal adam mibbechinat maalato ad asher yered matta matta rachamana litzlan. vehu sheramaz kan bishat habberia chelke yeridot hahadragot shebbahem yekabbel ansho, vegam shebbeemtzautam yachzor lesharsho. vehikdim lomar yeridat nefesh adam lemadregat haddagim, ki yerida hameyoedet lannefashot haramot ki yechetu hi shettered nafsham lehitgalgel baddagim, velaze yiches hakkatuv lahem bimkomam asifa ki en lahem lehitztaer betzaar shechitat cherev ella asifatam matteret otam (chullin 27:). veachar kach amar yerida happechuta mimmenna vehu gilgul hannefesh baof, veze yitztarech tzaar yeter al haddagim, vetzivva Adonai baruch hu bo chatzi shechita, keotah sheshshaninu rov echad baof. veachar kach amar yerida babbehema shehi bechina gerua yoter vetzaaro merubbe, keotah sheshshaninu (sham) rov shenayim babbehema. veachar kach amar yerida shehi bedomem vetzomeach vehu amro uvechol haaretz, tevat "haaretz" taggid al haddomem vetevat "bechol" ramaz bah hatztzomeach. vechol ellu hem yeridot hannefashot asher yeshnam betikvat hattikkun lashuv lekadmutam, ki mehaddomem yaale latztzomeach umehatztzomeach yikkanes bevaal chay bilti medabber, umibbaal chay bilti medabber yaale levaal chay medabber. veyeshno od birida pechuta vehu killayon sheen acharav tikva, vehi yerida livchinat shekatzim uremasim. ze avda tikvato, vehem bechinot harshaim hammemirin datam, poshe yisrael asher hifliu asot.

rashi: Zu chatanu lo. zo hi sheggarma et hammeshissa vehabbaz, et asher chatanu lo:
Velo avu. avotenu bidrachav haloch:
targum: Man mesar laade yaakov veyisrael livzozin hala Adonai min kodam dechavu kodamohi vela avu lemehach beorchan detaknan kodamohi vela kabbilu ulefan orayte:

rashi: E hevel achicha. lekanes immo bedivre nachat, ulay yashuv veyomar: ani haragtiv vechatati lecha:
Lo yadati. naasa kegonev daat haelyona:
Hashshomer achi. leshon tema hu, vechen kol hei hannekuda bachataf pattach:
Velo tiggeu bo. hosifa al hatztziuuy, lefichach baa lide geraon, hu shenneemar al tosp al devarav (Mishlei 30):

Veeva ashit. atta lo nitkavvanta ella sheyyamut adam kesheyyochal hu techilla vetissa et chavva, velo vata ledabber el chavva techilla ella lefi shehannashim kallot lehitpattot veyodot lefattot et balehen, lefichach veeva ashit:
Yeshufecha. yechattetcha (sota 9) kemo vaekkot oto (Devarim 9), vetargumo veshafit yate:

Veatta teshufennu akev. lo yehe lecha koma vetishshechennu baakevo, veaf mishsham temitennu, uleshon teshufennu kemo nashaf bahem (Yeshayahu 40) keshehannachash ba linshoch hu noshef kemin sherika ulefi shehallashon nofel al hallashavon ketiv leshon neshifa vishnehem:
ohc: Veeva vegomer. dan haddayyan din goel haddam, ki leheyot shellechol zera haishsha garam lo mita yirdof goel haddam vehikka et harotzeach, vehu amro hu yeshufecha rosh, perush ma sheasita lo battechilla ki hu patach baraa. o yomar "rosh" al shem rosh sheshsham teluyim hachayyim vesham hu shechitat malach hammavet. veatta teshufennu akev al asher nimshach lecha levassof mehem shebbau alav kol hakkelalot, o yomar akev shennifseku akevav veholech al gechono.

Veim tomar: bishlama amro "hu yeshufecha rosh" yesh taam, ki yecham levav enosh al asher asa hannachash veharog yahargennu, aval hannachash ma shennatal mehakkelalot hu onesh al asher kevar asahu, uma makom lashuf akev? hattaam hu, leheyot ki yesh maane befi hannachash shello haya lah lishmoa lidvarav, ki divre harav vedivre hattalmid divre mi shomim (sanhedrin 29.), velo haya nimshach ra lo lo velo lah. ha lamadta shehi hassovevet, uletzad bechinat taana zo tihye lo eva immah. veramaz zeman hassagat nitztzachon shel kol echad mehem, veamar hu yeshufecha bizman sheyyihye rosh, perush sheyyagdil maalato veyitnasse bivchinat hattora vehammitzvot, veatta teshufennu kesheyyihye akev birida. vechen hu kol zeman sheyyisrael osim retzono shel makom nachash kofef rosho, ulehefech bar minnan. od yirmoz maase shel rabbi chanina ben dosa (berachot log.) shenneshacho nachash beraglo umet hannachash, uchefi ze shaf oto beraglo merosho shel nachash.

rashi: Zot happaam. melammed shebba adam al kol behema vechayya, velo nitkarra dato bahem (yevamot 63):
Lezot yikkare ishsha ki meish vegomer. lashon nofel al lashon mikkan shennivra haolam bilshon hakkodesh (Bereshit Rabba):

Vehannachash haya arum. ma inyan ze lechan? haya lo lismoch vayyaas leadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem, ella limmedcha meezo etza kafatz hannachash alehem, raa otam arummim veoskim betashmish leen kol venitavva lah:
Arum mikkol. lefi armato ugedullato hayta mappalato, arum mikkol, arur mikkol (Bereshit Rabba):
Af ki amar vegomer. shemma amar lachem lo tochlu mikkol vegomer, veaappi sheraa otam ochlim mishshear perot, hirba aleha devarim kede shetteshivennu veyavo ledabber beoto haetz:
ohc: Vehannachash haya arum vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze sibba hodianu hakkatuv ki hannachash haya arum?
Od natatti libbi latur haarma asher heerim bainyan, velo raiti ella devar rishut vechachma niflet mimmennu.

Achen yitbaer hainyan behavin kavvanat devarav beamro af ki amar vegomer, shennirim devarav kedivre holelut, asher al ken kadam hakkatuv lehodia ki hannachash haya arum, kede lehitbonen baamarav shebbahem hissig lehasit ulehaddiach ishsha yirat Adonai.
Vehinne beseder devarav nitkavven lomar 3 inyanim, uvahem hissig kavvanato.

1, Ba lehodia otah yedia achat ki kevan shello hissiga leechol meetz haddaat yihye haddavar beeneha keillu enah ochelet mikkol etz haggan. hakkavvana baze ki chullan keayin negdo vehayu kelo hayu legodel maalato vachashivuto vechulei, vehu amro af ki amar vegomer, perush yihye beenayich keillu nitztavvet al hakkol, nitkavven baze lehagedil cheshkah bo ulehavzot kol taavoteha bechol atze haggan. vezo hi hammidda asher mitnaheg bah hayyetzer hara im hannishmaim lo, sheyyasir mehem taavat hahetter veyamisennu beenehem veyagdil beenehem taavat haissur ad en kamohu.

2, Nitkavven seder pittuy acher, vehu ki more horaa hu lah, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit 18) ki etz haddaat hu shennata Adonai techilla baggan umimmennu shatal kol hailanot shebbaggan, velaze ba hammesit veamar shehagam shello asar Adonai ella etz haddaat, titchayyev lomar sheaf kol shear haetzim shebbaggan asar, ki dan bahem din haveracha, utenan beferek 1 mimmassechet arla hivrichah shana achar shana mone lah mishshana shennifsak, ad kan. vehakkavvana baze ki kodem shennifsak hagam shehem musherashot baaretz af al pi chen ikkar yenikatam mehailan vehayu keanfe hailan hazzaken, vechen pershu rambam versh. vehu shettaan hammesit beamro af ki amar vegomer perush ki im tekabbel aleha lekayyem davar ze tzericha hi lehibbadel mehakkol, letzad shekkol atze haggan odennam yonkot meetz haddaat, betoano, ki muverachim hem vaadayin lo nifseku, ki zeman muat haya mizzeman shennata Adonai haggan leet tzauoto alav.

3, Nitkavven beamro af vegomer, leheyot, ki chavva lo nitztavvet mippi habbore ella mippi adam, uchemo shepperashnu bimkomo, laze ba hammesit veamar lah hodaa achat, ki mitzvat Adonai aleha hi shello tochal mikkol etz haggan, ki hu ed baddavar shekken tzivva Adonai aleha. vechavvanat hammesit 2 machshavot leinyan ze leraa: ha, taamin devarav veteesor hakkol, veaz yikkanes betaanat meniat haefshariyyut veyesh lo mavo lehikkanes bo lehasit. vehav, nitkavven kede shettihye edut adam shetztzivva lah al etz haddaat levad edut muchcheshet, vehi sevarat bet shammay beferek 4 mimmassechet eduyyot: mi shehayu 2 kitte edim meidot oto, ellu meidot shennadar 2 veellu meidot shennadar Adonai, bet shammay omrim nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut, uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal Adonai 2, ad kan. uvesanhedrin (lo.) heemidu machloket bet shammay uvet hillel bechat achat, perush, echad mehav amar Adonai veechad amar 2 vechulei. umeatta chashav hammesit kevan shello hayu ella 2, adam amar lo asar ella etz haddaat, vehammesit amar hakkol asar, nechleka haedut. veachar shekkatavti ze matzati maamar echad betikkune hazzohar tikkun 59 shemmaskim leferushenu, shekkatav veze leshono: vechivya bisha aavar hacha al lo taane vereacha ed shaker desahid shikra sheamar "af ki amar elohim" vegomer ad kan. vezo hi middato leshakker uleholid bilvav enosh emunot vedeot kozvot rachamana litzlan, velifamim yitkavven lehafelig ulehagdil averot belev adam, veyashuv lomar lo ki hu mehannimna bammussag, veen lecha arum baolam kaze.

Vetaam sheasa Adonai kacha, leheyot shekkol machshevet Adonai hu letzad hassagat tov hammufla, vehu taluy bivchinat avoda zo. laze higdil bechinat armato vichalto, ulefi hatztzaar sheyyisbol adam veyitchakkem lehinnatzel mimmennu yaale bemaalot.

Vayyomer el haishsha vegomer. perush: batztziftzuf asher yedabberu bo habbaale chayyim bilti medabberim, veaz hayu makkirim kol tziftzufe vechulei, vaafillu sichat haddomem. ki chol ma shebbara Adonai yesh lo kefi bechinato dibbur letaam asher yeshabbach et kono, keamro (Mishlei 16:4) "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu", vetze ulemad mippirke shira. umatzanu ligdole yisrael shehayu makkirim bechol tziftzuf vesicha, keamram zichronam livracha (socha koach:) amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay alav hashshalom vechulei, umikkol shekken adam harishon yetzir kappav yitbarach.

rashi: Vayyar elohim et haor ki tov vayyavdel. af baze anu tzerichin ledivre aggada, raahu sheeno cheday lehishtamesh bo reshaim, vehivdilo latztzaddikim leatid lavo. ulefi peshuto kach parshehu, raahu ki tov, veen nae lo velachoshech sheyyihyu mishtammeshim beirbuveya, vekava laze techumo bayyom, velaze techumo ballayla:
Arura haadama baavurecha. maala lecha devarim arurim, kegon zevuvim, paroshim unemalim, mashal leyotze letarbut raa vehabberiyyot mekallelot shadayim sheyyanak mehem:
ohc: Uleadam amar vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan makpid Adonai al shemiato lekol ishto, shello haya lo lomar ella "ki achalta min haetz" vegomer? od lamma dikdek lomar lekol ishtecha? od tzarich ladaat amro tevat lemor. achen lefi ma shepperashnu ki adam lo yada beet achlo ki etz haddaat hu, lo yutzdak lomar lo "ki achalta min haetz" vegomer, ki hu lo achal min haetz bidia ella beshogeg. laze amar elav Adonai ki shamata vegomer, perush shekkibbel divre ishto velo badak achareha, venimshach lo mizze sheachal min haetz. vedikdek lomar lekol lirmoz shello bachan bidvareha, ella lahavarat devareha sheamra lo "kach veechol" achal, vehaya lo lishol meeze etz lakcha. veamro vattochal min haetz asher tzivviticha lemor, kan ramaz hachet sheshshagag bo, ki hu tzivva lo lemor laishsha shello tochal min haetz, vehu amro "haetz asher tzivviticha lemor", perush lomar lehaishsha, vehu lo amar lehaishsha ella mehapperi kemo sheddiyyaknu devareha.

Veamro arura haadama velo killel laadam kemo shekkillel lechavva mittaam haamur bidvarav, kemo shekkatavnu, vekillel lehaadama ki hi sibba, ki hagam shehaadam tzivva lehaishsha al happeri levad velo al haetz, im kol ze lo haya baze michshol, im lo haya hashshinnuy sheshshinneta haadama beetz haddaat vehaya etzo kishar atze haggan, lo haya sibba lehachet, kemo shekkatavnu lemala. gam im hayta osa kol atze haggan taam haetz ketaam happeri, haya haadam nizhar lomar lechavva ki nitztavvet gam al haetz, vehi gam hi lo hayta sholachat yad baetz mikkodem. gam lo hayta mitpallet bo beshannoto et tamo shel etz mishshear atze haggan. laze killel Adonai lehaadama ki hi hayta sibba lakkol, shettotzi min kelala. uleadam lo killel ella shebbeemtzaut kelala zo shillem lo Adonai midda keneged midda, hu shama leishto veasa cheftzo betaavat achilat devar issur, gam hu tamid beitztzavon vegomer vetatzmiach lo kotzim vegomer. ucheneged arevut haachila amar lo veachalta et esev hassade. ucheneged shello tarach ladaat minnayin huva elav haochel amar bezeat appecha vegomer, shello yassig ochel bimnucha belo torach.

rashi: Vayyishmeu. yesh midreshe aggada rabbim uchevar sidderum rabbotenu al mechonam bivra uvishar midrashot; vaani lo vati ella lifshuto shel mikra uleaggada hameyashshevet divre hammikra davar davur al ofnav: vayyishmeu. ma shamu? shamu et kol hakkabba shehaya mithallech baggan:
Leruach hayyom. leoto ruach shehashshemesh baa lesham, vezo hi maaravit; shellifnot erev chamma bammaarav, vehem sarchu baasirit (sanhedrin 38):
ohc: Vayyishmeu vegomer leruach hayyom. taam shehodia hakkatuv seder mahalacho hu lomar shebbaze yadu livchon makom sheyyihyu nechbaim mippanav, vehu amro mithallech leruach hayyom, perush letzad maarav haggan vehem amdu beemtza haggan.
