rashi: Ayyekka. yodea haya hechan hu ella likkanes immo bidvarim, shello yehe nivhal lehashiv im yaanishehu pitom (Bereshit Rabba), vechen bekayin amar lo e hevel achicha (Bereshit 4), vechen bevilam mi haanashim haelle immach (Bamidbar 22), likkanes immahem bidvarim, vechen bechizkiyya bishluche merodach baladan:
ohc: Vayyomer lo ayyekka. perush: lamma atta mitchabbe veencha mitrae lefanay? veheshiv ki yare laamod lefanav letzad reot atzmo erom, veasur laamod lifne sefer tora erom, vechol shekken lifne haadon yitbarach. uleferushenu befasuk "vattippakachna" vegomer, shehirgishu biridatam uvefishehem, ana ki nichlam birot atzmo erom mizzohora dikdushsha. gam lefi maamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba) shennifshat mimmalbush shellavsho hammelech, ki im al heyoto erom mammash hu omer, halo tafar ale teena.

rashi: Deme achicha. damo vedam zariyyotav. davar acher, sheasa vo petzaim harebe, shello haya yodea mehechan nafsho yotza (sanhedrin 37):
Totze haaretz. hu shepperashti shehakkol nivra miyyom rishon, velo hutzrechu ella lehotziam:
Nefesh chayya. sheyyesh bah chayyut:
Varemes. hem sheratzim, shehem nemuchim veromsim al haaretz venirim keillu nigrarim sheen hiluchan nikkar. kol leshon remes vesheretz bilshonenu kavenamevaberaysh 109:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim vegomer. gam ze lo haya ella lefi shaa kederech shepperashnu bivriat sheretz hammayim (Bereshit 1:20). vetaam shello hutzrach lomar lahem sheyyifru, halo hitbia bahem haholada vehem meatzmam yaldu, ella shetztzivva lahem shello yitarvu min besheeno mino, vehu amro leminah vegomer:

rashi: Vattotze haaretz vegomer. aappi shello neemar leminehu baddeshain betziuuyehen, shamu shennitztauu hailanot al kach, nasu kava beatzman, kammeforash baaggada bishchitat chullin:
ohc: Vattotze haaretz vegomer. achar sheamar hakkatuv "vayhi chen" lo haya tzarich lomar kol pasuk ze, ella hattaam hu lehashemienu 2 devarim mechuddashim – echad baddeshaim veechad baetz. echad baddeshaim sheasu kal vachomer veyatzu leminehem. vetzarich ladaat leeze inyan hodianu hakkatuv shello yatzu beirbuveya, veulay ki lehodienu ba sheen leharekiv deshaim ze baze, vechidbae ravina bemassechet chullin (daf 60), veze leshonam: hirkiv deshaim ze al gav ze lerabbi chanina bar pappa mahu, kevan delo ketiv behu "leminehu" vechulei, o dilma kevan dehiskim hakkadosh baruch hu aydayhu keman dichtiv bahen leminehu damya – teku, ad kan. uferesh Rashi bedibbur hammatchil "lerabbi chanina" veze leshono: deamar middatan yatzu leminehem velo nitztauu al kach, ad kan. mashma middevarav dehashshas sover ki min hassetam nitztauu al kach, vahagam shello huzkar beferush samuch laddeshaim, ma sheamar hakkatuv "lemino" levassof chozer al haetz veal haddeshe. vehinne lefi divre rabbi chanina bar pappa delo amar Adonai "leminehu" ella laetz vehaddeshaim nasu kal vachomer, hishmianu hakkatuv bema shechazar lomar "vattotze haaretz" shehaddeshaim nasu hakkal vachomer. ulemay desover hashshas, im lo haya divre rabbi chanina bar pappa sheamro "lemino" chozer gam al haddeshaim, nire ki yashmienu shehaddeshaim hevinu haddevarim al bureyan, shemma sheamar "lemino" gam al haddeshaim hu omer, veze lo haya muvan lanu mippasuk rishon. vahagam sheamar bappasuk rishon "vayhi chen", af al pi chen en muvan amro "lemino" im chozer lechol haamur bappasuk, uva hakkatuv hav vehichria shechozer amro "leminehu" lechol haamur bakkatuv. umikkan atta lamed shebbechol makom sheyyomar Adonai keseder haddevarim hanneemarim beinyan ze, shepperush devarav hem kemo sheppaalu haddeshaim.
Vehodianu hakkatuv bemifal hotzaat haetz, ki haaretz lo kiyyema maamar habbore, shehu amar lah "etz peri" – sheetz atzmo yihye tamo ketaam peri, vehi hotzia "etz ose peri", velo chen haetz atzmo.

Veel ze abbit ech timrod haaretz beroka haaretz, uma gam ki en lah yetzer hara, shello hochichu chachamim (berachot 61.) sheyyesh lah yetzer hara ki im labbehema middevaata vechulei, uferashnuhu bimkomo (besefer chafetz Adonai) ki letzad shehi tzericha lechush hayyetzer lehizzakek asa hakkadosh baruch hu lah yetzer hamechammem, aval haaretz lo matzinu lah sheyyesh lah yetzer hara sheyyesitah limrod mered laavor pi Adonai.

Od yesh lachkor zot, ki lo matzinu muzkar babberia sheamar hashshem shettotzi haaretz ilane serak letashmish etzim, veanu roim sheggiddela bechinat haetzim shehem baolam en ketz, rabbu meilane perot. velaze efshar lomar ki kodem killat haaretz asher errah hashshem, hayu kol hailanot osim perot, ella achar shekkillel haadama nitmaet kochah velo hayu kol hailanot osim perot, ella kotzim vedardarim.

Achen perushan shel devarim hu ki haaretz dikdeka bechachmat Adonai asher yasad bah, dichtiv (Mishlei 3:19) "bechachma yasad aretz", dikdeka maamar Adonai lah shettotzi etz peri ose peri shessovel 2 derachim: haechad sheyyihye haetz tamo ketaam piryo, sheaz tihye hakkavvana sheyyihye haetz peri vegam ose peri. umeamro "ose peri" persha derech acher, shehakkavvana hu al ze hadderech: etz peri levad veose peri levad, perush etz sheyyaase peri levad meharishon vehem 2 minim. vetaam shello amar "veose peri" beVav shello lehavin sheyyihye haetz atzmo peri veod lo sheyyaase peri. gam bemashmaut "etz peri" yesh bah 2 derachim: ha etz shehu atzmo peri, vehav shehu rauy laasot peri vehu eno ose peri. venitchakkema haadama vehotzia 3 minim hannishmaim bedivre Adonai lerov zerizutah: ha hem ilanot sheosim perot veen taam etzam ketaam piryam, vehav sheosim perot vetaam etzo ketaam piryo vehu etz haddaat tov vara sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba parasha 15) shehaya taam etzo ketaam piryo, vehag hu etz shehu dome leetz peri vehem ilane serak, vahare hi nizdarza laasot kol hannishma. vehu sheamar hakkatuv vattotze haaretz deshe vegomer veetz ose peri, dikdek lomar veetz betosefet vav lelo tzorech, kemo shekken dibber hakkatuv besamuch bedivre Adonai shello hutzrach lomar "veetz" betosefet 6. nitkavven hakkatuv lomar millevad shear etzim shehotzia, hotzia od etz ose peri. vechan ribba etz peri sheamru zichronam livracha sheetz haddaat haya taam etzo ketaam piryo. veefshar dechalal gam ken etzim sheenam osim peri sheyyeshnam baolam, lichshennomar shehayu kodem killat haadama. vetaam shekkillel Adonai haadama leman deamar al asher shinneta afaresh bimkomo besiyyata dishmayya.

rashi: Veirad yalad. yesh makom shehu omer bezachar holid veyesh makom shehu omer yalad, shehalleda meshammeshet shete leshonot, ledat haishsha nayshateraa belaaz uzeriat toldot haish aynazeyrear belaaz. keshehu omer holid bilshon hifil, medabber beledat haishsha – peloni holid et ishto ben o vat, keshehu omer yalad, medabber bizriat haish:
Yikkavu hammayim. shehayu shetuchin al pene chol haaretz vehikvam baokyanos hu hayyam haggadol shebbechol hayyammim:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim yikkavu. tzarich ladaat mayim ellu im hem me hattehomiyyim, uveamro "yikkavu hammayim el makom echad" hinne lo nisharu memot acherim od, veze hefech ma sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 20:4) "vaasher bammayim mittachat laaretz", veim hem mayim acherim levad hattehom, tzarich ladaat bamme hayu muvdalim mimmeme hattehom leyached haddibbur lahem levaddam. gam lo rainu sheyyiched haddibbur lomar mayim peloni yikkavu ella setam "yikkavu hammayim" – kol memot hannimtzaim baolam bemashma. od lamma tala reiyyat hayyabbasha bikviat hammayim. od tzarich ledakdek tevat "veterae" shehaya lo lomar "vetihye hayyabbasha":

Uvema shepperashti befasuk "bereshit" shebbemaamar rishon nivra hakkol, ella haya meurbav ad shehechin Adonai seder kol echad devar yom beyomo, uchefi ze middivre Adonai bemaamar ze anu yodim ki hayyabbasha hayta shetucha toch hammayim lerochav haolam, umayim lemala umayim lematta lah, veotam hammayim shellemala layyabbasha chillekam harakia venasa chetzyam bichnafav, keamro yehi rakia betoch, usetam "toch" emtza bemashma, vachatzi hannishar haya mechasse layyabbasha, uleotam mayim amar Adonai yikkavu el makom echad, shehu me okyanos, veterae hayyabbasha bammakom shehayta bo beet beriatah, ki sham kanta mekomah ella shehayta mechussa vegazar aleha shetterae.

Veulay sheyyikkanes bemashmaut "terae" lefi shello hayta geluya bemare hayyabbashot, vehaya gonah kegon hammayim veen hekker ben gevulah ligvul hammayim, vegam yikkanes bemashmaut "terae" lefi shehayta reuya lema sherauy lihyot mehayyabbashot letzarche haolam.

Od yirtze beamro veterae – leheyot shekkol od shehammayim matta umala laaretz, en haaretz mitkayyemet betivah, ki hammayim yahafchu tivah. vetze ulemad ma shekkatav rambam beresh hilchot deot (hilchot yesode hattora perek 4 halacha 5) ki hammayim yahafchu yesod heafar lemayim. laze amar "yikkavu hammayim" vegomer uvaze terae hayyabbasha, uferush taamod bisodah lehafeil sibbat beriatah. uleolam kevar kadma beriatah bemaamar 1 beyom 1, kemo shennitbaer lemala. gam nimtzenu omrim ki lo kol memot haolam nikvu leyam okyanos, veyesh tehomot lematta laaretz.

Veefshar shehammayim shennikvu en hefresh benehem lattehom shemmittachat laaretz, veal oto chelek sheen bo eretz amru zichronam livracha (chagiga 12.) sheamar hashshem laaretz "day" shello titpashshet missof lesof, venisharu hammayim mechubbarim lammayim hattachtonim:

Achar shekkatavti kol hakkatuv, ba leyadi midrash mippirke rabbi eliezer (perek Adonai) veze leshono: bashshelishi hayta haaretz mishor kabbika, vehammayim mechassim al pene chol haaretz. uchesheyyatza haddavar mippi hakkadosh baruch hu "yikkavu hammayim" vegomer, harim ugevaot nitpardu al pene chol haaretz, ala tochah shel eretz venitgalgelu venikvu hammayim vechulei ad kan. hare dichsheamar hakkadosh baruch hu "yikkavu hammayim" kevar hayta haaretz bammetziut, vehem devarenu. hagam shellefi divre hammaamar nire shemmefaresh veterae hayyabbasha perush shettihye hayyabbasha chol gevul layyam, kesheyyerau hammayim leyabbasha yiknu mekomam, al derech amro (Yirmeyahu 5:22) "asher samti chol gevul layyam", veasa morao shel hayyabbasha al hayyam. uferush veterae milleshon yira, vehu amro "haoti lo tirau" vegomer "asher samti chol gevul layyam", veze meshunne mipperushenu. ze derech derash, vedarkenu derech peshat vehakkatuv yechavven lakkol.

Veramban zichrono livracha peresh amro veterae hayyabbasha, shehaya heafar meorav im hammayim, vegazar Adonai sheyyibbadlu ze mizze vetissamech bechinat heafar vetihye hayyabbasha, ad kan. uferusho zichrono livracha tzarich arev. gam en peshat hakkatuv maggid ze. gam lefi devarav zichrono livracha lo haya tzarich lehikkavot hammayim el makom echad, ella sheyyomar layyabbasha shetterae basseder haamur bedivre harav, sheyyitbarer heafar min hammayim veyatzuf lemala veyishshaaru hammayim bimkomam. veod, mehakkatuv mashma shekkol hammayim hannimtzaim mittachat larakia shehayu semuchim laaretz nikvu lemakom echad, velo chen mashma lefi perush harav. veod, en leshon "veterae" medukdak ledarko zichrono livracha. vehannachon beenay hu kemo shepperashti, shehaaretz hayta toch hammayim shetucha umayim lemala umayim lematta mimmenna, veal mayim shellemala laaretz gazar haggozer sheharakia yitmatztza betocham veyissa bichnafav mayim haelyonim, vehachelek hannishar mittachat larakia lo yishshaer tachat kol harakia behashevaa ella yikkavu bemakom echad, vehu amro yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad, uvaze terae hayyabbasha kifshatah.

Venire lomar ki chol bechinot hammayim sheal haaretz, ben haelyonim mimmaal larakia ben shennikvu lemakom echad, hem bivchinat mayim zecharim. velaze timtza sheholadat hazzeraim tihye mimmeme okyaynos shehem mayim hannikvim, keamram zichronam livracha (taanit 9:) shemmimmeme okyaynos hem haggeshamim, veachar sheyyamtir Adonai mehem olim mehattehom kenegdam. vehu amram zichronam livracha (taanit ko:) "en tippa yoredet milmala sheen tippim olim kenegdah milmatta", veen hazzeraim tzomchim lo min hannimtarim velo mehattehomiyyim ki zachar levad o nekeva levad lo yeldu. vehe lecha divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (pirki derabbi eliezer 103) shev memot hem, echad zachar veechad nekeva, veze leshonam: vehammayim gavru meod keshennitchabberu hammayim zecharim im mayim nekevot gavru beyoter:

rashi: Gichon. shehaya holech vehome, vehemyato gedola meod, kemo chi yiggach (Shemot 21), shemmenaggeach veholech vehome:
Vechivshuha. chaser vav lelammedcha shehazzachar kovesh et hannekeva, shello tehe yatzanit, veod lelammedcha shehaish sheddarko lichbosh metzuvve al periyya ureviyya velo haishsha:
ohc: Vayvarech otam. perush shello yikkaret min haenoshi, vayyomer vegomer tzivva elav lifrot velirbot, shehagam shebberach otam sheyyihye min haenoshi kayyam lo mippene ze yitrashshelu millifrot velirbot. veraiti deot nifsadot bannivraim mibbene ammenu dichsheyyesh 3 o 4 achim 1 o 2 mehen mishtaddelim bifriyya ureviyya veomrim ki hu ze kiyyum hammin. gam beadam echad kesheyyekayyem mino tavo lo hassevara shello yishtaddel od lifrot velirbot. laze amar Adonai techillat dibber Adonai mitzvat Adonai bara amar peru urevu velo asa gevul lammitzva, vahagam shebberach otam shello yikkaret min haadam min haolam. vegamar omer umilu et haaretz. veamro vechivshuha samuch leumilu" lomar ki beemtzaut sheyyemalleu haaretz baze tihye nichbasha lifnehem, ki makom hecharev en adam sholet bo ki letzad shommuto hu mitmalle negdiyyim laadam. od yirtze beamro vayvarech otam sheyyihye bahem koach hammolid, veachar kach tzivva otam al haddavar.

rashi: Vayyomer kayin el hevel. nichnas immo bedivre riv umatztza lehitolel alav lehargo. veyesh baze midreshe aggada, ach ze yishshuvo shel mikra:
ohc: Vayyomer kayin el hevel achiv. perush: amar lo devar achva, letzad shekkadam elav sibbat hassina mechamat kina, yargish hevel meemtzaut haddavar sheyyisnaehu veyaskil lehishshamer mimmennu. asher al ken amar elav haachva, ki lo nolad belibbo sina mechamat haddavar letzad kinato, vehitahu kede lehaamin bo letachlit kavvanato lehappilo bammichmoret hakkatuv achar ze. velachen nitchakkem mafsik pesukim sheasa piska veenah piska befasuk ze im pasuk shelleacharav.

Vayhi bihyotam bassade. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hodia hakkatuv heyotam bassade. gam amro vayyakam kima zo lamma, velo haya tzarich hakkatuv lomar ella "vayyaharog kayin lehevel". od lo haya tzarich lomar "achiv". od tzarich ladaat amro e hevel ma kavvanat habbore bishela zo. od mi peti kekayin sheyyashiv leyodea vaed "lo yadati", umi makkir hashegachato kenivraim rishonim? od ma yaarich lashon lomar hashomer? od amro "kol deme achicha tzoakim elay min haadama", lamma yutzrach lomar min haadama uma hi hatztzeaka? od lamma killel haadama im hu harotzeach, alav tavo kelala, uma maala uma moredet haadama birtzichato? im lo tekabbel hi damo yihye lilkikat hallokek, umaaseha naim bechassot damo, vechimat en mashmaut ledivre Adonai:

Achen hakkavvana hi leheyot ki kayin nitkanne behevel bechashvo ki hu sibba lehashepalato, ki beemtzauto hukkar aflo, vechashav ki keshello yihye hevel bammetziut yitratztze Adonai bekayin ki en od acher livchor bo, vechashav lehargo, vechash shettaal tzachanato uvasho befigo bo ki nitztavva al hartzicha, venityaetz etzot lehargo mibbeli sheloach yad bo. vehinne ze haish ish adama haya yodea motzaeha umovaeha uvaki bachadareha, veamru zichronam livracha (Kohelet Rabba 1:4; nedarim lat) ki haaretz yesh lah evarim keevre adam: enayim, yadayim veraglayim, pe vechulei, velammakkir bah yeda hammekomot, umeatta matza hayyoetz raa lehargo bearma mibbeli sheloach yado bo. vehu amro vayhi bihyotam bassade mithallechim baadama matza makom lemoatzotav, uveemtzaut ma shekkadam shehitahu bivchinat haachva heemin bo hevel, uvaze kam alav, uvekima zo shekkam, perush amad alav, baze harago, vehinne haamida enah horeget, ella shennitchakkem laamod alav bemakom sheyyihye nivla baadama, vezo hi mitato, vehaadama hi hahoreget. vahagam shello perash hakkatuv kan ofen hahariga hinne hu gilla bappasuk sheachar ze sheamar "asher patzta".

VaAdonai bochen levavot, shealo "e hevel achicha", lirot hayode al pisho, veheshiv "lo yadati". veim tomar haya lecha latet lev alav, laze amar hashomer achi vegomer, vechi shomer asitani alav, velo hoda al maasehu hara, shechashav ki Adonai lo yaanish al hassibba o lo yashgiach bah. veheshivo Adonai "ma asita", hodio ki maasav haraim hem sibba laadama livloa hevel, vehu amro kol deme achicha tzoakim elay min haadama, perush ki hevel choshev bedato ki adama haragattu vekaval lifne Adonai mimmenna. velaze killel Adonai oto ki hu hassibba, uvehitztarfut killato killel gam lehaadama asher patzta piha lakachat hevel miyyado shello tiftze od piha. vehu amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 37) shello patzta od piha umezammeret hi zemer veshir leel elyon chiyyuv hatztzericha laasot bichnafeha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 24:16): "mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu". ufachada beet sheamar lah Adonai shettivla hammitzriyyim mippachad petichat piha livloa hevel, ad shennishba lah Adonai (mechilta), dichtiv (Shemot 15:12): "natita yemincha", venishba lah veaz bala otam befiha. veefshar shellaze nitkavven maamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 22) veze leshonam: rabbanan amru beeven harago, ad kan. vehinne bimtziut hariga zo yease kol gufo petzaim petzaim, vehu amro "deme" leshon rabbim, velo hayta mitato mimmakom echad kederech hannishchatim. uvaze hufeshat hevel mikkol devek ra kemo shepperashti befasuk "kaniti ish et Adonai". veyesh midrashim rabbim bakkatuv.

Vattomer haishsha vegomer. nitchakkema lehashiv lechol hannishma middevarav kefi ma shepperashnu ki 3 teanot nitkavven lomar, veheshivattu, keneged ma shennishma bidvarav: 1 shehakkol asur, o letaanat shekkol atze haggan hem anfe hailan hahu muvrachim veodennam yonkot meetz haddaat, o letaanat shehu haed sheshshama ki hakkol asar habbore, amra lo chen hu, mikkol etz haggan nochel, ki Adonai sheasar etz haddaat hu hittir shear ilanot, uma bechach im hem muvrachot mimmennu. bishlama im lo haya Adonai mattir beferush kol atze haggan az yesh makom letzadded kidvarecha, ma sheen ken achar she hittir beferush kol atze haggan ma makom lanu leesor davar shehuttar mippi habbore. gam en lishmoa leeduto ki eduto muchcheshet hi etzlah middivre balah, vetoil hachechashat haeduyyot leval teesor atze haggan ki edut muchleket hi, aval lo toil lehachechish kol haedut lehattir hakkol, ki bichlal kol sheomer hannachash yeshno leetz haddaat uchedaat bet hillel.

Ucheneged ma shennishma middevarav behafelagat shevach hailan, amra adrabba, letzad pechituto asaro habbore, vehu amro pen temutun ki yesh bo bechinat mavet, vehaelohim amar lanu lo tochlu vegomer pen temutun. ulehaskilcha bamchuvvan yesh lecha ladaat ki chol asher yetzavve Adonai ammo lo tzivva Adonai davar letzad hahuremna vehannekama ella hakkol lesibbat harechakat hannezek vehakeravat hattoelet. vehinnecha roe kamma netiot nata Adonai vechamma inyanim muflaim bara baolam vehakkol nittenu litzir kappav, vehem divre chavva sheddana ki lo menaah Adonai meetz haddaat im lo shehu chelek hammazzik, veyafe dana, vehu amrah mikkol etz haggan nochel, perush, hare ze maggid ki chafetz Adonai lehetiv letzad haratzon, umizze atta lamed ki ma shemmenaanu mizze hu letzad harechakat hannezek. vehosifa lomar velo tiggeu bo hagam shello neemar bedivre Adonai, chashva kevan shehammenia hi letzad shello tistakken, meatta kol ma shettosif leharechik mibbechinat hammazzik ken rauy laasot. veefshar ki haadam keshetztzivva lah al haetz beseder ze amar lah, lehagedalat haharchaka keshetteda ki etz ze hu sam hammemit taflig baharechaka:

Od nitkavvena lomar lo: yihye shekkidvarecha ken hu, ki hu hameshubbach mikkol atze haggan, ki ma bechach im hailan meshubbach hu mikkullan? hare haelohim amar ki im nochal mimmennu nitchayyev mavet, veyesh lanu lachush leatzmenu. veamrah "velo tiggeu bo", efshar shechashsha leshumman happerot uvannegia yehane hagguf, keamram (shabbat 86.): minnayin lesicha shehi" vechulei, vahare hi nehenet mimmennu vehi bichlal achila, keamram bashshas (fesachim ka:): kol makom shenneemar lo tochlu vegomer echad issur achila vechulei. umechuvvan haddevarim ki hagam sheyyesh bo maala rama kidvarav veen dome lo, halo raglav yordot mavet, baze hu nishpal mikkol atze haggan.

Umeatta lo nishar makom liton od "kum echol", umimma nafshach menia zo shemmana Adonai otanu meetz ze lo timmana mechalukka: o letzad harechaka mehannezek, o letzad lekabbel alenu gezerat melech velishmoa bekolo, ki ze minnimuse hammelucha. velishne hatteamim yesh yirat mavet baddavar, vealenu lehitrachek.

Ulechol chayyat haaretz vegomer. samach hakkatuv chayyat haaretz im haamurim besamuch "lachem yihye leachla" vegomer, shennire shennoten maachal adam labbehema behashevaa, vegamar omer leachla paam sheniyya samuch leyerek esev, shennire sheachilat behema veof eno ella meesev hassade. hakkavvana hi ki lo bara Adonai livhema chayya veof ella davka yerek esev, veshemma tomar im en yerek esev nimtzet hachayya meta, talmud lomar "lachem leachla ulechol chayyat haaretz" vegomer. nimtzenu omrim ki haadam yichye mipperot haaretz umipperi haetz, vehachayya vehaof mehaasavim vehayyerakot, veim en michya meellu hare michyatah mimmaachal adam. veyesh lirmoz ze beamro (Devarim 11:15) "venatatti esev besadcha livhemtecha" uvaze "veachalta vesavata", aval zulat ze techsar hassevia ki tochlennu hachayya vehaof ki mezonotam mezonotecha.

rashi: Vayyeda adam vegomer. ba lo lemech etzel adam harishon vekaval al nashav, amar lahem: vechi alechem ledakdek al gezerato shel makom? attem asu mitzvatchem vehu yaase et shello. amru lo: keshot atzmecha techilla, vahalo parashta meishtecha ze mea usheloshim shana mishshenniknesa mita al yadcha: miyyad vayyeda adam vegomer. umahu od, lelammed shennittosfa lo taava al taavato (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Vaytzav Adonai vegomer. taam amro lemor vechafal achol tochel vechafal mot vegomer, yechavven al chavva, shetztzivvahu lemor hammitzva lechavva: achol – atta, tochel – bat zugecha, mot – atta, tamut – gam hi im taavor. yeshnah baazhara veyeshnah baonesh.

Umatzati sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba perek koach) veze leshonam: amar rabbi tachlifa, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: im nakdim laanashim kemo shehikdamti leadam harishon, veachar kach nitztavvet chavva veamda vekilkela" vechulei ad kan. dikdek lomar "nitztavvet" velo amar "tzivviti lechavva", lirmoz devarenu, ki leadam tzivva lemor lah.

Od yirmoz bechefel achol tochel mot tamut, lomar ki hammattana netuna lo ulechol habbaim mimmennu shehem kol zaro ad sof kol haddorot leechol mehaggan, veim vegomer mot vegomer, perush: mot hu veyamutu kol habbaim mimmennu immo, kemo shekken haya shenniknesa mita al kol hannivraim ad asher tovad zohama shennidbeka az uvilla hammavet lanetzach (Yeshayahu 25:8).
Vetaam amro vaytzav Adonai elohim, velo hispik beamro "vaytzav Adonai" o "vaytzav elohim", kan ramaz rachamim vedin: im yetiv yakkifehu berachamim, veim lo – mishpat lemulo.

rashi: Hannefilim. al shem shennaflu vehippilu et haolam, uvelashon ivrit leshon anakim hu:
Bayyamim hahem. bime dor enosh uvene kayin (Bereshit Rabba):
Vegam achare chen. af al pi sherau veavdan shel dor enosh, sheala okyanus vehetzif shelish haolam lo nichna dor hammabbul lilmod mehem:
Asher yavou. hayu yoldot anakim kemotam:
Haggibborim. limrod bammakom:
Anshe hashshem. otan shennikkevu veshemot irad mechuyael metushael shennikkevu al shem avdan, shennimmochu vehutteshu. davar acher anshe shimmamon, sheshshimmemu et haolam:
Al ken yaazov ish. ruach hakkodesh omra chen leesor al bene noach haarayot (sanhedrin 57):
Levasar echad. havvalad notzar al yede shenehem vesham naashe vesaram echad (sham 58):
Lo mot temutun. dechafah ad shennaga vo, amar lah keshem sheen mita vingia, kach en mita vaachila (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyomer hannachash vegomer. kafal lomar lo mot temutun nitkavven lishlol 2 mitot sheramza hi bidvareha, ben letzad shehaetz atzmo hu hammemit veyara leechol sam hammavet, ben letzad hayyira pen yifgaenna Adonai baddever. amar "lo mot temutun" – lo mita tivit, lo mita shiftiyyit. umeatta chala hakkusheya: im ken lamma yetzav Adonai shello leechol, uchemo shepperashti bedivre chavva. laze ba venatan taam chadash veshat bashshamayim piv, ki taam shemmenaam hu leval yishvu elav, ki "beyom achalchem" vegomer yihyu kelohim. vehinne harasha matza makom lomar kaddevarim haelle, leheyot shehu kadam livriat adam vechavva, matza makom lomar sheyyodea davar shello yadu habbaim acharav. gam leheyoto mushelal mikkenisat gan eden, matza makom lomar shello nittan reshut likkanes laggan ella lahem sheenam yodim sod haddavar, veasar lahem haetz. lo chen hu letzad heyoto yodea sod hainyan, lo netano Adonai likkanes sham. umeatta lefi haddevarim hahem, achar sheyyochlu en pachad elohim ki yihyu kemoto velo yishlot bahem lahamitam, uvaze naatz tzipporen avoda zara. vahalo lecha ladaat ki avoda zara danim bah gam al hammachshava (kiddushin 40:).

Od yirtze beamro lo mot temutun, lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 19:3) sheddechafah vehochiach shello meta bingia, laze kafal harasha lomar keshem shello meta bingia sheamra, gam lo tamut baachila. vehinne hochacha zo yeshnah leechad mehashshene teamim sheamra haishsha kemo shepperashti lemala, shehammichush hu shehaetz mitztzad atzmo memit yeshnah lehavechana zo, sheim haetz memit bingia hare naga velo meta, aval lema shennitkavvena lomar gam ken ki yerea hi meelohim hametzavve otah pen yifgaenna en hochacha mimma shello meta bingia, ki adayin yeshnah baonesh asher gazar aleha, vechozrim anu lattaam shepperashnu lemala.

Veim tomar: "lamma yivra Adonai beriyya raa kazo letakkala?" da ki beriyya zo, kol ma shehifli Adonai begodel bechinatah, ken godel bechinat hassagat hannefesh baolam haelyon, ki lefi hitatztzemut hatztzarich laadam lenitztzachon ken yittol secharo, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (avot 5:26): "lefum tzaara agra". veim haya magbil shiur koach hammesit beshiur muat, en makom larotze lehassig hassaga gedola lehassigah, ki en hassaga zulat emtzaut nitzchon hammesit. vetze ulemad mehaamur besefer zohar hakkadosh (teruma 163:) bemashal ben melech asher tzivvahu aviv leval kerov lehazzona, veet hazzona tzivva lahasito livchon ben yechabbed av, yeuyyan sham. umeatta hifli Adonai lehitchassed im ohavav lehachin lahem davar shebbeemtzauto yassigu alot bemaalot chayyim hannitzchiyyim, ashre haam shekkacha lo.

rashi: Vayyoled ben. shemmimmennu nivna haolam (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Vayyitten otam. lo hispik lomar "vayhi chen", ki ratza lehodienu ki Adonai natan betorat mattenat chinnam davar ze lehair laolam, keamram zichronam livracha bammidrash (Bereshit Rabba 86), yeuyyan sham. vehakkavvana baze shehodiam ki enam meirim laolam letzad sheruyim laor, deim ken kol zeman sheyyiru hammeorot ki yoshve tevel mashchitim darkam yaasfu nagham. gam beemtzaut ezo sibba yachpetzu leesof nagham, kemo sheamru bammidrash (Petichta laaykeh rabbati) sheamar moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom lashshemesh bechurban habbayit: lamma lo chashacht orecha keshennichnas oyev levet hammikdash" vechulei, laze amar Adonai ki hem netunim lehair al haaretz, umeatta enam birshut atzman umuchrachim hem bemaasehem lehair veen sibba monaat. uvaze heiru enenu lamma chazar paam 2 hakkatuv lomar velimshol bayyom, halo kevar amar "hammaor haggadol lememshelet hayyom" vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 86) darshu shehakkatuv romez el hatztzaddikim, yeuyyan sham divrehem. aval lefi happeshat en tzorech lachzor velomar, uledarkenu hutzrach lachzor velomar mittaam amro "vayyitten", ki netunim netunim hemma meatta hinne enam birshut atzman vechiyyuv acherim alehem, laze chazar veamar ki memshaltam bimkomah omedet, ella davka livchina zo lehair davka en beyadam leshannot, aval bishar hammemshalot sheyyeshnam bayyom uvallayla hameyuchadim lahem hen henna hammoshlim.
Vetaam shechazar lomar od ulehavdil, kan tzivva lahem shello yikkansu ze legader shel ze, vechol echad metzuvve al gevulo leval yaavor, shebbaze yihye nikkar yom millayla.

rashi: Vayyisha. vayyifen, vechen veel minchato lo shaa – lo fana, vechen velo yishe (Yeshayahu 17) – lo yifne, vechen shee mealav (Iyov 14) pene mealav:
Vayyisha. yarda esh velichacha minchato:
ohc: Vayyisha Adonai vegomer veel kayin vegomer. taam shello hitchil behodaat hammukdam al ze hadderech "velo shaa el kayin vayyisha el hevel", ba lelammedenu hafelagat richuk kayin, sheafillu achar shehaya nachat ruach lifne Adonai beemtzaut minchat hevel, lo shaa lekayin veel minchato, hagam heyoto rishon batteshura vegadol beseder halleda, yarad matta matta.

Vetaam shekkafal lomar el hevel veel minchato veel kayin veel vegomer, velo hispik lomar "el minchat hevel veel minchat kayin". kan ramaz ki haadon haya mare panim shel ratzon limkarve teshura, vehu amro vayyisha el hevel vegam kibbel teshurato, veel kayin lo hera panim lo lo velo litshurato.

rashi: Livyat chen. chibbur shel chen hem leroshcha, kelomar: hattora vehammusar yihyu leroshcha livyat chen, vechaanakim shel adi zahav yihyu:
Legargerotecha. letzavvarcha, veal shem shehakkane asuya tabbaot tabbaot, kore hatztzavvar bilshon rabbim:
targum: Mettul deyeuta vechisda inun lereshach vehamenicha letzavrach:

rashi: Vayvarech otam. lefi shemmechasserim otam vetzadin mehem veochlin otam, hutzrechu livracha, veaf hachayyot hutzrechu livracha, ella mippene hannachash sheatid liklala, lechach lo verchan, shello yehe hu vichlal:
Peru. l peri kelo ashu perot:
Urevu. im lo amar ella peru, haya echad molid echad velo yoter, uva urevu sheechad molid harebe:
ohc: Vayvarech – taam shehutzrach Adonai levarech sheretz hammayim, ma shello asa chen bannivraim hayyotzim min haaretz, veod lo sheggam betoldot hammayim atzmam hittil kina, shello berach sheretz haof, nire ki haddavar tzarich lihyot ken mittaam hechrechi lefi ma shepperashnu ki ma shetztzivva Adonai lammayim sheyyishretzu eno ella lefi shaa velo leachare chen, ulekiyyum hammin tzivva Adonai sheyyifru veyirbu, sheim lo chen hare minam kale. veleheyot shekkefi teva hannivraim asher bara Adonai koach hammolid hi yesod haesh, ki teva hakkor adrabba yafsid koach haholada, vetze ulemad mechachmat hatteva gam middivrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat kanu:) sheamar Adonai leavraham: may datach dekae tzedek vechulei dichtiv (Yeshayahu 41:2) "tzedek yikraehu leraglo", yeuyyan sham divrehem. uchefi ze haddagim en lahem metziut kefi teva hakkavua bannivraim leholid. asher al ken chazar Adonai bemaamaro hannichbad uvercham lemor, perush kavvanat habberacha shebbercham hu lomar sheyyuchelu leholid, velo yimnaem kerirut hammayim velo yitztarchu latzet chutz lammayim lehitchammem baaretz kederech hattarnegolim (betza 7.) desafne meara, ella toch hammayim yaasu peri.

Vehu amro umilu et hammayim bayyammim, vekashe lamma hutzrach lomar "bayyammim" velo hispik beamro "umilu et hammayim"? ella hakkavvana hi shebbetoch hayyammim sham yishretzu, vezo hi birkat hamevarech baruch hu. vegamar omer vehaof yirev baaretz, ki hu yirev kederech kol haaretz, venachon.

rashi: Ki yodea. kol umman sone et bene ummanuto, min haetz achal uvara et haolam (Bereshit Rabba):
Vihyitem kelohim. yotzre olamot (Bereshit Rabba):
Mitztzalotav. missetarav, kemo uletzela hammishkan (Shemot 26), zehu sheamru shene fartzufim nivreu (eruvin 17):
Vaysagevar. mekom hachatach:
Vayyishan vayyikkach. shello yire chatichat habbasar shemmimmenu nivret vetitbazze alav:
Keraticha. lishaya hu omer:
Veetztzarcha. kesheytzarticha, zot hayta machashavti shetteshiv et ammi livriti ulehair lahem:
Leor goyim. kol shevet karuy goy leatzmo, keinyan shenneemar: "goy ukehal goyim" (Bereshit 35:11):
targum: Ana Adonai rabbitach bikshot veatkefet bidach veatkeninach veetteninach likyam am lenehor ammin:

rashi: Shema beni musar avicha. ma shennatan hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe bichtav veal pe:
Immecha. ummatcha, keneset yisrael, kemo: "ma immecha leviyya" (Yechezkel 19:2). vehem divre sofrim, shechiddeshu vehosifu veasu seyagim lattora:
targum: Shema beri marduta daavuch vela tite minimosa deimach:

rashi: Yehi meorot vegomer. miyyom rishon nivreu uvarvii tzivva alehem lehittalot barakia, vechen kol toldot shamayim vaaretz nivreu miyyom rishon, vechol echad veechad nikba bayom shennigzar alav, hu shekkatuv et hashshamayim, lerabbot toldotehem, veet haaretz, lerabbot toldoteha:
Yehi meorot. chaser vav ketiv, al shehu yom meera lippol askara battinokot, hu sheshshaninu bed hayu mitannim al askara shello tippol battinokot:
Lehavedil ben hayyom uven hallayla. mishshennignaz haor harishon, aval beshivat yeme vereshit shimmeshu haor vehachoshech harishonim yachad ben bayyom uven ballayla:
Vehayu leotot. keshehammeorot lokin, siman ra hu laolam, shenneemar meotot hashshamayim al techattu (yirmeya 10), baasotchem retzon hakkabba en attem tzerichin lidog min happuranut:
Ulemoadim. al shem heatid, sheatidim yisrael lehitztauot al hammoadot vehem nimnim lemolad hallevana:
Uleyamim. shimmush hachamma chatzi yom veshimmush hallevana chetzyo, hare yom shalem:
Veshanim. lesof 365 yamim (sefer acher urevia yom), yigmeru mahalachatam beyv mazzalot hameshartim otam, vehi shana, vechozrim umatchilim paam sheniyya lesabbev baggalgal kemahalachan harishon:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot. taam amro yehi leshon yachid al 2, baze ramaz ki echad mehem hu hammeir bayyom, velaze lo amar leshon rabbim. uveemtzaut sheddibber Adonai bederech ze hu shehaya ma shehaya betachlit haddavar shennitmaata hayyareach, keamram zichronam livracha (chullin 60:) ki im haya Adonai omer petach devarav "yihyu meorot" behechreach haya haddavar omed ken, ki devar elohenu yakum leolam.
Od nire behair od, amro lehavedil ben hayyom uven hallayla, im hammeorot shavim hem veechad yeshammesh bayyom veechad yeshammesh ballayla, bamme yukkar layla miyyom kevan shellayla kayyom yair?

Achen yirtze hakkatuv, leheyot shekkadam beyom rishon uvara haor, vetimtza sheamar befarasha rishona Adonai peamim "or", veramzu zichronam livracha (Tikkunim 5) ki Adonai orot nivreu vehivdilam Adonai lenachalato leatid lavo latztzaddikim, vehen atta beyom revii heetzil mehaorot chelek hammaspik laolam utelao birkia hashshamayim, vehu amro yehi meorot perush yehi chelek echad meorot hannivraim beyom rishon, vehitna shello yihyu kevuim ella sheyyesovvu, kede shebbeemtzaut hassibbuv yukkar yom valayla, veze asa lesiman hakkarat hayyamim hamekuddashim, keamro leotot ulemoadim vegomer, ucheshenneetzal hammaor neetzlu 2 chalakim ushenehem leshammesh middat yom nivreu. velaze timtza (chullin 60:) shettaana hayyareach, i efshar lishne melachim lehishtammesh becheter echad, perush bizman echad, vechach huva bedivre rabbotenu, sheim gevulo shel yareach haya ballayla veshel shemesh bayyom, en keter echad lishnehem ella kol echad gevulo bifne atzmo. vechen timtza sheamar "vehayu limorot birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz" belo keviut zeman.

rashi: Vattifreu. utevattelu:
Kol atzati. sheyyaatzti legaddel etchem baolam:
targum: Veshanetun kol tariti umachsenuta la avitun:

rashi: Vehaadam yada. kevar kodem hainyan shel mala, kodem shechata venitrad miggan eden, vechen haherayon vehalleda, sheim katav vayyeda adam, nishma shelleachar shennitrad hayu lo vanim:
Kayin. al shem kaniti:
Et Adonai. kemo im Adonai, keshebbara oti veet ishi, hu levaddo beraanu aval baze shuttafim anu immo (nidda 31):
Et kayin et achiv et hevel. 3 etim ribbuyim hem, melammed, shetteoma nolda im kayin, veim hevel noldu shetayim, lechach neemar vattosef (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vatteled et kayin vattomer vegomer. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 1 54) ki kayin hu bechinat hara vehevel hu bechinat hattov, vehu nafsho shel moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom (tikun 69). vehinne beemtzaut hafelagat happetzaim sheppatza kayin behevel ad sheharago, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 37:) shello haya yodea mekom hannefesh, uvaze hesir chelek hara mimmennu vehukkar hattov muchlat, vehu amro kaniti vegomer perush beemtzaut ze kaniti ish shehu moshe et Adonai, shello hissig metziut ze lihyot im Adonai kemoshe alav hashshalom ella beemtzaut yissurin sheasa lo kayin.

rashi: Avoni minneso. bitmiha, atta toen elyonim vetachtonim, vaavoni i efshar liton? (Bereshit Rabba)
Vayhi kayin bone ir vayyikra shem hair lezecher beno chanoch:
Veholachti. yisrael shehayu ivrim ad henna mehabbit elay bederech hattov, asher lo yadu lahaloch bah:
Asitim. eese ken. leshon nevua ledabber al heatid keillu asuy:
targum: Vaedabber levet yisrael dedamin kesaman beorach dela yedau bishvilin dela alifu adarchinun ashave keval kodamehon linhor vechafla lemeshra ilen pitgamaya avedinun vela archikinun:

rashi: Vene haelohim. bene hassarim vehashshoftim. davar acher bene haelohim, hem hassarim haholchim bishlichuto shel makom, af hem hayu mitarvim bahem; kol elohim shebbammikra leshon marut, veze yochiach veatta tihye lo lelohim (Shemot 4), ree netatticha elohim (sham 7):
Ki tovot henna. amar rabbi yudan tovot ketiv, keshehayu metivin otah mekushshetet likkanes lachuppa, haya gadol nichnas uvoalah techilla (Bereshit Rabba):
Mikkol asher bacharu. af beulat baal, af hazzachar vehabbehema:

Shemaan koli. shehayu porshot mimmennu mittashmish, lefi sheharag et kayin veet tuval kayin beno, shehaya lemech suma vetuval kayin moshcho, veraa et kayin venidma lo kechayya veamar leaviv limshoch bakkeshet vaharago, vechevan sheyyada shehu kayin zekeno hikka kaf el kaf vesafak et beno venehem vaharago, vehayu nashav porshot mimmennu vehu mefayyesan:

Shemaan koli. lehishshama li letashmish, vechi ish asher haragti lefitzi hu neherag, vechi ani fetzativ mezid sheyyehe happetza karuy al shemi? veyeled asher haragti, lechabburati neherag? kelomar, al yede chabburati? bitmiha, vahalo shogeg ani velo mezid, lo zehu pitzi velo zehu chabburati:
Petza. makkat cherev o chetz makeadevareh belaaz:

Vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. Rabbi shimon omer basar vadam, sheeno yodea ittav uregaav tzarich lehosif mechol al hakkodesh, hakkabba sheyyodea ittav uregaav, nichnas bo kechut hassaara, venire cheillu chilla vo vayyom. davar acher me haya haolam chaser? menucha, bat shabbat bat menucha, kalta venigmera hammelacha:
ohc: Vaychal elohim vegomer. peshat hakkatuv hu shebba lelammedenu shello tachshov sheasa melacha acheret achar kach velo huzekra battora, laze amar vaychal elohim perush: killa ma sheala bedato yitbarach laasot. vechan shalal gam ken shello asa melacha achar hashshabbat beshishsha yamim acherim, vehaven.

Ella sheyyesh latet lev leamro asher asa shello haya tzarich lomar ella "vaychal elohim vegomer melachto". od yesh lehair amro bayyom hashshevii, mashma ki bayyom hashshevii asa melacha vechilla otah, veeno chen ki bayyom hashshishshi hu shekkilla. vahagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha hirgishu letakken ze veamru, veze leshonam (Bereshit Rabba 10,9): rabbi shimon omer basar vadam eno yodea vechulei ad kan, im kol ze tevat "bayyom" enah meduyyeket, ulefi divrehem perush hu keillu bayyom. uveemet ki divrehem divre emet, ella od yesh leeloah millin uchefattish yefotzetz.

Venire sheyyechavven hakkatuv lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (chagiga 12:) ki haolam haya rofef veroed ad shebbaa shabbat venitkayyem haolam venityassed. vehakkavvana hu ki beyom shabbat bara Adonai nefesh haolam, vehu sod amro "uvayyom hashshevii shavat vayyinnafash". hagam shechazal (betza 16:) darshu kevan sheyyatza shabbat vayyinnafash, en ze ella derech derash sheddarshu meamro "vayyinnafash" velo amar "venafash", darshu ki nitkavven hakkatuv lirmoz kevan sheyyatza shabbat "vay" sheavda hannefesh, aval mashmaut peshat hakkatuv eno yotze mimmenna, shennitkavven lomar kevan sheshshavat, perush ba shabbat vayyinnafash, perush nishpa shefa hachiyyuni bechol hannivraim, ki kodem hashshabbat lo haya nefesh lechol hannivraim.

Vechen matzanu lerazal besefer hakkadosh zohar hattora (zohar, tazria 44.) shennatnu taam lemitzvat Adonai lamul bayyom hashshemini veshello lekarev karban laAdonai ad yom hach, ki hattaam hu ad avor alav yom hashshabbat veyihye baal nefesh. vehu sheamar hakkatuv vaychal elohim vegomer, perush shekkilla Adonai beemtzaut yom hashshevii melachto, vechazar uferash ma hu melachto shekkilla, lo shehaya chaser davar measoto vealav hu omer "vaychal", ella hakkavvana hi "asher asa", perush hammelacha shekkevar asa adayin hayta chasera davar hammaamid, uveemtzaut yom hashshevii bo nigmar hainyan. uvaze nityashshev ma sheddikdaknu. gam baze hirvachnu limtzo battora beriat yom hashshevii atzmo, kederech shehodia otanu hattora beriat yom beyomo dichtiv "vayhi erev" vegomer, hare ze maggid havayat haerev vahavayat habboker, vechan lo matzinu shehodia beriat yom ze, uledarkenu hare hu amur. ulema shepperashti befasuk "vaychullu" shehu leshon teshuka vecheshek, yachol lehitparesh gam ken amro vaychal elohim vegomer al derech amro (Iyov 14:15): "lemaase yadecha tichsof", uchetiv (Devarim 10:15): "rak baavotecha chashak", ki haadon chashak vechafatz beolamo, veze haya beemtzaut yom hashshevii shennitkayyem haolam kederech shepperashnu, chashak Adonai venitratztza bivriyyotav, vedavar ze huva bedivrehem (Shir HaShirim 2) zichrono livracha, veayyen besamuch.
Vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii vegomer. mikra ze ma ba lelammedenu, ki hem haddevarim atzman hanneemarim besamuch "vaychal elohim"?

Venire lomar al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 87; fesachim ned) ki beriyyot nivreu erev shabbat im chashecha, velo hispiku ligmor beriat gufam ad shekkadash hayyom, vehen hem hammazzikim, ad kan. veyesh lanu lehasekil zot ech yutzdak lemor beerech habbore yitalle shemo shello hispik ligmor vechulei, halo davar yadua lakkol ki keheref ayin yachol livro olamot kullam. vetze ulemad ma shekkatavnu bitchillat happarasha vetire ketzat gevurotav yitalle shemo.

Achen hakkavvana hi ki ratza Adonai lehodia otzem maalat yom hamechubbad, ki halo teda sheyyishtanne haddavar ben melacha shehitchil bah veen bah hefsed limlacha shekkevar hitchil bah vetippased im lo yigmor otah. vechan hodianu hakkatuv ki millevad shello hitchil bimlacha acheret, ella afillu bimlacha shehitchil bah keshekkadash hayyom gam ken shavat milligmor otah, hagam shennifseda hammelacha shehitchil bah hefsed sheen acharav tikkun, af al pi chen lo ratza laasot od. vehu sheramaz beamro vayyishbot achar sheamar "vaychal", ki millevad shekkilla velo hosif od asot beria acheret, ella afillu ma shehaya beyado lehashelimo shavat, perush batel gemar haddavar shehaya beyado. velaze amar mikkol melachto, lomar afillu melacha shekkevar hitchil bah, vehu amro asher asa vehitchil bah, kevan shebba yom hashshevii shavat millehashlimah. vaAdonai asa chen lehareot davar ze lo letzad meniat hayyecholet chas veshalom, ki peshita shebbeheref ayin bore kahenna vechahenna ribbe revavot. gam omer ani ki letaam ze sidder Adonai hammelachot sheasa beseder hayyamim devar yom beyomo, kede sheyyukkar maalat hashshabbat, ki zulat ze yachol haya Adonai laasot kol hammaase beyom echad uvizman muat.

rashi: Pishon. hu nilus nehar mitzrayim, veal shem shemmemav mitbarchin veolin umashkin et haaretz nikra fishon kemo ufashu parashav (Chavakuk 1) davar acher pishon, shehu megaddel pishtan, shenneemar al mitzrayim (Yeshayahu 19) uvoshu ovde fishtim:
Tuval kayin. tovel ummanuto shel kayin, tuval leshon tavlin, tibbel vehitkin ummanuto shel kayin laasot kele zayin larotzchim:

Lotesh kol choresh nechoshet uvarzel. mechadded ummanut nechoshet uvarzel kemo yiltosh enav li (Iyov 16). choresh eno leshon poel ella leshon poel, shehare nakud kamatz katan vetamo lematta, kelomar, mechadded umetzachtzeach kol kele ummanut nechoshet uvarzel:
Naama. hi ishto shel noach:
Sheloshim umeat shana. ad kan parash min haishsha (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo. perush: leheyot shekkayin vehevel noldu betigboret bechinat hara, karov lemaase hara, uven ze haya meruchak mibbechinat hara, ki kevar nitroken hazzihum, laze amar bidmuto vegomer. od leheyot ki 2 harishonim metu gam shenehem, hevel techef umiyyad, kayin baavod dor hammabbul, umishshet hushtat haolam. laze amar bidmuto ketzalmo adam shemmimmennu binyan haolam, gam hu 3 labbeten hu hakkadosh, vetze ulemad millevi (tanchuma, yitro).

rashi: Lo yadon ruchi vaadam. lo yitraem veyariv ruchi alay bishvil haadam
Leolam. leorech yamim; hinne ruchi nadon bekirbi im lehashechit veim lerachem, lo yihye madon ze veruchi leolam, kelomar leorech yamim:

Beshaggam hu vasar. kemo besheggam, kelomar, bishvil sheggam zot vo, shehu vasar veaf al pi chen eno nichna lefanay, uma im yihye esh o davar kashe? kayyotze vo ad shakkamti devora (Shoftim Adonai) kemo shekkamti vechen shaatta medabber immi (sham 6) kemo sheatta, af beshaggam chemo vesheggam;

Vehayu yamav vegomer. ad 120 shana aarich lahem appi, veim lo yashuvu avi alehem mabbul. veim tomar mishshennolad yefet ad hammabbul eno ela mea shana, en mukdam umeuchar battora (fesachim 6) – kevar hayta haggezera gezura esrim shana kodem sheholid noach toladot, vechen matzinu beseder olam. yesh midreshe aggada rabbim belo yadon, aval ze hu tzichtzuach peshuto:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai lo yadon ruchi vegomer. mikra ze tzarich maggid, verazal darshu bo (Bereshit Rabba 26) harebe derashot, aval peshat hakkatuv lo noda. venire sheyyechavven lomar leheyot shehaya Adonai mitnaheg im beruav lehochiach ulehitdayyen immahem benigle: "vayyomer Adonai el hannachash" (Bereshit 3:14), "el haishsha amar" vegomer (Bereshit 3:16), "uleadam amar" vegomer, "vayyomer Adonai el kayin lamma" vegomer (Bereshit 4:10), "vayyomer Adonai e hevel" vegomer (Bereshit 4:9), vechaasher higdilu lehateiv amar Adonai lo yadon od leolam ruchi baadam panim befanim lehishshafet immo yachad.

Uferush ruchi hu shechinato yitbarach, shello yihye od nechshav haadam lehaderaga zo. vetimtza ki kefi maasav marchik haderagato matta matta, shebbitchilla haya Adonai mochiach laadam al panav venimtzaim hannivraim kullam bemadregat neviim, vayhi ki hechel haadam perush nitchallel o naasa chullin huvdal mehaderagat navi, uvehemshech hazzeman hannitztzanim niru vaaretz hem hatztzaddikim shehechziru haatara leyashnah, umishshecharav hammaon nistam chazon venishara bechinat ruach hakkodesh, ucheshennistattemu ene yisrael en ittanu massig reach hakkodesh veen tzarich lomar ruach hakkodesh, vezo hi tzarat bet yisrael sheen lemala mimmenna hatztzemeim lehariach reach avinu shebbashshamayim utechi ruchenu. utechillat kelala zo hitchila middor hammabbul. venatan Adonai taam ledavar ze beshaggam hu vasar perush bishvil shehosif lehateiv betiuv musrach baavon hanniuf hu basar kaamur bainyan, vaAdonai sone zimma umaas middabber elav.

Od yirtze al derech amram (harav rabbi yitzchak arama zichrono livracha) ki hatztzaddikim mehappechim hachomer laasoto tzura, veharshaim mehappechim hatztzura lechomer, veze hu ibbudan leolam. vehu amro lo yadon ruchi, perush: lo yihye li ratzon mehem leolam, perush meatta vead olam vaafillu olam hannitzchi, vehattaam hu beshaggam, perush: bishvil sheggam hu ruchaniyyut shebbo hafacho vaasao basar, veze hu ibbud hannefesh, vehu amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kach.) dor hammabbul en lahem chelek laolam habba.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyomer Adonai lo yadon od middat rachamim harmuza betevat ruchi leolam, hakkavvana hi shello yachzor bo miggezerato alehem leraa keminhago hattov asher yinnachem Adonai al haraa betaanat ki hem mechomer kortzu, vehu amro (tehillim 78:39) "vayyizkor ki vasar hemma", vehu amro beshaggam hu vasar, perush: im heyot hu basar, taana zo vesanegorya zo lo toil lahem lachzor ladun otam lerachamim.

Od yirtze, leheyot she kava hassachar vehaonesh hakkol laolam haelyon, yashuvu reshaim lishola, atta amar Adonai ki lo yadun din harshaim laolam habba, beshaggam hu vasar, perush bishvil sheggam hu basar shehu chomer, vehachomer yityasser baolam heachur vehaggas hu olam hazze hashshafal. vetala lahem 120 shana ulay yachzeru, gam shebbemeshech ze yashlimu shenotehem hatztzaddikim shehayu baddor hahu kimtushelach vechaddome. vetimtza sheddarshu zichrono livracha (zohar chelek 1 26:) befasuk (Bereshit 7:22) "kol asher nishmat ruach vegomer mikkol asher becharava metu", shehem hatztzaddikim sheyyesh lahem bechinat hanneshama, kullam metu kodem biat hammabbul, ad kan.

Od yirmoz shennitkavven Adonai lomar ki lo yanhig rachamim gemurim laolam, vehu amro vayyomer Adonai shehu shem harachamim, lo yadon ruchi perush retzon shem hameyuchad hazze shehu merutztze lerachem vechulei, lo yadon leolam perush lannivraim shebbaolam, ki beemtzaut ribbuy harachamim hannivraim mafliot lehitgaot ulevakkesh taavot nachriyyot, al derech amro (Hoshea 2:10) "vechesef hirbeti lah" vegomer, vesillek Adonai harachamim laolam haelyon. vetimtza sheggam hatztzaddikim afillu keyaakov avinu lo hissig haratzon lehityashshev beshalva baolam hazze vekafatz alav rugzo shel yosef (Bereshit 37:2). vechen kol tzaddik vetzaddik kesheroe atzmo avru alav 30 yom (arachin 16:) beshalva mefached al atzmo sheeno merutztze laolam haelyon. vehattaam hu ki chen gazar Adonai, shello yitnaheg bemiddat rachamim gemura baolam hazze vaafillu im hatztzaddikim. vehu amro beshaggam hu vasar perush meotan sheyyesh lahem lev basar, al kol panim tirdefem middat haddin leshallem dikduke haaverot, uvaze yitrabbe hammora belev hannivraim kesheyyaase din batztzaddikim veyiruhu, vegam hatztzaddikim lehanechilam shay olamot.

rashi: Ki chinnam mezora harashet. ki haofot haroot chittim vekitniyyot mezorim al hareshet, chinnam hu beenehem, sheenam makkirim al ma hi nizret, veyordin bah veochlin:
targum: Metul demagan perisa metzudeta al pirchata degappa:

rashi: Ki shivatayim yukkam kayin. kayin sheharag mezid nitla lo ad shiva dorot, ani sheharagti shogeg lo kol shekken sheyyittale li sheviiyyot harebe:

Shivim veshiva. leshon ribbuy sheviiyyot achaz lo, kach darash rabbi tanchuma. umidrash bereshit rabba lo harag lemech kelum, venashav porshot mimmennu mishshekiyyemu periya ureviyya, lefi shennigzera gezera lechallot zaro shel kayin leachar shiva dorot, amru ma anu yoldot labbehala? lemachar hammabbul ba veshotef et hakkol vehu omer lahen vechi ish haragti lefitzi? vechi ani haragti et hevel, shehaya ish bekoma veyeled bashshanim, sheyyehe zari kale beoto avon? uma kayin sheharag nitla lo shiva dorot, ani shello haragti, lo kashe sheyyittalu li sheviiyyot harebe? vezehu kal vachomer shel shetut, im ken en hakkabba gove et chovo umekayyem et devaro:

Velo yitboshashu. shello hayu yodim derech tzeniut lehavechin ben tov lara, veaappi shennittena vo dea likrot lo shemot, lo nittan bo yetzer hara ad achlo min haetz venichnas bo yetzer hara veyada ma ben tov lara (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyihyu shenehem arummim vegomer. taam haddavar lihyotam mikkodem meshullalim mibbechinat hara uchelalutam kodesh, hayu domot bahem panim shellematta kefanim shel mala, ki bechinat hara shennidbeka baadam hi asher tavdil bachelek shellematta baadam, ki sham kana hara mekomo. veze lecha haot – ot berit kodesh asher tesovvehu hakkelippa baarla, vetzivva Adonai lichrot otah. hinnecha roe ki sham hirgia sheda. vetimtza ki chol taavot harshaim hannoafim tivar bammakom hahu, vegazar Adonai lechassot hattiuv. vetimtza sheasru chachamenu zichronam livracha (nidda 13.) lehanniach yado vechulei, veamru (shabbat kach:) yad laamma tikkatzetz, ki yavir esh zara uteachlehu esh lo nuppach, veze lo haya kodem lachen. veyesh lanu livchon haddavar mimma sherainu beavraham avinu alav hashshalom sheamar (Bereshit 24:2) laeved: "sim na yadcha" vegomer. hattaam amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (zohar) ki avraham avinu alav hashshalom lo haya kol kach behashevaa im kol hannivraim bivchina zo, ki hirchik hattiuv. vahagam shello hurechak behechlet vehammita mochachat, aval al kol panim lo haya hattiuv kol kach, uverit kodesh shebbivsaro tamma hayta, nekiyya hayta. ulederech ze yeduyyak hakkatuv al nachon amro velo yitboshashu, shehaya lo lomar "velo nitbayyeshu", shennitkavven lomar shehagam shehayu arummim lo yitboshashu, perush, hattora maggedet alehem sheen lahem davar sheyyitbayyeshu mimmennu, vehaven. vehiggid hakkatuv mi garam bechinat haerva lehavedil baadam chetzyo shel matta, veamar "vehannachash" vegomer umizze nitgalgelu haddevarim vechulei:

rashi: Mi higgid lecha. meayin lecha ladaat ma boshet yesh beomed arom?
Hamin haetz. bitmiha:
ohc: Vayyomer mi higgid lecha vegomer. perush: ma nishtanna shaa zo mishshellefaneha, shehayita omed lefanay velo hirgashta baerom ad atta? davar ze meatzmecha lo titchaddesh lecha hayedia zulat al yede maggid, vehu amro mi higgid lecha bamme nitchaddesh bidiatcha davar ze. ulefi ma shepperashnu ki hayta hachelamato meheavon o miggeriat hammussag lo mehakkedushsha umikkesut anan kavod, lo yutzdak lomar "mi higgid lecha", ella tamo shel habbore hu lo ratza lehavezoto kol kach vedibber elav beseder ze "mi higgid lecha", keshoel davar, veyeshna lishela zo lema shepperashnu ki beemtzaut achila zo hirgishu ki erummim hem, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki chol happerushim sheanu mefarshim kemashmaut hakketuvim kullam tzodkim.
Hamin haetz vegomer. kan remazo ki gam al bechinat haetz tzivvahu Adonai:

rashi: Vehayu limorot. od zot yeshammeshu, sheyyairu laolam:
ohc: Vehayu limorot vegomer. mashmaut hakkatuv yaggid ki tzivva Adonai sheyyihye or hammeorot bokea bashshamayim, veod lo sheyyair baaretz, perush sheyyairu hammeorot bechol hekkef hashshamayim vegam yaggia oram ad lematta laaretz. od yirtze ki hechinam Adonai sheyyairu tokef oran barakia, umehaor hammitpashshet barakia tair eretz, ki en koach baaretz lisbol tokef or hammeorot, vehu sheddikdek lomar limorot birkia hashshamayim, perush ki sham yairu, veamro lehair al haaretz, perush ki meor habbahir bashshechakim tair eretz.

Uledivrehem zichronam livracha (chagiga 12:) ki hammeorot barakia 2, en meor hammeorot bokea ella bashshamayim, vehashshamayim 2 hem meirim laaretz. uma sheamru zichronam livracha (yoma koach:) "yoma deeva kulleh shimsha", eno machchish devarenu, ki al kol panim mekom hashshemesh, hagam shemmitpashshet tokef hashshemesh latztzedadin, yesh hevdel ben mekom keviut hashshemesh sheyyesh bo tokef yoter mitztzedadav, veyoma deeva chozer paam 2 umitpashshet tokef hashshemesh hannishar mechuvvan keneged haaretz shiur shettuchal lisbol, chozer umitpashshet begova hashshamayim beemtzaut haananim, vehayeynu "kulleh shimsha"

rashi: Vattippakachna vegomer. leinyan hachachma dibber hakkatuv velo leinyan reiyya mammash, vesof hammikra mochiach:
Vayyedu ki erummim hem. af hassuma yodea keshehu arum, ella mahu vayyedu ki erummim hem? mitzva achat hayta veyadam venitartelu hemenna (Bereshit Rabba):

Ale teena. hu haetz sheachlu mimmennu, baddavar shennitkalkelu bo nittakkenu (sanhedrin 70), aval shear haetzim menaum millittol allehem. umippene ma lo nitparsem haetz? sheen hakkabba chafetz lehonot beriyya, shello yachlimuha veyomru zehu shellaka haolam al yado, midrash rabbi tanchuma:
ohc: Vattippakachna ene vegomer. lefi ma shepperashnu befasuk (Bereshit 2:25) "vayyihyu shenehem arummim", sheheavon yolid haregashat haerva asher mitztziddah yolid boshet haerom, hu haddavar sheamar hakkatuv "vattippakachna" vegomer vechol echad nitbayyesh mechavero. od yirmoz beamro vattippakachna al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota 3.) en adam over avera ella im ken nistattemu ene sichlo, vehu shemmeyaches hakkatuv hassimmaon larshaim, keamro (Yeshayahu 42:18) "vehaivrim habbitu lirot", vehu shehodia hakkatuv kan beamro "vattippakachna", perush sheachar sheavru haavera veavar hammesit hamechunne bemiddat choshech, shemmachshich ene haadam, techef umiyyad nifkechu enehem vehirgishu ki erummim hem, perush shennifshetu mizzohora dikdushsha. vechen yikre lechol rasha shebbigmar maase hara yargish ki hitiv, veyikkalem bemaasav veyairu ene sichlo. uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (pirki derabbi eliezer yad) sheamru veze leshonam: levusho shel adam harishon or tzipporen vaanan kavod mechasse alav, yityashshev hakkatuv al nachon amro ki erummim hem mimmalbush shehaya alehem.

rashi: Hattanninim. dagim gedolim shebbayyam, uvedivre aggada hu livyatan uven zugo shebberaam zachar unekeva veharag et hannekeva umelachah latztzaddikim leatid lavo, sheim yifru veyirbu lo yitkayyem haolam bifnehem:
Nefesh hachayya. sheyyesh bah chayyut:
ohc: Vayyivra elohim vegomer. perush: hosif Adonai koach biv perate habberia shennivreu min hammayim, uma shechazar lomar "veet kol nefesh hachayya" vegomer velo hispiku hammayim lehotziam, ma shello matzinu sheasta haadama behotzaat haddeshaim vehaasavim shehispika imrat Adonai lah, da ki en hammatzmiach velo habbore bore yoter mimma sheyyesh bechoach toladto, ki ech yitten adam ma sheen bo, vehinne hammayim veheafar hem mechussere ruach hachiyyunit, uminnayin lahem ruach latet bivruehem. vahagam ki haaretz vehammayim yesh bahem chiyyuniyyut dak ad meod, hagam sheyyittenu mimmennu lo yittenu yoter mimma shebbahem, veze lo yaspik laddagim velaofot, asher al ken lo hispik kocham vehutzrach Adonai livro lahem ruach hachiyyunit, vehu amro vayyivra vegomer et kol nefesh vegomer. vahagam shebbetzavvoto lammayim amar "yishretzu sheretz nefesh chayya", perush: sheretz shettihye bo hachana lekabbel nefesh chayya, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki hachiyyuni yirtze hachana, vehu emtzai beno leven hachomer, veze yeshno bechoach hammayim laasoto kemo sheamarnu sheyyesh bechocham koach ruchani dak.

Uvattanninim haggedolim asa Adonai shinnuy bivriatam kemo sheamarnu, velo amar bederech kelal "vayyivra nefesh hattanninim veet kol nefesh" vegomer. baze gilla hakkatuv ki meshunnim hem mikkol ma shebbayyam, shemmillevad sheholid bahem nefesh, gam bechoach beriatam atzmah bara Adonai bahem koach nosaf asher en koach bayyam laasoto kemo sheamarnu, veze hu haddag hammufla livyatan ze, uchevar devarav meforashim bedivrehem zichronam livracha (bava batra ad:). vetaam shello amar bivria zo "vayhi chen", en lo makom, ki lo yitztarech lomar "vayhi chen" ella keshello yuzkar ella imrot Adonai levad, taggid hattora "vayhi chen" ki amar vattehi, ma sheen ken kesheomer "vayyivra" – yesh bichlalo amira, yesh bichlalo havaya.

rashi: Tzedek umishpat umesharim. tzedek, tzedaka mimmamono. umishpat, lishpot emet. umesharim, hi happeshara derech chalak umishor shave laze velaze:
targum: Limkabbala marduta desuchela vetzidketa vedina uteritzuta:

rashi: Vattere haishsha. raata devarav shel nachash vehenu lah veheeminattu (Bereshit Rabba):
Ki tov haetz. lihyot kelohim:
Vechi taava hu laenayim. kemo sheamar lah venifkechu enechem:
Venechmad lehasekil. kemo sheamar lah yode tov vara:
Vattitten gam leishah. shello tamut hi veyichye hu, veyissa acheret:
Gam. lerabbot behema vechayya:
ohc: Vattere haishsha ki tov vegomer. kashe ech yutzdak lehakkir haregashat hammaachol al yede reiyya? od kashe lamma hikdim haregashat happe leharegashat haayin, halo haayin targish barut kodem shettavchin chush hattoem, veim ken kodem sheachla kadam yediat taava laenayim, umeharauy lehakedim lomar "ki taava laenayim"? od minnayin yada sheyyeshno behasekel? veim al hatzedakat divre nachash hu omer, lo haya lo lomar "vattere haishsha" al davar shello raata. od lamma heerich lomar 2 tevot notarot tevat hu vetevat haetz sheniyya bakkatuv? od lamma amar tevat haetz bachalukka 3 velo bachalukka 2?

Achen hakkatuv yaggid ofen metzudatah shel haishsha veech nitratztzet lishmoa lammesit. vehinne timtza beseder devareha harishonim el hannachash dikdeka lomar "umipperi haetz asher betoch haggan", hare ze maggedet datah vidiatah ki lo neesar lah ella happeri atzmo, aval haetz shel hailan vaanafav vealav lo neesru. usevara zo nuchal lomar bah shennolda lah meechad mishshene derachim: o shehaadam betzauoto tzivva lah benosach ze, o shehagam sheamar setam "etz haddaat" vegomer, chashva bedatah ki lo yetzav hael ella al happeri, ki haetz en bo mammash velo tavo alav hammitzva. uchevar hikdamnu maamre kadmonenu (Bereshit Rabba 15) ki chol atze haggan lo haya taam baetz zulat etz haddaat shehaya taam etzo vetaam piryo shave. vechan modienu hakkatuv ki bidvar hammesit lechavva bachana chavva veshalcha yadah veachla mehaetz, lo mehapperi, ki choshevet sheen issur baddavar leechad mishshene hatteamim shekkatavnu, velo chashsha lingia ki lo neesra hannegia ella bapperi atzmo velo bailan. o efshar sheshshalla bedatah issur hannegia lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 19) sheamru sheddechafah venaga velo meta, hechlita issur hannegia kevan shello ba beferush bedivre Adonai.

Vattere haishsha ki tov haetz. perush: guf hailan vaanafav raata bahem midda meshunna mikkol ilane hassade, zo havechana rishona. veleheyot shettaama shinnuy baetz, natna datah lehistakkel bemarit happeri ma shello histakkela mikkodem. keshehechlita bedatah achilato, kesheraata hashshinnuy natna datah veraata happeri ki taava hu laenayim, vehu sheddikdek hakkatuv beamro vechi taava hu laenayim. dikdek lomar tevat "hu" chozer el happeri, sheim chozer el haetz lo haya tzarich lomar "hu" ella "vechi taava laenayim", umuvan shechozer el haetz kemo sheddikdaknu lemala. ucheshehodia havechanat hahaskala amar "venechmad haetz lehasekil", dikdek lomar "haetz" lihyot ki lo haya bo maamar hassamuch, ki maamar hassamuch medabber bapperi velo neemar bo ella havechana hannikkeret belo teima. vachalukka zo shel hahaskala enah nivchenet bechush hariyya ella beemtzaut haachila, laze dikdek hakkatuv lomar venechmad haetz, perush sheachla lehasekil shehirgisha bo hahaskala. uvaze nitammetu beeneha divre hassatan sheamar lah taam shehivdilam Adonai meachilato hu leval yihyu shavim elav. vattikkach mippiryo vattochal – dikdek lomar "mippiryo" ki meetzo kevar achla kodem. uvaze nityashshevu kol hakketuvim vechol haddikdukim sheddikdaknu al nachon. gam taam lifamim mazkir etz velifamim peri. vetaam shennatna levalah hu letzad chibbato kede sheggam hu yihye lelohim vegomer.

Veraiti latet taam tov, ki en kol kach ashma al chavva, ki lo chashva sheyyesh beriyya baolam shebbara Adonai lehavechin bah ahavat beruav, shehu hannachash shennitlabbesh bo hassatan. veim hayta yodaat ze, hayta chosheshet lo velo hayta notenet ozen lishmoa devarav, kaasher osim hen hayyom anashim tzaddikim sheenam mattim ozen lefittuyav, hagam ki yarbe chelek leshono vehafelagat cheshek maadanne matamme issuro. veze hu letzad shehikkiru ki hu aven umirma, yored umastin, ole umekatreg. vehi haishsha haaniyya lo ala bedatah ki yeshnah livriyya zo baolam lenassotah. venosaf ki hirgisha bitimat haetz letzad heyoto muttar lefi sevaratah, veraata ki meshunne hu leshevach, uvehitztarfut datah shekkalla meadam. aval im hayta yodaat kidiatenu ki bara Adonai satan lenassot yedidav, o im haya lah teimat haetz beissur velo hayta toemet, lo hayta sholachat yadeha leechol.

Od nire latet taam lechavva shemmihara laavor pi Adonai, shehu letzad shechashva shekkabbalat mitzva zo haya betaut, shello chashva shekkol kach haya haetz hahu chashuv keshekkibbela aleha hammitzva. vetimtza ki bintinat hattora kamma beritot karat Adonai al hattora im yisrael, hare ze maggid ki hu devar tzorech velo taspik hammitzva sheyyachol lachzor bo. vetimtza od sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat pach.) shekkiyyemu bime mardechay ma shekkevar kibbelu, letzad shehayta hashshevua harishona beones shekkafa alehem hahar kegigit, hare ze maggid ki tzorech bishvua. umeatta chavva shello nishbea en aleha chova. vahagam shekkibbela, vaamiratah laggavoah bimkom neder hu, im kol ze hi kabbala betaut. vehinne lefanecha ma sheamru zichronam livracha bemassechet nedarim perek 9 (nedarim 66:) veze leshonam: konam yayin sheeni toem shehayyayin ra lammeayim, amru lo vahalo hameyushshan yafe lammeayim, huttar vechulei bechol hayyayin vechulei, ad kan. vehu atzmo metziut shellefanenu, shehagam shekkibbela aleha haddavar, kevan sheraata ma shello haya bedatah beet hakkabbala, keamro "vattere haishsha ki tov haetz" vegomer.

Umeatta nigla lanu ki 2 sibbot sibbevu michshol haishsha: ha hu bechashvah shello neesar lahem ella happeri velo haetz, asher letzad ze shalcha yadah vetaama haetz venitkayyemu lah divre hannachash. vehav shello yada bishat hatztziuuy ki haetz hu machkim ochlav, sheim hayta yodaat bitchillat hammitzva sheal menat ken habbore metzavve lah, lo haya nishar makom lammesit achar shekkibbela aleha shello leechol achar sheyyada maalato.

Vehinne haadon Adonai tzevaot yada ma vachashocha, hu hannachash sheatid lavo bitanot ellu, uvechesef nivchar leshon tzaddik shalal 2 devarim ellu beamro (Bereshit 2:17): "umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu", hare sheddikdek lomar "umeetz" leesor afillu haetz, vehodia gam ken ki hu machkim veyesh bo daat havechanat tov vechulei, veal menat ken gazar omer leval yochlu afillu mehaetz. uvaze en makom lammesit lehasit, ella shehaadam lo amar haddevarim kichtavan lehaishsha, kammuvan mittoch devareha, kemo sheddikdaknu mimma sheamra lannachash shehaissur hu bapperi velo dikdeka lomar etz haddaat, gam meamro "vattere haishsha vegomer venechmad haetz lehasekil" hare ze maggid ki lo hayta lah yedia mittechilla.

Vetaam haadam shello amar lah lechavva, lo ratza lehodiah ki yesh bo maala zo shemmachkim ochlav, kede shello lehagedil belibbah taavato, velo yada ki haoyev bacheder. gam lo chash lomar lah issur haetz bechashvo ki en taam baetz letzavvotah alav. vahagam sheamar lo Adonai "umeetz haddaat", chashav sheen davar ze bediyyuk, vehakkavvana hi al ma shebbaetz shehu happeri, ki haetz kevar hissig mishshear ilanot ki en bo taam velo tavo alav hatztzavvaa. ushegaga zo nolda mishshiggat haadama asher shinneta etz haddaat mishshear atze haggan, veayyen ma shepperashnu bimkomo (Bereshit 1:12), velaze laku chavva vehaadam vehaadama ki chullam shagu, veshel chavva gadol mikkullan.

rashi: Petayim. hammitpattim al yede mesitim uminim:
Teehavu feti. hasata shem davar lefatyut" (Mishlei 9:13), kemo "keli" (Bamidbar 19:17), "keri" (Vayikra 26:21), (shene 62) "shefi" (Bamidbar 23:3):
targum: Ad emat shavre rachamin shavruta umemikne memiknuta regigu lehon vesachle sanin yediata:

rashi: Tohu vavohu. tohu leshon tema veshimmamon, sheadam tohe umishtomem al bohu shebbah:
Tohu. ashetaveradeyshevan belaaz:
Behu. leshon rekut vetzadu:
Al pene tehom. al pene hammayim sheal haaretz:
Veruach elohim merachefet. kise hakkavod omed baavir umerachef al pene hammayim beruach piv shel hakkabba uvemaamaro, keyona hamerachefet al hakken, akevabetayr belaaz:
Itztzevonech. ze tzaar giddul banim (eruvin 100):
Veheronech. ze tzaar haibbur:
Beetzev teldi vanim. ze tzaar halleda:
Veel ishech teshukatech. letashmish, veaappikke en lach metzach letavo bappe, ella hu yimshal bach, hakkol mimmennu velo mimmech:
Teshukatech. taavatech, kemo nefesh shokeka (Yeshayahu 29):
ohc: El haishsha amar vegomer. nitkavven Adonai lomar 3 kelalot keneged 3 devarim haamurim bainyan "ki tov haetz" vegomer vechi taava" vegomer "venechmad" vegomer. keneged "ki tov haetz" sheratzta lehishtashea ulehitanneg hefech retzono yitbarach, hirba itztzevonah vaafillu bizman simcha "beetzev teldi vanim". ucheneged "vechi taava" vegomer amar "veel ishech teshukatech" shettitavve lo tamid, veyesh baze 2 perate kelala: ha hi shettitavve veen beyadah lehashelim maavayah ella beyad habbaal, uferat ze nichlal bichlal amro "vehu yimshal bach". vehav hu shello yihye lah metziut lehashelim teshukatah, vetimtza shettishtanne haishsha meish bifrat ze ki haish yisba bitshukato ma sheen ken haishsha vehaven, vezo kelala gedola shettamid chasera teshukatah, veze keneged middat taava laenayim. ucheneged "nechmad" vegomer amar "vehu yimshal" vegomer, hi chashva lehasir mealeha koach hammoshel haggadol shettihye kelohim vegomer, hosif lah moshel lehacheniah.

rashi: Veatta. af kol zot ko amar Adonai… al tira:
targum: Uchean kidnan amar Adonai divraach yaakov udeatkenach yisrael la tidchal are feriktach rabbitach bishmach dili at:

rashi: Vayyithallech chanoch. tzaddik haya vekal bedato lashuv lehareshia, lefichach miher hakkabba vesilleko vehemito kodem zemanno, vezehu sheshshinna hakkatuv bemitato lichtov veenennu baolam – lemalleot shenotav ‏(Bereshit Rabba):
Ki lakach oto. lifne zemanno, kemo hinni lokeach mimmecha et machmad enecha (Yechezkel 24):

ohc: Vayyichar lekayin vegomer. hinne hecharon af yaggid haggavhut, unefilat appayim yaggid hahashpala. hecharon af hu neged achiv sheala bemaalot vehu yarad lematta, bechashvo ki hu sibba, shehevi karban meshubbach umeulle yoter mimmennu uveemtzauto hukkar chesron minchato. vehashshiflut behakkarato pechituto beene Adonai.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyichar lekayin – kesheraa shello kibbel Adonai minchato, ki ze yaggid shemmaas habbore bivruav veeno mashgiach bahem, laze chara af. umidda zo beovde avoda zara hi, keamro (Yeshayahu 8:21): "vehaya chi yirav vehitkatztzaf" neged elohav asher eno mashgiach bo. vechaasher raa ki shaa Adonai lehevel velo lo, az naflu fanav, veyada ki lo mitztzad hammashgiach ella mitztzad hannishgach hu sibba limnoa mimmennu haratzon, veachiv yochiach 2 devarim: yochiach ki Adonai mashgiach, veyochiach ki kayin meshullal meharatzon, ki hem 2 menachot ufiggul achat.

Od yirmoz hakkatuv amram zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 2 182:) ki chol hakkoes nishmato mistalleket mimmennu. uvechina zo mityacheset el tzelem elohim sheal pene adam, vehu amro vayyichar lekayin uvaze naflu fanav, shennistalleka mimmennu hanneshama vehusar mimmennu tzelem happanim. vetaam hashepalato beene Adonai hagam shello noda cheto, maasav meidot sherasha haya.

rashi: Lifkoach enayim ivrot. sheenam roin et gevurato, latet lev lashuv elay:
Lehotzi mimmasger assir. veal yede sheyyitpakkechu enehem, yetzu asirim mimmasger. davar acher: levasseram al galut bavel haatida lavo alehen, shessofan latzet mimmenna:
targum: Lefattacha ene bet yisrael deinun kesaman min orayta leafaka nalvathon mibbene ammaya deinun daman laasirin ulemifrakhon mishibud malkevata deinun aninin kaasire keval:

rashi: Vehem ledamam yeerovu. vehatztzayyadim yeerovu ledamam shel ofot:
targum: Vehinun lidmahon kamnan umitshin lenafshathon:

rashi: Lara yarutzu. leraat atzmam hem ratzim, veenam yodim latet lev laddavar:
targum: Metul deriglehon levishta rahatan umistarhavin lemishpach dama:

rashi: Halo im tetiv. ketargumo perusho:
Lappetach chattat rovetz. lefetach kivrecha chetacha shamur:
Veelecha teshukato. shel chattat hu yetzer hara, tamid shokek umitavve lehacheshilcha:
Veatta timshol bo. im tirtze titgabber alav:
Adonai chafetz. lehareotchem velifkoach aznechem lemaan tzedek, ulechach hu magdil umadir lachem tora:
targum: Adonai rae bedil lezakkaute yisrael verabbe leavde orayte veyatkef yathon:

rashi: Achariv harim ugevaot. eherog melachim veshiltonim shel ovde kochavim umazzalot
Vechol esbam. kol hannilvim alehem:
Ovish. leshon yovesh hu leinyan davar lach, kegon esev uneharot:
targum: Achariv turin veraman vechol isbehon ayabbesh vaashave naharin lenagvan vaagamin ayabbesh:

rashi: Lachen kol horeg kayin. ze echad min hammikraot shekkitztzeru divrehem veramzu velo fershu, lachen kol horeg kayin leshon geara, ko yease lo, kach vechach ansho velo peresh ansho:

Shivatayim yukkam. eni rotze lehinnakem mikkayin achshav, lesof shiva dorot ani nokem nikmati mimmennu, sheyyaamod lemech mibbene banav veyahargehu, vesof hammikra sheamar shivatayim yukkam, vehi nikmat hevel mikkayin, limmedanu shettechillat mikra leshon geara hi, shello tehe veriyya mazzikattu, vechayyotze vo vayyomer david kol makke yevusi veyigga batztzinnor (Shmuel 2 Adonai), velo peresh ma yease lo, aval dibber hakkatuv beremez kol makke yevusi veyigga batztzinnor veyikrav el hashshaar veyichbeshennu veet haivrim vegomer, vegam otam yakke al asher amru haivver vehappisseach lo yavo david el toch habbayit – hammakke et ellu ani eesennu rosh vesar, kan kitztzer devarav, uvedivre hayyamim peresh yihye lerosh ulesar:

Vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot. chakak lo ot mishshemo bemitzcho. sefer acher davar acher, kol motzi yahargeni, habbehemot vehachayyot, aval bene adam adayin lo hayu sheyyira mehem, rak aviv veimmo, umehem lo haya yare sheyyaharguhu, ella amar ad achshav haya pachdati al kol hachayyot kemoshe umoraachem vegomer, veachshav bishvil avon ze lo yiru mimmenni hachayyot veyaharguni, miyyad vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot – hechezir et morao al hachayyot:
ohc: Lachen kol horeg. taam "lachen", leheyot shehikkir veyada sheim Adonai lo yishmerennu kol motzo yahargehu, bishvil mitzva zo richem Adonai alav veamar "kol horeg" vegomer. verasham Adonai ot befanav kemishpato hannahug beose mitzva shennirshemet bemitzcho letova ot, vehu amro vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot, vehu al derech ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba perek 17) befasuk "vehaya haddam lachem leot" (Shemot 12:13), perush leot mitzva lahem lishmira.

rashi: Chattaim. chotim:
Al tove. al tove lahem:
targum: Beri in neshadlu lach chatae la titpayes:

rashi: Mipperi haadama. min haggarua, veyesh aggada sheomeret zera pishtan haya:
Kotnot or. yesh divre aggada omrim chalakim ketztzipporen hayu medubbakim al oran veyeo davar habba min haor, kegon tzemer haarnavim shehu rach vecham veasa lahem kuttonot mimmennu:

Avi yoshev ohel umikne. hu haya harishon leroe vehemot bammidbarot, yoshev ohalim chodesh kan vechodesh kan bishvil mire tzono, ucheshekkale hammire bemakom ze holech vetokea oholo bemakom acher. umidrash aggada bone vattim laaza, kema deat amar semel hakkina hammakne (Yechezkel 8), vechen achiv tofes kinnor veugav lezammer laaza:

Bereshit. amar rabbi yitzchak lo haya tzarich lehatechil et hattora ella mehachodesh hazze lachem, shehi mitzva rishona shennitztauu bah yisorael, uma taam patach bivreshit? mishum koach maasav higgid leammo latet lahem nachalat goyim (Tehillim 111), sheim yomru ummot haolam leyishrael listim attem, shekkevashtem artzot shiva goyim, hem omrim lahem kol haaretz shel hakkabba hi, hu veraah unetanah laasher yashar beenav, birtzono netanah lahem, uvirtzono netalah mehem unetanah lanu:

Bereshit bara en hammikra hazze omer ella darsheni, kemo shedderashuhu rabbotenu bishvil hattora shenikret reshit darko (Mishlei 8), uvishvil yisrael shenikreu reshit tevuato (yirmeya 2); veim bata lefarsho kifshuto, kach parshehu bereshit beriat shamayim vaaretz, vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vechoshech vayyomer elohim yehi or velo va hammikra lehorot seder habberia lomar sheellu kadmu, sheim ba lehorot kach, haya lo lichtov barishona bara et hashshamayim vegomer sheen lecha reshit bammikra sheeno davuk latteva shelleacharav, kemo bereshit mamlechet yehoyakim (shm 27), reshit mamlachto (bereshit 10), reshit degancha (Devarim 18, 4), – af kan atta omer bereshit bara elohim vegomer, kemo bereshit bero; vedome lo techillat dibber Adonai behoshea (Hoshea 1), kelomar techilat dibburo shel hakkabba behoshea, vayyomer Adonai el hoshea vegomer. veitto lehorot ba sheellu techilla nivreu, uferusho bereshit hakkol bara elu – vesh lecha mikraot shemmekatztzerim leshonam umemaatim teva achat, kemo ki lo sagar dalte vitni (Iyov 3), velo peresh mi hassoger uchemo yissa et chel dammesek (Yeshayahu 8), velo peresh mi yissaennu; uchemo im yacharosh babbekarim (Amos 6), velo peresh im yacharosh adam babbekarim, uchemo maggid mereshit acharit (Yeshayahu 46), velo peresh maggid mereshit davar acharit davar – ikke, tema al atzmecha, shehare hammayim kadmu, shehare chetiv veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim, veadayin lo gilla hammikra, beriat hammayim matay hayta, ha lamadta, shekkadmu hammayim laaretz, veod, shehashshamayim meesh umayim nivreu, al karchacha lo limmed hammikra seder hammukdamim vehameucharim kelum:

Bara elohim velo neemar bara Adonai, shebbattechilla ala vemachashava livroto bemiddat haddin, raa sheen haolam mitkayyem, hikdim middat rachamim veshittefah lemihaddi, vehayeynu dichtiv beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim:
ohc: Beezer yotzer ora. avaer perush hattora. leyached shemo hannora. asher asani mereshit. vayatzani vekarani reshit. laasok benoam reshit. atchil levaer sefer bereshit:

Niftechu hashshamayim vaere marot elohim, bore ketzot haaretz, vaetbonan bema shehuresheti lehitbonen befetach divre kodesh, vahairoti mimmizrachah shel tora. amro bereshit sheshshiur hatteva hi semucha, kemo shettomar "reshit davar", vechan chaser hannismach lah, umi kelohenu yodea davar, halo mimmennu motza davar.

Amro bitchillat seder habberia hashshamayim, verabbotenu zichronam livracha pershu hatteva shehi murkevet miv devarim: esh umayim. umeatta hare ze chas veshalom noten yad lapposhim lomar ki zo hi hatechalat habberia, aval hammayim vehaesh lo beraam chas veshalom habbore, achar shehishmianu hakkatuv atzmo shettechillat habberia hi shamayim, veim hammayim nivreu haya lo lehakedim beriatam. vachachamenu zichronam livracha (chagiga 12.) nishmeru miv hearot ufershu sheshshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: bereshit beriat shamayim vaaretz hayta haaretz tohu vegomer, lo shettechillat habberia hayta shamayim vaaretz. aval divrehem zichronam livracha lo hispiku lehasir hattaut, ki ledivrehem lamma lo hodia hakkatuv achar kach beriat mayim veesh veafar veruach, vahagam sheamar hakkatuv (bereshit 1:9) "yikkavu hammayim vegomer veterae hayyabbasha", eno benishma shennivret, veyoter tzodek hammashmaut shemmetzuya hayta ella sheggazar aleha lehitgallot kesheyyikkavu hammayim.
Yesh ledakdek bakkatuv amro et hashshamayim veet haaretz, ma ba lerabbot bev ettin ellu?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi al ze hadderech, vekodem aira shachar hammutztzag etzlenu miggedullat habbore ma gadlu maasav, ki haadon baruch hu yuchal dabber dibbur bilti mussag bannivraim, keamram zichronam livracha (mechilta yitro) beferush hakkatuv (Shemot 20:1) "vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim" vegomer, veze leshonam: "devarim sheen happe yachol ledabber", vehu sheamar kol aseret haddibberot bedibbur echad velo kadam dibbur lachavero.

Uvaze navo el habbeur, vehu ki haadon yitalle shemo kol ma shebbara baolam, shehem hammekorot vechol asher yeshno bammetziut veshamayim vaaretz, hakkol kaasher lakkol berao Adonai bedibbur echad. veze hu amro bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz. dikdek lomar shene etin lerabbot kol hannimtza baolam. velihyot shehannivraim hem rabbim, ki millevad haasara devarim hannikkarim venirim leen kol kemo shemmenaum chazal (chagiga 12.) veze leshonam: "asara devarim nivreu beyom rishon: shamayim vaaretz, or, choshech, tohu vavohu vegomer, mayim, ruach" ad kan, millevad ellu yesh od beriot acherim neelamim venivlaim bechochot hayyesodot, yesh mehem nikkarim beemtzaut hahattacha, yesh mehem beemtzaut haharkava, yesh mehem behishtannut hazzemannim, yesh mehem bechoach hahiyyuli verabbu millispor, asher laze kelalam habbore biv peratim gedolim vaatzumim bashshamayim uvaaretz, vehem hem hav ribbuyim sheribba beamro et hashshamayim veet haaretz, uvemaamar echad bara hakkol yitalle shemo. vetimtza sheamru zichrono livracha (rosh hashshana lev.) "bereshit" maamar hu, ki bo hishlimu asara maamarot shebbahem nivra haolam, harishon shebbechullan bo nivra hakkol, ella shello haya mesuddar, vehaya kol habberiot bannimtza aval chasru hasseder, vesidderan hakkadosh baruch hu devar yom beyomo. beyom rishon hechin vehivdil haor min hachoshech vekana hachoshech mekomo vehaor mekomo, uveyom 2 vechulei.

Vehaed hanneeman leferushenu ze ma sheamar hakkatuv (bereshit 2:3) "ki vo shavat mikkol melachto asher bara elohim laasot", sheen mashmaut lakkatuv. uvema shepperashnu yavo kemin chomer, ki vo shavat mikkol melachto asher bara beyom habberia laasot, perush: letakken besheshet yamim, keamro (Shemot 31:17): "ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai" vegomer, perush: tikken, ki habberia beyom rishon bemaamar echad nivret, ella shehaya hakkol chaser tikkun. lema haddavar dome? lemi sheratza livnot palterin, vekodem mechin avanim veetzim veafar vetzarche habbinyan bemushelam, veachar kach yivne bayit. ken habbore baruch hu bara kol tzarche haolam bedibbur echad vehechino, vehaya hakkol munach gadush beirbuveya, veachar kach hitchil lesadder davar davur al afnav veasa poolo yitalle shemo.

Vetimtza shekkesheratza livro hashshamayim amar (bereshit 1:6): "yehi rakia betoch hammayim", perush: kava lo makom, aval hu kevar nivra bemaamar rishon, vechen haaretz (bereshit 1:9) "veterae hayyabbasha".
