Vehaesh shello hizkir Adonai tikkuno kol ikkar, heve yodea ki haesh lo gilla Adonai mekorah kegilluy hashshamayim vehaaretz vehammayim, lihyotah makor chazak veyesh mimmennu killayon laolam im haya bannimtza kemayim vaaretz veen haolam yachol lehitkayyem. laze hinnicho hakkadosh baruch hu bimkomo shennivra bemaamar rishon muvla barafim, ad shehutzrach adam lo vehikkish barafim vehotzi mehem esh shiur hammaspik lo, keamram zichronam livracha (bereshit Rabba 11) sheal ken anu mevarchim bemotzae shabbat "bore meore haesh" (fesachim ned.). gam baze gilla Adonai ofen hairbuv shehayu meurbavin hammekorot vehayyesodot bishat beriatam kodem shehechinam Adonai kol echad al mishmarto, ki im lo haya davar ze bammetziut lo hayta daat enosh sovelet yedia ech yihyu meoravim yachad mekorot, uma gam afar vaesh.

Vehen emet shehaya yachol habbore lichlol bammaamar harishon gam et hasseder, ella lesibbot harebe asa chen, veechad mehem gillu otah razal beamram (avot 5:1): "vahalo bemaamar echad yachol lehibbarot, ella lippara vechulei, velitten sachar tov latztzaddikim" vechulei.

Veal yikshe beenecha amram zichronam livracha (avot 5:1): "baasara maamarot nivra haolam" leshon beria, ki sof kol sof kol zeman shehaya chaser hattikkun keillu en kan beria. hammashal – im haaretz lo hayta niglet en makom lannivraim, uchemo chen shear habberiot shehayu meurbavim kemo haor vehachoshech, im ken kol shello nitkan keillu lo nivra, laze yityaches gam ken lahem habberia.
Veal yikshe beenecha lamma katva hattora ikkar habberia bederech ze, velo katva beferush: "bara Adonai hammayim veheafar vehaesh veharuach", shebbaze lo yihye ish navuv yillavev.

Da, ki hattora todia vetashmia kol nistar, vechafetz Adonai lehodia koach maasav leammo, vehodianu seder habberia veofannah, vechi hu hael haggibbor hannezar bigvura bara bedibbur echad kol yesh vechol hove, vechafetz Adonai lehodia lididav koach maasav, velo yimna tov ze bishvil hashshotim hattoim.

Veod yesh taam acher sheyyechayyev ledabber kasseder haamur, vehu sheim haya omer hakkatuv kasseder hachafetzim bo hassechalim, vehu sheyyomar ki bara eretz uvara mayim vechulei, haya benishma ki beraam kol echad bifne atzmo, veachar haemet lo chen hu. vahalo yadata ki lo yachpotz Adonai bedover shekarim velo yikkon leneged enav, veech yatchil rosh devarav chas veshalom bidvarim shello chen hu? laze dibber emet ofen habberia, ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam (Hoshea 14:10), lehodot ulegaddel labbore baruch hu, veyomru lelohim ma nora maasecha.

Vedikdek lomar bereshit velo amar barishona, "koach maasav higgid leammo" (tehillim 111:6), vehu ki lefi ma shehikdamnu ki hakkol bara bedibbur echad. derech sham naskil ki mi sheyyedabber kamma devarim bedibbur echad, gam bedibbur lo yitztarech lehakedim ot lachavertah. umeatta kesheamar Adonai tevat shamayim, lo kadma shin lemem velo mem rishona lemem acharona, vegam otiyyot kol davar vedavar lo kadma hatechalat hatteva lesofah, vegam bechol ot vaot en lah kedam techillatah lesofah.
Veachare hodia elohim otanu et kol zot, elle hem haddevarim asher hodianu Adonai betevat bereshit, perush: hakkol hu reshit, ki lo hayta babberia chelek meuchar, ella hakkol hu reshit, vehaven:

Vetaam haadon asher bachar livro bederech ze, millevad hattaam sheamarnu sheratza lehodia chelek miggevurotav yitbarach, od timtza ki kesheyyedabber yitbarach bigvurot shehi bechina hammityacheset leshem elohim min hashshem, hu lihyot haddevarim nidbarim keseder ze. vetimtza sheramzu zichronam livracha (makkot kad.) benoam divrehem, veze leshonam: "anochi velo yihye lecha mippi haggevura shemanum" ad kan. nitkavvenu lomar bemetek leshonam haddevarim hanneemarim mibbechina zo shehu elohim hammityacheset ligvura tedabber kaddevarim haelle harebe devarim yachad, velav davka anochi velo yihye amar bedibbur echad, ella kol haasara haddibberot kaamur bedivrehem bemakom acher (mechilta yitro), ella hammussag etzlenu hu 2 mehem. veayyen ma shekkatavnu befarashat yitro (Shemot 20:1). vehinne beriat maase vereshit nivra beshem elohim, dichtiv "bara elohim" lesibbot harebe, laze dibber kedarko yitbarach devarim atzumim venoraim kemo shekkatavnu.

Uvederech derash yitbaer tevat bereshit al derech ma sheamar hakkatuv (Tehillim 33:6): "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uveruach piv kol tzevaam". veyesh lecha ladaat ki yitalle shem elohenu lo bara hammalachim ad yom 2 kede shello yitu hattoim ki hayu mesayyeim oto bemaase vereshit. uledivrehem zichronam livracha (bereshit Rabba 1) yesh lanu lehair ech yittachen lomar shehammalachim nivraim meucharim, halo lefi ma sheamar hakkatuv "uveruach piv kol tzevaam", ki tzeva hashshamayim nivreu meruach sheyyatza mippi elyon kivyachol, im ken behechreach lefi hammuregash hammalachim yibbaru kodem shamayim vaaretz, ki haruach yakdim latzet kodem sheyyetze haddibbur, vechevan shehashshamayim vehaaretz nivreu mehaddibbur hare kevar kadam haruach shemmimmennu yatzu hammalachim. laze amar hakkatuv bereshit bara vegomer, perush ki Adonai hikdim hameuchar shehu haddibbur laruach, hefech hayyadua etzlenu beteva haddibbur, uvara shamayim techilla vehafach hasseder veasa reshit dibbur laruach, lattaam haamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (sham), vehu shello yomru shehayu hammalachim ozrim umotchim immo shamayim vechulei. umodienu hakkatuv ki haadon baruch hu lo yukkach elav shiur mehannivraim, shehannivraim enam yecholin lehappech hasseder hammutba bahem beet habberia, ma sheen ken habbore baruch hu yachol hu ledabber bederech asher yachpotz. velaze timtza sheddiyyek hakkatuv beamro "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu" shehikdim beriat shamayim shennivreu mehaddibbur, veachar kach amar "uveruach piv kol tzevaam".

Umeatta shiur perush tevat bereshit hu al ze hadderech, ki leheyot sheyyesh baddibbur 2 devarim: haruach vehaddibbur atzmo, vechol echad bara mimmennu Adonai beria chadasha, veen ani yodea mi kadam mishshenehem – im haruach im haddibbur, laze amar ki reshit haya maase shamayim vaaretz, umimmotza davar atta yodea ki haddibbur haya reshit laruach sheyyatza mippi elyon.

Od yesh lanu lehavin shinnuy shebben 2 hakketuvim: befasuk ze lo amar ella shem elohim, vechatuv echad hu omer (bereshit 2:4) "beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim" shehizkir 2 shemot. veod, ki kan hikdim shamayim laaretz, vesham hikdim eretz lashshamayim.

Venire ki 2 kushyot ellu kol achat metaretzet chavertah, vehu al derech ma sheppershu zichronam livracha (sota lo.) biv mikraot hakketuvim betashlum sechar hatztzaddikim: katuv echad omer (Shemot 20:6): "veose chesed laalafim", vechatuv echad omer (Devarim 7:9): "leohavav uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor". veamru zichronam livracha ki ma sheamar hakkatuv "laalafim" – leohavav bilvad, veeno chozer gam leshomre mitzvotav shehem haosim miyyira, ki otam befasuk acher huzekar shehem elef dor. gam pasuk sheamar "leohavav uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor" eno chozer amro "leelef dor", ella leshomre mitzvotav hannismechet lah velo letevat "ohavav" hakkodemet, ki otam hinne secharam ittam befasuk acher shehu "laalafim".

Gam anachnu nefaresh 2 mikraot hallalu al ze hadderech: bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim – shem ze shel elokim perush midda zo shel haddin belo shittuf shem harachamim, ze hu davka lema shennogea lehashshamayim veeno chozer leamro "veet haaretz", ki haaretz beraah beshittuf shem harachamim, veal katuv acher somech, vehu amro (bereshit 2:4): "beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz", ki en olam bene adam yachol lehitkayyem bedin gamur belo shittuf rachamim, letzad shehem mechomer kayyadua. veamro "veshamayim" enah nimshechet im haaretz bivchina zo shel hashshittuf, veofen maaseha halo hem ketuvim befarashat bereshit. uvaze nityashshevu 2 haddikdukim kemin chomer, veinyan yediat mi kadam, hinne katavnu lemala shekkol habberia yachad nivrea bigvurato yitbarach.

Velo yikshe lecha ma mishpat yaaroch Adonai livne elim yoshve shamayim, sheyyutzdak lomar alehem shem elohim. halo timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (chagiga 15.) bemaase 314 sheddanuhu lifne elisha umachyuhu shittin pulese denura, vegam eliyyahu vechulei (bava metzia pe:), vechamma mishpatim lesare mala. vahagam sheen lahem yetzer, im kol ze yimmatze bahem hattaut, ki lifamim lo yechavvenu el haemet veyishgu. vetze ulemad mimmaase hammalach 314 veeliyyahu ki shaggu, vechen yiker mikre veyaanishem Adonai afillu al hashshogeg, ma sheen shofet bemishpat ze leyoshve aretz. uvaze yitammet ma shepperashnu, venachon.

Vahagam ki matzinu lerabbotenu zichronam livracha (bereshit Rabba 1) shehirgishu biv haddikdukim shebbakketuvim, vetertzu ki taam shebbefasuk 1 hikdim shamayim uveechad hikdim eretz, ki nitkavven lomar sheshshenehem yatzu keechad, vetaam shebbemakom echad amar elohim uvemakom echad shittef shem harachamim, amru (bereshit Rabba 12) ki mittechilla ala al dato livro beshem elohim, veraa sheen haolam yachol lehitkayyem shittef vechulei:

Da ki reshut lanu netuna lefaresh mashmaut hakketuvim bintivot haiyyun veyishshuv haddaat, hagam shekkadmunu rishonim veyishshevu beofen acher, ki shivim panim lattora, veen anu muzharim shello lintot middivre harishonim ella beferushim sheyyishtanne haddin lefihen. velaze timtza shehaamoraim en koach bahem lachlok al hattannaim bemishpete Adonai, aval beyishshuv hakketuvim uvemashmautan matzinu lahem bechamma mekomot sheyyefarshu beofen acher.

Shuv hitztzatzti besichliyyut haiyyun hakketuvim ki yisbelu devarenu gam divre kadmonenu alehem hashshalom. vekodem naskil ladaat ech yutzdak behaadon baruch hu rosh vasof bemachshavto, shebbitchilla chashav bedin, vechazar leshattef, ki haadon baruch hu lo yibbatzer mimmennu mezimma bimat zeman uvefachot meheref ayin yeda hakkol vichavven el haemet behashekafa rishona, kivyachol, baruch hu uvaruch shemo.

Achen da ki kavvanat shittuf harachamim tisbol 2 inyanim: ha ki Adonai yerachem lifamim lemi sheyyachpotz lerachem mibbeli havio bammishpat, ki zo hi middat harachamim limchol velisloach. veshem elokim gam ken lemi shello yirtze limchol yeviehu bammishpat, uchefi ze yesh lecha adam shello yavo bammishpat. vederech 2 hu ki leolam en Adonai mevatter leshum adam baolam, vechol haolam yaamdu lammishpat en nimlat. veyesh lecha ladaat amram zichronam livracha (bava kamma 50.) veze leshonam: "kol haomer hakkadosh baruch hu vatran, yivvatteru bene meav, ella bemishpat yaamid aretz veen adam nimlat min haddin". uchefi ze hinne berarnu lanu derech hav.

Umeatta ofen habberia lefi divrehem zichronam livracha hu al ze hadderech: bitchilla bara bemiddat elohim shehu yichus hammishpat, vechach hu hattachlit sheamad hakkol bedin. ella sheraa sheoto haddin lo yuchal haolam amod bo, shittef immo middat harachamim. perush: lo shechazar bo mimmachshava rishona chas veshalom, ella sheyyaase hammishpat bederech rachamim, kemo shettomar shello lippara mehaadam ansho keachat, gam shello lippara mimmennu techef umiyyad belo haarachat zeman, uleolam en laadam ella ma sheyyaggia elav bemishpat, vehu amram zichronam livracha (yerushalmi shekalim perek 5) "maarich appeh vegave dileh".

Nimtzeta omer shello chazar bo mimmachashavto, ki lo matzinu shekkadam bemachshevet Adonai shello lehitnaheg bemishpat beseder ze sheyyihye nifra berachamim. ulefi ze behechreach sheyyomar hakkatuv kasseder haamur, sheim haya omer "bereshit bara Adonai elohim" hayta hassevara notenet ki yesh mishpat veen mishpat gam ken letzad harachamim, ki lo hechlit Adonai mishpat levaddo. umeamro "bara elokim" levad hare hechlit ki en davar belo mishpat, vahagam sheamar hakkatuv achar kach "Adonai elohim" titparesh al amittatah kemo shepperashnuha, shehammishpat al kol panim yihye ella sheyyihye happeraon bederech rachmanut. vesamach aleha hakkatuv shennachriach lefaresh al ze haofen, lihyot davar yadua muchezak beyadenu ki yediat Adonai lo tithappech kivyachol.

Veachar shepperesh kavvanat razal gam achar divrehem yesh moshav lidvarenu, ki midda zo shel hashshittuf shehechin Adonai leyoshve tevel lehaarich appo veligbot meat meat benikkuy, lo yitnaheg Adonai ken ella immanu velo im haelyonim yoshve shamayim, ella techef umiyyad yeshallem lammitchayyev chiyyuvo keachat, gam lo yoil lahem hacharata vehavvidduy vehatteshuva velo taanat hashshegaga. vetze ulemad mimmaase huva bashshas (chagiga 15.) bed shennichnesu lappardes sheheenishu hammalach hayyoshev birshut hammelech yitalle shemo baruch hu al asher lo amad mippene elisha kede shello yite bemachshavto, vezot lammalach shegaga, gam lo huzehar aleha, vechen lo yishpot hashshofet leammo yisrael kayyadua mimmishpete torato shettitalle:

Od ramaz behakedamat shamayim laaretz lehareot ki lo kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam: middat basar vadam bone habbayit veachar kach haaliyya al gabbav, aval hakkadosh baruch hu hikdim haaliyya veachar kach habbayit, lehareot ki hashshamayim teluyim veomdim hem bemaamaro yitbarach:

Vederech remez razal darshu (bereshit Rabba 1) tevat bereshit sheyyechavven baruch hu lomar bishvil tora shennikret reshit, uferush bet shel bereshit hi bet hassibba. umeatta mi shezzacha battora zacha bechol haolam, umi shello zacha battora en lo lehanot min haolam ad midrach kaf regel, zulat im yeshammesh hechsher ameleha. vegam amru (Vayikra Rabba 36) bishvil yisrael shennikreu reshit, dichtiv "reshit tevuato" (Yirmeyahu 2:3), veen maamaram ze machchish harishon, ki taam atzmo shennikreu yisrael reshit hu letzad kabbalatam hattora, uvaze nivdelu leshem velithilla mehaammim. vegam amru (bereshit Rabba 12) bishvil avraham uvishvil yaakov (Vayikra Rabba 36), vehakkol holech lattaam harishon "ekev asher shama avraham" vegomer. gam amru (shabbat lo:) bishvil yira shennikret reshit, dichtiv (Tehillim 111:10) "reshit chachma yirat Adonai", ki hu ze gam ken yesod hattora, ki im en chachma en yira, veim en yirat Adonai en tora, ki hu otzar nechmad lattora.

Od titparesh bereshit al derech amro (Mishlei 8:30) "vaehye etzlo amon", vedarshu zichronam livracha (bereshit Rabba 1): "al tikre amon ella omen", vehu atzmo sheramaz hakkatuv techillat dibber Adonai vehodia beriat olam, hodia bamme beraah, veamar battora beraah ki hi haomen (en ze soter leferush rishon ki hattora hechina olam lehithallech bemesharim), ulefi ze gadla maalat bealeha shezzochim bakkol, velaze yihye haddin lahem sheyyikkaru bonim, vehu amram zichronam livracha (shabbat 114:): "talmide chachamim nikraim bonim", ki ma shebbefihem uvilvavam hu habbone, vehu amro (Yirmeyahu 33:25): "im lo veriti vegomer chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti".

Od titparesh bet shel bereshit al derech amram zichronam livracha (hakedamat Tikkunei zohar 5:), ki 2 ofanne yirat Adonai hem: haachat hi yirat haonesh, vehav hi yirat harommut, vezo yira penimit umeulla meha, vehu sheramaz baot bet reshit ki 2 yirot hechin Adonai lekiyyum haolam, veramaz ofen shenehem: ha remazah betevat elohim ki hi yirat haddin bekumo lemishpat, vehav remazah beamro et hashshamayim veet haaretz, vehu al derech amro (Tehillim 8:4) "ki ere shamecha" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 1 1:) ki yirat harommut tikkanes belev maskil behabbito behitbonnut bemaase shamayim vaaretz, ma gadlu maase Adonai, titlahev hannefesh veyira miggedullato yitbarach shemo.

O yirmoz 2 afne hayyira: achat beamro hashshamayim, kan ramaz yirat harommut al derech amro "ki ere shamecha" vegomer, veyira 2 veet haaretz shehi yirat haonesh, veyichasah laaretz lishlol ki enah letzad harommut ella letzad emato miyyalde haolam, al derech amro (Iyov 20:27) "veeretz mitkomama lo".

Od yirmoz bereshit al derech amro (Yeshayahu 33:6) "yirat Adonai hi otzaro", hakkavvana hi ki mi sheyyesh bo yirat Adonai hi otzar letikvat hallevavot shehu devekut oro yitbarach benefesh adam, keamro (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim" vegomer, vechol mi sheyyesh bo yirat shamayim hu mishkan hashshechina, keamro (Tehillim 78:60) "ohel shikken baadam". vehu sheramaz betevat "bereshit" al ze hadderech: bet perush bet moshav elohim, hi hayyira harmuza betevat reshit, bara Adonai vehechin poolo.

Od titparesh bereshit al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 35:5): hassefer vehassayif yardu keruchim vechulei, vehu amro bereshit bara elohim – perush: im reshit shehi hattora bara elohim, perush haddin shehu remez hassayif.

Od titparesh al derech ma sheamar hakkatuv (Melachim 1 18:39) "Adonai hu haelohim", vehakkavvana hi shehagam sheshshem elohim yityaches el haddin, af al pi chen rachamim hu, vechol shemotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu letova yechavvenu yachad lehetiv ulehitchassed. ella diltzad maase haacharonim yatza haddin leyasser lemi sherauy leyasser, vezulat ze gam shem elokim middato lehetiv. vehu amro bereshit bara elohim, ki shem elohim hetiv uvara olam lachon ulerachem ulehetiv leshochne shamayim vaaretz, veen lecha rachamim gedolim mizze. vehu sheamar hakkatuv (bereshit 27:28) "veyitten lecha haelohim", hare sheggam shem elohim yetiv lattovim betorat mattenat chinnam, ella sheose risha yesovvu laasot lahem elohim musar, veleatid lavo hamekuvve ken yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Od yitparesh tevat bereshit al derech amram zichronam livracha (hakedamat Zohar 2) ki bishat beriat haolam nichnesu haotiyyot lifne habbore. nichnesa 400 veamra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, retzoncha livro bi haolam vechulei, vechullam heshivam Adonai ki eno chafetz, lattaam haamur bedivrehem lechol achat veachat. ad shennichnesa bet vekibbelah uvara bah haolam, dichtiv "bereshit". alef shatka, amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu: alef, lamma at shoteket vechulei, amar lah: at tihyi rosh lechol haotiyyot vechulei, ad kan. hinne middivre Adonai yerae ki alef yesh lah maala meot bet, umeatta im hayu haotiyyot olot lefanav beyosher hayta haalef zocha livrot bah haolam. veleheyot ki yomar haomer: velamma lo alta haalef rishona vehinnichah ad levassof? da ki amru zichronam livracha (hakedamat Tikkunei zohar) ki haotiyyot keshehem bederech yashar al ze hadderech alef bet gimel vechulei hem romzim lemiddat rachamim, ucheshehem lemafrea al ze hadderech tav shin resh vechulei hem morim al middat haddin. veze lecha haot: chodesh tishre shehaotiyyot lemafrea tav shin resh hu zeman haddin haggadol, ella shehashshem letzad rachamav shittef ot achat mishshem harachamim vehi yod lerachem haddin (hakedamat Tikkunei zohar 16). veachare hodia otanu et ze, nefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech: bet reshit – teda taam likdimat bet lealef, leheyot shehabberia hayta bemiddat elohim, vechevan shekken alu haotiyyot lemafrea kammishpat uvaze kadma bet lealef vekanta mekomah.

Od yirtze beamro bereshit al derech amram zichronam livracha (hakedamat Zohar) ki elef olamot nelamim bara Adonai, vekorin otam zichronam livracha (Zohar chodesh bereshit 2) almin dechissufin, vehem harmuzim bappasuk (Shir HaShirim 8:12) "haelef lecha shelomo", umeatta hitchil hakkatuv bevet ki haalef kevar kanta mekomah shebbah bara elef olamot kishmah shel alef, vehitchil bevet livrot haolam hazze, leheyot sheyyeshno gam ken becheshbon habberia shehem 2 shamayim vaaretz, velaze gam ken lo amar "barishona" shettavin shezze hu techilla velo ken hu, shekkevar bara olamot hachemda, ella bifrat ze shel shamayim vaaretz hu sheomer reshito.

Od yirmoz betevat bereshit al derech amram zichronam livracha (midrash Shmuel avot 86) ki Adonai bara 4 olamot, veyichasu lahem shemot: atzilut, beria, yetzira, asiyya. uremazum bappasuk (Yeshayahu 43:7): "kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetzartiv af asitiv". vehu sheramaz kan beamro bereshit – hu olam hakkavod shehu haatzilut vehu yikkare reshit lakkol, "bara" – hu olam habberia, "elohim" – remez leolam hayetzira ki yesh sham dinim, "et hashshamayim veet haaretz" – hu olam haasiyya ki hu ze shamayim vaaretz, kaamur bedivrehem hanneimim.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha (fesachim 54.) ki gan eden vegehinnom nivreu kodem shennivra haolam, shehem sachar veonesh al hattora vehammitzvot, vehu sheramaz beamro 2 reshit, ki 2 devarim bara Adonai meyuchadim bishvil hayyira, shehem sachar veonesh, gehinnom vegan eden (chagiga 15). zacha veyare meAdonai – notel chelko vechelek chavero began eden, lo zacha – notel chelko vechelek chavero begehinnom. veulay ki ramaz ki shenehem notzru yachad, velishnehem yikkare reshit, ki im kadma achat lachavertah lo yityaches reshit ella leechad, ha lamadta ki bedibbur echad nivreu yachad.

Od yirmoz ki leheyot sheyyesh 2 olamot – olam hazze veolam habba, vehaadam al yede hitasseko battora uvemaasim tovim yassig hattov vehachayyim, kan hodianu hakkatuv ki lo yeshullam latztzaddikim sechar hattora vehammitzvot baolam hazze ad asher yachin lahem otzar hattov shehi haikkar lechelek hanneshama, veachar kach im yotir metivin lo gam baolam hazze. ki yivchar Adonai techilla lehachin laadam gemul olam haelyon shehu hannitzchi, vehu sheramaz beamro bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim shehem olam hanneshamot, veachar kach veet haaretz shehu olam hashshafal im heedif betuvo. ha lamadta sheen metivin latztzaddikim baolam hazze ad achar sheyyizku benachalatam leor beor hachayyim.

Od yirmoz al pi ma shennechleku razal (rosh hashshana 10:) – echad amar betishre nivra haolam veechad amar benisan nivra haolam. venire li ki ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim, ki yesh lecha ladaat sheamru zichrono livracha (bereshit Rabba 81) shebbattechilla chashav Adonai livro haolam veachar kach hotzi Adonai machashavto lappoal. uchefi ze nuchal lomar ki benisan chashav uvetishre yatza lappoal o lehefech, velishnehem yityaches leshon beria – ben ma sheala bemachashavto yitbarach beria tikkare ben kesheyyatzta lappoal, uvaze yitkayyemu divre rabbotenu yachad. vehu sheramaz babbet shel tevat bereshit ki 2 reshit hayu – achat lammachashava veachat lammaase, ella sheen anu yodim im benisan chashav uvetishre paal o lehefech.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 6:): kol mi sheyyesh bo yirat shamayim devarav nishmain, vehattaam ki hayyare devar Adonai yedabber mittoch kimat nafsho, vechevan shekken takkir nefesh hashshomaat utekabbel tochachat musar. veim haddevarim yatzu mehagguf en shayyachut lannefesh lishmoa, kemo sheramzu zichronam livracha bema sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 6:7): "vehayu haddevarim vegomer al levavecha" az "veshinnantam levanecha" – hem hattalmidim. vehu amro bereshit shehi hayyira, keamram zichronam livracha, bara Adonai et hashshamayim – perush sheyyihye yere shamayim, az yishshama kolo vilammed adam daat, vehu amro veet haaretz:

Od yirtze leheyot shetztzivva Adonai harebe yirot baolam: yira meaviv veimmo, dichtiv (Vayikra 19:3) "ish immo veaviv tirau", gam mehammelech umehachachamim, gam lira mehabberiyyot leval yachsheduhu. veyomar haomer shettihye shava mitzvat hayyira bechol mekomot sheyyeshnah, veyetze mizze shellifamim yezalzel chas veshalom bemitzvot Adonai lichvod hammelech o lichvod aviv vechaddome. laze ramaz kan bitchillat divre Adonai ki kodem kol davar yakdim liro et hashshamayim veachar kach veet haaretz shehem peratim hamechuyyav lachush lahem, vehu sheamar hakkatuv (Bamidbar 32:22) "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai" techilla veachar kach "umiyyisrael". umeatta en makom lekayyem shum mitzvat mora shel hazzulat ella im lo yaavor al shum mitzva mimmitzvot Adonai.

Od yirmoz ki beemtzaut hattora bara Adonai 2 haderagot baadam, o yishve bemadrega lashshamayim, vehu al derech amro (tehillim 82:6) "ani amarti elohim attem", o im lo yekayyemah tered madregato lematta laaretz, vehu amro bereshit perush beemtzaut reshit bara Adonai 2 hachanot ellu et vechulei:

Od tirmoz happarasha kullah al beriat haadam, ki hu ikkar tachlit habberia, al ze hadderech: bereshit keshebbara Adonai et haadam, berao mimmekor haruchaniyyut haramuz betevat "hashshamayim" umimmekor haggashmiyyut haramuz betevat "haaretz". vetimtza sheramzu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tze:) bema sheamar hakkatuv (tehillim 50:4) "yikra el hashshamayim meal" shehu haruach, "veel haaretz" hu hagguf habbanuy mehaaretz. uretzono yitbarach baze hu sheal yede maase haadam yitatztzem lahafoch hachomer shehu hagguf ad sheyyihye nechshav tzura.

Vehinne timtza (shabbat kinnev:) shehatztzaddikim enam chozrim afar, leheyot ki zikkechu hachomer shellahem ad shennaasa ruchani, kemo shekkatav harav rabbi yitzchak arama zichrono livracha veze leshono: vehitatztzemut hashshelemim lehappech hachomer letzura, ad kan leshono, velaze amru zichronam livracha (berachot 18.) shehatztzaddikim bemitatan nikraim chayyim, ki chelek haggeshem naasa ruchani hammityaches el hachayyim, veharshaim bechayyehem keruyim metim letzad sheggam haruchaniyyut shebbahem nitgashshem venaasa eretz hammityaches el haddomem shehu met

Uv middot ellu remazam beamro et hashshamayim veet haaretz al ze hadderech: im zachu, hare hem masmichim chelek haggeshem shebbahem haramuz el haaretz, mechabberim oto venaase (chavemavenaya) [homonya] achat im hashshamayim, veim lo zachu, hare hem mehappechim chelek haruchaniyyut shebbahem livchinat haaretz venaase hatztzura chomer, vehu amro veet haaretz.

Veamro vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu, kan ramaz ma shehaya baavonot, shennitgabber tzad hachomer shehi haaretz venitroken meharuchaniyyut, kemo shettirgem tzadya verekanya, vechoshech shehu yetzer hara hannikra bedivre kadsham (Zohar chelek 1 63:) demachshich anpe divriyyata, al pene tehom, vekara lehagguf tehom lihyoto kattehom bolea tamid, umitztzad hayyetzer shehu hachoshech, veruach elohim hannittenet bo merachefet al pene hammayim, ki lo matza haruach manoach lechaf raglah, ki hayyetzer gershah vehurema mimmekom hannachatah, vayyishkon sham hachoshech shehu yetzer hara, venisheret hannefesh merachefet al pene hammayim, hem mayim hazzedonim shehem kochot shel hattuma.

Uviroto hakkadosh baruch hu ken, vayyomer elohim yehi or – sholeach el haadam ezer neged yitzro, veze yihye behaggio leyd shana, yofia alav mimmeon kadsho ruach elahin kaddishin, neshama kedosha utehora. o yirmoz el hattora ki hi haor hanneerav, velah yikkare or, dichtiv (Mishlei 6:23) "vetora or". vehamechuvvan echad, ki bechinat hanneshamot hakkedoshot hem bechinat or hattora, uvaal nefesh hu baal tora. vehu amro vayyomer elohim yehi or – shehi hanneshama sheorah rav, lihyotah chatzuva mittachat kisse chevodo yitbarach, chelek eloah mimmaal, sholchah Adonai lehair el haadam leval yitba betit hayyetzer hara. o gam ken lema sheamarnu shehi hattora hammeira lenefesh adam, veaz vayhi or, vayyar elohim et haor asher natan baadam ki tov, shebbeemtzauto yelech haadam bederech hattov vehayyashar.

Velo tachshov ki bihyot hanneshama baadam o al yede esek hattora baze hu shaket mittachbulot hayyetzer hammachtio ufana vehalach lo, sheim ken en kan lo sachar velo onesh. laze amar ki adayin hachoshech baolam, ella sheal yede ze mistayyea haadam lehaarich milchama immo ulehavdilo mealav leval happilo bemoatzotav, veyakkir bechinat asot ra ki ra hu, veze hu amro vayyavdel elohim ben haor shehi hanneshama uven hachoshech shehu hayyetzer hara, veze sheamar hakkatuv (Kohelet 10:2) "lev chacham limino" shehu mekom haor, mekom hanneshama, "velev kesil lismolo" shehu mekom hayyetzer hara. vekara laor yom velachoshech kara layla, velaze hitpallel david (tehillim tze) sheyyatztzilehu mippachad ballelot.

Veamro "vayhi vegomer yom echad" – ki i efshar sheyyukkar orah shel hanneshama ella mechashko shel hayyetzer hara, sheim lo chen lo yishtannu mimmalache hashsharet veen kan lo sachar velo onesh, velaze amar "yom echad".

Vichavven od lomar yom echad al derech amram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 35:) befasuk (Shir HaShirim 1:3) "al ken alamot ahevucha" – "al mot", perush: afillu malach ra one beal karcho amen. velaze amar vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad, perush: middat erev umiddat boker kullam behasekama achat letovat hatztzaddik.

O yirmoz sheal yede siyyua hanneshama yihye haerev, et sheyyaariv shimsho lalechet laolam haelyon, keet boker, et boo laolam, shettachzor hanneshama meira keyom boah, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kinnev:) "veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah" (Kohelet 12:7), veze leshonam: tenah lo kemo shennetanah lach, uvaze yishve yom boo keyom lechto keechad.

Od yechavven hakkatuv lehodia ki bitchillat habberia hechin Adonai veasa peullato shava shamayim vaaretz, shehagam shehashshamayim hem haelyonim, af al pi chen gam haaretz hayta begeder hattohora. vetze ulemad maalatah uzechutah ki mimmenna nivra adam afar min haadama vetooro kemalach Adonai (bereshit Rabba 8:9). vetimtza ki Adonai bachar lishkon baaretz im hannivraim vehechin bayit limnuchato kivyachol, vedavar pashut hu ki moshav elohim shalem hu vekadosh yeamer lo. vetimtza ki kodem shechata adam haya Adonai matzuy battachtonim kevaelyonim, vehu amro bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz begeder echad binkiyyut vetohora. vehu maamar hannavi (Yeshayahu 66:1) "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay", veamru zichronam livracha (chagiga yad.) shehu sherafraf, ha lamadta shehi begeder reuyat moshav elohim. ella sheal yede maase hattachtonim vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu venitgashshema vehucheshach orah letzad maase harshaim, vayyomer elohim yehi or shehi hattora, az chazra haaretz lekadmutah lehair orah veshachan Adonai baaretz im ammo venachalato, vehu amro vayhi or.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech, ki davar yadua ki matzinu lehakkadosh baruch hu shebbachar lishkon baarafel (Melachim 1 8:12), vechibbev lishkon betochenu. veod lo shemmatzinu (taanit 5.) kivyachol shennishba shello yikkanes lirushalayim shel mala ad sheyyikkanes lirushalayim shel matta, hare ze maggid shechaviva lo shel matta yoter mishshel mala. gam keshennaskil betaam beriat kol haolam neda ki haikkar hem hattachtonim shehem ammo venachalato.

Ulefi ze yechavven hakkatuv lomar seder habberia lo zo af zo, bederech chibba. bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim, veod bara beria yoter chaviva etzlo umeulla yoter vehi et haaretz, shehashshamayim adrabba teluyim bah. vechol ze beemtzaut bene yisrael am kedosho (Devarim 32:9), ki bahem taluy kiyyum haolamot gam haelyonim, kayyadua labbekiim bechadre hachachma haamittit.

Ulederech ze yitbaer amro vehaaretz hayta tohu, kan ramaz baavonot legaluyyot yisrael shehi sibbat meniat dirato yitbarach baaretz. galut haechad hu galut mitzrayim asher nisharu bo 400 usheloshim keminyan tohu 400 veachad asar vavohu cheshbono 19 hare 430 (Shemot 12:40), umashmaut vavohu gam ken yirmoz legalut shelleacharav shehu galut bavel, nikra galut bavel bohu ki targum "bohu" – "rekanya", uchetiv beyirmeya (Yirmeyahu 51:34) al galut bavel "achalani hamamani nevuchadnetztzar melech bavel hitztzigani keli rik". veamro vechoshech al pene tehom yirmoz al haggalut hammar asher anu bo shekuim bithom asher en lo sof, ze lanu elef vetr shana. velo day orech haggalut ella choshech sheyyirmoz lev devarim: ha leshibud haammim vechoved ol hammissim ad ki chashach mishshechor tooram, ze rode veze meradde – ashre mi shello raa, uvifrat bammaarav shellanu. vehav hu al hayyetzer hara asher hechshich haolam, uvaavonotenu rabbu paritze ammo yisrael vehuttar lahem nivlut happe ushevuat shav velashon hara vegazel, umonam millaasot teshuva lashuv shevutam. velo yomar adam biroto kol kach yeridat yisrael kol orech hazzeman ki chas veshalom avda tikva mibbanim, lo chen hu, ella vayyomer elokim yehi or – hu or haggeulla haatida hammufla.

Veamro vayhi or al derech amram betikkune hazzohar (tikun 21) "vayhi raz" sheor begimatriyya raz, hakkavvana sheggazar Adonai yitalle shemo sheor ze shel melech hammashiach lo yitgalle baolam veyihye sod tamun etzlo, keamram (Tikkunei Zohar tikun 21): lelibbi gilliti, millibba lefumma la galle. veamro vayyar elohim et haor ki tov chozer al haor mitztzad atzmo ki tov hu, ashre ayin raata, vechozer gam al ma sheramaz sheyyaasehu besod nistar ki tov, shekken tzarich lihyot, keamram zichronam livracha (yoma 9.) mikkamma teamim. veamro ruach elohim vegomer, amru bammidrash (bereshit Rabba 82) ze rucho shel mashiach, merachefet al pene hammayim – en mayim ella tora, al derech amram bazzohar (baheshametavet lachalok 1 13) shello yiggaalu yisrael ella bizchut hattora shennimshela lemayim.

Vehinne yadua hu ki baavonotenu harabbim harebe nitzotzot shel kedushsha hatbeu betoch hakkelippot, vegam harebe erev rav nishtakkeu betoch hakkedushsha, keamram besefer tikkune hazzohar hakkadosh (tikun 66), umeoravim ra betov vetov bera. laze tzarich kivyachol lehavedil hattov mehara vehaor mehachoshech asher nitarvu. vehinne yadua ki hakkelippa chiyyutah hi yenikatah mehakkedushsha davka, vezulat ze en lah chiyyut. velachen az behavedilo Adonai et haor shehi hakkedushsha venishar hara muvdal veen lo mekom chiyyut linok mimmennu, mimmela yibbatel. veze hu amro (Zecharya 13:2-3): "veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz", ki yidme liktzitzat hailan mimmekom yenikato vesharsho asher yonek mimmennu sheyyivash velo yitzlach od, velo yishshaer ki im haor hattov. veze hu sheamar vayyikra elohim laor yom, perush "vayyikra" leshon yekar ugedulla, ki en maalat hakkedushsha nikkeret ella behappil hakkelippa hannikret choshech. vehodia hakkatuv ki bayyom hahu hayyadua lefanav bammarom yikra Adonai laor bikar ugedulla, veze yihye beyom yivvada laAdonai sheyyihye bo Adonai echad (Zecharya 14:9).

Veamro velachoshech kara layla leshon mikre hu bilti tahor, velaze lo samach hakkatuv al tevat "vayyikra" sheamar battechilla, ki en yekar vechavod od lachoshech ella mikrehu yihye davka ballayla, vehu sod amro (Devarim 23:11) "mikkere layla", aval kesheyyaavor hallayla shehu zeman haggalut, kemo sheamar hakkatuv (Yeshayahu 21:11) "massa duma vegomer shomer ma millayla" ki haggalut doma lallayla, veaz baalot hashshachar en od choshech velo layla ella "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad", ki bechinat hara nistalleka veenah, velayla kayyom yair vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma, vehu amro yom echad, vehu sheramaz hakkatuv beamro (Zecharya 14:9) "bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad":

Vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam vegomer vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro raat haadam baaretz, lamma yiches haraa baaretz, shennire sheraatam hayta beguf haaretz, veachar haemet rishat harshaim hahem hayta biznut umeforash bakkatuv uvechamas vegazel, veaf sheyyutzdak lomar "baaretz" al bechinat gezel haaretz, im kol ze yihye ze perat mehapperat. od lamma dikdek lomar vayyinnachem [Adonai ki asa et haadam] baaretz lamma amar tevat "baaretz", shennire sheim asao bemakom acher lo yinnachem leolam, veen mashmaut laze. od ech yutzdak lomar "vayyinnachem Adonai" ki lo ish el vegomer. od amro vayyitatztzev itztzavon ze lamma, sheachar shehu nokem nikmato mehem umoche kol mored. velaze efshar lomar al hefsed habberia.

Achen kavvanat hakketuvim hu, leheyot ki haadam hu murkav med yesodot: esh, ruach, mayim, afar, vehem behaderagot. haddarga happechuta shebbad hu heafar, ki hu achur vegas mikkullam. lemala mimmennu yesod hammayim, lemala mimmennu yesod haesh, lemala mehaesh yesod haruach, shehu haruchani shebbechullan. vetimtza ki chol hannivraim shebbaolam, hagam shekkullan med yesodot beraam, im kol ze kol beriyya ikkar binyanah miyyesod echad vehu yesod hayyesod vehag senifim lo. yesh beriyya sheikkar yesodah hu hammayim, kaddagim haggedelim bammayim, veyesh sheikkar yesodam min haruach kaofot, vahagam shemmin harkak nivreu im kol ze Adonai higbir bahem yesod haruach, velaze lo yanuchu hatztzipporim, afot hen kivchinat haruach. veyesh beriyya sheikkarah min haesh kassalmandera. vehen haadam yesod shealav nivnu bo hayyesodot hu yesod heafar, dichtiv (Bereshit 2:7): "vayyitzer Adonai vegomer et haadam afar min haadama", shehu yesod haggas veheav shebbed yesodot. velaze yeshivato umenuchato baadama, velo yisbol dira bammayim velo baavir velo baesh. veasa Adonai chen lesibbot harebe, veachat mehenna ki hu hassullam asher bo olot hammadregot mimmatta lemala, vehammadrega hattachtona hi yesod heafar vetzarich lihyot baaretz. veim haya nivne yesodo min hag haacherim haruchaniyyot beerech heafar, lo hayta hakkavvana shelema bivriato, vehammaskil yavin ki hu sod habberur, vehaven.

Velaze kaasher raa Adonai ki rabba raat haadam, hikkir ki rov hattiuv hu letzad yesodo shehu banuy min haaretz, vegam mekom hannachato vechayyuto baaretz. vehu amro vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz, ki hu yesod haggas venegdi laruchani betachlit. velaze nicham Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz velo asao banuy mishshear hayyesodot haddakkim, shebbaze lo haya rak ra kol hayyom. veleheyot shemmaasehu mishshear yesodot lo tetze kavvanat hayyetzira shechashav Adonai belibbo lappoal, vehu amro vayyitatztzev el libbo velo amar belibbo, perush: el retzono umachashavto asher chashav bivriat haadam. umitztzad ze lo hafach Adonai habberia, sheim lo chen haya Adonai soter uvone binyan chadash beharekava mig yesodot. velaze, hagam shehevi mabbul veibbed hakkol, hinniach habberia kemot shehayta letaam kamus belibbo yitbarach. vahagam shebbaadon yitbarach lo yutzdak lomar "vayyinnachem" ki hu tzofe umabbit ad sof kol haddorot, amar ken leheyot ki haadon yitbarach middotav middot harachamim, gam bo yitbarach tzad haddin. uvizman shehannivraim holchim bederech yashar, Adonai hu haelohim maskemet middat haddin lemiddat rachamim, uchesheharshaim machisim, middat harachamim tarchik harachamim vetachpotz bishlilat hahavaya measot din bahem. vehu amro vayyinnachem Adonai, perush: bechinat harachamim tachpotz shello tihye habberia kede shello lehappech hammidda, velo mippene ze tushelal habberia.

Od nire lomar lefi ma shekkatav harambam perek Adonai mehilchot teshuva veze leshono: ki yitalle shemo hu vedato echad, veen dato shel adam yechola lehassig davar ze al bureyo vechulei, veen banu koach leda heach yeda hakkadosh baruch hu habberuim umaasehem, aval neda vadday shemmaase haadam beyad haadam veen hakkadosh baruch hu moshcho vechulei, ad kan. veharavad, Adonai yechapper baado, nahag miut kavod beharambam al dabbero baze, veheela ki tov lomar sheruto yitbarach kirot itztagninin vechulei, yeuyyan sham devarav. vedivre harambam ikkar, ki en ofen yediat Adonai musseget etzlenu, umi yidme laAdonai lakachat yedia mehannidme elav. veaskilcha, ki Adonai yachol lishlol hayedia hammusseget bidiato leval yedaenna, kesheyyirtze haadon, ma sheen koach beenosh laasot zot shettaggia elav hayyedia velo yedaenna, vehu sheramaz rambam beamro: "veen dato shel adam yechola lehassig" vechulei, ki ech efshar shettaggia adav hayyedia meatzmah vetihye meshullelet meatzmah, vehu sheamar hakkatuv (Bamidbar 23:21): "lo hibbit aven beyaakov velo raa amal". hinnecha roe kesheyyirtze Adonai shello ladaat, yushlal hayyedia hagam shehayedia yeshnah meatzmah, ki eno bivchinat haadam shehayyedia hu chutz mimmennu, lomar yimmana velo yedaenna, ki Adonai hu vedato echad veeno tzarich latet lev ladaat, shebbaze nomar dichshello yitten lev lo yeda, lo chen, veaf al pi chen kivyachol yeshno bivchina zo dichtiv "lo hibbit" vegomer.

Umeatta nuchal lomar ki Adonai beet bero haadam shalal mehayyedia pishe adam liv sibbot: 1, lattaam happashti ki tov Adonai velo yabbit el hattiuv, vetaam ze levad lo yaspik kevan shehu tzorech bayyedia ladaat ma yaase vehannimshach. ella sheyyesh od taam 2 vehu shennitchakkem laasot Adonai ken leval tachul taanat harshaim sheyyomru yediato machrachat, kevan she yada ki peloni ze yaavor al ma sheavar, haddavar meatzmo yitchayyev lihyot hagam she lo gazar lihyot ken, umeatta en onesh larshaim ki lo mershaim yetze resha, uvamme yifchad rasha veyechdal meoshek. laze mana Adonai yedia zo shel maase harshaim. aval maase hatztzaddikim lo shelalo mehayyedia uvo samach, velsibba zo hayta habberia, vehu sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 1:31): "vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod". veim tomar im lo hibbit aven shel reshaim heach kava onesh leose risha, vechi tzarich likboa onesh lifloni hammarshia en tzarich likboa onesh ella leose avon vafesha. uveerech hatztzaddikim, en makom letaanat yediato machrachat, ki taana zo hi hattashlum, vehinne Adonai chafetz leshallem veen toen neged atzmo. ma sheen ken beonesh harshaim sheyyavou betaana leval yekabbelu onesh, laze shamar Adonai et haddavar. veen liton velomar, illu hibbit Adonai bahem sheyyihyu tzaddikim hayu ose tzedek, shettaana zo enah taana lefatram mipperat habbechira shennatan beyadam uvacharu bara umaasu battov birtzonam. veachare hodia elohim otanu et ze, en temiha beamro "vayyinnachem Adonai" vegomer, "ki nichamti", ki hu atzmo shalal yedia zo mimmennu.

rashi: Lehavin mashal umelitza. sheyyittenu lev lehavin bammikraot shene hadderachim: hammashal vehammelitza, sheyyavinu et ma himshil lammelitza. veaf min hammelitza lo yasuru libbam, sheggam hi tzerichim lehavin. kesheamar "lehatztzilcha meishsha zara" venachriyya" (Mishlei 2:16) – al avoda zara neemar, hare hammashal. veaf hammelitza shehotzi meshalo bilshon 'ishsha – haven bah vehizzaher meishsha (0 zona):
Divre chachamim vechidotam. dorshe reshimot: mikra male vechaser, remez, dimyon vechida:
targum: Lemitbeyana matlaa ufilata umile dechakkime veochadathon:

rashi: Na vanad. en lecha reshut ladur bemakom echad:
Goralcha tappil betochenu. im tirtze tachalok, o im tirtze yihye beshuttafut:
Kis echad yihye lechullanu. beyachad:
targum: Paysach arme benatana kisa chad yeheve lechulana:
Titpenun lemachsenuti abba lechon ruchi veodinun milay:
Yeshavun kodam Adonai yekara vetushebachte benagvan yechavun:
La tidchal are vesadach memri mimadincha ayti venach umimaarva ekarev galvatach:
Adonai lemebad gevuran itgele lemebad gevura mitgele birgaz bemilul af bezia al baale devavohi mitgele bigvurete:
Yistacharun laachora yibbahatun bahata falche tzalmaya deamrin litzlam mattecha attun taavatana:
Af ana betavrechon egchach veedchach kad yete delucheya alechon:
Beri la tezil bearcha imhon mena raglach min shevilehon:
Kol utera vikara nishchach unemale vattana bizta:

bart: Nosin al haanusa. leachar sheanas o pitta ishsha muttar lissa bittah o immah o achotah, dichtiv (Vayikra 20) veish asher yikkach et ishsha veet immah, bechullan neemar shechiva vechan neemra lekicha, lomar lach derech lekicha asra tora:

Rabbi yehuda oser. dichtiv (Devarim 23) lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv, kanaf sheraa aviv lo yegalle. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. aval chachamim asru lenitan min haishsha lissa bittah o achotah o immah o achat mikkerovoteha, mippene shehi metzuya etzlam tamid veatu lide hergel avera. veim avar venasa achat mikkerovot anusato umefuttato o mikkerovot haishsha shennechshad aleha en motziin otah miyyado. umatnitin dekatane nosin al haanusa demashma afillu lechattechilla, mayre leachar mitat haanusa vehammefutta, dehashta lekka lemechash shemma leachar sheyyissa bittah yizne im harishona:

Kasher battorin pasul bivne yona. detorim mashma gedolim velo ketannim. bene yona ketannim velo gedolim. delo lishtemit kera velichtov min bene hattorim o min hayyona, umiddechatav bechullehu torim uvene yona shema minna leakkev:

Techillat hatztzihuv. keshemmatchil lehavi notza yafa tzehubba saviv letzavvaro, pesulim baze uvaze. bivne yona pesulin mishshum gadlan, uvattorim mishshum katnan, deyatzu mikkelal ketannim, velichlal gedolim lo vau. umihu bene yona hakketannim beyoter, sheshshomtin kanaf mehem veen dam yotze mimmennu, pesulim merov katnan:
En shochatin letoch yammim. shello yomru lesaro shel yam hu shochet:
Velo letoch hakkelim. shello yomru lizrok damah laavoda zara ka avid:
Uga. gumma. leshon ugiot laggefanim, bemoed katan [81 41]:
Uga shel mayim. davka achurim, aval tzelulin lo. shemma yomru lefartzuf panav hannire bammayim hu shochet:
Uvisfina. yachol lishchot al gabbe chelim vehaddam shotet veyored letoch hayyam. sheharoe omer kede shello lelachlech hassefina hu ose:
En shochatin legumma kol ikkar. vaafillu babbayit. vetaama degumma, mippene shehu chok hamminim:
Aval ose gumma. baggemara mefaresh dehachi kaamar, en shochatim legumma kol ikkar. veharotze lenakker chatzero ketzad hu ose, ose makom chutz laggumma veshochet, vehaddam shotet veyored laggumma:
Yechakke et hamminim. yachazik yedehen bechukkotehem. yechakke leshon chok:
Haya kore vattora. parashat keriat shema:
Vehiggia zeman. keriat shema:

Im kivven libbo yatza. ledivre haomer mitzvot tzerichot kavvana tzarich lefaresh im kivven libbo sheyyehe mitkavven latzet yede chovato, vehaomer mitzvot en tzerichot kavvana mefaresh im kivven libbo likrot kinkudatan uchehilchatan, laappuke kore lehaggiah sheeno kore hattevot kinkudatan ella kore kichtivatan kede lehavin bachaserot viterot, devikria kazo lo yatza. vaanan kayma lan keman deamar mitzvot tzerichot kavvana:
Bapperakim. lekamman bematnitin mefaresh ma hem happerakim:
Shoel mippene hakkavod. shoel bishlom adam nichbad sherauy lehakedim lo shalom kegon aviv o rabbo o sheggadol mimmennu bechachma:
Umeshiv. veen tzarich lomar shemmeshiv lahem shalom im hikdimu lo:
Uvaemtza. happerek:
Shoel mippene hayyira. adam shehu yare mippanav shemma yahargehu, veen tzarich lomar shemmeshiv lo shalom. aval mippene hakkavod lo:
Rabbi yehuda omer baemtza. happerek, shoel bishlom mi shehu yare mimmennu, umeshiv shalom lemi shemmutal alav lechabbedo:
Umeshiv shalom lechol adam. shehikdim lo shalom. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. uvechol makom sheasur lehafesik, kach asur ledabber bilshon hakkodesh kemo bishar leshonot:
Rachatz layla harishon shemmeta ishto. veaf al pi sheavel asur birchitza:
Istenis ani. kar umetzunnan, leshon tzinna. veikka tzaara im lo haya rochetz, veen issur bime evlo ella rechitza shel taanug:
Sheniyya labbaal velo sheniyya layyavam. em immo shel baal velo shel yavam, kegon achim min haav velo min haem:
En lah ketubba. mane umatayim shehem ikkar ketubba hu delet lah lashsheniyya, aval tosefet yesh lah:

Velo ferot. en meshallem lah perot nichse melog sheachal shellah, veaf al gav deferot takkinu rabbanan tachat pirkonah, vezo en chayyav lifdotah delo karinan bah veotvinach li leintu, ulefichach haya rauy sheyyeshallem lah ma sheachal mipperot nichse melog shellah, afillu hachi kenasuha rabbanan delo tigbe minneh perot sheachal bitnay ketubba, ki hechi diknasuha delo tigbe minneh ikkar ketubba, ditnay ketubba kichtubba dame:

Velo mezonot. en tzarich lomar sheeno chayyav lazun otah beodah tachtav, deha baamod vehotze kae, ella afillu halach limdinat hayyam velavta veachla lo meshallem, deillu beishsha keshera im lavta veachla chayyav habbaal leshallem, shehammalve tovea otah ma shehilva lah vehi tovaat levaalah, dedavka bemi sheppirnesah shello bederech halevaa amrinan bichtubbot halacha kechanan deamar mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veamad echad ufirnes et ishto hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi, dechevan shebbishvil baalah pirnesah velo hilva lah kelum leman ka tava, hi lo lavta vehabbaal lo bikkesh mimmennu sheyyefarnesah, hilkach mitzva hu deavad, aval im hilva lah, chayyav habbaal leshallem im hi keshera, veim hi min hashsheniyyot eno chayyav leshallem:

Velo velaot. im nishtammesh habbaal benichse melog shellah ad shebbalu eno chayyav leshallem, desalka datech amina hoil veen lah ketubba, im achal habbaal nichse melog shellah chayyav leshallem ma sheavad uvala mehem, ka mashma lan diknasuha rabbanan shello yeshallem habbaal habbelaot. aval ma sheyyimmatze mehen kayyamim notaltan:

Almana lechohen gadol vechulei. yesh lahen ketubba uferot, dimshallem lahen habbaal perot sheachal minnichse melog shellahen. umezonot yesh lahen, shennizzonot minnechasav, vedavka leachar mita, aval bechayyav en kofin oto lezunan, deha kayme aleh baamod vehotze. veim lavta achat mehen limzonoteha bechayye baalah, en chayyav habbaal leshallem lammalve. uvelaot nammi yesh lahen, shechayyav lehachazir ma shebbala veavad minnichse melog shellahen. vehane mile keshehikkir bahen, aval lo hikkir bahen en lahen lo ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot, aval yesh lahen tosefet uvelaot deitnehu beenayhu. vehay dishniyyot en lahen ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot vealmana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot vechulei‏ yesh lahen ketubba uferot umezonot uvelaot, lefi shehallalu middivre sofrim utzerichim chizzuk, vehallalu middivre tora veen tzerichim chizzuk. uveferek ellu hen hallokin muchach dachalutza lechohen gadol deorayta hi. veaf al gav dachalutza lechohen hedyot hi middivre sofrim, asauha keshel tora ledin ze:

Behema hammaksha kulei. muttar baachila. haubbar kullo, vaafillu mekom chatach shel evar. deim hotzi yado velo hechezirah tzarich lehanniach mimma shebbifnim latztzad hachitzon ulechatcho, shemmekom hachatach havedalat hachitzon vehappenimi asur, mippene shehu omed al sefat harechem. aval hechezirah en tzarich lachtoch letzad penim, ella metzamtzem vechotech umekom chatach muttar. demay taama neesar haevar kesheyyatza lachutz, mishshum uvasar bassade terefa, basar sheyyatza chutz limchitztzato shehu lo sade, terefa. ma terefa kevan shennitrefa shuv en lah hetter, af basar kevan sheyyatza chutz limchitztzato shuv en lo hetter. umekom chatach lo yatza chutz limchitztzato, hilkach muttar keshehechezirah kodem shechita, dekarinan beh behema babbehema tochelu:
Hare hu cheyalud. vetu lo mahane leh shechitat immo, vetzarich shechita leatzmo im nimtza chay. veim nimtza met hare hu chinvela:
Chotech meubbar shebbemeeha. vehinniach hachaticha betochah, muttar bishchitat habbehema velo neesar mishshum evar min hachay:
Min hattechol umin hakkelayot. shel behema atzmah:
Asur baachila. veaf al pi shehinnicho babbehema lo huttar bishchitatah. ulehachi nakat techol uchelayot, mishshum demidi delo mittarfa behu hu:

Beyadayim mesoavot. kelomar belo netilat yadayim. degazru al hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot lattuma. uvechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh mayre, desheni ose shelishi bahen. deillu bechullin gereda, afillu hayu muchsharin bedam en sheni ose shelishi bechullin:
Lefi shello huchsheru vedam. sheen ochel mekabbel tuma ad sheyyavo alav mayim o echad mishshiva mashkin, shehem mayim yayin shemen chalav udevash dam tal:
Huchsheru vashshechita. miggo desharya shechita lehach basar mide evar min hachay, meshavveya leh nammi ochla legabbe tuma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto umet choletzet velo mityabbemet. sheyyesh aleha zikkat shene yevamin, shebbeviato shel ze hakkatan shehu kemaamar begadol lo yatzat mide zikkat nefila rishona, vechala aleha zikkat nefila sheniyya, utenan beferek arbaa achim, mi shealeha zikkat yavam echad velo shealeha zikkat shene yevamin:
Nasa ishsha. sheenah yevimto, umet velo achim:
Hare zo fetura. deaf al gav deviato bia en kinyano kinyan kelum ad sheyyavi shete searot, aval bivama hoil uzekuka lo asu otah rabbanan kemaamar:
Shetayim lefaneha. yotzer or veahava:
Veachat leachareha. emet veyatztziv:
Uvaerev. mevarech:
Shetayim lefaneha. maariv aravim veahavat olam:
Ushetayim leachareha. emet veemuna vehashekivenu:

Achat arukka veachat ketzara. ashshetayim shellefaneha kae, yotzer or arukka sheppotachat bevaruch vechotemet bevaruch, vechen maariv aravim. ahava ketzara, shechotemet bevaruch veenah potachat bevaruch:
Lachtom. bevaruch:
Shello lachtom. kegon birkat happerot uvirkat hammitzvot:
Yesh muttarot. kohen hedyot shennasa almana. vehu haddin betula, shehare keshemmet naaset almana. venakat almana mishshum devae lemitne sefa kohen gadol shennasa almana:

Meen shemone esre. it dimfarshe baggemara sheomer mikkol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot bekotzer vechotem al kol achat veachat. veit deamre, havinenu Adonai‏ elohenu ladaat darkecha, shehi beracha achat sheyyesh bah meen kol habberachot haemtzaiyyot shel shemone esre, vechotem baruch atta Adonai‏ shomea tefilla:

Shegura befiv. shehu lamud veragil bah. vahalacha kerabbi akiva, shemmi sheen tefillato shegura befiv, o bishat haddechak, mitpallel adam shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot vahavinenu baemtza shehi meen kol haemtzaiyyot, chutz mimot haggeshamim sheeno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar sheela bevirkat hashshanim, vechutz mimmotzae shabbatot veyamim tovim shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat:
Lo tochal batteruma. keditnan beferek almana lechohen gadol, haubbar vehayyavam vehaerusin poslin velo maachilin:
Lo tochal bammaaser. kullah matnitin rabbi meir hi deamar maaser rishon asur lezarim, veenah halacha:

Bat kohen lelevi lo tochal lo vatteruma velo vammaaser. hachi kaamar, en cholkin teruma velo maaser bevet haggeranot lo levat kohen velo levat levi, gezera mishshum gerusha bat yisrael shehi asura leechol bammaaser, veim yechalleku leishsha maaser bevet haggeranot yavou lachlok levat yisrael achar shennitgarsha millevi, sheen hakkol yodin shebbishvil baalah hayu mechallekin lah, lefichach gazar rabbi meir shello tachalok ishsha bevet haggeranot afillu bat kohen uvat levi. veha ditnan bat levi hammeoreset lechohen vechulei‏ lo tochal lo batteruma velo vammaaser, hu haddin afillu nesua, umishshum resha detane bat yisrael hammeoreset lechohen dehatam davka meoreset sheim hayta nesua tochal, tana nammi bassefa gabbe bat levi meoreset:
Ma makom. kelomar ma tivah:
Shello teera takkala. shello yavo michshol al yadi, kedimfaresh babberayta shello ekkashel bidvar halacha veyismechu chaveray, hare raa shettavo al yadi sheegrom lahem sheyyeanshu:

Ani noten hodaya al chelki. mode al hattova shechalak li shessam chelki miyyoshve vet hammidrash. ushete tefillot hallalu bichnisato levet hammidrash uvitziato chova al kol ish vaish leamran, dehachi amrinan babberayta, bichnisato ma hu omer uvitziato mahu omer, mashma dechova lememrinhu:
Achuzat haddam. sheachazah dam vechalta:
Vehameushshenet. shennichnas ashan begufah:

Vehametzunnenet. choli mechamat tzinna. verambam peresh achuzat haddam sheggavar aleha haddam, vehameushshenet sheggavra aleha hallecha hashshechora, vehametzunnenet sheggavra aleha hallecha hallevana. velo hizkir hallecha harviit shehi haadumma, lefi sheenah metzuya kol kach babbehemot:
Haredufni. sam hammavet divhema. vechen tzoat hattarnegolim, habbehemot haochlot mimmenna metot:
Mayim haraim. mayim megullim:
Sam hammavet. davar shehu sam hammavet laadam veeno sam hammavet labbehema:
Rabbi yose omer lo yatza. dichtiv shema, hashema leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha. vetanna kamma savar, shema bechol lashon sheatta shomea. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Velo dikdek beotiyyoteha. lehotzian bisfatav yafe, bishte tevot shehatteva hashsheniyya matchelet baot shehatteva harishona nigmeret, kegon al levavecha, esev besadcha, vaavadtem mehera, im eno noten revach benehem lehaferidam nimtza kore otam shete otiyyot keot achat:

Rabbi yose omer yatza. vahalacha kerabbi yose. mihu lechattechilla tzarich ledakdek beotiyyoteha, vechen yizzaher shello yaniach hannad velo yanid hannach velo yerappe hechazak velo yechazzek harafe, vetzarich lehattiz zayin shel tizkeru shello yehe nire keomer tiskeru besin, kelomar kede shettarbu sachar, shehare en rauy leshammesh et harav al menat lekabbel peras:
Hakkore lemafrea. hikdim pasuk shelishi lesheni vesheni lerishon vechayyotze vaze:

Lo yatza. dichtiv vehayu haddevarim bahavayatan yihyu, kelomar kemo shehen sedurin battora. umihu im hikdim parashat vayyomer lefarashat vehaya im shamoa, ufarashat vehaya im shamoa lishma, nire deen ze chashuv lemafrea veyatza, shehare enan sedurot zo leachar zo battora:

Yachazor lemakom shettaa. im ben perek leferek taa, sheeno yodea beeze perek hifsik ulerosh eze perek yachazor, chozer lehefsek rishon shehu vehaya im shamoa. veharambam omer shehu veahavta et Adonai‏, veim beemtza happerek pasak, sheyyodea happerek sheppasak bo, aval eno yodea beeze makom meoto perek pasak, chozer lerosh oto happerek. haya kore uchetavtam, veeno yodea im hu beuchetavtam shel shema o beuchetavtam shel vehaya im shamoa, chozer leuchetavtam shel shema, veim nistappek leachar shehitchil lemaan yirbu, eno chozer, sheal hergel leshono hu holech:

Lo kol harotze littol et hashshem yittol. im lo huchzak chacham ufarush bishar devarim en [ze] ella gaava shemmare beatzmo sheyyachol lechavven libbo, veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. vechazinan liktzat merabbotenu deamre dehaidna kol adam yikra keriat shema ballayla harishon, shekkevan shebbaddorot hallalu en mechavvenim kol kach bishar yamim, im lo yikra belayla rishon mechaze yoter keyohara, shemmare atzmo shehu mechavven bechol shaa ella hasheta mishshum detarid bemitzva:
Met velah mimmennu ven tochal batteruma. dichtiv (Vayikra 22) vilid beto hem yochlu belachmo, kare beh yaachilu. vechol zeman shebbenah kayyam maachilah batteruma:
Nisset lelevi. achar sheyyalda mikkohen:
Ochelet bammaaser. velo batteruma, veaf al gav deyesh lah ben mikkohen, dehadra haveya lah zara:
Met velah mimmennu ven ochelet bammaaser. bishvil benah millevi, aval lo batteruma bishvil benah mikkohen, shehare yesh lah zera min hazzar:
Hashshochet min hatztzedadim. tzidde hatztzavvar:
Shechitato cheshera. vaafillu lechattechilla nammi. veayde devae lemitne sefa hammolek min hatztzedadim, tane nammi hashshochet bediavad:
Hammolek min hatztzedadim melikato fesula. devammelika ketiv (Vayikra 5) mimmul arpo, dehaynu meachorav:

Hashshochet min haoref shechitato fesula. vehane mille shello hechezir hassimanim achore haoref ella chatach hammifreket ad shehiggia lassimanim, dekodem shehiggia lassimanim nitrefa bishvirat hammifreket. veaf al gav devimlika keshera, hatam hu dechullah mittechilla vead sof have min hammelika vahave kishar shochet shennokev et havveshet meat meat ad sheggomer shechitato. aval shachat min haoref, kevan dishchita lav hachi gemire, lo have shevirat hammifreket min hashshechita, veitarfa la. vehashshochet min hatztzedadim dekatane resha, afillu bidlo ahdar hassimanim. deha mishshachate simanim shappir kodem chatichat hammifreket:

Hammolek min haoref. lav oref mammash dehaynu ma sheyyesh mishshippuy hakkadkod meachorav kol devahade partzuf, deha ketiv mimmul arpo, ella mul haroe et haoref, dehaynu achore hatztzavvar, malak betzipporen vechatach basar umifreket ad shehiggia lassimanim:
Melikato cheshera. dezo hi mitzvat melikato lechattechilla. veayde detana hashshochet min haoref pesula vaafillu bediavad, tana nammi hammolek bediavad:
Hashshochet min hatztzavvar. tachat haggaron kare tzavvar. vehu derech rov hashshechitot:
Shekkol haoref. kol mul haroe et haoref:

Haishsha. veamru lah met balech. sheamar lah ed echad met baalech venisset al pi ed echad. ulefichach tetze mizze umizze kedin eshet ish shezzinta sheasura labbaal vaasura labboel, delav anusa hi. veaf al gav dehemnuhu rabbanan leed echad beishsha mishshum aguna, taama may, mishshum dehi gufa dayka uminnasva, vehach delo dayka kansinan lah. aval nisset al pi shene edim sheamru lah met baalech, ha amrinan besefa nisset shello al pi bet din kelomar shello hayta tzericha lehetter bet din kevan shehayu shene edim meidin baddavar, mutteret lachazor levaalah harishon, daanusa hi, demay hava lah lemeevad. uvaggemara muchach delet hilchata hachi, ella lo shena nisset al pi bet din beed echad velo shena nisset al pi shene edim, im ba baalah harishon tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah:

Utzericha get mizze umizze. taama devaya get mishsheni, shekkesheroim et harishon chay sevurim sheggershah veal yede chen nesaah sheni veishto gemura hi, veim motziah belo get nimtzet eshet ish yotza belo get:
Velo velaot. shenneevdu, aval belaoteha hakkayyamim lo hifsida:
Vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. im yalda min hashsheni, mamzer gamur. veim hechzirah harishon veyalda, have mamzer middivrehem:
Lo ze vaze zakkain bimtziatah. detaama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levaalah, mishshum eva, hacha tahave lah eva veeva:
Velo vemaase yadeha. detaama may amur rabbanan maase yadeha levaalah, mishshum mezone, vehacha dimzone let lah, maase yadeha lav dileh:
Velo vahafarat nedareha. detaama may baal mefer nidre ishto, ki hechi delo titganne al baalah, hacha titganne vetitganne:
Nifsela min hakkehunna. dezona hi:
Min hammaaser. kenasa hi, devat levi shezzinneta lo nifsela min hammaaser:
Min hatteruma. afillu teruma derabbanan:
Yorshim ketubbatah. ketubbat benin dichrin:
Choltzin velo meyabbemin. achiv shel rishon choletz middeorayta, verabbanan gazur delo leyabbem, veachiv shel sheni choletz midderabbanan ki hechi devaya get mishsheni midderabbanan:
Biatah o chalitzatah. aresha paleg dekatane velo meyabbemin:
Veen havvalad mimmennu mamzer. im hechzirah rishon. velet hilchata lo kerabbi yose velo kerabbi eliezer velo kerabbi shimon:
Nisset shello virshut. bet din, kegon sheamru lah shene edim met baalich, sheenah tzericha lehetter bet din:
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad posel. et hayevama laachin im ba aleha, deviato bia. o im natan get o asa bah maamar, sheyyesh lo get veyesh lo maamar, aval eno get gamur velo maamar gamur:

Ella shehu fosel techilla. baggemara mefaresh divmaamar hu posel techilla velo bassof, sheim achiv haggadol asa maamar veachar kach asa maamar ze shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad lo pesalah meachiv, aval bevia posel ben tesha shanim veyom echad ben battechilla ben bassof. umatnitin chissure michassera vehachi katane, ella hu posel techilla vehen poslin techilla vasof. bamme devarim amurim, bemaamar, aval bia afillu bassof nammi pasil, ketzad, ben tesha shanim veyom echad habba al yevimto vechulei:

Kasher bappara pasul baegla. para adumma veegla arufa shetehen naasin bachutz. ella sheppara adumma bishchita keshera, baarifa pesula. egla arufa, baarifa keshera, bishchita pesula. nimtza hakkasher bappara pasul baegla, vehakkasher baegla pasul bappara:

Kasher bakkohanim pasul balviyyim. kohanim, bemumin pesulim, beshanim kesherim. leviyyim, bemumin kesherim beshanim pesulim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 8) umibben chamishshim shana yashuv mitztzeva haavoda. uveshilo uvevet olamim shello haya sham massa bakkatef, en hashshanim poslim balviyyim ella hakkol bilvad, vehakkol eno fosel bakkohanim leolam. nimtza, ben bammidbar ben beshilo uvevet olamim, hakkasher bakkohanim pasul balviyyim, hakkasher balviyyim pasul bakkohanim:

Tahor bichle cheres tame vechol hakkelim. avir keli cheres tame, sheim higgia tuma laaviro velo naga vo, nitma hakkeli cheres, dichtiv beh (Vayikra 11) asher yippol mehem el tocho. uvegabbo tahor, sheafillu naga tuma begabbo lo nitma bechach. avir kol hakkelim tahor, kol zeman shello naga bahen hattuma af al pi shennitlet baaviran. vegabban tame, sheim naga tuma begabban nitmeu. nimtza, hattahor bichle cheres, tame bechol hakkelim. vetahor bechol hakkelim, tame bichle cheres:

Tahor bichle etz tame vichle mattachot. golme chele etz, dehaynu kelim shello nigmera kol melachtan. aval nigmera chakikatan ureuyin hen letashmishan, temeim. ufeshute chele etz tehorim afillu nigmera kol melachtan, deitkash keli etz lesak, dichtiv (sham) mikkol keli etz o veged o or o sak, ma sak mittaltel male verekan, af keli mittaltel male verekan. golme chele mattachot tehorim, hoil ulechavod asuyin la chashive keli lemilletayhu ad shettiggamer kol melachtan. peshutehen temeim, delo ittakkish lesak kichli etz. nimtza, hattahor bichle etz tame bichle mattachot, hattahor bichle mattachot tame bichle etz:

Hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim. shekedim hammarim, ketannim chayyavin bammaaser, sheddarkan leachlan bekatnan kodem sheyyihyu marim. gedolim peturim, sheenan reuyin laachila. metukim, gedolim chayyavin, shennigmar piryan. ketannim peturin, sheen derech achilatan ken. nimtza, hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim patur bammetukim, vehachayyav bammetukim patur bammarim:

Mitzvat chalitza. vaafillu shelashtan hedyotot. veha dekari lehu dayyanim, shetztzarich sheyyihyu yodim lehakerot happesukim keen dayyanim. veaf al gav ditnan mitzvat chalitza bishlosha, tzerichin letzaref immahen shenayim acherim, shettihye chalitza bachamishsha lefirsume milleta. vehashshenayim hallalu shemmosifim al hashshelosha, afillu en yodim lehakerot:

Minal. shel or rach, chalitzato keshera, aval lechattechilla lo, gezera shemma yachlotz beminal karua millemala, daafillu ki karua metav akkareh hoil vehu rach, vaanan mide demegin bainan veha lekka. aval sandal shehu shel or kashe vechi karua lo metav akkareh, lekka lemigzar shemma yachlotz besandal karua, hilkach ikkar chalitza besandal hi:
Beanpeliot. kemin batte raglayim shel beged:
Chalitzatah pesula. demide demegin bainan, ketiv hacha (Devarim 25) naalo uchetiv hatam (Yechezkel 16) vaenalech tachash, vehu or:
Min haarkubba ulemala chalitzatah pesula. shehayu retzuot hamminal keshurot lemala min haarkubba:
Im lo yada harishona mishshehigdil, rishona choletzet velo mityabbemet. dezikkat shene yevamin aleha hoil velo yedaah mishshehigdil lo yatzat yede nefila rishona:
Rabbi shimon omer meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze. delet leh lerabbi shimon zikkat shene yevamin. vehachi nammi amrinan beferek arbaa achim:

Vecholetz lashsheniyya. deha lav tzarot ninhu leifture chada beyibbum chavertah. veyibbume tarvayhu lo, hoil vehaveya tzaratah bemiktzat maamar derabbanan, mechezu kishte yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad:

Echad ben tesha veechad ben esrim. shenehen shavin lechol haamur lemala, dechol kamma delo ayti shete searot katan hu, ad sheyyihye ben sheloshim vechamesh shana, veim higgia lechamesh usheloshim shana velo hevi shete searot, af al pi shello niru bo simane saris hammeforashim lemala, hare ze seris chamma:
Mutteret lachazor lo. dekiddushe sheniyya enan kelum, uviznut ba aleha. veamrinan baggemara veshachav ish otah (Bamidbar 8), shechivatah osartah veen shechivat achotah osartah:
Umuttar bikrovot hashsheniyya. lissa bittah, dekayma lan nosim al haanusa veal hammefutta:

Rabbi yose omer kol shepposel al yede acherim posel al yede atzmo. rabbi yose shameh letanna kamma dekaamar lo shena deazle ishto vegiso shehu baal achot ishto limdinat hayyam velo shena deazle arusato vegiso, uvau veamru lo meta ishtecha umet gischa, venasa et achotah, veachar kach bau ishto vegiso, eshet giso asura al giso, veishto mutteret lo. veamar lo rabbi yose, arusato vegiso deikka lememar tenaa have bakkiddushin vehay denasiv laachotah shappir kanasiv, uvaaya get minneh delo lemru eshet ish yotzet belo get, defasil lah al yede acherim dehaynu giso, dechevan denafka minneh begitta ifsela lah mibbaalah, posel nammi al yede atzmo veittesra leh itteteh aleh dehavya achot gerushato, aval hecha deazle ishto vegiso limdinat hayyam veka nasiv lah laachotah, delekka lememar tenaa hava leh bannissuin veshappir kanasiv lah lehay kidikka lememar beerusin, velo baya get minneh velo kafasil al yede acherim, deha lo pasla eshet giso aggiso, eno posel al yede atzmo, vesharya leh itteteh shehare enah achot gerushato:
Lehatechil veligmor. parasha achat shel keriat shema:
Lashshura. shehayu osim shurot shurot seviv haavel lenachamo beshuvam min hakkever:
Veim lav. shehaya hadderech karov min hakkever ad hammakom shebbo osim hashshura, veen penay lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggiu lashshura:
Happenimim. haroim haavelim:
Vehachitzonim. sheenam roim pene haavelim:

Nikkeva haggargeret. belo chesron issar kedimfaresh. veim nikkeva nekavim harebe mefullashim veen bahen chissaron, roin im kesheyyitztarfu yesh bechullan shiur rov gargeret, terefa, veim yesh beotan nekavim chissaron o shechasru mimmennu retzuot arukkot, roin im kesheyyitztaref kol ma shechaser yaale yoter mishshiur issar, terefa, veim keissar o pachot, keshera. vechen halacha:
O shennisdeka. vehu sheyyishtayyer bah bakkane lemala ulematta kol shehu:
Nifchata haggulgolet. haetzem nifchat veroim anu shello nikkav kerum shel moach:
Nittela hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna chazzayit. vehu sheyyihye kazzayit bimkom mara vechazzayit bimkom shehi meura:

Ze letoch ze. shessemuchin hen vedafnan shel shenehem adukim ze laze uveemtzaitan hen shofchin ze laze. veim chazru venikkevu bimkom adikat dafnotehem veen hannekev nire lachutz ella ze letoch ze, keshera, deha lahadade nammi shafche:
Nittal hattechol. lo shanu ella nittal, aval nikkav bimkom avyo velo nishtayyer bo koovi dinar zahav, terefa, kedimfarshinan leel:

Nittelu hakkelayot. ben shennittelu shetehen ben shennittela achat mehen, keshera. velo shanu ella nittelu, aval hakkulya shehiktina mechamat choli, baddakka ad kefol, baggassa ad kaanava benonit, terefa. veim melea mayim seruchim, terefa. mayim zakkim, keshera:

Nittal lechi hattachton. meal habbasar vehassimanim mechubbarin babbasar. velo shanu ella sheyyechola lichyot al yede haleata, sheshshofchim hammaachol letoch piha. aval enah yechola lichyot al yede haleata, terefa:
Nittela haem. hi harechem, 349 belaaz, shehaubbar munnach bah:

Vacharuta vide shamayim. shetztzamka harea shellah veyavsha kachariyyot shel dekel mikkol raam (uvarak) [ureiyyat barak], keshera. uvide adam, kegon shehivitah adam o shear kol habberiyyot kegon shaagat arye vekol shachal, terefa. vehechi yadinan im bide shamayim ucheshera im bide adam uterefa. bakkayitz mevi kele cheres levanim umemallean mayim karim umanniach harea betocham meet leet, i hadra bari, bide shamayim hi ucheshera, vei lo hadra bari, bide adam hi uterefa. uvachoref mevi keli cheres shachor, sheeno mazzia kemo hallavan veen hammayim mitztannenim bo. veyesh mefarshim shemmevi kele nechoshet, umemallean mayim poshrim umanniach harea betochan meet leet, i hadra bari keshera, veim lav, terefa:

Haggeluda. shehufshat orah mealeha. im nishar bah or kerochav sela al pene hashshidra chullah, shennimtzeu chulyot hashshidra kullan mechuppim, hare zo cheshera. veim nifshat mimmennu rochav sela al pene chol hashshidra, af al pi shekkol shear orah kayyam, terefa. vechen pesak halacha:

Nidbach. shura shel binyan avanim, kemo nidbachin di even gelal beezra (perek 6), veaf al gav demistefe dilma nafle velo matzu mechavvene, lo hitzrichum chachamim laredet, dikriat shema lo vae kavvana ella pasuk rishon bilvad:
Ma sheenan rashshain laasot ken batfilla. ditzlota rachame hi uvae kavvana, hilkach yordin lematta umitpallelin:

Meematay korin. mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasin leechol bitrumatan. kohanim shennitmeu vetavlu, en yecholim leechol bitruma ad sheyyaariv shimshan, dehaynu tzet hakkochavim. veha delo tane mishsheat tzet hakkochavim, milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, sheim nitmeu hakkohanim betuma shettohoratan teluya bekarban kegon zav umetzora, en hakkappara meakkavtan milleechol bitruma, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkadashim, biat shimsho meakkavto milleechol bitruma, veen kapparato meakkavto milleechol bitruma vechulei‏:

Ad sof haashmura harishona. shelish harishon shel layla, shehallayla nechlak leshalosh mishmarot. umishsham veelach lo mikre tu zeman keriat shema dishchiva, velo karena veh beshachbecha. umikkamme tzet hakkochavim nammi yemama hu velav zeman shechiva. vehammakdimim vekorim keriat shema shel arvit mibbeod yom, somchim aha derabbi yehuda deamar lekamman beferek tefillat hashshachar, tefillat hammincha ad pelag hammincha, shehu shaa urevia kodem hallayla. vekayma lan deavad kerabbi yehuda avad. umiyyad keshekkala zeman hammincha matchil zeman keriat shema shel arvit:

Ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. dechol hallayla mikre zeman shechiva. vahalacha kerabban gamliel, sheggam chachamim modim lo, velo amru ad chatzot ella kede leharechik et haadam min haavera. umihu lechattechilla mishshehiggia onat keriat shema shel arvit dematnitin dehaynu mitztzet hakkochavim, asur lisod vechol shekken lishon, ad sheyyikra keriat shema veyitpallel:

Maase shebbau vanav mibbet hammishte. bene rabban gamliel shaminhu lerabbanan deamre ad chatzot, vehachi kaamre leh, ha diflige rabbanan alach, davka kaamre ad chatzot vetu lo, veyachid verabbim halacha kerabbim, o dilma rabbanan kevatach sevira lehu, vehay dekaamre ad chatzot, kede leharechik et haadam min haavera. veamar lehu, rabbanan kevati sevira lehu, vehay dekaamre ad chatzot kede leharechik et haadam min haavera, vechayyavim attem likrot:
Velo zo bilvad. kullah milleta derabban gamliel hi deamar levanav:
Hekter chalavim. shel karbanot:
Veevarim. shel olat tamid shel ben haarbayim shennizrak damo bayyom, mitzva lehaalot hannetachim kol hallayla, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) hi haola al mokdah al hammizbeach kol hallayla ad habboker:
Vechol hanneechalin leyom echad. kegon toda vechattat veasham vechayyotze vahem shehem neechalim leyom valayla, zeman achilatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar, vehu hammevi lide notar:

Im ken lamma amru chachamim ad chatzot. bikriat shema uvaachilat kadashim, aval behekter chalavim veevarim lo amru vo chachamim ad chatzot kelal, velo nakat leh hacha ella lehodia shekkol davar shemmitzvato ballayla kasher kol hallayla:
Kede leharechik et haadam min haavera. shello yavo leachlan achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar veyitchayyev karet, vechen bikriat shema shello yomar adayin yesh li shahut vetaavor onatah:
Hattemed ad shello hechemitz. ad hasheta ayre betarte mille vedavar hannoheg baze eno noheg baze, vehasheta ayre bachada milleta uvizman sheddavar ze noheg bah en davar ze noheg bah:

Temed. mayim shennotnim al hachartzannim vehazzaggim ucheshemmachmitz vetoses naase yayin, o al hashshemarim vekoltim otan hammayim taam hayyayin. uvizman shennatan shelosha chalakim mayim vehotzi arbaa, lechulle alma yayin maalya hu. vehacha mayre kegon shello hotzi ella kemo shennatan, o pachot o meat yoter:

Ad shello hechemitz. mayim bealma hu veeno nikkach bechesef maaser. deyayin huzkar bekichat kesef maaser (Devarim 14) venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha vegomer, ma happerat meforash peri mipperi vegiddule karka, af kol peri mipperi vegiddule karka:
Ufosel et hammikve. dishlosha luggin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve im nafal letocho kodem hameshachat arbaim sea, veyayin eno fosel et hammikve ella beshinnuy mare:
Mishshehechemitz. chashuv yayin. venoheg bo kichat maaser, veen noheg bo pesul mikve:
Haachin hashshuttafin. haachin shehen shuttafin birushshatan:

Keshechayyavim bakkalbon peturin mimmasar behema. haachin shechalku velivsof nishtattefu, chayyavim bakkalbon, ucheshemmeviin shiklehen meviin shene chatzae shekalim venotnim shene kalbonot. vehakkalbon hu leshon hechrea, shechayyavin lehacheria shiklehen. veim natnu ben shenehem shekel shalem notnim shene kalbonot, shehaya lahen lishkol lachatzain. ufeturim mimmasar behema mikkol hannoladim lahem kol yeme shuttafut, shehashshuttafut patur mimmasar behema, kidita bivchorot beferek batra [daf 57], yihye lach, velo shel shuttafut. vehatam mokim leh lehay kera bammaaser, veaf al gav devabbechor ketiv:

Ucheshechayyavin bemasar behema. kegon im lo chalku meolam chayyavin bemasar behema, leasser kol hannoladim lahem kol yeme shuttefutam. deamar hatam, yachol afillu kanu bitfusat habbayit, talmud lomar yihye, mikkol makom:

Ufeturin min hakkalbon. legamre. sheshshoklin ben shenehem shekel shalem. shemmamon avihem bechezkato omed, vehaav hashshokel al banav o al echad mibbene iro ufoter beshello, patur min hakkalbon, ditnan bishkalim [p] hashshokel bishvil heani o bishvil shecheno o bishvil ben iro patur, uvanav nammi en mitzvat shiklehem alav vahavu lehu kishcheno uven iro:
Kol makom sheyyesh mecher. sheadam yachol limkor et bitto. dehaynu keshehi ketanna:
En kenas. im neensa o nitpatteta en leaviha chamishshim kesef. denaara ketiv, (Devarim 22) venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef:
Vechol makom sheyyesh kenas. dehaynu keshehi naara:

En mecher. sheen adam mocher et bitto leachar shehevia simane naarut. umatnitin rabbi meir hi, deamar ketanna mibbat yom echad ad shettavi shete searot yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas. mishshettavi shete searot ad shettibbager yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher. aval chachamim omrim, ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad ad shettavi shete searot, yesh lah mecher veyesh lah kenas. vahalacha kachachamim. venimtza shehabbat miyyom shennolda ad shetterae levia yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas. umishshetterae levia ad shettavi simanin, yesh lah mecher veyesh lah kenas. umishshettavi simanin ad shettibbager, yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher. veen ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim:

Kol makom sheyyesh meun. yetoma shehissiuha immah veacheha vaafillu ledatah, yechola lemaen veyotza belo get, ad shettavi simanin. vechol yeme katnutah enah reuya lachalitza im yevama hi, deish ketiv bapparasha (sham 25) veim lo yachpotz haish, umakshinan ishsha leish. umishshenniret lachalitza enah yechola lemaen:
Kol makom sheyyesh tekia. bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim tokim shalosh tekiot lehavetil et haam mimmelacha, uven hashshemashot tokea umeria vetokea veshovet:
En havedala. lo al hakkos velo vattefilla. sheen havedala ella bemotzae shabbatot veyamim tovim:
Yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat tokim. af al pi sheggam hayyom yom tov haya veen bo melacha, tokin lehavetil mimmelechet ochel nefesh:
Velo mavdilin. mippene shehannichnas chamur min hayyotze:
Chal lihyot bemotzae shabbat mavdilin. lefi shehayyotze chamur min hannichnas. utekia en kan:
Ketzad mavdilin. ben shabbat leyom tov keshechal yom tov lihyot bemotzae shabbat:
Rabbi dosa omer ben kodesh chamur. veen halacha kerabbi dosa, delo mezalzelinan beyom tov likroto kodesh hakkal:
Ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv lo yafsik. dichtiv vaAdonai‏ elohim emet (yirmeya 10), hilkach en mafsikin ben ani Adonai‏ elohechem leemet. vechen halacha:
Vehaya im shamoa noheg ben bayyom ben ballayla. dichtiv beh (Devarim 11) velimmadtem otam et benechem, vetalmud tora noheg ben bayyom uven ballayla:
Vayyomer eno noheg ella bayyom. deit beh parashat tzitzit sheenah noheget ballayla, dichtiv (Bamidbar 15) ureitem oto:
Haose tefillato keva. shettefillato doma alav kemasseoy. uleshon keva, sheomer chok kavua alay lehitpallel vetzarich ani latzet mimmenna:
Mitpallel tefilla ketzara. uma hi tefilla ketzara, sheomer hosha Adonai‏ et ammecha vegomer:

Bechol parashat haibbur. afillu beshaa shehem porshim laavera, yihyu tzarchehem geluyim lefanecha lerachem alehem. parashat leshon perisha, haibbur shel avera. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua, ella hattefilla shemmitpallelim bimkom sakkana hi tzarche ammecha merubbim vechulei. umitpallel otah adam keshehu mehallech. veeno mitpallel lo shalosh rishonot velo shalosh acharonot. uchesheyyaavor mekom hassakkana vetityashshev dato tzarich lachazor ulehitpallel tefilla ketiknah im lo avra onatah:
Uvachagavim. zehu siman tohoratam:

Kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim vearba kenafayim veyesh lo karsullayim. hem shene raglayim arukkim levad haarba. vehem samuch letzavvaro mimmaal leraglav lenatter bahem, keshehu rotze likpotz mitchazzek bahem:
Rabbi yose omer ushemo chagav. af al pi sheyyesh bo arbaa simanim hallalu eno chasher, ella im ken yadua sheshshemo chagav. vechen halacha:
Kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekaskaset. afillu en lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman, o sheyyesh lo achshav veatid lehashshiran kesheyyotze min hammayim, muttar:
Usenappirin happoreach bahen. sheshshat bahen al pene hammayim:

Mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim ballelot. parashat tzitzit omrim otah bikriat shema shel arvit, veaf al pi sheen layla zeman tzitzit, dichtiv ureitem oto, perat lichsut layla, omrim otah ballayla mippene yetziat mitzrayim shebbah:
Keven shivim shana. hayiti nire zaken. velo zaken mammash ella shehilbinu saarotav yom shemminnu oto nasi kede sheyyerae zaken verauy linsiut, veoto hayyom darash ben zoma mikra ze:
Velo zachiti. lo nitztzachti lachachamim. vedome lo bashshas beferek benot kutim (nidda lach:) beha zachinhu rabbi elazar lerabbanan, kelomar nitztzecham:
Besandal shel etz keshera. vehu sheyyihye mechuppe or:
Chaltza vegadol. shehaya hassandal gadol mimmiddat raglo, im yachol lahaloch bo chalitzato keshera:
O vekatan. mimmiddat raglo, im chofe et rov raglo chalitzato keshera. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer bema shepposel chalitza ballayla, veen halacha kemoto bema shemmachshir chalitza bismol:
Kohen gadol shekkiddesh et haalmana. aval nesaah nitchallela beviato vaasura labbaal velayyavam:
Shenayim ochazin bassakkin veshochatin. behema achat:
Afillu echad lemala veechad lematta. shezze ochez bekatze echad shel sakkin vachavero betziddo hashsheni:
Hittiz et harosh. keadam hammattiz kane o delaat, sheddochek hassakkin bechoach ufosek. vezo hi derasa:
Haya shochet. bimshicha, vehittiz harosh bahavaa bilvad o veholacha bilvad. velishchitat hassimanim shiur hakkasher, kare hittiz et harosh:
Im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar. chutz letzavvar habbehema vehaof sheshshochet:

Keshera. sheyyesh bassakkin kede lishchot bimshicha belo derasa. aval im en orech hassakkin ella koovi hatztzavvar o chutz latztzavvar mashshehu, derasa hi, sheen hassimanim nechtachin bimshicha zo levaddah belo derasa:
