Im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar echad. chutz lishne hatztzavvarim, dehaynu shiur shelosha tzavvarim:

Izmel. taar dak katan meod. velo gazrinan izmel sheen lo karnayim attu izmel sheyyesh lo karnayim. veizmel sheyyesh lo karnayim hu shergilim laasot kemin karnayim laizmel lenoy al gabbav venotim letzad rosho. umittoch shehu katan meod hu nishmat min hatztzavvar, ucheshehu molich umevi yesh lachush shemma yachalidu hassimanim otan hakkarnayim:

Nafla sakkin veshachata. taama denafla, ha hippilah hu, keshera. veaf al gav delo ikkavven lishchot, delo vainan kavvana bishchita, middeitzterich kera lememar gabbe kadashim lirtzonchem tizbachu, ledatechem zevochu kelomar middaat vechavvana, shema minna divchullin lo vainan kavvana:
Nafla sakkin vehigbihah. veshaha behagebaha zo:
Kelav. begadav:
O shehishchiz et hassakkin. kodem shechita:
Veaf. naasa ayef veyagea mechamat hashechaza, ucheshehitchil lishchot lo haya vo koach ufasak shechitato, uva chavero veshachat:

Kede shechita acheret. kede sheyyishchot rov shenayim bivhema acheret kemotah keshehi revutza, gassa legassa, vedakka ledakka, veof leof. veharambam pasak kedivre haomer kede shechitat behema dakka leof, uvae nammi kede sheyyagbihenna veyarbitzenna. velo nahagu chen:
Kede vikkur. keshiur shehattabbach bodek umevakker et sakkino. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ufetura min hakkarban. deyachid sheasa behoraat bet din patur min hakkarban:

Shello al pi vet din. ella bishne edim, chayyevet bakkarban, deshogeget hi. velet hilchata ki ha matnitin, ella ben nisset al pi bet din beed echad ben al pi shene edim, chayyavin bakkarban hi uvaalah hashsheni:

Hashshochet leshem harim vechulei‏ shechitato fesula. vetikrovet avoda zara lo haveya leaser bahanaa, mishshum dechol hane enan naasim avoda zara, dichtiv (Devarim 12) elohehem al heharim, velo heharim elohehem. umihu pesula milleechol, mishshum dedamya lishchita leshem avoda zara umichallefa vah. vedavka sheamar leshem harim leshem gevaot, aval im amar lammalach hammemunne al heharim veal haggevaot, hare zo zivche metim vaasura vahanaa:
Leshem davar kasher. shechita setam:

Hen choltzin velo meyabbemin. leishto shel safek. veechad mibbene harishon choletz shemma ben avihem haya. velo meyabbemin, shemma ben haacharon hu vahare hu achihen min haem velo min haav veishto alehen becharet. vechen bene haacharon. vechen hu choletz linshotehen velo meyabbem:
Hayu lo achim min harishon umin haacharon. shello meotah haem:
Hu o choletz o meyabbem. leeshet ben harishon, im achiv hu hare tov, veim lav, nachrit hi etzlo, uchegon sheen sham ach ella hu, delekka lesappuke bivama lashshuk. vechen leeshet ben haacharon:

Hem echad choletz veechad meyabbem. o ben harishon o ben haacharon choletz lah vachavero meyabbem. im yevimto hi hare tov, veim lav, nachrit hi. umishshum yevama lashshuk lekka lemechash shehare chalatz lah yevamah:
Ochlim batteruma. deechad kohen veechad eved kohen ochlin batteruma:

Vecholkim chelek echad. mefaresh baggemara dehachi kaamar, vecholkim chelek keechad, im bau shenehem al haggoren keechad notnim lahem, aval ze belo ze en cholkin lahem, dekasavar hay tanna en cholkim teruma laeved ella im ken rabbo immo:
Ben kesherot ben pesulot. dechol echad mehem sefek kohen sefek eved, kesherot asurot laeved ufesulot asurot lakkohen, usefek issura lechumra:
En sofgin et haarbaim. dechol chad amar ana lav kohen ana:
En meshallemin. dechol chad amar kohen ana, velo mafkinan mamona missefeka:

Umochrin hatteruma. terumat tevuatan en notnin otah lakkohen keshemmafrishin otah, dechol chad amar ayti reaya delav kohen ana, umikkol makom i efshar lahen leachlah, ella mochrin otah lakkohen vehaddamim shellahen:
Veen cholkim bekadshe hammikdash. kegon orot kadashim, dilchol chad minnayhu amrinan ayti reaya dechohen at ushekol:
Veen notnin lahem kadashim. lehakeriv:
Veen motziin shellahem. kegon im nolad lahem bechor en motziin oto miyyadan, veyire ad sheyyistaev:

Chumre yisrael vechumre chohanim. mefaresh baggemara shemminchatan nikmetzet keminchat yisrael vekarev bifne atzmo, veen sheyareha neechalin keminchat yisrael ella nisrefet keminchat kohanim shehi kalil:
Verabbi eliezer posel. im behemat nachri hi. af al gav deyisrael kashachet lah mehaneya bah machashevet nachri, distam machashavto laavoda zara:
Chatzar kaved. yoteret hakkaved:
Amar rabbi yose kal vachomer. delo mehaneya machashevet bealim, hoil veyisrael shachet lah:
Uma bimkom shemmachashava foselet. dehaynu bemukdashim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 7) hammakriv oto lo yechashev, kare veh lo yachashov, kelomar shello yachashov leachlah chutz lizmanno ki piggul yihye:
En hakkol holech ella achar haoved. dichtiv hammakriv lo yechashev. aval bealim lo fasle bemachashavtan ki makriv lah kohen:

Mekom sheen hammachashava foselet. baggemara mefaresh lematnitin dehachi kaamar, uma bimkom shehammachashava foselet bemukdashim bearba avodot, en hakkol holech ella achar haoved, mekom sheen machashava foselet bechullin ella bishte avodot, eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet. vehachi perushah, bemakom shehammachashava foselet bemukdashim bearba avodot, shechita vekabbalat haddam zerika veholacha, beezo meellu shechashav al menat leechol min hazzevach chutz lizmanno, piggul hu, veaf al pi sheyyesh bah chumra zo en machashava holechet ella achar haoved. chullin leinyan avoda zara sheen machashava foselet bahen bearba avodot ella bishtayim, bishchita uvizrika, dehane hu dichtivan, zoveach laelohim yochoram (Shemot 22), bal assich niskehem middam (tehillim 16), aval kabbala veholacha lo chetiv behu. vehaketara af al gav deshayyecha baavoda zara, mihu lav avoda hi leafsode behema mishshum hekter chelbah laavoda zara hecha delo nishchata velo nizrak damah laavoda zara, deha afillu bifnim lo mippesil karban im chashav al achilat basar bishat hekter chalavim, vechevan shemmatzinu kulla bemachashevet chutz, din hu shennakel baze shello yehe haddavar taluy ella vashshochet. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Haya rochev al hachamor yered. en halacha kistam mishna zo, ella ben yesh lo mi sheyyeechoz chamoro ben en lo mi sheyyeechoz chamoro lo yered, mippene sheen dato meyushshevet alav keshehu yored:
Yachazir et panav. letzad yerushalayim, shenneemar (Melachim 1 8) vehitpallelu elecha derech artzam:
Yechavven et libbo keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim. shenneemar (sham) vehitpallelu elecha el hammakom hazze:
Ben techelet lelavan. ben chute techelet lechute lavan shebbatztzitzit. perush acher, gizat tzemer shetztzivah techelet veyesh bah mekomot shello niklat hatztzeva yafe venishar lavan:
Ben techelet lecharti. tzeva hattechelet karov legaven shel karti kerishin shekkorin porosh belaaz:

Ad shalosh shaot. bayyom, ad sof shaa shelishit shehu revia hayyom bizman shehayyamim vehallelot shavim. uleolam zeman keriat shema hu ad revia hayyom, ben shehayyamim arukkim ben ketzarim. vechen ha ditnan lekamman (perek 4 mishna 1) tefillat hashshachar ad arba shaot bayyom, hayenu ad shelish hayyom, vearba shaot denakat, lefi sheshshelish hayyom hu arba shaot bizman shehayyamim vehallelot shavin. vechol makom shennizkar bammishna kach vechach shaot bayyom, al derech ze atta tzarich lachashov veladun. zo hevanti mipperushe harambam venitkabbel li. vetaama derabbi yehoshua deamar ad shalosh shaot bayyom, shekken derech bene melachim sheen omdin mimmittatan ad sof shaa shelishit. verachamana deamar uvekumecha, ad shaa shekkol bene adam omdim mimmittatan kaamar. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua, umihu lechattechilla tzarich lechavven likrot keriat shema im hanetz hachamma kemo shehayu havvatikim osim:
Lo hifsid. kelomar lo hifsid millevarech lefaneha uleachareha, ella af al pi sheavra onatah kore umevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
Keadam hakkore vattora. af al pi shello yatza yede chovat keriat shema beonata, yesh lo kibbul sachar kekore vattora:

Amru lo meta ishtecha venasa achotah meaviha. shello meimmah, vechazru veamru lo meta hashsheniyya, venasa achotah shel hashsheniyya meimmah velo meaviha, venimtzet zo hashshelishit nachriyya etzel harishona, vechazru veamru lo meta zo hashshelishit, venasa achotah shel shelishit zo meaviha velo meimmah, nimtzet reviit rechoka min hashsheniyya vechol shekken min harishona, vechazru veamru lo meta zot harviit:
Venasa achotah meimmah. vehi rechoka min hashshelishit vechen min harishona umin hashsheniyya, veachar kach amru lo kullan kayyamot:

Muttar barishona, bashshelishit uvachamishit. sheenan kerovot zo lazo. veaf al pi shehashshelishit achot hashsheniyya, sharya, dekiddushe sheniyya lo tafse, daachot ishsha hi larishona shellekachah mikkodem, vehaveya lah kaanusa umefutta, vetanya, anas ishsha muttar lissa bittah, delo asra tora ella achot ishsha bilvad, vehecha delo tafse kiddushin lav achot ishsha hi. vechen hachamishit af al pi shehi achot harviit, mutteret, dehoil vetafse kiddushin bashshelishit nimtzet biat reviit shehi achot shelishit biat zenut velo neesra chamishit alav:
Ufotrot tzarotehen. im met uva yavam veyibbem achat mehen, poteret tzaratah:
Veasur bashsheniyya. mippene harishona. uvarviit mippene hashshelishit:
Veim ba al hashsheniyya leachar mitat harishona. sheemet hayu haddevarim shel rishona, ushear haddevarim sheker hayu, asur bashshelishit mippene hashsheniyya uvachamishit mippene harviit:

Nashim vaavadim peturim mikkeriat shema. af al pi shehi mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama, vechol mitzvot ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot, salka datach amena lechayyevan hoil veit bah malchut shamayim, ka mashma lan. utefillin mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hen, delayla veshabbat lav zeman tefillin ninhu, vesalka datach amena hoil veitkash tefillin limzuza, nashim nitchayyevu, ka mashma lan:

Ketannim. afillu katan shehiggia lechinnuch lo hittilu al aviv lechannecho bikriat shema, lefi sheeno matzuy tamid etzlo beonat keriat shema. velo vitfillin, mishshum distam katan eno yodea lishmor tefillav shello yafiach bahen:
Vechayyavin bitfilla. ditfilla rachame hi, umidderabbanan hi, vetikkenuha af lenashim ulechannech bah hakketannim:

Uvimzuza. demahu detema hoil veitkash letalmud tora, ki hechi denashim peturot mittalmud tora dichtiv (Devarim 11) velimmadtem otam et benechem, velo et benotechem, hachi nammi nifteru mimmezuza af al pi shehi mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama, ka mashma lan:

Uvevirkat hammazon. mibbaya lan i chayyavot bevirkat hammazon middeorayta kevan dichtiv (sham 8) veachalta vesavata uverachta, haveya leh mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama, o shemma en chayyavot middeorayta mishshum dichtiv (sham) al haaretz hattova asher natan lach, vehaaretz lo nittena linkevot. velo ifshita:
Hashshochet mittoch hattabbaat. battabbaat haggedola shehi elyona lechullan kaamar:
Veshiyyer bah melo hachut al pene chullah. letzad harosh. shello hitta lassakkin latzet min hattabbaat letzad harosh ad sheggamar kol hattabbaat kullah, keshera:

Melo hachut. kelomar kol dehu. aval im kodem sheggamar et kullah higrim et hassakkin letzad harosh. veyatza min hattabbaat vegamar et hashshechita lemala min hattabbaat sheeno mekom shechita, shehi hagerama, af al pi shennishchat rov hakkane bimkom shechita, pasle rabbanan, hoil ugemaro bifsul:

Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer melo hachut al pene rubbah. im shiyyer bah melo chut hassaara min hattabbaat letzad harosh al pene rov hattabbaat, kelomar shechatach rov hakkane betoch hattabbaat uvemiutah higrim veyatza mimmenna letzad harosh vegamar hashshechita lemala mimmenna, keshera, divrubba itkashshera la shechita, veidach ki ka shachet mechattech basar bealma hu. ufesak halacha, hashshochet lemala mittabbaat haggedola, mishshippuy kova ulemala, terefa. mishshippuy kova ulematta, kasher. vehayenu deshiyyer bechitte, sheshshachat beotan shene chittin shel basar shehen lemala mittabbaat haggedola ulematta mishshippuy kova, veshiyyer bahen kol shehu letzad harosh:

Hashshochet echad baof. mishshum dilchattechilla mibbae lishchot shene simanin afillu vaof, tana hashshochet, demashma deechad baof diavad in lechattechilla lo. aval shenayim babbehema lechattechilla have, dead kamma lishchot velezil. i nammi, mishshum devae lemitne rubbo shel echad kamohu dedavka diavad, dilchattechilla tzarich sheyyitkavven lishchot kol hassiman kullo. veechad baof nafka lan dechasher, mikkera dichtiv (Vayikra 11) zot torat habbehema vehaof vechol nefesh hachayya haromeset bammayim, hittilo hakkatuv laof ben behema laddagim, lechayyevo bishne simanin i efshar shekkevar hukkash laddagim, lefatro belo chelum i efshar shekkevar hukkash labbehema, ha ketzad, hechshero besiman echad. ushechita min hatztzavvar uvishne simanim. vachamishsha devarim happoslim et hashshechita, shehiyya derasa chalada hagerama veikkur, kullehu gemara gemire la. detanya, vezavachta kaasher tzivviticha, melammed shennitztavva moshe beal pe al hilchot shechita, al havveshet veal hakkane veal rov echad baof veal rov shenayim babbehema:

Ad sheyyishchot et havveridim. kemin chutin sheal shene tzidde hakkane. veaof bilvad kae rabbi yehuda, kede lehotzi et damo, hoil vetzolehu kullo keechad. ushechita dekaamar rabbi yehuda lav davka, ella sheyyenakkev havveridin bishat shechita kodem sheyyikrosh haddam, detu lo nafek al yede melicha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Rov echad baof kulei. veaf al gav ditnan beresha rubbo shel echad kamohu, hadar tana hacha rov echad baof vechulei, chad bechullin vechad bekadashim. dei ashmeinan bechullin hava amena chullin hu desagge leh berubba mishshum delav laddam hu tzarich, aval kadashim deladdam hu tzarich lo tisge leh berubba, kamashma lan:
Shennitarvu valdotehen. veyesh lechol achat mehen ben vadday, shello nitarev:

Arbaa choltzin leachat. ben vadday shel kol achat min haarba choletz leachat mehen, dechol achat mesappek lah leeshet ach. uven hachamishit yissaenna mimma nafshach, im eshet achiv hi hare meyabbem lah, veim lav hare chalatz lah yevamah:

Hu ushelosha. ze sheyyibbem choletz laacheret ushelosha immo. vehachamishi meyabbem mimma nafshach. vechozrin hashshenayim hallalu vecholtzin lashshelishit ushenayim immahem vehachamishi meyabbem, vechen kullam:

Arba chalitzot. techilla, lefi sheen echad mehem rashshay leyabbem ad sheyyachletzu lah haarbaa, ki hechi delo lifga bivama lashshuk. vehu haddin dematzu haarbaa lemechlatz lechullehu vehaechad kones et kullan, ella dehachi shappir tefe, dilma lechol chad vechad mitrammi dileh umitkayyema mitzvat yibbum:

Baal keri. ezra tikken shello yikra baal keri battora ben sheraa keri leonso ben lirtzono ad sheyyitbol. velo mippene tuma vetohora sheen divre tora mekabbelin tuma ella kede shello yihyu talmide chachamim metzuyin etzel neshotehen ketarnegolim:
Mehareher. keriat shema belibbo keshehiggia zeman hammikra:
Veeno mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. vaafillu behirhur, kevan divrachot lav deorayta lo atzrechuhu rabbanan:
Veal hammazon mevarech leacharav. dechiyyuva deorayta hu:

Veeno mevarech lefanav. delav chiyyuva deorayta hi. uchevar nifseka hahalacha devitteluha litviluta, uvaale keryin korin keriat shema kedarkan veoskin battora umitpallelin umevarchin kol habberachot veen mearer baddavar:
Hashshochet. chullin bachutz:
Leshem ola. kevan deola baa beneder unedava haroe omer achshav hu makdish veshochatah leola vekadashim bachutz muttarim. hilkach gazzur rabbanan alah ufesula. vechen shelamim [vechulei]:

Asham taluy. ba al safek chiyyuv karet. kegon shete chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman veachal achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, ishto vaachoto immo vammitta uva al achat mehen veen yadua al ezo mehen ba, mevi asham taluy lehagen min hayyissurim ad sheyyivvada lo im chata vadday mevi chattato. umatnitin rabbi eliezer hi deamar [keretot ko.] mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom, shebbechol yom omed bisfek chet velibbo nokfo shemma chatati. venimtza sheddavar hanniddar veniddav hu:
Leshem pesach. ufesach nammi mikkere davar hanniddar veniddav, hoil vehu asuy lehaferisho kol yemot hashshana ulehannicho ad zemanno, amre ka shachet shelamim bachutz veachel lehu:
Verabbi shimon machshir. delo chayesh lemarit haayin:
Asham vadday. kegon asham gezelot, mi shennishba lashsheker al kefirot mamon. vaasham meilot, vaasham shifcha charufa. veal shem sheasham taluy ba al safek, kare lehane asham vadday:
Leshem bechor leshem maaser. meda yade eynashe desheker hu, divchor umaaser kala it lehu umeda yade mikkamme hachi, deillu hahu shata lav bene afroshe ninhu denema hasheta kamakdish lehu:

Ze hakkelal. laatoye im amar hareni shochet leshem olat nazir, shehi fesula. demahu detema lekka lemechash lechurba, demeda yade deha lo nadar, ka mashma lan dememar amre dilma nadar betzina ze sheloshim yom shehu setam nezirut uvishloshim yom lo minkera milleta lishchenav:

Vesheeno niddar veniddav. laatoye olat yoledet, sheim amar leshem olat yoledet beferush, keshera. vaafillu leshem ishsha sheenah chayyevet karban leda. umahu detema hoil veen otah ishsha chayyevet karban leda lo hayta zo ella nedava, ka mashma lan deemur shemma hippila, demappelet en lah kol, venimtza karban ze chova velo nedava, ulefichach shechitato cheshera:
Hikkattah chulda al roshah. shennashcha veshinneha. deillu bayyad, yesh derisa lechulda beofot vechol keneged hechalal mittarfa veh:

Mekom sheose otah terefa. sheyyesh lachush shemma nikkav kerum shel moach. vechetzad hu ose, machnis yado letoch pi haof vedochek etzbao lemala, im hammoach mevatzbetz veyotze beyadua shennikkav hakkerum uterefa:

Nikkav hakkurkevan. vehu sheyyihye hannekev bivsar hakkurkevan uvakkis shebbetocho shehammaachol over bo, dehaynu sheyyihyu nekuvim hakkis vehabbasar ze cheneged ze. aval kurkevan shennikkav vechis shello kayyam, o afillu nikkevu shenehem ze shello cheneged ze, keshera:
Venechmeru vene meeha. kuvvetzu mechamat haur venehefchu maritan. leshon meay chomarmaru:

Yerukkim pesulim. hachi kaamar, evarim sheddarkan lihyot adummim, kegon hallev vehakkaved vehakkurkevan sheddarkan lihyot adummim beavvazin vetarnegolim vetorim uvene yona vechayyotze vahen, im nishtannu venaasu yerukkim mechamat haur, pesulim, veim nisharu adummim kemo shehayu, kesherim. vehu haddin haddakkim sheddarkan lihyot yerukkim, im nishtannu mibberiyyatan venehefchu adummim, pesulim. vechen ofot hammayim shehallev vehakkaved vehakkurkevan shellahem yerukkim, im naflu laur veheedimu, pesulim. shekkol shennishtannu maritan mechamat haur, pesulim. veshiur shinnuy hammare, bemashshehu, kemo shehannekev bemashshehu:
Derasah. adam beraglav:
O shetterafah bakkotel. shehikka vah bakkotel:
O sheritztzetzattah behema. deikka lemechash lehane telata mishshum rissuk evarim. vaadayin mefarkeset:
Im shahata meet leet ushechatah keshera. uvaya bedika kidchatvinan leel gabbe vehema. shekkol terefot shemmanu chachamim babbehema, kenegdan baof. yater alehen haof, ellu hashshenuyin bammishna:
Hamevakkeret hammaksha leled. befeter rechem shellah. muttar lachtoch evar evar keshehu yotze rishon rishon:
Umashlich lakkelavim. dechol kamma delo nafak rubbeh lo kaddish:
Yatza rubbo. keechad, vachatacho:
Hare ze yikkaver. devitziat harov chala kedushsha alav, dekarinan beh asher yivvaled:
Veniftera min habbechora. shehabba acharav eno vechor. ben sheyyatza rishon evar evar uven sheyyatza rov keechad, deha sheni lav peter rechem hu:
Mi shemmeto muttal lefanav. echad min hakkerovim shechayyav lehitabbel alehem, muttal alav lekavro:
Patur mikkeriat shema. mishshum detarid tirda demitzva:
Vechillufehen. shekken derech shemmitchallefin lefi shehakkol rotzim lizkot bammitzva:
Et shellifne hammitta. hammezummanim lenasah keshettaggia hammitta etzlam:
Veet shelleachar hammitta. kelomar ben otam shellifne hammitta uven otam shelleachar hammitta, im hammitta tzericha lahem lesetah, peturim:
Veet sheen lammitta tzorech bahen. kegon haholchim lelauot et hammet lichvodo bilvad, chayyavin:
Ellu vaellu peturim min hattefilla. delav deorayta hi kemo keriat shema. veikka deamre mippene shehi tzericha kavvana yetera:
Lo yafsik. tefillato legamre ella yekatztzer kol beracha uveracha:
Velikrot ad shello tanetz hachamma. shehavvatikin medakdekim al atzman ligmor otah im hanetz hachamma, dichtiv (tehillim av) yiraucha im shamesh:
Yitkasse bammayim. vedavka mayim achurim sheen libbo roe et haerva, aval tzelulim lo:
Bammayim haraim. mayim seruchim:
Beme hammishra. mayim sheshshorin bahem pishtan:
Ad sheyattil letochan mayim. chasure michassera vehachi katane, velo yikra etzel me raglayim ad sheyyitten letochan mayim, veshiur hammayim sheyattil leme raglayim shel paam achat, reviit:
Vechamma yarchik mehem. min hamme raglayim shello hittil letochan mayim, umin hatztzoa:
Arba ammot. vedavka keshehu litzdadim o leacharav aval lefanav marchik kimlo enav:
Yattu. al tziddehem, dichtiv beshachbecha, derech shechiva:
Yaamdu. dichtiv uvekumecha, derech kima:
Kedarko. ben bekima ben bishiva ben bishchiva ben bahalicha:
Keday hayita. rauy hayita lehareg, veim hayita met hayita mitchayyev benafshecha:

Ellu terefot. nikkav havveshet. shene orot yesh lo lavveshet, hachitzon adom vehappenimi lavan. im nikkav ze belo ze, keshera, nikkevu shenehen afillu ze shello cheneged ze, terefa. vechol nekev bemashshehu:

Ufesukat haggargeret. lerachbah berubbah. veenah terefa ad sheyyippasek rov hechalal. voovi hattenuch eno mashlim lerov. vedavka keshennifseka lerachbah hu difsula berubbah, aval learkah shel kane, afillu lo nishtayyer bah ella chulya achat lemala letzad harosh vechulya achat lematta samuch lechanfe rea, keshera, lefi shekkol zeman shehabbehema moshechet tzavvarah yoter hassedek mitmaet veeno nire:

Nikkav kerum shel moach. shene kerumim yesh lammoach, haelyon davuk leetzem haggulgolet, vehashsheni hassamuch lammoach. im nikkav haelyon vehashsheni hassamuch lammoach kayyam, keshera. nikkav hashsheni hassamuch lammoach af al pi shehaelyon kayyam, terefa, veaf al pi shello nikkav haetzem:

Nikkav hallev levet chalalo. shene chalalim yesh lallev, haggadol letzad yemin habbehema, vechalal katan letzad semol. im nikkav hallev bemashshehu vehiggia hannekev leechad mishshene ellu hachalalim, terefa. vechen im nikkav bassechus shebballev heasuy keen biv vehu karuy kene hallev, terefa:
Nishbera hashshidra. chulyot hashshidra:

Venifsak hachut. kemin chut lavan yotze min hammoach veover al pene orech hashshidra chullah, ukerum dak makkif et hachut. veim nifsak rov hekkefo shel kerum ze berachbo, hayenu nifsak hachut uterefa, vaafillu lo nishbera hashshidra, ella orcha demilleta nakat, derov pesikat hachut al yede shevirat hashshidra hu:

Nittal hakkaved velo nishtayyar hemennu chelum. terefa, ad sheyyishtayyer kazzayit bimkom mara vechazzayit bimkom shehi chayya mishsham, dehaynu mekom teliyyatah keshehi meura udevuka tachat hakkelayot. veim nishtayyer bah pachot mishshene zetim bishne mekomot hallalu, o afillu yoter mishshene zetim veshello vishne mekomot hallalu, terefa:

Harea shennikkeva. shene kerumim dakkim yesh larea, nikkav ze belo ze, keshera. nikkevu shenehen veharuach yotze keshennofchim otah, terefa. umittaam rea shennikkeva neesru kol hassirchot shebbarea keshehem bimkom daavide leintoke, lefi sheen sircha belo nekev, sheharea shoevet kol mine mashke vehammashke naase av betochah veyotze meat meat derech hannekev venikpe venaase kerum. ucheshehassirchot bimkom dela avide leintoke, kegon una veuna kesidran, zo meginna al zo vechozeret livriutah veen hannekev mitgalle. aval keshehem bimkom daavide leintoke, hakkerum mitparek vehannekev mitgalle:

O shechasra. kegon shechasra achat mechamesh unot sheyyesh larea. veim nechsera achat mishshelosh haunot shel tzad yamin, yesh omrim shehaanunita mashlemet ucheshera. veim chasra haanunita atzmah, yesh machshirin, deen ze chissaron, sheharebe vehemot en lahem anunita. kach muchach baggemara:

Ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot. kenoknot ketannot hammitpashshetot betoch harea kullan shofchin lassimpon haggadol. ulevet hassimponot ditnan, kelomar lassimpon haggadol shekkol hassimponot shofchim lo. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Nikkeva hakkeva. nekev mefullash letoch chalalah bechol shehu:
Nikkeva hammara. hakkis shellah, limkom sheen hakkaved sotamtah:
Nikkevu haddakkin. bene meayim, limkom sheen dakkim acherim samuch lannekev lehagen alav. aval hadera dechanta deinkiv lechavreh, chavreh magen aleh:

Keres happenimi. kol hakkeres kullo karuy keres penimi, unekuvato bemashshehu. keres hachitzona, basar hachofe et rov hakkeres vehu kerum av over al kol hechalal min hechaze vead hayerechayim. vehakkeres miuto nechba tachat tzalot hechaze. verubbo tachat oto kerum. venikra berubbo dekaamar, hayenu sheroim kamma yesh min hakkerum keneged oto rov hakkeres, veim nikra sham rov ma sheyyesh min hakkerum keneged hakkeres, terefa. veim mimmekom shehakkeres kale ulematta nikra oto kerum, keshera:
Haggedola tefach. beshor gadol im nikra tefach, terefa, af al gav delo have rubbah. uveegel katan mittarfa berubbah, af al gav delo have tefach. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hameses uvet hakkosot. sof hakkeres asuy kechova vekaruy bet hakkosot, vehameses mechubbar bo, vesaviv lechibburan keshebbaim lehavedilan yesh dofen laze vedofen laze, uvaemtza hen shofchin ze letoch ze, vehammaachol nichnas mibbet hakkosot lahameses umin hameses lakkeva umehakkeva laddakkin:

Shennikkevu lachutz. shehannekev nire mibbachutz, kegon shennikkevu o ze o ze shello vimkom chibburan, laafoke im nikkevu vimkom chibburan dechasher, lefi sheddofen hameses magen al nikve vet hakkosot, vedofen bet hakkosot magen al nikve hameses:

Nafla min haggag. ushechatah miyyad, terefa, im lo halcha veragleha achar nefilatah. dechayshinan shemma nitrasseku evareha. veim halcha melo komatah, keshera veenah tzericha bedika. veim amda velo halcha ushechatah, tzericha bedika. vechen im shahata meet leet achar shennafla ushechatah, af al pi shello halcha velo amda, keshera utzericha bedika. uvedika zo bachalal hagguf bifnim lirot im nitrasseku evareha. uvet harechem vechen hassimanim en bahem mishshum rissuk evarim:

Nishtabberu rov tzaloteha. esrim ushetayim tzelaot gedolot sheyyesh bahen moach yesh labbehema, achat esre mikkan veachat esre mikkan. nishtabberu shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan, o achat esre mikkan veachat mikkan, zehu nishtabberu rov tzaloteha. vehu shennishberu mechetzyan kelappe hashshidra, lefi sheshsham chayyutah, velo mechetzyan letzad hechaze:

Uderusat hazzeev. shemmakke vetzipparnav babbehema umattil bah eres vesorfah. veen derisa ella bayyad, aval lo varegel. veen derusa ella middaat. uderusa sheamru, tzericha bedika cheneged bene meayim, uchegon safek derasah o sheraa shedderasah veen mekom hadderisa nikkar mibbachutz, tzericha bedika gabbah ucheresah vetziddeha vechol shekkeneged bene meayim. veim heedim sham basar, terefa. veim vadday derusa hi, bodek keneged mekom hadderisa veroe im heedim habbasar, terefa, veim lav, keshera:
Derusat hazzeev baddakka. aval baggassa lo allim zihareh lemikleye:
Uderusat ari baggassa. vechol shekken baddakka. verabbi yehuda leferushe milleteh detanna kamma ate velav leifloge aleh. vahalacha kemoto:
Hannetz. 797 belaaz:
Baof haddak. yonim vetzipporim:
Derusat haggas. 516:
Baof haggas. avvazim vetarnegolim:

Ze hakkelal. laatoye shiva mine terefot shello huzkeru bammishna, veellu hen. [1] kulit hayyarech shekkafatz mimmekomo min hachor shebbeetzem haalya shehu tachuv bo, vehu deiakkul niveh. [2] lakta afillu bechulya achat, vechol shekken bishtehen. vehu dematya lakkuta limkom charitz shel kulya. [3] techol shennikkav nekev mefullash bemakom ave shebbo. veim nishtayyer bo koovi dinar zahav, kasher. [4] simanim shenniddaldelu berubban, kelomar shennitleshu bechamma mekomot umechubbarim kan meat vechan meat. [Adonai] nekera tzela meikkarah. dedavka nishtabberu tenan bematnitin devainan rubba, aval nekera tzela achat meikkarah ad chatzi chulyatah, terefa. [6] gulgolet shehukketa makkot rabbot al gulgaltah velo nifchata velo nikkav hakkerum, im rubbah nechbesa dehaynu nitrotztza, terefa. [7] uvasar hachofe et rov hakkeres berubbo, nammi ikka leman deamar detana mayte leh beze hakkelal. velo huzkar beferush bammishna, lefi sheenam mefarshin hakkeres hachitzona sheshshanuy bammishna shehu basar hachofe et rov hakkeres kidfareshna leel. vechen mayte tana beze hakkelal behema shennechtechu ragleha haacharonim min haarkubba ulemala, terefa. vechissaron bashshidra, sheim chasera chulya achat, terefa. ugeluda, shennafal orah vehufsheta chullah, o mechamat shechin o mechamat melacha, terefa. vacharuta, shetztzamka rea shellah venaaset kachariyyot shel dekel mechamat pachad shehivitah adam, dedavka vide shamayim tenan lekamman shehi keshera mishshum dehadra beria, aval lo vide adam. vechol hane terefot rabbinhu tanna beze hakkelal:
Kol sheen kamoha chayya. shellakta makka sheen behema lekuya dugmatah yechola lichyot:

Zav sheraa keri. af al pi shettame tumat shiva mishshum ziva veen tevila zo metaharto, afillu hachi tzarich tevila ledivre tora ketakkanat ezra mishshum keri. vechen nidda im baa lehitpallel ufoletet shichvat zera hare hi kevaal keri. veshichvat zera metamme haishsha biflitato kol shelosha yamim leachar tashmish, uleachar mikkan kevar hisriach begufah veen rauy od lihyot valad notzar mimmennu. vehachi perusho nidda sheppalta atta tashmish sheshshimmesha etmol kodem sheraata vehammeshammeshet mittatah sheraata nidda achar sheshshimmesha tzerichin tevila:

Verabbi yehuda poter. af bimshammeshet sheraata nidda patar rabbi yehuda, veaf al gav demeikara bat tevila havat veikka lememar delo paka chovat tevila minnah. uchevar katavnu leel devitteluha litviluta mippene shehayta takkana sheen rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bah:
Haya echad yisrael. echad min habbealim yisrael veechad kohen:
Hu onen alehem. shemma ze aviv uveyom mitato asur leechol bekadashim:

Vehem onnim alav. uveyom moto asurim shenehem bekadashim. umashkachat lah deroe bemitat shenehen vechohen kasher hu deha eno mittamme lahen, kegon shennitkaddesha kiddushe taut al tenay velo nitkayyem, denafka minneh belo gitta, venisset toch shelosha, uvichhay gavna mashkachat le deroe bemitat shenehem vechohen kasher hu, lefichach eno mittamme lahen:
Hu lo yoresh otan. deyorshin madchin oto ellu etzel ellu:
Vehen yorshin oto. demi meakkev al yadan, vecholkim hammamon ben shenehen:
Veole vemishmaro. laavod, veen bene mishmar meakkevin alav. aval eno cholek, dechol bene mishmar dachu leh gabbe chavreh:
Hashshochet et hamesukkenet. kol shemmaamidim otah veenah omedet mechamat chalyah, haveya mesukkenet. vaafillu yesh lah koach beshinneha leechol korot uvekaiyyot shel etz:
Ad shettefarkes. dei lo firkesa chayshinan shemma nittela nishmatah kodem gemar shechita:
Im zinneka. kederech shehabbehemot nofchot bigronam vehaddam mekalleach umezannek bechoach:

Hashshochet ballayla. behema mesukkenet shetztzericha pirkus, velo yada im pirkesa, ulemachar hishkim umatza katle vet shechitat hatztzavvar meleim dam, keshera, mippene shezzinneka. ucheshitat rabbi eliezer demachshir lah bezinnuk, amarah rabbi shimon. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Echad behema dakka veechad behema gassa. tzericha firkus im hi mesukkenet:
Sheppashta yadah. bigmar shechita:
Velo hechezira pesula. im hayta mesukkenet. lefi sheen ze pirkus ella ken darkah bishat tzet nafshah. aval gassa lav orchah behachi, uven sheppashta velo chaffa ben shekkaffa velo fashta, keshera:
Veachar kach met benech. velo huzkeka leyibbum:
Venisset. lashshuk:
Rishon veacharon. rishon shellifne hashshemua, veacharon shelleachar hashshemua. ucherabbi akiva mittokma deamar yesh mamzer mechayyeve lavin, veenah halacha:

Tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot. shekken tamid shel shachar karev ad chatzot lerabbanan, ulerabbi yehuda eno karev ella ad arba shaot bayyom. vead arba shaot hayenu ad sof shaa reviit shehu shelish hayyom bizman shehayyom shetem esre shaot, vechen zemannah leolam ad sof shelish hayyom lefi orech hayyamim vekatnan kidchatvinan leel gabbe keriat shema. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Tefillat hammincha ad haerev. ad shettechshach:

Ad pelag hammincha. zeman mincha ketanna hu mittesha shaot umechetza ad hallayla, shehem shete shaot umechetza, nimtza pelag hammincha shehu chatzi shiur ze shaa urevia. ufesak hahalacha baze, deavad kemar avad udeavad kemar avad, veharotze laasot kedivre chachamim ulehitpallel tefillat hammincha ad haerev yaase, uvilvad shello yitpallel arvit bizman ze, shekkevan shemmachashiv oto yom leinyan shemmitpallel bo mincha eno yachol lehacheshivo layla ulehitpallel bo arvit. veim ba laasot kedivre rabbi yehuda shello lehitpallel mincha ella ad pelag hammincha shehu shaa urevia kodem hallayla ose umishsham veelach yuchal lehitpallel arvit:

En lah keva. zemannah kol hallayla. veha detane en lah keva velo katane zemannah kol hallayla, leashmeinan ditfillat arvit reshut, lefi shehi keneged hakeravat evarim ufedarim shekkerevim kol hallayla, vahanach reshut ninhu shekkevan shennizrak haddam nirtza hakkarban af al pi shennitmeu evarim ufedarim o sheavdu. umihu haidna kibbeluha alehem kechova:
Veshel musafin kol hayyom. im echarah achar sheva yatza, aval nikra poshea vechen halacha:
Beasda. etzim harebe keshurim umehuddakim yachad, umeshitim otam bannahar uvene adam holchim alehem. uvilshon mikra (divrei hayamim 2 2) keruyin rafsodot:

Bivhema tehora tahor. mikkal vachomer, uma im hoila lo mechitztzat immo lehattiro baachila bishchitatah af al pi shehu met, lo toil lo keshehi chayya letaharo milletamme. uvehema temea menalan, deamar kera (Vayikra 11) vechi yamut min habbehema, zo vehema temea. asher hi lachem leachla, zo vehema tehora. itkash behema temea livhema tehora, ma behema tehora ubbarah tahor, af behema temea ubbarah tahor:

Rabbi yose haggelili omer bitmea tame. umappik leh mikkera dichtiv (sham 5) o nefesh asher tigga bechol davar tame o venivlat chayya temea o venivlat behema temea, vechi nivlat behema temea metammea venivlat behema tehora enah metammea. ella eze, ze ubbar shebbattemea tame, uvattehora tahor mikkal vachomer. uvattemea tame delekka kal vachomer velo darshinan hekkesha. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Hachayya temea tumat shiva. umidrabbanan, gezera shemma yotzi haubbar et rosho chutz lapperozdor vahare hu cheyalud umetamme, vehachayya sevura sheadayin hu bemeeha veate lithure. aval beroe shehoshit yado lime vehema dekatane matnitin tahor, lekka lemigzar hachi, mippene sherechem shel behema galuy vechi mappik chaze leh:
Vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze havvalad. deishsha margeshet beatzmah keshemmotzi rosho chutz lapperozdor velo ate letihure:

Maggal yad. yesh lah shete fiyyot, haachat chalaka kassakkin vehaachat yesh bah pegimot, uvatztzad shehi chalaka en shochatim lechattechilla, gezera shemma yishchot batztzad happagum. ulehachi tana hashshochet demashma diavad in lechattechilla lo. veshaminan meha, desakkin peguma veyesh bah kede lishchot min happegam ulehallan, asur lishchot bah lechattechilla, ella im ken karach happegam beveged o vegemi dehashta lekka lemigzar dilma ate lishchot bimkom happegam:

Betzor uvekane. matnitin mayre betzor uvekane shehayu telushim velivsof chibberan veshachat bahen keshehen mechubbarim, vediavad in lechattechilla lo. aval bimchubbar meikkaro, afillu diavad pasul. vetalush gamur afillu lechattechilla share:
Tzor. sela mechuddad. uleshon mikra hu (Shemot 4), vattikkach tzippora tzor vattichrot:

Hakkol shochatim. laatoye yisrael mumar laavera achat o afillu laaverot harebe, shemmuttar leechol mishshechitato. vehu shello yihye mumar laavoda zara o mechallel shabbatot befarhesya. uvodek yisrael kasher hassakkin venoten lo, mippene shechezkato sheeno toreach livdok, veachar ken shochet afillu beno leven atzmo, vechozer yisrael uvodek sakkino leachar shechita, im hi yafa shechitato cheshera. veellu hatztzedokin sheanu korin lahen karaim, sheenan maaminim battora shebbeal pe, shechitatan pesula, ella im ken yisrael omed veroe hashshechita mittechilla vead sof:

Uleolam shochatim. ben bayyom, ben ballayla leor haavuka, ben berosh haggag, velo chayshinan shemma yomru litzva hashshamayim ala lishchot. vechen shochatim berosh hassefina, demochcha milleta dilnakker sefinato hu tzarich velo lesar hayyam kashachet:

Uvakkol shochatim. ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane shehu esev haggadel baagam shechotech kesakkin. aval bekane atzmo en shochatin bo lechattechilla, mippene nimin shepporshim mimmennu venokvim hassimanim, veate lemebad chalada:
Maggal katzir. shekkotzrim bah hattevua. sheppegimoteha notot kullan letzad echad beshippua:
Megera. sakkin male fegimot, veyesh lechol pegima morsha mikkan umikkan, dehaynu ogrot:
Shinnayim. hattechuvim belechi shel behema. vedavka keshehen shenayim o yoter:
Vehatztzipporen. hamechubberet:
Shehen chonkin. sheen chotchin, ella korin mechamat happegimot. vehay chonkim, ashsheera kae velav atztzipporen, detaama detzipporen mishshum mechubbar hu:
Maggal katzir. rasheha kefufim meod vederech halichatah enah koraat:
Bet shammay omrim nevela. umetammea vemassa. degazrinan holacha attu hovaa. uvet hillel lo gazre, daafushe tuma lo mafshinan mishshum gezera. aval baachila modu daasura, gezera holacha attu hovaa:
Ufasak et haggargeret. hayenu ikkur. uvivhema kae:
Tachat hashsheni. tachat hassiman hashsheni. shehaya tochev hassakkin ben hassiman latztzavvar:
Hechelid. kissa. uleshon chalada, kechulda haddara beikkere habbattim dimchasya:
Ufesako. millematta lemala:
Nevela. umetammea vemassa:
Terefa. veenah metammea:
Vedavar acher garam lah lehippasel. kegon echad min hatterefot hashshenuyot beferek veellu terefot:
Metu hakkesherim. havvaddain:

Echad choletz. techilla, vahadar meyabbem idach, mimma nafshach, i hay dechalatz hu ben hakkalla vechalatz leeshet achiv, ha ishtarya lah behach chalitza veshappir nasiv lah idach shehu ben hazzekena, deeshet ben achiv mutteret lo. vei hay dechalatz hu ben hazzekena veeshet ben achiv chalatz, haveya lah kecholetzet min hannachri, uven hakkalla ki meyabbem lah shappir kamyabbem:
Haddores. haochez betzipparnav umagbiah min hakkarka ma shehu ochel. veyesh sheppershu, sheeno mamtin labbaal chay ad sheyyamut ella ochlo mechayyim:
Etzba yetera. zo etzba haggevoha sheachore haetzbaot:

Vekurkevano niklaf. hakkis shebbetoch hakkurkevan niklaf mibbesar hakkurkevan. velo sheyyihye kol of tahor tzarich lechol hassimanim hallalu, ella siman echad bilvad day, uvilvad shenneda bo sheeno dores veochel. vehaggeonim katvu shemmasoret beyadam sheen machshirim of habba besiman echad veaf al pi sheyyadua lanu bo sheeno dores veochel, ella im ken haya oto siman shekkurkevano niklaf bayyad, aval im eno niklaf bayyad af al pi sheyyesh lo zefek o etzba yetera meolam lo hittiruhu:
Hacholek et raglav. keshemmaamido al hachut noten shete etzbeotav mikkan ushetayim mikkan:
Tame. beyadua shehu dores:
Hacheresh shennechelatz chalitzato fesula. sheeno potrah bemakom sheyyesh ach acher kasher:
Vehachereshet shechaltza fesula. shehi atzmah enah nifteret bachalitzatah, veen lah takkana ella beyibbum, veim ratza achar kach lehotzi yotzi beget:

Vehacholetzet lakkatan chalitzatah pesula. kol hecha detaninan befirkin chalitza pesula, enah yechola lehityabbem achar otah chalitza utzericha chalitza acheret mealyata lehattirah lealma. vehay tanna dekare lachalitzat katan chalitza pesula demashma shepposlah millehityabbem, rabbi meir hi, deillu rabbanan amre en bachalitzat katan kelum velo nifsela millehityabbem. vahalacha kachachamim:
Chaltza velo kara chalitzatah keshera. dechi katav rachamana kacha demashma ikkuva, ammaase hu dichtiv (Devarim 25) kacha yease laish, ukeria dibbur bealma hu:
Davar shehu maase vaish. kegon chalitza shehaishsha osa maase begufo shel ish, laafoke rekika delav maase begufo shel ish hu:

Nikkeva haggargeret o shennisdeka. nekuvat haggargeret usedikatah baof, kinkuvat haggargeret usedikatah babbehema. uchevar perashnu leel. veim nikkeva nekev sheyyesh bah chissaron, im hachissaron have keshiur rov chalal hakkane shel oto haof, terefa, veim lav, keshera:
Hazzefek. hu samuch lavveshet. vechol hannimshach im havveshet keshehaof moshech tzavvaro dino chavveshet unekuvato bemashshehu, ushear hazzefek im nikkav kasher:
Rabbi omer afillu nittal. veen halacha kerabbi:

Yatzu vene meeha. lo shanu ella shebbeshaa shehichnisan letocho lo hafach elyono letachtono, o agulla zo lemala mikkemot shehayta, shehechelif zo lemala vezo lematta. aval hafach bahen, terefa, shekkevan shennehpach echad mehem eno yachol lichyot:

Nishtabberu gappeha. atzmot hakkenafayim. vedavka nishtabberu, aval shemutat gaf baof, terefa, chayshinan shemma nikkeva harea. lefi sheharea nechbet ben hatztzelaot ukerum habbasar rach vedak ben tzela letzela, uchesheshshomet gappah mitnatteket harea im haggaf:
Nishtabberu ragleha. min haarkubba ulematta, o afillu lemala velo yatza haetzem lachutz. aval yatza lachutz, tenan bivhema hammaksha dahave terefa, vesham nefaresh:
Nimretu chenafeha. hayenu notza gedola sheal kol gufah:
Notza. hi haddakka sheal habbasar sheen lah kanim, dachashiv lah kigluda. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Chatan. shennasa betula:

Patur mikkeriat shema layla rishon. mishshum detarid shemma lo yimtzaenna betula. vaani shamati shemmityare shemma yease kerut shafcha bivilato, vetirda demitzva hi, verachamana amar uvelechtecha vadderech, belechet didach hu dimchayyevat, ha demitzva petirat:
Im lo asa maase. im lo baal ad motzae shabbat shehem arbaa lelot, tarid. umishsham veelach libbo gas bah vetu lo tarid, veaf al pi shello asa maase chayyav bikriat shema:
Pasal al yado. dahave leh kemaamar achar maamar, dishnehem tofsin bah:

Rabbi shimon omer lo fasal. deviat ben tesha lerabbi shimon safek kanya safek lo kanya, i kanya kanya legamre velo mahanya biat achiv, vei lo kanya hava leh kemi shello baal lo hu velo achiv, hilkach lo pasal. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Lo choltzin. deachava min haav bainan, vegerim en lahem sheer min haav:
